Since you need to be doing what the smart traders are doing, you need to buy at least a small amount at the market or on a one-or two-tick pullback and risk to the bottom of the spike. Even if the pullback begins on the next tick, the odds are that it won't fall too far before smart bulls see it as value and they buy aggressively. Remember, everyone is waiting to buy a pullback, so when it finally comes it will only be small and not last long. All of those traders who have been waiting to buy will see this as the opportunity that they wanted. The result is that your position will once again be profitable very soon. Once the market goes high enough, you can look to take partial profits or you can look to buy more on a pullback, which will probably be at a price above your original entry. The important point is that as soon as you decide that buying a pullback is a great idea, you should do exactly what the strong bulls are doing and buy at least a small position at the market.


有些交易者喜欢在市场向上突破前一个摆动高点时买入突破，用买入止损单挂在前高点上方一个最小报价单位处入场。总体而言，在回调时入场，回报更大、风险更小、成功概率也更高。如果交易者买入这类突破，他们通常不得不再扛过一次回调，才能赚到比较可观的利润。买回调通常比买突破更好。例如，与其在市场向第9根K线走高的过程中买在第6根K线上方，不如改为买入第10根K线回调的高点上方，后者的交易者等式可能更强。


> Some traders like to buy breakouts as the market moves above a prior swing high, entering on a buy stop at one tick above the old high. In general, the reward is greater, the risk is smaller, and the probability of success is higher when entering on pullbacks. If traders buy these breakouts, they usually will then have to hold through a pullback before they can make much profit. It is usually better to buy the pullback than the breakout. For example, rather than buying above bar 6 as the market moved up to bar 9, the trader's equation was probably stronger for a buy above the bar 10 pullback instead.


第11根K线突破第9根K线的这波行情也一样。面对每一次突破，交易者都必须判断它会成功还是失败。如果他们相信突破会成功，就会设法买在突破K线或后续行情K线的收盘价、前一根K线低点处及更低的位置，以及前一根K线高点上方。如果他们相信突破会失败，就不会买入；如果已经做多，就会平掉仓位。如果他们相信这次失败后的下跌空间够做一次剥头皮，就可能做空去剥头皮。如果他们判断这次失败会导致趋势反转，就可能考虑做空并持成一段下行波段。就这个具体例子而言，当市场强势突破第9根和第11根K线构成的双顶时，买入突破是合理的；但在第15根K线收盘价买入的交易者，入场价与之相近，手里的交易理由却更站得住脚——他们买的是强劲多头急速行情中一根强劲多头趋势K线的收盘价。


> The same is true for the bar 11 move above bar 9. With every breakout, traders have to decide if it will succeed or fail. If they believe that it will succeed, they will look to buy the close of the breakout or follow-through bars, at and below the low of the prior bar, and above the high of the prior bar. If they believe that it will fail, they will not buy and if they are long, they will exit their positions. If they believe that the failure will trade down far enough for a scalp, they might go short for a scalp. If they think that the failure will lead to a trend reversal, they might look to swing a short down. In this particular case, as the market moved strongly above the bar 9 and bar 11 double top, it was reasonable to buy the breakout, but traders who bought the close of bar 15 entered around the same price and had a more sound reason to take the trade (buying the close of a strong bull trend bar in a strong bull spike).


在任何多头趋势或突破中，如果它看起来还不够强劲、不宜在急速行情顶部附近买入（比如买入最近一根K线的收盘价），那么交易者改为等待买入回调，交易者等式反而更强。第22根K线是从一个 ii形态（内包内包）突破出来的第二根K线，因此也可能是一段末端旗形反转建仓形态的开端。这很可能是一次小级别买入高潮（在第3册论述高潮反转的那一章中有讨论）。此时，买入回调的交易者等式比买第22根K线收盘价更强。第24根K线也一样。随着趋势变得越来越双向，更好的做法是等待买入回调。一旦双向交易足够强、此前的回调也更深、大致持续五根K线以上，交易者就可以开始做空剥头皮，例如第24根K线处那两根K线构成的反转（在其后那根空头K线的低点下方做空）。当市场转入交易区间之后，空头就会开始为了做波段而做空，预期出现更深的回调以及可能到来的趋势反转。


> If any bull trend or breakout that does not look quite strong enough to buy near the top of the spike, like on the close of the most recent bar, the trader's equation is stronger if traders instead wait to buy pullbacks. Bar 22 was the second bar of a breakout from an ii pattern and therefore the beginning of a possible final flag reversal setup. This was likely a minor buy climax (discussed in book 3 in the chapter on climax reversals). At this point, the trader's equation was stronger for buying a pullback than for buying the close of bar 22. The same was true for bar 24. As a trend becomes more two-sided, it is better to look to buy pullbacks. Once the two-side trading becomes strong enough and the prior pullbacks have been deeper and lasted for more than five bars or so, traders can begin to short for scalps, like at the two bar reversal at bar 24 (shorting below the low of then bear bar that followed). After the market has transitioned into a trading range, the bears will begin to short for swing trades, expecting deeper pullbacks and a possible trend reversal.


这轮多头趋势中，其它突破回调用作买入建仓形态的例子还包括：第8根K线的高2牛旗（它是对涨到第6根K线那波上涨行情的回调，而那波行情突破了从第3根K线到第5根K线的空头通道）；第12根K线在均线处的高2（第11根K线向上突破了交易区间，也突破了第10根K线的高1牛旗；第一次向下推进，是第11根K线之后第二根K线形成的那根空头K线）；第14根K线的外包上涨K线（交易者可以在它向上走出外包形态时买入，但如果买在第14根K线上方，成功概率更高，因为它是一根多头趋势K线）；第20根K线的 ii形态；第23根K线处的高2（第23根K线是入场K线）；以及第25根K线的高2（所有双底都是高2形态）。信号K线带有多头实体时更可靠。


> Other examples of breakout pullback buy setups in this bull trend include the bar 8 high 2 bull flag (a pullback from the rally to bar 6, which broke out of the bear channel from bar 3 to bar 5), the bar 12 high 2 at the moving average (bar 11 broke above the trading range and out of the bar 10 high 1 bull flag; the first push down was the bear bar that formed two bars after bar 11), the bar 14 outside up bar (traders could have bought as it went outside up, but the probability of success was higher if they bought above bar 14, because it was a bull trend bar), the bar 20 ii, the high 2 at bar 23 (bar 23 was the entry bar), and the bar 25 high 2 (all double bottoms are high 2 patterns). The signal bar is more reliable when it has a bull body.


总体而言，只要一轮刚刚强烈翻转为始终做多的趋势出现第一次回调，交易者就应当立刻挂一张买入止损单，挂在急速行情高点上方买入。这是因为，许多交易者不敢在前一根K线低点下方或高1上方买入，担心市场会走两段式回调。然而，如果他们非要等两段式回调，就会错过许多最强的趋势。为了不让自己被关在强趋势之外，交易者需要养成挂这张最后防线式买入止损单的习惯。如果他们买到了高1，就可以把买入止损单撤掉。但如果错过了更早的入场点，至少他们还能进入这个趋势——而这正是他们需要做到的。到第19根K线时，趋势显然非常强劲，很可能会以急速行情的高度为基准继续上行约一个等距运动。市场一旦露出可能回调的迹象，交易者就需要把最坏情况入场用的买入止损单挂在急速行情高点上方。第19根K线之后的那根K线是一根空头趋势K线，可能是回调的开始。他们需要把买入止损单挂在第19根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处，以防趋势迅速恢复上行。如果他们改为买第20根K线 ii形态的高1建仓形态，就会把第19根K线上方那张买入止损单撤掉。不过，如果他们因为任何原因没能买上高1，至少还能在市场奔向新高时被顺带带进趋势。他们的初始保护性止损应当放在最近一次小级别回调下方，也就是第20根K线的低点下方。


> In general, whenever there is an initial pullback in a trend that has just become strongly always-in long, a trader should immediately place a buy stop to buy above the high of the spike. This is because many traders are afraid to buy below the low of the prior bar or above a high 1, thinking that the market might have a two-legged pullback. However, if they wait for a two-legged pullback, they will miss many of the very strongest trends. To prevent themselves from being trapped out of a strong trend, traders need to get into the habit of placing that last-ditch buy stop. If they buy the high 1, they can cancel their buy stop. But if they miss the earlier entries, at least they will get into the trend, which is what they need to do. By bar 19, the trend was clearly very strong and was likely to continue up for about a measured move based on the height of the spike. As soon as the market gave a sign of a possible pullback, traders needed to place their worst-case entry buy stop orders above the spike high. The bar after bar 19 was a bear trend bar and a possible start of a pullback. They needed to place a buy stop at one tick above the bar 19 high, in case the trend quickly resumed. If they instead bought the bar 20 ii high 1 setup, they would have canceled the buy stop above bar 19. However, if they missed buying the high 1 for any reason, at least they would have been swept into the trend as the market moved to the new high. Their initial protective stop would have been below the most recent minor pullback, which was the bar 20 low.


第24根K线是两根K线构成的多头急速行情，也是连续第三次没有经过修正的买入高潮。当天剩下的时间已不足以完成一次10根K线的两段式修正，所以愿意做空的空头并不多，更何况从第5根和第12根K线起的那两波上涨几乎没有卖压。不过，一些多头把它当成止盈的机会，事后看这是个合理的决定，因为当天余下的时间里市场再没有回到过那个高点之上。


> Bar 24 was a two-bar bull spike and the third consecutive buy climax without a correction. There was not enough time left in the day for a 10-bar, two-legged correction, so not many bears were willing to short it, especially since the move up from bars 5 and 12 had had so little selling pressure. However, some bulls used it as an opportunity to take profits, which turned out to be a reasonable decision, since the market did not get back above its high for the rest of the day.


交易者知道，大多数反转趋势的尝试都会失败，而许多人也乐于反向操作这些尝试。第12根K线之前的那根K线是一根大空头趋势K线，它既跌破了趋势线，也是一次从第11根K线多头突破处向下反转的尝试。多头买入了这根空头趋势K线的收盘价，预期市场会回到它的高点，而且很可能走出一个等于这根K线高度的等距运动上涨。当他们看到第12根K线以阳线收盘后，就买入第12根K线的收盘价及其高点上方。一次成功的空头突破之后，通常还会跟着一根空头趋势K线，或者至少一根十字星K线；如果出现的反而是一根多头实体——哪怕很小——那么这次突破尝试失败的概率就更高，尤其当这根K线正处在多头趋势中的均线位置时。空头希望在这段空头急速行情之后出现一个空头通道，或者其他某种空头趋势，但多头把这段空头急速行情看作短暂打折买入的机会。空头急速行情——尤其在日线图上——可能由消息面引起，但大多数都缺乏后续行情，最终是更长周期上的看涨基本面占了上风，导致空头突破失败、多头趋势重新恢复。糟糕的消息让空头兴奋、充满期待，但这条消息通常只是影响一天的次要事件，与全部基本面的总和相比微不足道。


> Traders know that most attempts to reverse a trend fail, and many like to fade the attempts. The bar before bar 12 was a large bear trend bar, which was a break below the trend line and an attempt to reverse down from the bar 11 bull breakout. Bulls bought the close of the bear trend bar, expecting a move back up to its high, and probably a measured move up equal to the height of the bar. Once they saw that bar 12 had a bull close, they bought the close of bar 12 and above its high. A successful bear breakout usually is followed by another bear trend bar or at least a doji bar, and if there is instead a bull body, even a small one, the odds of a failed breakout attempt become higher, especially when the bar is at the moving average in a bull trend. The bears wanted a bear channel after the bear spike, or some other type of bear trend, but the bulls saw the bear spike as an opportunity to buy during a brief discount. Bear spikes, especially on daily charts, can be due to news items, but most fail to have follow-through, and the longer-term bullish fundamentals win out, leading to a failed bear breakout and a resumption of the bull trend. The bears get excited and hopeful because of the terrible news, but the news is usually a one-day minor event and trivial compared to the sum of all of the fundamentals.


![图 1.2](figures/fig-01-02.jpg)


**图 1.2　突破回调**


在图 1.2中可以看到，当一段多头波段向上突破之后，市场通常会回测进入突破缺口。市场一路抛售到第8根K线，然后向上反转。第12根K线是一次二次入场的均线缺口K线做空机会，但它失败了。市场没有去回测空头低点，反而在第13根K线向上突破。突破K线之后那根K线的低点，与第11根K线突破点的高点之间，形成了一个突破缺口。无论是这个缺口的中间位置，还是向第11根K线走的那第一段行情的高点，都可能引出一段等距运动上涨。第13根K线的急速上行之后，出现了一条在第15根K线结束的窄幅四根K线通道，随后市场向下测试这条通道的底部。第19根K线的这次测试也测进了突破缺口——在这类情形里，这种事情通常都会发生。


> Figure 1.2 shows that when a bull swing has a breakout to the upside, the market usually tests back into the breakout gap. The market sold off down to bar 8 and then reversed up. Bar 12 was a second-entry moving average gap bar short, but it failed. Instead of testing the bear low, the market broke to the upside on bar 13. The low of the bar after the breakout bar and the high of the bar 11 breakout point created a breakout gap. Either its middle or the high of the first leg up to bar 11 could lead to a measured move up. After the bar 13 spike up, there was a tight four-bar channel that ended at bar 15 and then a test down to the bottom of the channel. The bar 19 test also tested into the breakout gap, which usually happens in these situations.


从第5根K线跌到第8根K线的抛售没有任何回调，而第8根K线之后的那根K线，是第一根价格越过前一根K线高点的K线。既然强趋势中的第一次回调通常会失败，经验丰富的交易者为什么还要把自己利润丰厚的空单买回来呢？因为他们明白，自己应当始终寻找理由去分批止盈或全部止盈，尤其在利润很大时——因为这些利润可能转眼就消失，特别是在一次可能的卖出高潮之后。这里连续出现了三次卖出高潮（分别跌到第6、7、8根K线），而第7根K线之后的那根内包K线是一个潜在的末端旗形（这些形态在第3册中有讨论）。市场极有可能向上修正约10根K线，目标很可能是均线、第4根K线低点，甚至第5根K线高点。空头把它看作在第8根K线附近锁定利润的绝佳机会，他们预期至少会出现10根K线的上涨行情，然后如果出现做空建仓形态，再在市场高得多的地方重新做空。这波上涨太强了，根本没给出任何做空形态，空头反而庆幸自己明智地止盈了，也并不在意没有再次做空的好机会。要是他们一直抱着空单，所有利润都会变成亏损。在任何强趋势中，止盈都是第一次回调的原因。那些错过了这波抛售的空头，本希望有一次回调能让他们做空，但他们始终没等到这个机会。


> The selloff from bar 5 to bar 8 had no pullbacks, and the bar after bar 8 was the first bar that traded above the high of the prior bar. Why would experienced traders ever buy back their highly profitable shorts when the first pullback in a strong trend usually fails? They have learned that they should always look for reasons to take partial or full profits, especially when they are large, because those profits can vanish quickly, especially after a possible sell climax. Here, there were three consecutive sell climaxes (the moves down to bars 6, 7, and 8), and the inside bar after bar 7 was a potential final flag (these patterns are discussed in book 3). The odds were high that the market would correct up for about 10 bars, probably to the moving average, the bar 4 low, or even the bar 5 high. The bears saw this as a great opportunity to lock in their profits around bar 8, expecting at least a 10-bar rally, and then look to sell again much higher, if a sell setup developed. The move up was so strong that there was no sell pattern, and the bears were happy that they wisely took their profits, and they were not concerned about the absence of another good chance to short. Had they held onto their shorts, all of their profits would have turned into losses. Profit taking is the cause of the first pullback in any strong trend. The bears who missed the selloff were hoping for a pullback that would allow them to short, but they never got that opportunity.


那些错过了跌到第4根K线这波抛售的空头，或者在第4根K线止盈后想在回调时重新做空的空头，在均线处的第5根K线低2上等到了机会。那根K线带有空头实体，同时也是一次20根均线缺口K线的做空建仓形态（本书后文会讨论）。


> The bears who missed the selloff to bar 4, or who took profits at bar 4 and were looking to sell again on a pullback, got their chance at the bar 5 low 2 at the moving average. It had a bear body and was also a 20-gap bar short setup (discussed later in this book).


# 第 2 章　突破中的强势信号

*2. Signs of Strength in a Breakout*


一次突破要算成功，最低标准是交易者能够在突破处入场，并至少赚到一个剥头皮交易者的利润。最强的突破会带来强趋势，这样的趋势可能持续几十根K线。有一些早期迹象，会提高一次突破强到足以奔向一个或多个等距运动目标位的可能性。例如，一次多头突破具备下列特征中的越多，这次突破就越可能走强：


> The minimum criterion for a breakout to be successful is that a trader could enter on the breakout and make at least a scalper's profit. The strongest breakouts will result in strong trends that can last for dozens of bars. There are early signs that increase the likelihood that a breakout will be strong enough to run to one or more measured move targets. For example, the more of the following characteristics that a bull breakout has, the more likely the breakout will be strong:


- 突破K线有一个巨大的多头趋势K线实体，影线很小或没有影线。K线越大，这次突破就越可能成功。
- 如果成交量达到最近K线平均成交量的10到20倍，出现后续买入、并进而可能形成一段等距运动的概率就会上升。


> • The breakout bar has a large bull trend body and small tails or no tails. The larger the bar, the more likely the breakout will succeed. • If the volume is 10 to 20 times the average volume of recent bars, the chance of follow-through buying and a possible measured move increases.


- 急速行情走得很远，持续好几根K线，并且突破了若干个阻力位，比如均线、此前的摆动高点以及趋势线，而且每一个都突破了很多个最小报价单位。
- 在突破K线的第一根K线形成的过程中，它大部分时间都停在自己的高点附近，回调很小（不到这根正在生长的K线高度的四分之一）。
- 有一种紧迫感。你觉得自己非买不可，却又想等一个回调，可回调偏偏不来。
- 接下来两三根K线同样带有多头实体，其大小至少达到最近多空K线实体的平均水平。即便这些实体相对较小、影线很显眼，只要后续K线（即最初那根突破K线之后的那根K线）很大，趋势延续的可能性就更大。
- 急速行情长到5到10根K线，中间回调不超过一根K线左右。
- 当多头突破越过此前某个重要的摆动高点时，越过该高点后的涨幅足够大，使得在比该摆动高点高一个最小报价单位处挂止损单入场的剥头皮交易者也能获利。


> • The spike goes very far, lasts several bars, and breaks several resistance levels like the moving average, prior swing highs, and trend lines, and each by many ticks. • As the first bar of the breakout bar is forming, it spends most of its time near its high and the pullbacks are small (less than a quarter of the height of the growing bar). • There is a sense of urgency. You feel like you have to buy but you want a pullback, yet it never comes. • The next two or three bars also have bull bodies that are at least the average size of the recent bull and bear bodies. Even if the bodies are relatively small and the tails are prominent, if the follow-through bar (the bar after the initial breakout bar) is large, the odds of the trend continuing are greater. • The spike grows to five to 10 bars without pulling back for more than a bar or so. • As a bull breakout goes above a prior significant swing high, the move above the high goes far enough for scalpers to make a profit if they entered on a stop at one tick above that swing high.


- 急速行情中有一根或多根K线的低点，正好等于、或只比前一根K线的收盘价低一个最小报价单位。
- 急速行情中有一根或多根K线的开盘价高于前一根K线的收盘价。
- 急速行情中有一根或多根K线的收盘价收在最高价上，或仅比最高价低一个最小报价单位。
- 一根多头趋势K线之后那根K线的低点，正好位于或高于这根多头趋势K线之前那根K线的高点，从而形成一个微型缺口，这是一种强势信号。这类缺口有时会变成测量缺口。虽然它对交易并无重要意义，但它们很可能代表了更小时间级别上艾略特波浪第1浪高点与第4浪回调之间的空隙——两者可以触碰，但不能重叠。
- 整体背景使突破变得很可能，比如回调之后趋势恢复，或者在强劲突破空头趋势线之后，对空头低点做一次更高的低点或更低的低点测试。
- 市场最近出现过好几个强劲的多头趋势日。
- 交易区间内买压不断积聚，表现为许多根巨大的多头趋势K线，而且在区间里多头趋势K线明显比空头趋势K线更醒目。
- 第一次回调只在突破进行了三根或更多K线之后才出现。
- 第一次回调只持续一两根K线，而且它跟随的那根K线并不是一根强劲的空头反转K线。
- 第一次回调没有回到突破点，也没有触及保本止损（即入场价）。
- 这次突破反转了最近许多根K线的收盘价和高点。例如，当市场处在空头通道中、并形成一根巨大的多头K线时，这根突破K线的高点和收盘价都高于五根、甚至20根或更多K线的高点和收盘价。由这根多头K线的收盘价反转的K线数量多，比由它的高点反转同样多的K线，是更强的信号。一次多头突破具备下列特征中的越多，它就越可能失败，并导致交易区间或反转：


> • One or more bars in the spike has a low that is at or just one tick below the close of the prior bar. • One or more bars in the spike has an open that is above the close of the prior bar. • One or more bars in the spike has a close on its high or just one tick below its high. • The low of the bar after a bull trend bar is at or above the high of the bar before the bull trend bar, creating a micro gap, which is a sign of strength. These gaps sometimes become measuring gaps. Although it is not significant to trading, they probably represent the space between a smaller time frame Elliott wave 1 high and a wave 4 pullback, which can touch but not overlap. • The overall context makes a breakout likely, like the resumption of a trend after a pullback, or a higher low or lower low test of the bear low after a strong break above the bear trend line. • The market has had several strong bull trend days recently. • There was growing buying pressure in the trading range, represented by many large bull trend bars, and the bull trend bars were clearly more prominent than the bear trend bars in the range. • The first pullback occurs only after three or more bars of breaking out. • The first pullback lasts only one or two bars and it follows a bar that is not a strong bear reversal bar. • The first pullback does not reach the breakout point and does not hit a breakeven stop (the entry price). • The breakout reverses many recent closes and highs. For example, when there is a bear channel and a large bull bar forms, this breakout bar has a high and close that are above the highs and closes of five or even 20 or more bars. A large number of bars reversed by the close of the bull bar is a stronger sign than a similar number of bars reversed by its high. The more of the following characteristics that a bull breakout has, the more likely it will fail and lead to either a trading range or a reversal:


- 突破K线只有一个小或中等大小的多头趋势K线实体，上方却有一根很长的影线。
- 下一根K线是空头实体，而且要么是一根空头反转K线，要么是一根空头内包K线；那根K线收在最低价上或最低价附近，其实体大小约等于突破之前那些K线实体的平均水平（而不是只有一根最小报价单位高的空头实体）。
- 整体背景使突破不太可能发生，比如一波上涨行情去测试交易区间日的高点，但这波上涨行情里有空头K线、许多重叠的K线、影线显眼的K线，沿途还有两三次回调。
- 市场已经在交易区间里待了好几天。
- 突破K线之后的那根K线是一根强劲的空头反转K线或一根空头内包K线。
- 一根多头趋势K线之后的那根K线，其低点低于这根多头趋势K线之前那根K线的高点。
- 第一次回调出现在反转之后两根K线处。
- 回调延续了好几根K线。
- 回调之后的趋势恢复陷入停滞，市场带着一根空头信号K线形成一个更低的高点。
- 急速行情只比某个阻力位高了大约一个最小报价单位就反转向下——这个阻力位可能是摆动高点、空头趋势线或多头趋势通道线。


> • The breakout bar has a small or average-size bull trend body and a large tail on top. • The next bar has a bear body and is either a bear reversal bar or a bear inside bar; that bar closes on or near its low, and the body is about the size of the average bodies of the bars before the breakout (not just a one-tick-tall bear body). • The overall context makes a breakout unlikely, like a rally to test the high of a trading range day, but the rally has bear bars, many overlapping bars, bars with prominent tails, and a couple of pullbacks along the way. • The market has been in a trading range for several days. • The bar after the breakout bar is a strong bear reversal bar or a bear inside bar. • The bar after a bull trend bar has a low that is below the high of the bar before the bull trend bar. • The first pullback occurs two bars after the reversal. • The pullback extends for several bars. • The trend resumption after the pullback stalls and the market forms a lower high with a bear signal bar. • The spike breaks above a resistance level like a swing high, a bear trend line, or a bull trend channel line by only a tick or so and then reverses down.


- 急速行情勉强突破了某一个阻力位，但在突破只稍高一点的其他价位之前就回调了。
- 在比此前的摆动高点高一个最小报价单位处挂止损单买入的交易者，在回调出现之前赚不到一个剥头皮交易者的利润。
- 在突破K线形成的过程中，它的回调幅度超过这根K线高度的三分之二。
- 在突破K线形成的过程中，它至少有两次回撤幅度达到自身高度的三分之一。
- 回调跌破了突破点。任何一根K线的低点，与比它早两根的那根K线的高点之间，都不存在缺口。
- 回调跌破了急速行情第一根K线的低点。
- 回调触及了保本止损。
- 有一种困惑感。你觉得自己拿不准这次突破到底会成功还是失败。对空头突破来说，上面所有内容的反面都成立。一次空头突破具备下列特征中的越多，这次突破就越可能走强：


> • The spike barely breaks above a single resistance level but pulls back before breaking above other levels that are just a little higher. • A trader who bought on a stop above a prior swing high would not be able to make a scalper's profit before there was a pullback. • As the breakout bar is forming, it pulls back more than two-thirds of the height of the bar. • As the breakout bar is forming, it pulls back for at least a third of its height two or more times. • The pullback falls below the breakout point. There are no gaps between the low of any bar and the high of the bar two bars earlier. • The pullback falls below the low of the first bar of the spike. • The pullback hits the breakeven stop. • There is a sense of confusion. You feel like you are not certain whether the breakout will succeed or fail. The opposite of all of the preceding is true for bear breakouts. The more of the following characteristics that a bear breakout has, the more likely the breakout will be strong:


- 突破K线有一个巨大的空头趋势K线实体，影线很小或没有影线。K线越大，这次突破就越可能成功。
- 如果成交量达到最近K线平均成交量的10到20倍，出现后续卖出、并进而可能形成一段向下等距运动的概率就会上升。
- 急速行情走得很远，持续好几根K线，并且突破了若干个支撑位，比如均线、此前的摆动低点以及趋势线，而且每一个都突破了很多个最小报价单位。
- 在突破K线的第一根K线形成的过程中，它大部分时间都停在自己的低点附近，回调很小（不到这根正在生长的K线高度的四分之一）。
- 有一种紧迫感。你觉得自己非卖不可，却又想等一个回调，可回调偏偏不来。
- 接下来两三根K线同样带有空头实体，其大小至少达到最近多空K线实体的平均水平。即便这些实体相对较小、影线很显眼，只要后续K线（即最初那根突破K线之后的那根K线）很大，趋势延续的可能性就更大。


> • The breakout bar has a large bear trend body and small tails or no tails. The larger the bar, the more likely the breakout will succeed. • If the volume is 10 to 20 times the average volume of recent bars, the chance of follow-through selling and a possible measured move down increases. • The spike goes very far, lasts several bars, and breaks several support levels like the moving average, prior swing lows, and trend lines, and each by many ticks. • As the first bar of the breakout bar is forming, it spends most of its time near its low and the pullbacks are small (less than a quarter of the height of the growing bar). • There is a sense of urgency. You feel like you have to sell but you want a pullback, yet it never comes. • The next two or three bars also have bear bodies that are at least the average size of the recent bull and bear bodies. Even if the bodies are relatively small and the tails are prominent, if the follow-through bar (the bar after the initial breakout bar) is large, the odds of the trend continuing are greater.


- 急速行情长到5到10根K线，中间回调不超过一根K线左右。
- 当空头突破跌破此前某个重要的摆动低点时，跌破该低点后的跌幅足够大，使得在比该摆动低点低一个最小报价单位处挂止损单入场的剥头皮交易者也能获利。
- 急速行情中有一根或多根K线的高点，正好等于、或只比前一根K线的收盘价高一个最小报价单位。
- 急速行情中有一根或多根K线的开盘价低于前一根K线的收盘价。
- 急速行情中有一根或多根K线的收盘价收在最低价上，或仅比最低价高一个最小报价单位。
- 一根空头趋势K线之后那根K线的高点，正好位于或低于这根空头趋势K线之前那根K线的低点，从而形成一个微型缺口，这是一种强势信号。这类缺口有时会变成测量缺口。虽然它对交易并无重要意义，但它们很可能代表了更小时间级别上艾略特波浪第1浪低点与第4浪回调之间的空隙——两者可以触碰，但不能重叠。
- 整体背景使突破变得很可能，比如回调之后趋势恢复，或者在强劲跌破多头趋势线之后，对多头高点做一次更低的高点或更高的高点测试。
- 市场最近出现过好几个强劲的空头趋势日。
- 交易区间内卖压不断积聚，表现为许多根巨大的空头趋势K线，而且在区间里空头趋势K线明显比多头趋势K线更醒目。
- 第一次回调只在突破进行了三根或更多K线之后才出现。
- 第一次回调只持续一两根K线，而且它跟随的那根K线并不是一根强劲的多头反转K线。
- 第一次回调没有回到突破点，也没有触及保本止损（即入场价）。
- 这次突破反转了最近许多根K线的收盘价和低点。例如，当市场处在多头通道中、并形成一根巨大的空头K线时，这根突破K线的低点和收盘价都低于五根、甚至20根或更多K线的低点和收盘价。由这根空头K线的收盘价反转的K线数量多，比由它的低点反转同样多的K线，是更强的信号。


> • The spike grows to five to 10 bars without pulling back for more than a bar or so. • As a bear breakout goes below a prior significant swing low, the move below the low goes far enough for scalpers to make a profit if they entered on a stop at one tick below that swing low. • One or more bars in the spike has a high that is at or just one tick above the close of the prior bar. • One or more bars in the spike has an open that is below the close of the prior bar. • One or more bars in the spike has a close on its low or just one tick above its low. • The high of the bar after a bear trend bar is at or below the low of the bar before the bear trend bar, creating a micro gap, which is a sign of strength. These gaps sometimes become measuring gaps. Although it is not significant to trading, they probably represent the space between a smaller time frame Elliott wave 1 low and a wave 4 pullback, which can touch but not overlap. • The overall context makes a breakout likely, like the resumption of a trend after a pullback, or a lower high or higher high test of the bull high after a strong break below the bull trend line. • The market has had several strong bear trend days recently. • There was growing selling pressure in the trading range, represented by many large bear trend bars, and the bear trend bars were clearly more prominent than the bull trend bars in the range. • The first pullback occurs only after three or more bars of breaking out. • The first pullback lasts only one or two bars and it follows a bar that is not a strong bull reversal bar. • The first pullback does not reach the breakout point and does not hit a breakeven stop (the entry price). • The breakout reverses many recent closes and lows. For example, when there is a bull channel and a large bear bar forms, this breakout bar has a low and close that are below the lows and closes of five or even 20 or more bars. A large number of bars reversed by the close of the bear bar is a stronger sign than a similar number of bars reversed by its low.


一次空头突破具备下列特征中的越多，它就越可能失败，并导致交易区间或反转：


> The more of the following characteristics that a bear breakout has, the more likely it will fail and lead to either a trading range or a reversal:


- 突破K线只有一个小或中等大小的空头趋势K线实体，下方却有一根很长的影线。
- 下一根K线是多头实体，而且要么是一根多头反转K线，要么是一根多头内包K线；那根K线收在最高价上或最高价附近，其实体大小约等于突破之前那些K线实体的平均水平（而不是只有一根最小报价单位高的多头实体）。
- 整体背景使突破不太可能发生，比如一波抛售去测试交易区间日的低点，但这波抛售里有多头K线、许多重叠的K线、影线显眼的K线，沿途还有两三次回调。
- 市场已经在交易区间里待了好几天。
- 突破K线之后的那根K线是一根强劲的多头反转K线或一根多头内包K线。
- 一根空头趋势K线之后的那根K线，其高点高于这根空头趋势K线之前那根K线的低点。
- 第一次回调出现在反转之后两根K线处。
- 回调延续了好几根K线。


> • The breakout bar has a small or average-size bear trend body and a large tail on the bottom. • The next bar has a bull body and is either a bull reversal bar or a bull inside bar; that bar closes on or near its high, and the body is about the size of the average bodies of the bars before the breakout (not just a one-tick-tall bull body). • The overall context makes a breakout unlikely, like a sell-off to test the low of a trading range day, but the sell-off has bull bars, many overlapping bars, bars with prominent tails, and a couple of pullbacks along the way. • The market has been in a trading range for several days. • The bar after the breakout bar is a strong bull reversal bar or a bull inside bar. • The bar after a bear trend bar has a high that is above the low of the bar before the bear trend bar. • The first pullback occurs two bars after the reversal. • The pullback extends for several bars.


- 回调之后的趋势恢复陷入停滞，市场带着一根多头信号K线形成一个更高的低点。
- 急速行情只比某个支撑位低了大约一个最小报价单位就反转向上——这个支撑位可能是摆动低点、多头趋势线或空头趋势通道线。
- 急速行情勉强跌破了某一个支撑位，但在跌破只稍低一点的其他价位之前就回调了。
- 在比此前的摆动低点低一个最小报价单位处挂止损单做空的交易者，在回调出现之前赚不到一个剥头皮交易者的利润。
- 在突破K线形成的过程中，它的回调幅度超过这根K线高度的三分之二。
- 在突破K线形成的过程中，它至少有两次回撤幅度达到自身高度的三分之一。
- 回调向上反弹，越过了突破点。任何一根K线的高点，与比它早两根的那根K线的低点之间，都不存在缺口。
- 回调向上反弹，越过了急速行情第一根K线的高点。
- 回调触及了保本止损。


> • The trend resumption after the pullback stalls, and the market forms a higher low with a bull signal bar. • The spike breaks below a support level like a swing low, a bull trend line, or a bear trend channel line by only a tick or so and then reverses up. • The spike barely breaks below a single support level but pulls back before breaking below other levels that are just a little lower. • A trader who shorted on a stop below a prior swing low would not be able to make a scalper's profit before there was a pullback. • As the breakout bar is forming, it pulls back more than two-thirds of the height of the bar. • As the breakout bar is forming, it pulls back for at least a third of its height two or more times. • The pullback rallies above the breakout point. There are no gaps between the high of any bar and the low of the bar two bars earlier. • The pullback rallies above the high of the first bar of the spike. • The pullback hits the breakeven stop.


- 有一种困惑感。你觉得自己拿不准这次突破到底会成功还是失败。在交易者眼中，突破意味着强势，也意味着可能出现一轮新趋势。它出现在一段双向交易之后——在那段时间里，多空双方都认同价格有价值，也都愿意建仓。在突破期间，双方则一致认为市场应当在另一个价位找到价值，而突破就是一次奔向那个新价位的快速运动。市场偏爱不确定性，并且会快速移动去寻找它。突破则是一段确定性的时期。在空头突破中，多空双方都确信突破区间内的价格太高；在多头突破中，双方都确信价格太低；而出现后续行情的概率通常约为60% 到70%。市场快速移动，去寻找这样一个价位：在那里，多空双方都认同有价值，愿意开仓。这意味着不确定性再一次出现，没有人知道哪一方会获胜、并成功制造出下一次突破。不确定性正是交易区间的标志，所以突破是在寻找一个交易区间、寻找不确定性，以及寻找等距运动中50% 的方向概率。急速行情之后的通道，通常会大致勾勒出随后那个交易区间的顶部和底部。


> • There is a sense of confusion. You feel like you are not certain whether the breakout will succeed or fail. To a trader, the breakout implies strength and a possible new trend. It follows a period of two-sided trading where the bulls and bears both agree that there is value and both are willing to take positions. During the breakout, they both now agree that the market should find value at another price and the breakout is a fast move in search of that new price. The market prefers uncertainty and quickly moves in search of it. A breakout is a period of certainty. Bulls and bears are certain that the prices within the breakout are too high in a bear breakout or too low in a bull breakout, and the odds of follow-through are usually about 60 to 70 percent. The market moves quickly in search of a price level where both the bulls and bears agree there is value for them to initiate trades. This means that there is once again uncertainty, and no one knows which side will win and succeed in creating the next breakout. Uncertainty is the hallmark of a trading range, so a breakout is a search for a trading range, for uncertainty, and a 50 percent directional probability of an equidistant move. The channel that follows the spike usually creates an approximate top and bottom of the trading range that typically follows.


当市场沿着通道向上运行时，上下等幅运动的方向概率会逐渐削弱；当它走到通道末端时，方向概率实际上反倒偏向反转。这是因为交易区间的突破通常会失败，而概率偏向价格回到区间中部，也就是方向概率归于中性的地方。那个区间中部就是这次突破的目标位，而它的位置要等形态形成之后才能知道。


> As the market is moving up in the channel, the directional probability of an equidistant move erodes and it actually favors a reversal when it reaches the end of the channel. This is because trading range breakouts generally fail and the odds favor a move back into the middle of the range where the directional probability is neutral. That middle of the range is the target of the breakout, and its location is unknown until after it forms.


一次突破从一根趋势K线开始，这根K线可大可小，但相对于最近K线的大小，它通常至少算是偏大的。记住，所有趋势K线都应当被视为突破、急速行情、缺口以及高潮。当它很小时，人们很容易忽视它的重要性；但如果它之后出现一段横盘走势、接着又是一段稳定的方向性运动，那么一轮突破正在进行。最容易辨认的突破，是那种情况：一根异常大的趋势K线迅速把市场带出交易区间，并且很快就有其他同方向的趋势K线跟上。不论这次突破是一根趋势K线还是一连串趋势K线，它都是一段急速行情。如前所述，几乎所有趋势都可以看作某种急速与通道式趋势。例如，如果一根多头突破K线收得很强，随后几根K线同样收得很强、影线很小或没有影线、高点与低点不断上移（没有回调K线），而且连续多头趋势K线的实体之间几乎没有重叠，那么在市场反转、重新跌回这轮突破起点之前，总会有某个时点价格高于当下的水平。如果趋势延续下去，它的动能终将放缓，之后一般会出现某种通道。


> A breakout begins with a trend bar, which can be large or small, but it is usually at least somewhat large compared to the size of the recent bars. Remember, all trend bars should be viewed as breakouts, spikes, gaps, and climaxes. When it is small, it is easy to dismiss its importance, but if it is followed by some sideways price action and then a steady directional move, a breakout is underway. The easiest breakouts to spot occur when an unusually large trend bar quickly moves the market out of a trading range and it is soon followed by other trend bars in the same direction. Whether the breakout is a single trend bar or a series of trend bars, it is a spike. As mentioned earlier, almost all trends can be considered to be some type of spike and channel trend. For example, if a bull breakout bar has a strong close and the next several bars also have strong closes, small or nonexistent tails, and trending highs and lows (no pullback bars), and there is very little overlap between the bodies of consecutive bull trend bars, then the market will likely be higher than it is at the current moment at some point before the market reverses back beyond the start of the breakout move. If the trend continues, eventually its momentum will slow and there will generally be some type of channel.


交易中最重要的概念之一，就是大多数突破都会失败。正因如此，在每一次突破出现时都顺着突破方向入场，是一种亏钱的策略。不过，价格行为中常常会出现一些事件，提高一次突破成功的可能性。例如，如果先有一轮强劲的空头趋势，接着一波两段式上涨行情来到均线处，那么在这面熊旗向下突破时做空，是一笔合理的交易。反之，如果市场并不处于趋势之中，而且有大量重叠的K线、许多影线很长的K线，那么市场处于均衡状态。多空双方都乐于建仓，一个交易区间正在形成。如果此时市场出现一根多头趋势K线，向上延伸到交易区间的顶部甚至越过顶部，那些原本乐于在区间中部卖出的空头，会在这样更有利的价位上变得更加激进。同时，那些原本乐于在区间中部买入的多头，会变得不敢追高，反而会在区间顶部迅速离场。多空双方的这种行为，在区间中部形成了一股磁力，结果是大部分成交都发生在区间中部。即便市场成功突破、并走出了大约相当于区间高度的一段等距运动，这股磁力仍然倾向于把市场拉回区间之内。这正是末端旗形反转之所以如此可靠的原因（在第3册中讨论）。


> One of the most important concepts in trading is that most breakouts fail. Because of this, entering on every breakout in the direction of the breakout is a losing strategy. However, there are often price action events that increase the likelihood that a breakout will succeed. For example, if there is a strong bear trend and then a two-legged rally to the moving average, going short on the downside breakout of this bear flag is a sensible trade. However, if the market is not in a trend and there are lots of overlapping bars and many bars with large tails, the market is in balance. Both the bulls and the bears are comfortable taking positions and a trading range is developing. If the market then has a bull trend bar that extends to the top of or even above the trading range, the bears who were happy to sell in the middle of the range are going to be even more aggressive at this better price. Also, the bulls who were happy to buy in the middle of the range will become hesitant to buy higher and instead will be quick to exit at the top of the range. This behavior by the bulls and the bears creates a magnetic pull in the middle of the range, and the result is that most of the trading will be in the middle of the range. Even once the market successfully breaks out and travels for maybe a measured move equal to the height of the range, the magnetic pull will still tend to draw the market back into the range. This is what makes final flag reversals so reliable (discussed in book 3).


如果你看任何一张走势图，都会注意到大量多头和空头趋势K线，它们实体相对较大、影线很小。每一根这样的K线都是一次突破尝试，而几乎所有这些尝试都没能带来趋势，交易区间反而继续延续。在5分钟 Emini 小型合约（标普500迷你股指期货合约）图上，这些K线可能代表着试图推动市场的买入和卖出程序。有些算法就是专门用来反向操作这类趋势K线的——它们预期大多数趋势K线都会失败。当经验丰富的交易者认为某次突破很可能会失败时，他们也会这么做。例如，如果一次突破表现为一根巨大的多头趋势K线，这些程序可能会在这根K线收盘时做空、在其高点上方做空、在接下来一两根K线收盘时做空，或者在其低点下方做空。如果反向操作一方（即卖出方）有足够多的程序化交易资金涌入，它们就会压过那些试图启动多头趋势的程序，交易区间便会继续。最终总会有一次突破成功。那时突破K线会很大，K线形成过程中的回调会很小，并且在接下来几根K线里会有良好的后续行情。那些试图反向操作这次行情的程序正在失败，它们将回补亏损头寸，从而进一步推动趋势。这种强势会吸引其他趋势交易者，其中许多人都是动能交易者，一旦看到动能就迅速入场。


> If you look at any chart, you will notice lots of bull and bear trend bars with relatively large bodies and small tails. Each of these is a breakout attempt and almost all fail to lead to a trend, and instead the trading range continues. On a 5 minute Emini chart, these probably represent buy and sell programs trying to move the market. Some algorithms are designed to fade these trend bars, expecting most to fail. Experienced traders will do this as well when they believe that the breakout will probably fail. For example, if there is a breakout in the form of a large bull trend bar, these programs might short on the close of the bar, above its high, on the close of the next bar or two, or below their lows. If enough program trading dollars come in on the fade side (the sell side), they will overwhelm those programs that are trying to initiate the bull trend, and the trading range will continue. Eventually, a breakout will succeed. The breakout bar will be large, the pullbacks as the bar is forming will be small, and the breakout will have good follow-through over the next several bars. The programs that are trying to fade the move are failing and they will cover their losing positions and drive the trend further. The strength will attract other trend traders, many of whom are momentum traders and quickly enter whenever they see momentum.


一旦所有人都确信市场现在正处在趋势中，那么在回调出现之前，行情可能会走得很远。为什么会这样？来看一个例子：市场以一段由三根强劲多头趋势K线构成的急速行情，向上突破进入强劲的多头趋势。交易者相信用不了多久，市场就会在某个时点走高，而且他们没有信心认为接下来几根K线内市场会走低。这让空头回补他们的空单，从而把市场推得更高。仓位不足的多头相信市场短期内还会走高，也相信直接以市价买入、或者在两三个最小报价单位的回调中买入，会比等到8到10个最小报价单位的回调、或等到回踩均线再买入赚得更多。这同样推高了市场。由于多空双方本质上都是在市场上涨时以市价买入，回调始终不来；或者至少可以说，等到市场远远高于当前价位之后，还得再过五根或更多根K线，回调才可能出现。


> Once everyone is convinced that the market is now trending, it might go far before there is a pullback. Why is that? Consider an example of a market breaking into a strong bull trend with a spike formed by three strong bull trend bars. Traders believe that the market will be higher at some point before long and they are not confident that it will be lower within the next few bars. This makes bears buy back their shorts, lifting the market even more. Bulls who are underin-vested believe the market is going higher in the near term and that they will make more money by simply buying at the market or on a two-or three-tick pullback than they would if they waited for an eight-or 10-tick pullback or a pullback to the moving average. This also lifts the market. Since bulls and bears are both essentially buying at the market as it is going up, the pullback never comes, or at least it does not come for five or more bars after the market is well above the current price.


这一点在第8章有更详细的讨论，但交易者在突破中的任何时刻都愿意以市价买入，因为他们相信成功的概率好于五五开，也就是至少能赚到与他们所冒风险相同的点数。当突破很强时，这个概率通常是60% 到70%，甚至更高。如果他们在5分钟 Emini 图上，趁着急速行情顶部高出急速行情低点四个点的时候，买在最高的那个最小报价单位上，他们相信市场在他们那个四个点的止损被打掉之前再上涨四个点的概率大概是60% 或更好。你怎么能确定这一点？因为在成功概率远低于60% 时，让风险等于回报在数学上是不明智的，机构因此不会做这笔交易。既然市场仍在上涨，那么机构就是在做这笔交易。而这笔交易只要市场维持在急速行情底部之上就依然成立，所以他们是在拿急速行情底部作为风险点。他们知道急速行情通常会上涨到大约一段等距运动的幅度，所以他们的止盈目标——也就是他们的回报——等于他们的风险。如果急速行情在停顿之前又长高了两个点，这段急速行情就有六个点那么高。


> This is discussed in more detail in Chapter 8, but traders are willing to buy at the market at any time in a breakout because they believe that the odds are better than 50–50 that they will make at least as many points as they are risking. When the breakout is strong, the probability is usually 60 to 70 percent or more. If they buy the 5 minute Emini on the high tick when the top of the spike is four points above the low of the spike, they believe that the odds are probably 60 percent or better that the market will go up four more points before their four-point stop is hit. How can you be sure of this? Because it is mathematically unwise to have your risk equal your reward if the chance of success is much less than 60 percent, and institutions would therefore not be taking this trade. Since the market is still going up, then institutions are taking the trade. Since the trade remains valid as long as the market stays above the bottom of the spike, they are risking to the bottom of the spike. They know that the spike usually goes up to about a measured move, so their profit target, which is their reward, is equal to their risk. If the spike grows another two points before pausing, the spike is then six points tall.


如果这段急速行情就此结束，他们会假定市场在下跌六个点之前再上涨六个点的概率约为60%。这意味着，所有在更低价位买入的多头，都有60% 的概率在四个点的止损被打掉之前看到市场再上涨六个点。例如，在急速行情只有四个点高时买入的多头，现在是用四个点的风险去博总共八个点的回报，下的是一笔60% 胜率的注，这在数学上是非常有利的局面。他们预期市场有60% 的概率去测试急速行情收盘价上方六个点处，也就是他们入场价上方两个点处，这给了他们八个点的止盈目标。


> If that is the end of the spike, they will assume that there is about a 60 percent chance that the market will go another six points higher before it falls six points. This means that all of the bulls who bought lower have a 60 percent chance that the market will go another six points higher before their four-point stop is hit. For example, the bulls who bought when the spike was four points tall are now risking four points to make a total of eight points on a 60 percent bet, which is a great mathematical situation. They expect that the market has a 60 percent chance of testing six points above the close of the spike, which is two points above their entry, giving them an eight-point profit target.


当一次突破取得成功并带来一轮趋势时，最初的快速运动之后动能会放缓，双向交易的迹象开始出现，比如K线相互重叠、影线变长、出现反方向的趋势K线以及回调K线。尽管趋势可能持续很长时间，但趋势的这一部分通常会被回撤，并成为交易区间的一部分。例如，在急速与通道式多头趋势形态中，急速行情就是那次突破，而通道通常会变成交易区间的第一段行情，因此通常会被回撤。典型情况是，市场最终会一路回调到通道的起点，从而完成这个初生交易区间的第二段行情。在上面那个多头突破的例子中，市场随后通常会在那个支撑位处尝试反弹。这形成了一个双底牛旗；这个形态有时会带来向上突破新区间的行情，另一些时候则会演变成一个持续很久的交易区间，比如窄幅交易区间或三角形。较少见的情况是，它之后会跟着一次反转。


> When a breakout is successful and leads to a trend, the momentum slows after the initial fast move, and signs of two-sided trading develop, like overlapping bars, increasing tails, trend bars in the opposite direction, and pullback bars. Even though the trend may continue for a long time, this part of the trend usually gets retraced and becomes part of a trading range. For example, in a spike and channel bull trend pattern, the spike is the breakout and the channel usually becomes the first leg of a trading range and therefore will usually be retraced. Typically, the market eventually pulls back all the way to the start of the channel, completing the second leg of the incipient trading range. In the example of that bull breakout, the market will then usually try to bounce off that support. This results in a double bottom bull flag that sometimes leads to a breakout above the new range, and other times it evolves into a protracted trading range like a tight trading range or a triangle. Less often, it is followed by a reversal.


在5分钟 Emini 图上，每天通常都有很多次突破尝试，但大多数在一两根趋势K线之后就失败了。它们很可能代表着某家机构一笔程序化交易的启动，却被其他机构方向相反的程序所压倒。当足够多的机构在同一时间运行方向相同的程序时，它们的程序就能把市场推到一个新的价位，这次突破就会成功。不过，从来没有什么是100% 确定的，即便是最强的突破，也有大约30% 的时候会失败。


> On the 5 minute Emini chart, there are usually many attempts to break out every day but most fail after one or two trend bars. They most likely represent the start of a program trade by some institution, but they get overwhelmed by opposite programs by other institutions. When enough institutions have programs running in the same direction at the same time, their programs will be able to move the market to a new price level and the breakout will be successful. However, nothing is ever 100 percent certain and even the strongest breakouts fail about 30 percent of the time.


当一次突破非常强时，会出现三根或更多影线很小、彼此重叠极少的趋势K线。这意味着交易者并没有在等一个明显的回调。他们担心在市场走出很长一段行情之前可能根本不会有回调，而他们想确保至少抓住这轮趋势的一部分。他们会以市价入场，也会在一两个最小报价单位的微小回调中入场；这些持续不断的委托会给趋势注入力量，同时不利于明显回调的形成。


> When a breakout is very strong, there will be three or more trend bars with small tails and very little overlap. This means that traders are not waiting for a significant pullback. They are afraid that there might not be a pullback until after the market has run a long way, and they want to be certain to capture at least part of the trend. They will enter at the market and on tiny pullbacks of one or two ticks, and their relentless orders will give the trend strength and work against the formation of a significant pullback.


突破K线常常伴随很大的成交量，有时它们的成交量会达到普通K线的10到20倍。成交量越大、急速行情里的K线越多，出现明显后续行情的可能性就越大。在突破之前，多空双方都在分批建仓，争夺市场的控制权，各自都想制造出朝自己方向的成功突破。一旦出现一次清晰的突破，输的一方会迅速亏损平掉自己的大仓位，赢的一方则会更加激进地入场。其结果就是一根或多根趋势K线，且往往伴随高成交量。成交量并不总是特别高，但当它达到最近K线平均水平的10倍或更多时，一次成功突破——也就是会有许多根K线后续行情——的概率就更高。另外，在几根K线之内就失败了的突破上，成交量也可能异常地高，但这种情况不那么常见。成交量还没有可靠到值得去跟踪它的程度，而且构成急速行情的那些巨大趋势K线，本身就已经能告诉你这次突破是否可能成功。再多去想成交量，往往只会分散你的注意力，妨碍你发挥出最佳的交易水平。


> The breakout bars often have large volume and sometimes they will have 10 to 20 times the volume of an average bar. The higher the volume and the more bars in the spike, the more likely it is that there will be significant follow-through. Prior to the breakout, both the bulls and the bears were scaling into their positions, fighting over control of the market and each trying to create a successful breakout in their direction. Once there is a clear breakout, the losing side will cover their large position quickly with a loss, and the winning side will enter even more aggressively. The result is one or more trend bars, often with high volume. Volume is not always especially high but when it is 10 or more times the average of the recent bars, the probability of a successful breakout, meaning that there will be follow-through for many bars, is higher. Also, volume can be unusually high on breakouts that fail within a few bars, but this is less common. Volume is not reliable enough to warrant following it, and the large trend bars that comprise the spike will already tell you whether the breakout is likely to be successful. Trying to think about the volume in addition will, more often than not, distract you and hinder your ability to trade at your best.


所有成功的突破都应当被看作急速行情，因为大多数突破之后都会跟着通道，并形成急速与通道式趋势形态。不过，突破也可能失败；此时如果它原本是趋势中的一面旗，那么它之前的那个交易区间就变成了末端旗形。事实上，大多数突破确实会失败，只不过那根突破K线太平淡无奇，大多数交易者根本没意识到曾经出现过一次突破尝试。较少见的情况是，市场在突破之后进入一个窄幅交易区间，这通常之后会跟着趋势恢复；但有时这个窄幅交易区间的突破方向可能是相反的，从而形成一次反转。


> All successful breakouts should be viewed as spikes, since most are followed by channels and create a spike and channel trend pattern. However, the breakout can also fail and the trading range that preceded it then becomes a final flag, if it was a flag in a trend. In fact, most breakouts do fail but the breakout bar is so unremarkable that most traders don't even realize that there was an attempted breakout. Less commonly, the market can enter a tight trading range after the breakout, and this is usually followed by trend resumption, but sometimes the breakout of that tight trading range can be in the other direction, resulting in a reversal.


一次突破可以是一根巨大的趋势K线，也可以是一连串或大或小的趋势K线；这次突破通常会成为前面讨论过的某一种趋势形态的一部分。例如，如果出现一轮“开盘即趋势”的空头趋势，它很可能是对前一天某个形态的向下突破。如果这轮趋势很有秩序，它之后可能跟着持续几个小时的窄幅交易区间，然后这一天可能演变为一路持续到收盘的趋势恢复型空头日。反之，如果这次突破不断向下加速，每根K线的斜率都更陡，图形呈现出抛物线式、也就是高潮式的外观，那么它之后可能跟着一次回调，然后再出现一段通道。这一天就可能变成一个急速与通道式空头趋势日。


> A breakout can be a single large trend bar or a series of large or small trend bars, and the breakout usually becomes part of one of the trend patterns previously discussed. For example, if there is a “trend from the open” bear trend, it is likely a breakout below a pattern from the previous day. If the trend is orderly, it might be followed by a tight trading range for several hours and then the day could turn into a trend resumption bear into the close. If instead the breakout is accelerating to the downside with each bar resulting in a steeper slope, and the chart assumes a parabolic and therefore climactic look, it might be followed by a pullback and then a channel. The day could become a spike and channel bear trend day.


有时，在市场已经处于强趋势中许多根K线之后，它会沿着趋势方向造出一根异常大的趋势K线。这根大K线通常要么成为一次突破，把市场带入更陡、更强的趋势（或者至少成为趋势中的又一段行情），要么标志着趋势的高潮式结束。如果市场回调了几根K线，并且没有把这根突破K线回撤太多，那么这次突破成功的概率就不错，交易者会在高1的突破回调处入场——前提这是一次多头突破（如果是空头突破，则做空低1）。


> Sometimes, after the market has been in a strong trend for many bars, it creates an unusually large trend bar in the direction of the trend. That large bar typically either becomes a breakout into an even steeper, stronger trend, or at least another leg in the trend, or can signify a climactic end of the trend. If the market pulls back for a few bars and does not retrace too much of the breakout bar, the odds of the breakout being successful are good, and traders will enter on the high 1 breakout pullback if this was a bull breakout (or short a low 1 in a bear breakout).


即便回调回撤过了突破点，趋势仍可能延续；但回调越深，这次突破失败、市场反转的可能性就越大。在这种情况下，那根大K线代表的将是趋势的高潮式结束，而不是一次突破。如果回调相当深，交易者可能会在之后一个小时左右的时间里犹豫要不要顺势入场。例如，如果有一根巨大的多头趋势K线向上突破了某个摆动高点或交易区间，但随后的回调相当深，也许略微跌到该摆动高点顶部之下，交易者就无法确定这次突破是已经失败了，还是这波上涨只是稍微有些过头。


> The trend can continue even if the pullback retraces beyond the breakout point, but the deeper the pullback, the more likely it is that the breakout will fail and the market will reverse. In this case, the large bar will represent a climactic end of the trend rather than a breakout. If the pullback is fairly deep, traders might hesitate to enter with the trend for an hour or so. For example, if there is a large bull trend bar that breaks above a swing high or trading range but the pullback is fairly deep, maybe a little below the top of the swing high, traders will not be certain if the breakout has failed or if the rally is just a little overdone.


在这种情况下，多头往往在大约10根K线左右的时间里不会买入，而市场常常会进入一个小型交易区间。他们不会去买高1，而很可能等一个高2，尤其是当高2在一个小时左右之后才形成的时候。如果这个交易区间维持在均线上方，而且已经过去了大约一个小时，多头就会寻找机会买入一段横向或向下的两段式回调。有时，这段横盘之后会跟着向下的第二段行情。这第二段行情可能带来新高，也可能带来趋势反转和更多的卖出。


> The bulls in this case often will not buy for about 10 bars or so and the market will frequently enter a small trading range. Instead of buying a high 1, they will likely wait for a high 2, especially if it forms after an hour or so. If the trading range is holding above the moving average and about an hour has passed, bulls will look to buy a two-legged sideways or down pullback. Sometimes the sideways move is followed by a second leg down. That second leg can lead to a new high, or to a trend reversal and more selling.


一旦出现回调——回调本身就是一个小型交易区间——交易者就会期待趋势恢复。从回调中发生的突破，其初步目标大约是一段相当于这个交易区间高度的等距运动。许多交易者会在那个区域部分或全部止盈，而激进的逆势交易者则会建立新的头寸。


> Once there is a pullback, which is a small trading range, traders will look for the trend to resume. The breakout from the pullback has an initial target of an approximate measured move equal to about the height of the trading range. Many traders will take partial or total profits in that area, and aggressive countertrend traders will initiate new positions.


最容易辨认的突破失败，是市场迅速掉头反向、完全没有做出任何像样的努力去延续突破方向的那种。当还存在其他可能反转的证据时，这种情况更容易发生，比如向上突破趋势通道线之后，又带着一根强劲的信号K线反转向下。


> The easiest breakout failures to spot are those where the market quickly reverses direction and does not make any significant attempt to continue in the direction of the breakout. This is more likely to happen when there is other evidence of a possible reversal, like a breakout above a trend channel line and then a reversal down with a strong signal bar.


突破的对象可以是任何东西，比如一条趋势线、一个交易区间，或者今天或昨天的最高价、最低价。这并不重要，因为它们的交易方式全都一样。如果突破失败，就反向操作它；如果反转尝试失败、从而变成了一次突破回调，就顺着突破方向重新入场。只有当突破非常强时，才在突破处入场。这方面的一个例子是：先有一轮强劲的多头趋势，然后出现一段两根K线的回调、形成高1买入建仓形态。交易者可以在前一根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处买入，也可以通过下指令在旧高点上方一个最小报价单位处挂止损单买入，从而在新高突破时进一步加仓。不过，通常情况下，更好的做法是买入回调，或者寻找机会做空一次突破失败。


> The breakout can be of anything, such as a trend line, a trading range, or the high or low of the day or yesterday. It does not matter because they are all traded the same. Fade it if it fails and reenter in the direction of the breakout if the reversal attempt fails and therefore becomes a breakout pullback. Enter on the breakout only if it is very strong. An example of this is if there is a strong bull trend and then a two-bar pullback to a high 1 buy setup. Traders can buy at one tick above the high of the prior bar, and they can buy more on a breakout to a new high by placing an order to buy on a stop at one tick above the old high. Usually, however, it is better to buy a pullback or to look to short a failed breakout.


在大多数日子里，交易者会把新的摆动高点和摆动低点视为可能反向操作的建仓形态。但在强劲的趋势日里，突破通常伴随巨额成交量，而且即便在1分钟图上，回调也非常小。很明显，趋势交易者在掌控局面。例如，当多头趋势那么强时，价格行为交易者会选择在高1和高2回调处买入，而不是等价格突破趋势的前一个高点。他们始终在设法把交易的风险降到最低。不过，一旦一轮强趋势启动，出于任何理由顺势入场都是一笔好交易。在强趋势中，每一个最小报价单位都是顺势入场点，所以你完全可以在任意时点直接以市价入场，并使用一个合理的止损。


> On most days, traders look at new swing highs and lows as possible fade setups. On a strong trend day, however, the breakouts are usually on huge volume and there is very little pullback even on a 1 minute chart. It is clear that the trend traders are in control. For example, when a bull trend is that strong, price action traders will be buying on high 1 and high 2 pullbacks instead of waiting for a breakout above the prior high of the trend. They are always trying to minimize the risk of the trade. However, once a strong trend is underway, entering with the trend for any reason is a good trade. In a strong trend, every tick is a with-trend entry, so you can simply enter at the market at any point and use a reasonable stop.


如果一次突破带来了一根巨大的趋势K线，而这根K线还没有收盘，你就需要做一个决定。假如你刚刚已经对一部分仓位剥头皮止盈，现在正在考虑把剩下的仓位转为波段持有，那就始终要考虑你承担了多少风险。要帮助自己决定是否继续持有这个波段头寸，一个办法是问自己：如果此刻我没有持仓，我会怎么做？如果你愿意以波段级别的仓位规模和波段保护性止损在现价入场，那么你就应当继续持有当前的波段头寸。反之，如果你认为带着这么大的风险在现价入场实在太冒险，那么你就应当在现价平掉你的波段头寸。


> If there is a breakout with a large trend bar and the bar has not yet closed, you have a decision to make. If you just scalped out of part of your trade and are now thinking about swinging the remainder, always consider how much risk you have. One way to help decide if you should continue to hold your swing position is to ask yourself what you would do at this moment if you were not holding a position. If you would be willing to enter at the market using a swing-size position and the swing protective stop, then you should stay in your current swing position. If instead you think that it would be too risky to enter at the market with that amount of risk, then you should exit your swing position at the market.


当出现突破时，买方和卖方都把它视为机会。例如，如果市场形成一个摆动高点、随后回调，那么当市场向上越过此前那个摆动高点时，多空双方都会入场。多头会买入这次突破，因为他们把它视为强势信号，并相信市场会涨到足够高于他们入场价的位置，让他们能获利离场。空头同样会把这次突破看成赚钱的机会。例如，空头可能会在此前那个高点所在的价位挂限价单卖出，或者在该高点上方几个最小报价单位处卖出。如果市场反转下跌，他们会寻找机会获利离场。但如果市场继续上涨，只要他们认为市场可能会回调去测试这次突破，他们就会考虑加仓做空。由于大多数回调都会一路回到此前那个摆动高点，他们可以在这次突破回测中离场：第一笔入场大致保本，第二笔在更高价位入场的空头则能获利。


> When there is a breakout, both buyers and sellers see it as an opportunity. For example, if the market has a swing high and then pulls back, both bulls and bears will enter as the market moves above that prior swing high. Bulls will be buying the breakout because they see it as a sign of strength and they believe the market will go high enough above their entry for them to exit with a profit. Bears will also see the breakout as an opportunity to make money. For example, bears might sell on a limit order at the level of that prior high or maybe a few ticks above it. If the market reverses and comes down, they will look to exit with a profit. If, however, the market continues up, they will look to add to their short position if they think the market might pull back to test the breakout. Since most pullbacks come all the way back to the prior swing high, they can exit on that breakout test at about breakeven on their first entry and with a profit on their second, higher entry.


当交易者想到突破时，通常立刻浮现的画面是交易区间。不过，突破的对象可以是任何东西。有一种许多交易者都忽略的常见突破，是旗形朝意料之外的方向突破，比如熊旗向上突破，或者牛旗向下突破。例如，如果有一轮相当强的空头趋势，交易者又不确定一个可交易的底部是否已经出现，而此时他们看到一面熊旗正在形成，他们就可能开始在此前那些K线的低点下方买入，预期低1、然后是低2、甚至低3会失败。有时这面熊旗形态不错，触发了低2做空或楔形熊旗做空，随后却立刻反转向上，走出了一两根多头趋势K线。这种突破通常会造成一个测量缺口，并带来一段向上的等距运动。交易者会在突破处以及任何小幅回调中入场；而由于空头被套，在市场至少走出两段上涨行情之前，他们很可能不会急着再次做空。多头趋势中的牛旗，情形正好相反。


> When traders think of breakouts they usually immediately have the image of a trading range. However, the breakout can be of anything. One common breakout that many traders overlook is a flag breaking out in the unexpected direction, like a bear flag breaking out of the top or a bull flag breaking out of a bottom. For example, if there is a reasonably strong bear trend and traders are not sure if a tradable low is in and they see a bear flag forming, they might start buying below the low of the prior bars, expecting a low 1 and then a low 2 or even a low 3 to fail. Sometimes the bear flag will have a good shape and trigger the low 2 short or the wedge bear flag short and then immediately reverse up into one or two bull trend bars. This breakout usually creates a measuring gap that leads to a measured move up. Traders will enter on the breakout and on any small pullback; and since bears were trapped, they will likely not be eager to short again until the market has had at least two legs up. The opposite is true of bull flags in bull trends.


有一种特殊的突破，有时会出现在趋势日的最后一个小时。例如，如果市场正在下行趋势中、毫无回调迹象，就可能出现一两根巨大的空头趋势K线，向下跌破空头通道的底部。之后可能有一次小幅回调，接着是第二次短暂的突破，创出新低。另一些时候，市场只是不间断地向下跌到收盘，并没有出现巨大的空头趋势K线。这两种情况下很可能发生的，是交易公司的风险经理正在告诉那些一直在抄底的交易员：他们站错了市场的方向，必须按市价把仓位卖出去。这类急跌通常没有多少后续行情，因为它们大多源于被迫卖出。很可能也有一些聪明的程序员预见到这一点，并试图加以利用——他们设计出短暂做空的程序，从而放大了卖出高潮的规模。动能程序也是这轮强趋势的一部分。在这一两次卖出高潮之后，收盘前可能会有反弹，也可能没有。在那些以强劲多头急速行情或通道收尾的日子里，情形正好相反。风险经理会要求交易员在收盘前买回他们亏损的空单；而随着市场快速上涨，动能程序会察觉到这一点，只要动能还在延续，它们也会不停地买入。


> There is a special type of breakout that sometimes occurs on trend days in the final hour. For example, if the market is trending down with no sign of a pullback, there can be one or two large bear trend bars that break out of the bottom of the bear channel. There may be a small pullback and then a second brief breakout to a new low. At other times, the market just moves down into the close relentlessly without large bear trend bars. What is likely happening in both cases is that risk managers at trading firms are telling their traders who have been bottom picking that they are on the wrong side of the market and that they have to sell out of their positions at the market. The plunges usually do not have much follow-through since they are mostly due to forced selling. There are likely some smart programmers who anticipate this and try to capitalize on it by designing programs to go short briefly, increasing the size of the sell climax. Momentum programs are also part of the strong trend. There may or may not be a bounce into the close after the one or two sell climaxes. The opposite is true on days that end with strong bull spikes or channels. The risk managers are telling their traders to buy back their losing shorts before the close, and as the market is rising quickly, momentum programs detect this and also buy relentlessly as long as the momentum continues.


交易者的目标之一，就是去做机构正在做的事。许多突破都由当天成交量最大的那些巨大趋势K线构成。这些时候正是机构交易最密集的时刻，而它们之所以这么做，是因为预期这波行情会有持久的后续行情。尽管在一次大突破期间市场可能让人感到恐惧、情绪化，但机构把它视为绝佳的机会——成交量已经说明了这一点——你也应当如此。设法学会交易突破，因为它们的交易者等式非常出色。如果确实需要，那就只用四分之一规模的仓位（也就是“我不在乎”的规模）去交易，权当积累经验。这波行情往往足够大，让你赚到的钱和用满仓做一笔常规交易一样多。


> One of the goals of traders is to do what the institutions are doing. Many breakouts are made of large trend bars that have the biggest volume of the day. These are times when the institutions are trading most heavily, and they are doing so because they expect the move to have protracted follow-through. As scary and emotional as the market can feel during a big breakout, the institutions see it as a great opportunity, as indicated by the volume, and so should you. Try to learn to trade breakouts because they have an excellent trader's equation. If you have to, simply trade only a quarter-size position (“I don't care” size), just to get experience. The move will often be large enough that you can make as much as you do on a routine trade using your full position size.


![图 2.1](figures/fig-02-01.jpg)


**图 2.1　突破每天都会发生很多次**


每一张走势图上，每隔几根K线就会出现某种类型的突破，正如图 2.1所示——这是欧元兑美元外汇的日线图。严格来说，只要一根K线的高点高于此前任何一根K线的高点，或者它的低点低于此前任何一根K线的低点，它就是对那根K线的突破。此外，每一根趋势K线都是一次突破（还记得第1册里说过的吗——每一根趋势K线都是急速行情、突破、缺口和高潮）。这张图上标注了许多不同类型的突破与突破失败。


> Breakouts of some type occur every few bars on every chart, as shown in Figure 2.1 in the daily chart of the Euro/U.S. Dollar Forex. Strictly speaking, if the high of a bar is above the high of any prior bar or the low of the bar is below the low of any prior bar, it is a breakout of that bar. Also, every trend bar is a breakout (remember from book 1, every trend bar is a spike, breakout, gap, and climax). Many different types of breakouts and failures are highlighted on this chart.


第1根K线向上突破了趋势通道线，随后下一根K线又向下跌破了它的低点，从而构成一个两根K线反转，并在第3根K线这根入场K线处被触发。第2根K线是第二次尝试向上突破多头通道，它突破了另一个两根K线反转的形态，但这些突破都失败了，市场反转向下。


> Bar 1 broke above a trend channel line and was followed by a breakout below its low on the next bar, setting up a two-bar reversal, which was triggered on the bar 3 entry bar. Bar 2 was a second attempt to break out above the bull channel and it broke out above another two-bar reversal but the breakouts failed and the market reversed down.


第4根K线向下跌破了一个摆动低点，它是从第2根K线开始下跌的那段卖出高潮中的第6根K线。由于这根K线的区间很大、影线很小，它可能代表一次卖出高潮——在出现后续卖出之前，市场需要一次修正。事实正是如此，因为第5根K线是一根强劲的多头反转K线，把第4根K线变成了一个突破失败。


> Bar 4 was a breakout below a swing low and it was the sixth bar is a sell climax down from bar 2. Since the range of the bar was large and it had small tails, it might represent a sell climax that needed a correction before there was follow-through selling. This turned out to be the case, because bar 5 was a strong bull reversal bar that turned bar 4 into a failed breakout.


市场出现了一段两段式回调，回落到均线处，随后第8根K线突破了这面熊旗。


> There was a two-legged pullback to the moving average and bar 8 broke out of the bear flag.


第9根K线向上突破了空头趋势线。第10根K线向上突破了一个摆动高点，但当下一根K线交易到它的低点之下时，这次突破失败了。


> Bar 9 broke above the bear trend line. Bar 10 broke above a swing high but the breakout failed when the next bar traded below its low.


第12根K线跌破第9根K线这根入场K线，也跌破了它前面的那根信号K线。


> Bar 12 fell below the bar 9 entry bar and below the signal bar just before it.


第13根K线试图反转向上，制造一次突破失败，但那次突破失败在第14根K线反转向下时也失败了。第14根K线同样是一次反转向下：它来自一次突破失败——那次尝试向上越过了微型趋势线，也越过了前面那根多头反转K线。当一次突破失败未能让市场反转时，它就变成了一次突破回调。


> Bar 13 tried to reverse back up and create a failed breakout, but that failed breakout failed on the bar 14 reversal back down. Bar 14 was also a reversal down from the failed breakout above a micro trend line and above a bull reversal bar. When a failed breakout fails to reverse the market, it becomes a breakout pullback.


第16根K线向上突破空头趋势线的尝试失败了，这根K线反转向下，形成一次外包下跌K线反转，并跌破了此前三根K线构成的熊旗趋势线。


> The bar 16 break above the bear trend line failed and the bar reversed down into an outside down reversal, falling below the bear flag trend line of the prior three bars.


第16到第18根K线形成了一次四根K线的突破，由强劲的空头趋势K线构成，实体大、影线小、彼此重叠极少。那些在交易区间里分批做多的多头终于放弃了抵抗，他们不仅停止了买入，还不得不迅速卖出自己庞大的多头仓位，根本等不及回调。他们既没有信心认为回调很快会来，又确信市场在几根K线之内会走低。这意味着，按市价离场、或者在K线内部的微小回调中离场，是他们最好的选择。他们平掉多单、以及随后好几根K线都不再买入，共同加剧了这波抛售的强度。当一次突破强到这个程度时，它通常会跟着一段通道，并常常带来一段从急速行情第一根K线的开盘价到最后那根K线收盘价的等距运动。第36根K线的低点就在这个等距运动目标位下方一点点，通道至此结束。此后市场通常会一路回升，去测试急速行情之后第一个合理的买入信号，也就是第19根K线那根多头内包K线的高点。如果价格到了那里，它接下来会尝试测试空头通道的起点，也就是第20根K线的高点。


> Bars 16 to 18 created a four-bar breakout composed of strong bear trend bars with large bodies, small tails, and very little overlap. The bulls who scaled into longs within the trading range finally capitulated and not only stopped buying, but had to sell out of their large long positions quickly without waiting for a pullback. They were not confident that a pullback would come soon and were confident that the market would be lower within a few bars. This means that getting out at the market or on a tiny pullback within the bar was their best option. Their long liquidation and their lack of buying for several bars contributed to the strength of the sell-off. When a breakout is that strong, it usually is followed by a channel and often leads to a measured move from the open of the first bar to the close of the final bar in the spike. The bar 36 low was just below that measured move projection, and that ended the channel. The market then usually works its way back up to test the first reasonable buy signal after the spike, which was the high of the bar 19 bull inside bar. If it gets there, it next tries to test the start of the bear channel, which was the bar 20 high.


第20根K线是在试图让这次四根K线的突破失败，但当一次突破强到这个程度时，通常会有后续行情，而这次失败通常也会失败，仅仅变成一次突破回调——这里正是如此。市场在距离第15根K线这个突破点和均线都还差一点的地方就反转向下。每当市场在没有触及某个阻力位的情况下就掉头向下，说明空头非常强大，因为他们并没有等阻力位被触及。空头担心多头可能根本没法把市场推上去，所以空头就在略低于该价位的地方挂着限价单。这是空头紧迫感的一种表现。突破点（第15根K线的低点）与突破回调（第20根K线的高点）之间的那个缺口，通常会变成一个测量缺口，而且往往是这波行情的大致中点。空头趋势的起点是第2根K线的高点，而市场最终跌破该缺口的幅度，超过了第2根K线高点与测量缺口中点之间的点数。这次突破、以及突破回测时强劲的反转向下，确立了这轮空头趋势非常强，交易者在当天余下的时间里只应寻找做空机会。可能有一两次做多的剥头皮机会，但交易者只有在一根K线跌破前一根K线低点时能够立刻反手做空的条件下，才应该去做——因为那意味着这次小幅回调可能即将结束。顺带一提，在艾略特波浪交易者看来，这次回调是第4浪的顶部，而突破点是第1浪的底部。如果中间那段向下的波浪3确实是第3浪——通常是趋势中最强的一浪——那么这两者就不能重叠。


> Bar 20 was an attempt to make the four-bar breakout fail but when a breakout is that strong, there is usually follow-through and the failure will typically fail and just become a breakout pullback, as it did here. The market reversed back down just shy of the bar 15 breakout point and the moving average. Whenever a market turns back down without touching a resistance level, the bears are very strong because they are not waiting for the resistance to be touched. The bears are afraid that the bulls might not be able to get the market up there, so the bears have limit orders just below. This is a sign of urgency by the bears. That gap between the breakout point (the bar 15 low) and the breakout pullback (the bar 20 high) usually becomes a measuring gap and often is the approximate midpoint of the move. The start of the bear trend was the bar 2 high, and the market ultimately fell below the gap by more than the number of points between the bar 2 high and the middle of the measuring gap. The breakout and the strong reversal down on the breakout test established the bear trend as very strong, and traders should only look for shorts for the rest of the day. There might be a long scalp or two, but a trader should take them only if the trader is able to immediately reverse back to short as soon as a bar falls below the low of the prior bar, indicating that the small pullback might be ending. Incidentally, Elliott Wave traders see the pullback as the top of wave 4 and the breakout point as the bottom of wave 1. The two cannot overlap if the downward wave 3 in between is in fact wave 3, which is usually the strongest wave of the trend.


第22根K线是一根大区间的空头K线，向下跌破了四根K线通道的底部。它可以说是连续第三次卖出高潮（第一次是第14根K线，第二次是向下跌到第18根K线的那段四根K线急速行情）。在连续出现两三次高潮之后，市场通常至少会有一轮10根K线的两段式修正。不过在这里，那段四根K线的空头急速行情是当天压倒一切的特征，也是一轮强劲突破的开端。没错，它是一段急速行情，因此也是一次卖出高潮，但它太大了，以至于市场的性质发生了变化，任何数浪都得从头开始。它一形成，交易者就认定接下来会有一轮强劲的下跌，而通道是强劲急速行情之后最常见的形态。通道在修正之前往往会有三次推进，这一次也是如此。这三次推进分别出现在第18、第25、第36根K线上，之后市场以一波疲弱的上涨进入收盘。


> Bar 22 was a large-range bear bar that broke below the bottom of a four-bar channel. It was arguably the third consecutive sell climax (the first was bar 14 and the second was the four-bar spike down to bar 18). The market usually has at least a 10-bar, two-legged correction after two or three consecutive climaxes. Here, however, that four-bar bear spike was the overwhelming feature of the day and was the beginning of a strong breakout. Yes, it was a spike and therefore a sell climax, but it was so large that the character of the market changed and any counting has to start all over. Once it formed, traders decided that there was going to be a strong move down, and a channel is the most common pattern that follows a strong spike. Channels often have three pushes before they correct, and this one did as well. The three pushes were bars 18, 25, and 36, and they were followed by a weak rally into the close.


第23根K线是在第22根K线那次卖出高潮、以及价格过靶跌穿三根K线空头通道底部之后的一次反转尝试。然而，在大局如此看空的情况下，仅凭这几根K线就去找做多机会是个错误。市场总是在试图反转趋势，而在实时行情中，人们很容易被筑底形态带来的情绪裹挟；但你绝不该忽视大局。那段四根K线的空头急速行情非常强，而且始终入场方向仍然是做空。此时任何筑底的尝试都几乎肯定会变成一面熊旗，这里就是如此。市场总有惯性，当它正处在趋势中时，要预期所有反转尝试都会失败。


> Bar 23 was a reversal attempt after the bar 22 sell climax and overshoot through the bottom of the three-bar bear channel. However, it is a mistake to be looking for a long based on these few bars when the big picture is so bearish. The market is always trying to reverse trends, and it is easy to get caught up in the emotion of a bottoming pattern as it happens in real time; but you should never lose sight of the big picture. That four-bar bear spike was very strong, and the always-in position is still short. Any attempt at a bottom at this point will almost certainly result in a bear flag, as it did here. The market always has inertia, and when it is trending, expect all reversal attempts to fail.


第25根K线是向下跌破第20到第21根K线那段通道之后的第二次反转向上尝试。由于两次尝试的信号K线都有强劲的多头实体，市场可能会去测试均线。大多数交易者不应该做这笔交易，而应该继续做空。太常见的情况是：交易者逆势剥头皮赚了一个点，却没有反手做回空头，结果错失了顺势交易中四个点甚至更多的利润。如果你刚刚才做多，要迅速把心态调回做空可能很难；如果你做不到这一点，就不要去做那笔逆势剥头皮，免得错过后面那波下跌波段。


> Bar 25 was a second attempt to reverse up after the breakout below the bars 20 to 21 channel. Since the signal bars for both attempts had strong bull bodies, the market might test the moving average. Most traders should not take this trade and instead should stay short. Too often, traders will scalp the counter-trend trade for a point and then do not reverse back to short, and they miss out on making four or more points on the with-trend trade. It can be difficult to change your mind-set quickly back to short if you just went long, and if you cannot do this easily, do not take the countertrend scalp and then miss the swing down.


第26根K线如预期那样向上突破了通道的顶部。


> Bar 26 broke out of the top of the channel, as expected.


第27根K线向上突破了空头趋势线，也突破了第18根K线这个突破点，但未能成功，并在下一根K线反转向下。


> Bar 27 broke above the bear trend line and above the bar 18 breakout point but failed and reversed down on the next bar.


第28根K线是对一面三根K线熊旗的突破。


> Bar 28 was a breakout of a three-bar bear flag.


第29根K线跌破了第26根K线这根做多入场K线，但它找到了买方，从它那根长长的影线就能看出来。


> Bar 29 broke below the bar 26 long entry bar but it found buyers, as seen by the large tail.


第32根K线是对空头趋势线的又一次测试，因此也是一次突破尝试，但它失败了。


> Bar 32 was another test of a bear trend line and therefore an attempted breakout, but it failed.


第35根K线又是一根巨大的空头趋势K线，因此也可能是又一次卖出高潮。当市场在短时间内开始形成第二次、第三次卖出高潮时，它很可能会反转，至少走出一轮两段式修正。


> Bar 35 was another large bear trend bar and therefore another possible sell climax. When the market begins to form second and third sell climaxes within a short time, it is likely to reverse for at least a two-legged correction.


第36根K线跌破了等距运动目标位，但没有遇到卖方。相反，它遇到的是清淡的成交，这可能是在暗示，第22到第34根K线那面熊旗的突破已经失败。在一轮漫长的空头趋势之后，一个水平方向的熊旗往往会变成末端旗形，之后通常至少会有两段横盘到向上的行情。第36根K线也是空头通道中的第三次向下推进，而这通常会带来至少一次反转尝试。


> Bar 36 broke below the measured move but did not find sellers. Instead, it found quiet trading, which might be signaling a failed breakout of the bars 22 to 34 bear flag. A horizontal bear flag after a long bear trend often becomes a final flag and is typically followed by at least two legs sideways to up. Bar 36 was also the third push down in the bear channel and that usually leads to at least a reversal attempt.


第36根K线之后的那根K线向上突破了第36根K线的高点，成为这笔做多交易的入场K线。


> The bar after bar 36 broke above the bar 36 high and became the entry bar for the long.


第37根K线是向上突破空头趋势线的一根多头突破K线。


> Bar 37 was a bull breakout bar above the bear trend line.


第38根K线向上突破了第35根K线那根强劲的空头趋势K线。在这根K线上方肯定挂着许多空头的买入止损单，因为它巨大的空头实体代表强劲的卖出。一旦市场涨到它的高点上方，许多空头就认定继续做空的力度已经不够，于是买入回补自己的空单（空头回补），一直补到收盘。


> Bar 38 broke above the strong bar 35 bear trend bar, and there were certainly many buy stops for shorts above this bar because its large bear body represented strong selling. Once the market got above its high, lots of bears decided that there was no longer enough strength to stay short and they bought back their shorts (short covering) into the close.


![图 2.2](figures/fig-02-02.jpg)


**图 2.2　旗形也可能朝可能性较小的方向突破**


旗形有时会朝意料之外的方向突破，并带来等距运动。在图 2.2中，有一面失败的楔形熊旗，它在第9根K线向上突破。第7根K线这个突破点的高点，与第10根K线那次突破回测之间的测量缺口，带来了一段几乎完美的向上等距运动。


> Flags can sometimes break out in the unexpected direction and lead to measured moves. In Figure 2.2, there was a failed wedge bear flag that broke to the upside on bar 9. The measuring gap between the high of the bar 7 breakout point and the bar 10 breakout test led to an almost perfect measured move up.


第3根K线是一个低1做空建仓形态，但在三根强劲的多头实体以及第2根K线那次卖出高潮之后，它很可能会失败。激进的交易者本来会在第3根K线低点处及更低的位置挂限价买单做多。第5根K线是一笔低2做空的入场K线，但在第4根K线那根强劲的外包上涨K线之后，市场可能正在形成当日的低点。同样，激进的交易者本来会在低2信号K线的低点处或下方做多。第7根K线是楔形熊旗做空的信号K线，但市场处在多头通道中，而第4根K线那根外包上涨K线使始终入场的交易方向变为做多。与其在第7根K线下方做空，空头更应当等待，看市场是否会形成一个更低的高点。多头在第8根K线上方做多，预期这面失败的楔形熊旗会带来一段向上的等距运动。


> Bar 3 was a low 1 short setup, but after three strong bull bodies and the bar 2 sell climax, it was likely to fail. Aggressive traders would have gone long on limit buy orders at and below the bar 3 low. Bar 5 was an entry bar for a low 2 short, but after the strong bar 4 outside up bar the market might have been making a low of the day. Again, aggressive traders would have gone long at or below the low of the low 2 signal bar. Bar 7 was a signal bar for a wedge bear flag short, but the market was in a bull channel and the bar 4 outside up bar made the always-in trade long. Rather than short below bar 7, bears should have waited to see if the market formed a lower high. Bulls went long above bar 8, expecting a measured move up from the failed wedge bear flag.


随后，在第22根K线上方出现了一个失败的低2熊旗买入建仓形态，其入场K线是一根多头趋势K线。这次突破同样带来了一段向上的等距运动。第21根K线是某个多头日里一段空头通道的底部，而第22根K线是那次通道突破之后的突破回调，所以警觉的交易者认为，这个低2极有可能失败，并带来一次对当日高点的测试。


> There was then a failed low 2 bear flag buy setup above bar 22 and the entry bar was a bull trend bar. This breakout also led to a measured move up. Bar 21 was the bottom of a bear channel on a bull day and bar 22 was the breakout pullback from that channel breakout, so alert traders thought that the low 2 had an excellent chance of failing and leading to a test of the high of the day.


第26根K线的低点反转了此前12根K线的低点（即它低于那些低点），也反转了此前13根K线的收盘价。它的收盘价反转了同样这些低点，这一点意义重大，因为收盘价低于某个低点，比仅仅低点低于此前的低点更能算作强势信号。被反转的低点和收盘价越多，这次反转就越强。在那之前12根K线里买入的每一位交易者，现在都握着一笔亏损头寸，他们会寻找任何小幅反弹来卖出自己的多单。许多人在下一根K线就卖出了，从而造出了那根K线顶部的影线。而且，这些多头至少在之后好几根K线里都不太可能再考虑买入。


> The low of bar 26 reversed the lows of the past 12 bars (it was below those lows) and the closes of the past 13 bars. Its close reversed these same lows, which is significant because a close below a low is more of a sign of strength than simply a low that is below a prior low. The more lows and closes that are reversed, the stronger the reversal. Every trader who bought during those prior 12 bars is now holding a loser and will look for any small bounce to sell out of his longs. Many sold on the next bar and created the tail on the top of the bar. Also, those bulls will not likely look to buy again for at least a few bars.


![图 2.3](figures/fig-02-03.jpg)


**图 2.3　小突破K线**


如图 2.3所示，虽然像第3根和第19根K线那样的大突破K线常常带来大趋势，但有时像第12根K线这样的小突破K线也能成为一段持久行情的开端。在第9根K线那段空头急速行情之后，交易者一度怀疑：涨到第11根K线的那波上涨，会不会在均线处演变成一个低2熊旗（第10根和第11根K线是两次向上推进）。然而，市场并没有向下突破，而是向上突破了第10根K线和第11根K线的双顶（这使得这波上涨变成了一面末端旗形，因为它是这轮空头趋势的最后一面旗，尽管它自始至终都没有向下突破）。第12根K线这根突破K线很小，但它已经足以让交易者开始抛弃“涨到第11根K线的行情是一面熊旗”的想法，并开始怀疑第9根K线是不是一次衰竭性卖出高潮——那样的话，市场可能会修正10根K线甚至更久。第12根K线之后的那根K线也很小，但它有两个强势特征：一根多头实体，以及一个没有跌破第11根K线高点（即突破点）的低点。虽然涨到第14根K线的这波上涨并没有走出很多点，但它是一轮毫不松懈的多头趋势，并成为两段上涨行情中的第一段（第二段始于第18根K线与第15根K线构成的双底，以及由第13、15、18根K线低点构成的三角形）。


> As shown in Figure 2.3, although big breakout bars like bars 3 and 19 often lead to big trends, sometimes a small breakout bar like bar 12 can be the start of a protracted move. After the bar 9 bear spike, traders wondered if the rally to bar 11 might become a low 2 bear flag at the moving average (bars 10 and 11 were two pushes up). However, instead of breaking to the downside, the market broke above the bar 10 and bar 11 double top (this made the rally a final flag, since it was the final flag of the bear trend, even though it never broke to the downside). The bar 12 breakout bar was small, but it was enough to make traders begin to discard the notion that the move to bar 11 was a bear flag, and they began to wonder if bar 9 was an exhaustive sell climax, which could correct for 10 or more bars. The bar after bar 12 was also small, but it had two signs of strength: a bull body and a low that did not fall below the bar 11 high (the breakout point). Although the rally to bar 14 did not cover many points, it was a relentless bull trend and became the first of two legs up (the second began with the bar 18 double bottom with bar 15, and the triangle formed by the lows of bars 13, 15, and 18).


# 第 3 章　初始突破

*3. Initial Breakout*


在大多数市场的5分钟图上，每天通常至少会有两三次成功的重大突破。多数突破都是从一根单独的趋势K线开始的，这根K线通常比之前的K线更大，而且没有影线，或者只有小影线。在最强的突破中，会出现一连串几乎没有重叠的趋势K线。例如，在5分钟Emini 小型合约图上的一段强多头突破中，一旦突破K线收出，有些交易者就会挂限价单，在那根K线的收盘价处买入。如果下一根K线在那个价格开盘，并立即向上成交，没有跌到那个价格之下，那些限价单很可能不会成交，这些看多的交易者就被关在场外。他们会感到一种紧迫感，因为害怕错过这波行情，会想尽办法尽快做多：或者用市价单，或者用限价单去买任何一个一到两个最小报价单位的小回调，或者干脆换到1分钟图或2分钟图这样更小的时间级别，然后在一次高1或高2回调中入场。这事在情绪上往往很难做到，好比从高高的跳台上往下跳。两种情况下可能都管用的办法就是硬着头皮去做：捏住鼻子，紧紧闭上眼，全身肌肉绷紧，相信你不会伤得太重，难受的感觉很快就会过去。如果你交易的是Emini 小型合约，你只管买进那个小回调，然后靠你的止损就行。如果突破是好的，你的止损不会被碰到，在接下来许多根K线里，你有不错的机会赚到两个点，甚至六个点以上，而承担的风险大约是两个点。


> On 5 minute charts of most markets, there are usually at least a couple of successful significant breakouts every day. Most breakouts begin with a single trend bar that is usually larger than the previous bars and has no tails or only small tails. In the strongest breakouts, there will be a series of trend bars with very little overlap. For example, in a strong bull breakout on the 5 minute Emini chart, as soon as the breakout bar closes, some traders will place limit orders to buy at the closing price of that bar. If the next bar opens at that price and immediately trades up without going below that price, the limit orders will likely not get filled and these bullish traders will be trapped out of the market. They will experience a sense of urgency because they are afraid of missing the move and will look to get long as soon as possible, using either a market order or a limit order to buy any one-or two-tick or small pullback, or they will switch to a smaller time frame chart like a 1 or 2 minute, and then enter on a high 1 or high 2 pullback. This is often hard to do emotionally and it is comparable to jumping off a high diving board. What might work in both situations is to just do it: pinch your nose, close your eyes tightly, tense up every muscle in your body, and trust that you won't get hurt too badly and that the bad feelings will end quickly. If you are trading the Emini, you simply buy the small pullback and rely on your stop. If the breakout is good, your stop will not be hit and you will have a good chance of making two to even six or more points over the next many bars while risking about two points.


如果一到两根K线的突破之后，跟着的不是连续好几根强多头趋势K线，而是一根小K线、一根十字星、一根内包K线、一根带长影线的K线，或者一根空头趋势K线，那么这次突破可能失败。这可能带来向交易区间内的反转，也可能是一次转变为空头趋势的趋势反转；再或者是一次反转失败——所谓反转失败，就是仅仅一到两根K线的回调，之后上涨行情又恢复。当突破成功时，它会形成某种形式的急速与通道趋势。


> If, instead of having several strong bull trend bars in a row, the bar after a one-or two-bar breakout is a small bar, a doji, an inside bar, a bar with large tails, or a bear trend bar, the breakout might fail. This could lead to a reversal back into the trading range, a trend reversal into a bear trend, or a failed reversal, which is simply a one-or two-bar pullback that is followed by a resumption of the upward move. When the breakout is successful, it will create some version of a spike and channel trend.


收盘后对着走势图看，突破入场看上去简单得颇具迷惑性。然而在实时行情中，这些建仓形态往往要么模糊不清，要么清晰但吓人。在突破上入场、或者在突破K线收出之后入场，都很难做到，因为突破的急速行情往往很大，交易者必须迅速决定去承担比平时大得多的风险。结果，他们常常选择去等一次回调。即使他们缩小仓位规模，让亏损的金额与其它交易一样，一想到要承担两到三倍于平常的最小报价单位数，他们还是害怕。等回调入场也很难，因为每一次回调都是从一次小级别反转开始的，交易者担心这次回调可能是一次深度修正的开头。如果反转只有一到两根K线，并且形成了一次突破回调的入场机会，他们又不敢进，因为他们担心市场可能正在进入交易区间：如果市场走的是多头突破，他们不想买在顶部；如果是空头突破，他们不想卖在底部。趋势会想尽一切办法把交易者挡在外面，因为只有这样它们才能让交易者整天追着市场跑。当一个建仓形态既简单又清晰时，这波行情通常只是一次又快又小的剥头皮。如果这波行情要走很远，它就必须显得模糊、难以出手，才能把交易者留在场外，逼他们去追这个趋势。


> A breakout entry appears deceptively easy to take when you see it on the chart at the end of the day. However, in real time, the setups tend to be either unclear or clear but scary. Entering on the breakout or after the breakout bar closes is difficult to do, because the breakout spike is often large, and traders have to quickly decide to risk much more than they usually do. As a result, they often end up choosing to wait for a pullback. Even if they reduce their position size so that the dollar risk is the same as with any other trade, the thought of risking two or three times as many ticks frightens them.
