每一次回调都始于某种反转建仓形态。这个反转之所以必要，是因为许多顺势交易者要靠它开始止盈，逆势交易者也要靠它建立仓位。是的，反转形态是机构制造出来的：顺势的机构止盈，逆势的机构开始分批建立反转交易。不过，还有许多其他机构和交易者会等到反转出现早期迹象之后才建立自己的仓位，所有交易者累积起来的效果就制造了这次回调。如果趋势很强而反转建仓形态很弱，回调有时只持续一两根K线，比如图 PIII.2中的第3根、第9根和第19根K线处。有时它只是一次停顿，形成一个横盘式的回调，比如第7根K线。


> Every pullback begins with some kind of reversal setup. The reversal is needed for many with-trend traders to begin to take profits, and for countertrend trades to initiate trades. Yes, institutions create the reversal pattern as the with-trend institutions take profits and the countertrend institutions begin to scale into reversal trades. However, lots of other institutions and traders wait for the early signs of a reversal before initiating their trades, and the cumulative effect of all traders creates the pullback. If the trend is strong and the reversal setup is weak, the pullback sometimes lasts only a bar or two, like at bars 3, 9, and 19 in Figure PIII.2. Sometimes it is just a pause and creates a sideways pullback, like bar 7.


市场出现了一段四根K线的空头急速行情，一直跌到第2根K线；但第三根和第四根K线的空头实体在缩小，说明动能正在流失。第2根K线上的影线是双边成交的信号。有些交易者认为这可能预示一次开盘反转、以及当日的低点，于是他们在第2根K线上方买入。


> There was a four-bar bear spike down to bar 2, but the third and fourth bars had shrinking bear bodies, indicating a loss of momentum. The tails on bar 2 are a sign of two-sided trading. Some traders thought that this could be signaling an opening reversal and the low of the day and they bought above bar 2.


从第5根K线开始的那段五根K线多头急速行情，足以让大多数交易者相信始终入场交易已经翻转为做多。他们预期价格会更高，也相信任何抛售都会被激进地买入、并形成一个更高的低点。不过，上涨到第8根K线为止共有三次推进，而这个楔形顶可能带来两段下跌。结果只出现了一根K线的回调，随后又是另一段强劲上涨。由于从第5根K线起的这轮上涨行情如此强劲，很多交易者相信任何回调都会被买入。


> The five-bar bull spike up from bar 5 was enough to make most traders believe that the always-in trade had flipped to long. They expected higher prices, and they believed that any sell-off would be bought aggressively and result in a higher low. However, there were three pushes up to bar 8, and this wedge top could have two legs down. This resulted in a one-bar pullback that was followed by another strong leg up. Since the rally up from bar 5 was so strong, many traders believed that any pullback would be bought.


一旦人人都相信下方有强劲的买盘，他们就干脆以市价买入。他们不知道市场近期会不会回调，但他们确实相信，无论回调与否，市场不久之后都会更高。与其冒着错过这段趋势太多部分的风险，他们开始以市价买入，并且一直买到他们认为市场可能终于要开始回调为止。


> Once everyone believes that there are strong buyers below, they just buy at the market. They don't know if the market will pull back soon but they do believe that whether or not it does, it will soon be higher. Rather than risk missing too much of the trend, they start buying at the market, and they keep buying until they think that the market might finally be starting to pull back.


在急速与高潮式多头趋势中的一段抛物线式上涨之后，第10根K线附近出现了一两根十字星K线。从第5根K线起的五根K线构成了这段多头急速行情。它同时也是当日的新高。有些交易者开始做空他们所认为的当日高点，但结果只是又一次回调。


> Bar 10 had a couple of doji bars after a parabolic move in a spike and climax bull trend. The five bars up from bar 5 formed the bull spike. It was also a new high of the day. Some traders began to short what they thought could be the high of the day, but it resulted in only another pullback.


有些交易者把第18根K线看作与第10根K线可能形成双顶，于是在那根内包K线信号K线下方做空。由于此前连续出现了七个多头实体，大多数交易者预期上涨还会继续，所以他们在那根信号K线的低点下方买入，而不是在那里做空。


> Some traders saw bar 18 as a possible double top with bar 10, and they shorted below the inside bar signal bar. Since there were seven consecutive bull bodies, most traders expected more uptrend so they bought below the low of that signal bar instead of shorting there.


第26根K线是一根空头反转K线，是在市场反转向下、跌破第16根K线处的交易区间底部之后可能出现的一个更低的高点。不过，更多交易者相信当天是一个强多头趋势日，他们在第26根K线的低点处及其下方买入。


> Bar 26 was a bear reversal bar and a possible lower high after a reversal down through the bar 16 bottom of the trading range. However, more traders believed that the day was a strong bull trend day and they bought at and below the low of bar 26.


![图 PIII.3](figures/fig-PIII-3.jpg)


**图 PIII.3　突破回调**


当通道很陡时，最好不要在突破趋势线时就做反转交易，而应该等着看是否会出现一个突破回调、形成第二个信号。在图 PIII.3中，上涨到第2根K线的急速行情太陡，不适合在第一次跌破趋势线时做空。相反，交易者只有在出现一次回测急速行情高点的突破回调时才应该考虑做空。这次回测可以是更低的高点、双顶，或者更高的高点。在这里，这个更高的高点出现在均线略下方的第4根空头反转K线处。


> When a channel is steep, it is better not to enter a reversal trade on the breakout through the trend line and instead wait to see if there is a breakout pullback that sets up a second signal. In Figure PIII.3, the spike up to bar 2 was too steep to short the first breakout below the trend line. Instead, traders should consider shorting only if there is a breakout pullback that tests the high of the spike. The test can be a lower high, a double top, or a higher high. Here, there was a higher high just below the moving average at the bar 4 bear reversal bar.


上涨到第6根K线的急速行情同样太强，不适合在跌破第6根K线时做空。空头原本希望出现一次成功的、跌破多头趋势线并向下方有良好后续行情的突破。相反，交易者应该先等一次突破回调，再考虑做空。在这里，第6根K线之后那根K线变成了外包上涨K线，它对从第5根K线到第6根K线那段紧凑通道的高点做了一次更高的高点回测。它后面跟着一根空头内包K线，形成一个 ioi（内包—外包—内包）更高的高点做空建仓形态。


> The spike up to bar 6 was also too strong to short on the breakout below bar 6. The bears were hoping for a successful breakout below the bull trend line with good follow-through to the downside. Instead, traders should wait for a breakout pullback before considering going short. Here, the bar after bar 6 became an outside up bar, and it was a higher high test of the high of the tight channel from bar 5 up to bar 6. It was followed by a bear inside bar, forming an ioi (inside-outside-inside) higher high short setup.


从第8根K线上涨到第9根K线的通道连续出现四根多头趋势K线，因此太强，不适合在第一次跌破该通道时做空。交易者应该先等一等，看突破回调长什么样。它在第11根K线处形成了一个更低的高点，他们可以在该K线低点下方1个最小报价单位处做空。


> The channel from bar 8 up to bar 9 had four consecutive bull trend bars and was therefore too strong to short the first breakout below the channel. Instead, traders should wait to see what the breakout pullback looked like. It was a lower high at bar 11, and they could go short at one tick below its low.


从第12根K线到第14根K线的多头通道非常紧凑，因此交易者不应该在跌破趋势线时做空。相反，他们应该等着看是否有好的突破回调做空建仓形态。第16根K线形成了一次对通道高点的更低的高点回测，当第16根K线跌破前一根K线的低点、变成一根外包下跌K线时，交易者就可以做空。另一种做法是等这根K线收盘。一旦看到它带空头实体、并且收在前一根K线低点之下，他们就可以在第16根外包下跌K线的低点下方做空；这是一笔概率更高的做空，因为那个空头收盘给了他们额外的确认：空头很强。


> The bull channel from bar 12 to bar 14 was very tight and therefore traders should not short the breakout below the trend line. Instead, they should wait to see if there was a good breakout pullback short setup. Bar 16 formed a lower high test of the channel high, and traders could short as bar 16 fell below the low of the prior bar and became an outside down bar. Alternatively, they could wait for the bar to close. Once they saw that it had a bear body and it closed below the low of the prior bar, they could short below the low of the bar 16 outside down bar, which is a higher-probability short since that bear close gave them additional confirmation that the bears were strong.


下跌到第17根K线的抛售处在一段紧凑通道中，并且连续七根K线没有出现多头收盘。这太强了，不适合在第一次尝试向上突破时买入。突破回调是到第20根K线处的一个更低的低点，而买入建仓形态是一个 ii（内包内包）形态。


> The sell-off down to bar 17 was in a tight channel and there were seven bars without a bull close. This is too strong to buy the first attempt to break out to the upside. The breakout pullback was to a lower low at bar 20, and the buy setup was an ii (inside-inside) pattern.


上涨到第21根K线的这轮上涨行情处在一段陡峭的多头通道中，连续七根K线创出更高的低点和更高的高点。这太强了，不适合在第一次跌破多头通道时做空。回调到第23根K线的突破回调，与第21根K线处的通道高点形成了双顶。随后那根K线是一根强势的空头内包K线，它是这次突破回调做空的一个好信号K线。


> The rally to bar 21 was in a steep bull channel with seven bars with higher lows and highs. This is too strong to short the first breakout below the bull channel. The breakout pullback to bar 23 formed a double top with the bar 21 channel high. The following bar was a strong bear inside bar, which was a good signal bar for the breakout pullback short.


下跌到第5根K线的行情是一面牛旗，它之后跟着一次突破，然后是一次回调到第8根K线的走势，而第8根K线位于另一面牛旗的底部。随后市场突破到第9根K线，又形成一次回调到第12根K线的走势，那是又一个牛旗买入建仓形态。市场经常出现这样的情形：突破引出回调，而回调又变成旗形。这通常发生在较弱的趋势和交易区间中，就像这里一样。


> The move down to bar 5 was a bull flag, and it was followed by a breakout and then a pullback to bar 8, which was at the bottom of another bull flag. It then broke out to bar 9 and formed another pullback to bar 12, which was another bull flag buy setup. The market often has breakouts that lead to pullbacks that become flags. This usually happens in weaker trends and in trading ranges, as it did here.


尽管第5根和第12根K线都是强势空头趋势K线、也都是试图把始终入场仓位翻转为做空的尝试，但它们做了大多数此类尝试都会做的事——失败了。空头还需要再来一根强势空头趋势K线，才能让交易者相信短期趋势向下、并且在接下来几根K线中价格很可能走低。当多头在不停地买入、空头又根本压不下去这一局面变得清楚时，空头便买回了自己的空头仓位。他们的买入，再加上那些把强空头趋势K线看作低价买入良机的多头持续买入，促成了多头趋势的恢复。多头喜欢看到强势空头趋势K线打到支撑位。他们知道这类K线代表空头试图反转趋势，而大多数都会很短暂、并且失败。他们常常退到一边等它形成，并把它看作回调可能结束的标志。这给了他们一个低价买入的短暂机会。有经验的交易者可以在那根空头趋势K线的收盘价处、在它的低点处及其下方、以及在接下来一两根K线的收盘价处买入。大多数交易者则应该等一根多头反转K线，在它的高点上方买入；或者等反转向上出现后，再买入牛旗突破之后那次回调的上方（比如第12根K线高2牛旗在第13根K线完成突破之后，那两根K线的横盘回调的上方）。


> Although bars 5 and 12 were strong bear trend bars and attempts to flip the always-in position to short, they did what most such attempts do—they failed. The bears needed one more strong bear trend bar before they could convince traders that the short-term trend was down and lower prices were likely over the next several bars. When it became clear that the bulls were buying relentlessly and the bears could not push the market down, they bought back their shorts. Their buying, combined with the continued buying by the bulls who saw the strong bear trend bars as great opportunities to buy at a low price, resulted in the resumption of the bull trend. Bulls like to see strong bear trend bars into support. They know that they represent attempts by the bears to reverse the trend and that most will be brief and fail. They often step aside and wait for one to form, and they see it as a likely end of the pullback. This gives them a brief opportunity to buy at a low price. Experienced traders can buy at the close of the bear trend bar, at and below its low, and at the close of the next couple of bars. Most traders should instead wait for a bull reversal bar and buy above its high, or wait for the reversal up, and then buy above a pullback from the breakout of the bull flag (like above the two-bar sideways pullback that followed the bar 13 breakout of the bar 12 high 2 bull flag).


# 第 11 章　第一次回调序列：K线、小趋势线、均线、均线缺口、主要趋势线

*11. First Pullback Sequence: Bar, Minor Trend Line, Moving Average, Moving Average Gap, Major Trend Line*


趋势中可能出现的回调有很多种，有些浅、有些深，可以按幅度大小对它们进行分类和排序。其中任何一类第一次出现时，都是该类回调的第一次回调。此后每一次回调，都会是更大一类回调中的第一次；而每一次回调之后，通常都会跟着一次对趋势极值的测试，因为强劲的行情通常至少有两段行情。因此，每一类逆势行情的第一次出现，之后都很可能跟着趋势中的又一段行情。这些回调并不一定严格按照同一个顺序出现。比如，如果高2之后趋势加速了，有时会出现高1在高2之后发生的情况。


> There are many types of pullbacks that can occur in a trend, some shallow and others deep, and they can be classified and ranked in terms of their extent. The first time any one of them appears is a first pullback for that type of pullback. Each subsequent pullback will be the first one of a larger variety, and each one will usually be followed by a test of the trend extreme since strong moves generally have at least two legs. Each type of first countertrend move will therefore likely be followed by another leg in the trend. The pullbacks don't have to occur in the exact same order. For example, sometimes a high 1 will occur after a high 2 if the trend accelerated after the high 2.


随着多头趋势推进，它终将失去动能，变得更偏向双边，并开始出现回调。这些回调会变得更大，并演变成交易区间，而交易区间最终会反转成空头趋势。在最终反转之前，每一次逆势行情之后通常都会跟着趋势的又一个新高。因此，每一个弱势信号在理论上都是一个买入建仓形态，而在下面这份清单里的任何一项形成之前，每一项都可能先出现好几次。而且，某一项可能出现之后，等其它项都出现过，它又可能再次出现。


> As a bull trend progresses, it eventually loses momentum, becomes more two-sided, and starts to have pullbacks. The pullbacks become larger and evolve into a trading range, and eventually a trading range will reverse into a bear trend. Prior to the final reversal, each countertrend move is usually followed by another high in the trend. Therefore, each sign of weakness is theoretically a buy setup, and each can occur several times before any other on the following list develops. Also, one can occur and then occur again later after others have occurred.


下面就是多头趋势中弱势信号大致的出现顺序：


> Here is the general order in which signs of weakness in a bull trend develop:


- 多头实体变小。
- 上影线开始出现在K线顶部，并在随后的K线上变得更大。
- K线与各自前一根K线的重叠比此前更多。
- 某根K线实体很小，或是十字星实体。
- 某根K线是空头实体。
- 当前K线的高点位于前一根K线高点处或之下。


> • The bull bodies become smaller. • Tails start to form on the tops of bars, and the tails become larger on subsequent bars. • Bars overlap their respective prior bars more than they did earlier. • A bar has a very small body or a doji body. • A bar has a bear body. • The high of the current bar is at or below the high of prior bar.


- 当前K线的低点位于前一根K线低点处或仅略高于它。
- 当前K线的低点低于前一根K线的低点。
- 出现一段式回调（高1买入建仓形态），此时该K线的高点低于前一根K线的高点。
- 出现两段式回调（高2买入建仓形态），只持续5根到大约10根K线。
- 出现三段式回调（楔形牛旗或三角形），只持续5根到大约15根K线。
- 小多头趋势线被突破。
- 某根K线触及均线（20根均线缺口K线买入建仓形态）。
- 下一轮涨到新高的上涨行情中出现一根或多根空头趋势K线，以及一两次回调。
- 某根K线的收盘价低于均线。
- 某根K线的高点低于均线（一根均线缺口K线）。
- 主要多头趋势线被突破。
- 一旦出现一根高点低于均线的K线，市场要重新升到均线上方，就得先走出第二段下跌行情。


> • The low of the current bar is at or just above the low of the prior bar. • The low of the current bar is below the low of the prior bar. • There is a one-legged pullback (a high 1 buy setup), where the high of the bar is below the high of the prior bar. • There is a two-legged pullback (a high 2 buy setup) lasting only five to about 10 bars. • There is a three-legged pullback (a wedge bull flag or a triangle) lasting only five to about 15 bars. • There is a break of a minor bull trend line. • A bar touches the moving average (a 20 gap bar buy setup). • The next rally to a new high has one or more bear trend bars and a pullback or two. • A bar has a close below the moving average. • A bar has a high below the moving average (a moving average gap bar). • There is a break of a major bull trend line. • Once there is a bar with a high below the moving average, there is a second leg down before the market gets back above the moving average.


- 涨到新高的上涨行情有两次或更多次回调，每次持续两三根K线，并且空头实体更加醒目。
- 出现一次更大的两段式回调，持续10根K线以上，第二段下跌行情跌破一个醒目的更高低点，形成更低的低点。
- 市场进入交易区间，多头K线和空头K线大致同样醒目。
- 市场向上突破交易区间，随后又回到交易区间之内，形成一个更大的交易区间。 下面则是空头趋势变弱的顺序：


> • The rally to the new high has two or more pullbacks, each lasting two or three bars and having more prominent bear bodies. • There is a larger two-legged pullback, lasting more than 10 bars, with the second leg down falling below a prominent higher low, forming a lower low. • The market enters a trading range, and the bull and bear bars are about equally prominent. • The market breaks above the trading range and comes back into the trading range, forming a larger trading range. This is the sequence of weakening of a bear trend:


- 空头实体变小。
- 下影线开始出现在K线底部，并在随后的K线上变得更大。
- K线与各自前一根K线的重叠比此前更多。
- 某根K线实体很小，或是十字星实体。
- 某根K线是多头实体。
- 当前K线的低点位于前一根K线低点处或之上。
- 当前K线的高点位于前一根K线高点处或仅略低于它。


> • The bear bodies become smaller. • Tails start to form on the bottoms of bars, and the tails become larger on subsequent bars. • Bars overlap their respective prior bars more than they did earlier. • A bar has a very small body or a doji body. • A bar has a bull body. • The low of the current bar is at or above the low of prior bar. • The high of the current bar is at or just below the high of the prior bar.


- 当前K线的高点高于前一根K线的高点。
- 出现一段式回调（低1卖出建仓形态），此时该K线的低点高于前一根K线的低点。
- 出现两段式回调（低2卖出建仓形态），只持续5根到大约10根K线。
- 出现三段式回调（楔形熊旗或三角形），只持续5根到大约15根K线。
- 小空头趋势线被突破。
- 某根K线触及均线（20根均线缺口K线卖出建仓形态）。
- 下一轮跌到新低的下跌行情中出现一根或多根多头趋势K线，以及一两次回调。
- 某根K线的收盘价高于均线。
- 某根K线的低点高于均线（一根均线缺口K线）。
- 主要空头趋势线被突破。
- 一旦出现一根低点高于均线的K线，市场要重新跌到均线下方，就得先走出第二段上涨行情。
- 跌到新低的这波抛售有两次或更多次回调，每次持续两三根K线，并且多头实体更加醒目。


> • The high of the current bar is above the high of the prior bar. • There is a one-legged pullback (a low 1 sell setup), where the low of the bar is above the low of the prior bar. • There is a two-legged pullback (a low 2 sell setup) lasting only five to about 10 bars. • There is a three-legged pullback (a wedge bear flag or a triangle) lasting only five to about 15 bars. • There is a break of a minor bear trend line. • A bar touches the moving average (a 20 gap bar sell setup). • The next rally to a new low has one or more bull trend bars and a pullback or two. • A bar has a close above the moving average. • A bar has a low above the moving average (a moving average gap bar). • There is a break of a major bear trend line. • Once there is a bar with a low above the moving average, there is a second leg up before the market gets back below the moving average. • The sell-off to the new low has two or more pullbacks, each lasting two or three bars and having more prominent bull bodies.


- 出现一次更大的两段式回调，持续10根K线以上，第二段上涨行情升到一个醒目的更低的高点之上，形成更高的高点。
- 市场进入交易区间，多头K线和空头K线大致同样醒目。
- 市场向下跌破交易区间，随后又回到交易区间之内，形成一个更大的交易区间。 大多数第一次回调都属于小级别，仍然是大趋势第一段行情的一部分。不过，随着逆势交易者越来越愿意建仓、顺势交易者越来越急于止盈，每一次回调往往都会变得更大。逆势交易者开始在新的极值处夺取控制权。比如在多头趋势中，交易者将开始能够通过做空新高处的反转来赚钱，而顺势交易者在新高突破处买入则会开始亏钱。到了某个时点，逆势交易者将压过顺势交易者，趋势将反转。


> • There is a larger two-legged pullback, lasting more than 10 bars, with the second leg up reaching above a prominent lower high, forming a higher high. • The market enters a trading range, and the bull and bear bars are about equally prominent. • The market breaks below the trading range and comes back into the trading range, forming a larger trading range. Most of the first pullbacks are minor and are still part of the larger trend's first leg. However, each pullback tends to be greater as the countertrend traders become more willing to take positions and the with-trend traders become quicker to take profits. Counter-trend traders start to take control at new extremes. For example, in a bull trend, traders will start to be able to make profitable trades by shorting reversals from new highs, and with-trend traders will begin to lose when they buy breakouts to new highs. At some point, the countertrend traders will overwhelm the with-trend traders and the trend will reverse.


强趋势中的第一次小回调是一段持续一到两根K线的回调，它后面几乎总会跟着一个新的极值。比如，如果有一段持续4根K线的多头急速行情，K线之间重叠很少，影线也很小，那么这个趋势就很强。如果下一根K线的低点低于前一根K线的低点，这就是这个多头趋势中的第一次回调。交易者会在它的高点上方挂买入止损单，因为他们预期至少还会有一次向上的推进。如果他们的订单成交了，这就是一次高1做多入场，本书第17章会详细讨论。激进的交易者会用限价单在前一根K线低点下方买入，他们预期这次回调会很短暂，并且想比那些等着在回调K线或回调K线组上方用止损单买入的交易者拿到更低的价格。下一次回调可能有3到5根K线长，很可能会跌破一条小趋势线，然后跟着又一个新极值。如果这次回调有两个小段，那么做多入场就是高2做多（两段式回调，通常称为 ABC 回调）。虽然这第二次回调可以是一个高2建仓形态，但如果趋势非常强，它也可以是又一次高1（一段式回调）。如果市场先是出现一两次高1入场，然后出现一次高2入场，而眼下看起来它又在形成另一次高1，那么明智的做法是等待。在一连串赚钱的交易之后，如果还没有先看到一次更大的回调，你就应该对这种重新出现的强势保持怀疑，因为这种强势可能是在布置一个陷阱（比如末端旗形，第3册会讨论）。更好的做法是等待更多价格行为、错过一个可能的陷阱，而不是因为把自己骗得相信自己是在拿别人的钱交易，就觉得自己无所不能、毫无畏惧。如果你真去做这笔交易，这些钱很可能就会变成别人的钱。


> The first minor pullback in a strong trend is a one-or two-bar pullback, which almost always is followed by a new extreme. For example, if there is a bull spike that goes on for four bars and there is little overlap between the bars and the tails are small, the trend is strong. If the next bar has a low below the low of the prior bar, this is the first pullback in this bull trend. Traders will place a buy stop above its high, since they expect at least one more push up. If their order is filled, this is a high 1 long entry, which is discussed in detail in Chapter 17 in this book. Aggressive traders will buy on a limit order below the low of the prior bar, expecting the pullback to be brief and wanting to get in at a lower price than the traders who are waiting to buy on a stop above the pullback bar or bars. The next pullback might be three to five bars long and will likely break a minor trend line and then be followed by another new extreme. If this pullback has two small legs, then the buy entry is a high 2 long (a two-legged pullback, commonly called an ABC pullback). Although this second pullback can be a high 2 setup, if the trend is very strong, it can be another high 1 (a one-legged pullback). If the market went from one or two high 1 entries and then a high 2 entry, and it appeared to be setting up another high 1, it is wise to wait. After a series of winning trades, you should be suspicious of renewed strength without first seeing a larger pullback, since this strength might be a trap setting up (like a final flag, discussed in book 3). It is better to wait for more price action and miss a possible trap than to feel invincible and fearless because you fooled yourself into believing that you are playing with someone else's money. If you trade, it will likely become someone else's money.


在强空头趋势中情况正好相反：第一次回调通常是一段持续一到两根K线的短暂低1做空入场，之后的回调则会有更多的K线和更多的段。比如，一次 ABC 回调有两段，形成一个低2做空入场。


> The opposite is true in a strong bear trend, where the first pullback is usually a brief one-or two-bar low 1 short entry and later pullbacks have more bars and more legs. For example, an ABC pullback has two legs and sets up a low 2 short entry.


如果趋势很强，它可能连续两个小时或更久都不靠近均线，但一旦触及均线，它很可能会形成又一个顺势建仓形态，从而引出又一个新极值，或者至少是对旧极值的一次测试。在多头趋势中回调到均线时，许多交易者认为价格已经折让得足够多，可以买入了。在上方做空的空头会买回空头仓位止盈；在高位止盈的多头会考虑再度买入；而此前一直在场外等待更低价位的交易者，会把均线视为支撑，认为折让已经足够，可以建立新的多头仓位。如果市场在大约10到20根K线之后仍无法升到均线上方，那很可能是因为交易者想要更大的折让才会积极买入。价格还不够低，不足以吸引足够的买家把市场抬起来。结果是，市场必须先跌得更深，等足够多的买家回来，才能把市场上抬到测试旧高点。同样的过程会发生在所有支撑位。


> If the trend is strong, it might stay away from the moving average for two hours or more, but once it hits the moving average, it will likely form another with-trend setup that will lead to another new extreme, or at least a test of the old extreme. In a pullback to the moving average in a bull trend, many traders believe that the price is at a good enough discount for them to buy. The bears who shorted above will buy back their shorts to take profits; the bulls who took profits higher will look to buy again; and the traders who had been on the sidelines, waiting for lower prices, will see the moving average as support and a sufficient discount for them to initiate new longs. If the market cannot move above the moving average after about 10 to 20 bars, it is probably because traders want more of a discount before aggressively buying. The price is not low enough yet to attract sufficient buyers to lift the market. The result is that the market will have to fall further before enough buyers return to lift the market up to test the old highs. This same process happens at all support levels.


如果回调越过了均线，就会出现第一次均线缺口K线建仓形态（比如在一个强劲的多头趋势中，终于出现一次回调，其中有一根K线的高点低于指数移动平均线）。这之后通常是对极值的一次测试，而且很可能是一个新极值。最终会出现一次逆势行情，跌破一条主要趋势线，而这次行情往往就是回调到第一根均线缺口K线的那次。它之后会跟着一次对极值的测试，这次测试可能未及靶位（空头趋势中是更高的低点，多头趋势中是更低的高点），也可能过靶（空头趋势中是更低的低点，多头趋势中是更高的高点）。这之后通常至少会跟着一次两段式的逆势行情，甚至是一次趋势反转。在反转之前的每一次回调，都是一次顺势入场，因为每一次都是某一类（K线、小趋势线、均线、均线缺口或主要趋势线）的第一次回调；而任何一类第一次回调，通常都至少会引出对极值的一次测试，并且通常会引出新极值——直到主要趋势线被跌破之后，情况才不再如此。


> If a pullback goes beyond the moving average, it will have the first moving average gap bar setup (for example, in a strong bull trend, there is finally a pullback that has a bar with a high below the exponential moving average). This is usually followed by a test of the extreme and likely a new extreme. Eventually, there will be a countertrend move that will break a major trend line, and it often is the pullback to the first moving average gap bar. It will be followed by a test of the extreme, which may undershoot (higher low in a bear trend or lower high in a bull trend) or overshoot (lower low in a bear trend or higher high in a bull trend) the old extreme. This is then usually followed by at least a two-legged countertrend move, if not a trend reversal. Each pullback prior to the reversal is a with-trend entry, because each is a first pullback of one type or another (bar, minor trend line, moving average, moving average gap, or major trend line), and any type of first pullback is usually followed by at least a test of the extreme and usually a new extreme until after the major trend line is broken.


在5分钟图上交易时，并不值得花力气去关注更大时间级别的走势图；不过，5分钟图上那些较大的回调，很可能终结于15分钟、30分钟或60分钟图，甚至日线图、周线图或月线图上的一些有意义的点位，比如指数移动平均线（EMA）、突破点和趋势线。另外，回调到15分钟图均线的第一次回调，之后往往跟着一次对趋势极值的测试；然后是一次回调到30分钟或60分钟图均线的行情，这之后很可能又跟着一次对极值的测试。既然更大时间级别的这些有意义点位出现得相对稀少，花时间去寻找对这些点位的测试就会分散注意力，让交易者错过太多5分钟图上的信号。


> Although it is not worth the effort to pay attention to higher time frame charts when trading on a 5 minute chart, it is likely that the larger 5 minute pullbacks end at 15, 30, or 60 minute, or even daily, weekly, or monthly chart points of significance like exponential moving averages (EMAs), breakout points, and trend lines. Also, there is often a tendency for the first pullback to the 15 minute moving average to be followed by a test of the trend extreme, and then a pullback to the 30 or 60 minute moving average, which would likely be followed by another test of the extreme. With higher time frame points of significance occurring relatively infrequently, spending time looking for tests of those points will be a distraction and cause traders to miss too many 5 minute signals.


如果趋势很强，你已经做了好几笔赚钱的交易，但眼下出现好几根横盘K线，那么对继续入场要谨慎，因为这实际上已经是一个交易区间。在多头趋势中，如果区间低点附近有建仓形态，你可以买入；但对突破交易区间高点后追多要小心，因为空头可能愿意在新高卖出，而多头可能正开始在高点止盈。


> If a trend is strong and you have made several profitable trades but there are now several sideways bars, be cautious about further entries because this is effectively a trading range. In a bull trend, you can buy if there is a setup near the low of the range, but be careful buying a breakout of the high of the trading range, because bears might be willing to sell a new high and bulls might be beginning to take profits at the high.


在长时间下跌之后出现的熊旗里也是如此。横盘K线意味着买方和卖方都在活跃，所以你不想在跌破旗形低点后去追空。不过，如果旗形顶部附近出现做空建仓形态，你的风险很小，这笔交易就值得做。


> The same is true in a bear flag after a protracted down move. Sideways bars mean that both buyers and sellers are active, so you do not want to be shorting on a breakout of the low of the flag. However, if there is a short setup near the top of the flag, your risk is small and the trade is worth taking.


![图 11.1](figures/fig-11-01.jpg)


**图 11.1　后续的回调往往越来越大**


趋势中总会有回调，而且趋势延续得越久，它们往往越大。不过，在出现反转之前，每一次回调都至少应该测试前一个极值（在图 11.1中，也就是空头趋势中前一个当日低点），而这次测试通常会创造出一个新极值。


> In a trend there will always be pullbacks, and they tend to get larger the longer the trend extends. However, until there is a reversal, each pullback should at least test the prior extreme (in Figure 11.1, in a bear trend, the prior low of the day), and the test will usually create a new extreme.


第1根K线是在多头趋势线被跌破之后出现的一个两段式更高的高点。它以两根K线反转的方式掉头向下。此时，聪明的交易者会在这个潜在的新空头趋势中寻找做空入场，而不是在先前那个多头趋势中寻找做多入场。


> Bar 1 was a two-legged higher high after a bull trend line break. It reversed down in a two-bar reversal. At that point, smart traders were looking for short entries in the potential new bear trend instead of long entries in the prior bull trend.


第3根K线是在两根K线回调到均线之后的一次做空，而这轮回调是从昨日高点上方开始下跌反转的那段两根K线空头急速行情之后的第一次回调。它也是跌破昨日摆动低点之后的突破回调。


> Bar 3 was a short after a two-bar pullback to the moving average, which was the first pullback after the two-bar bear spike that started the reversal down from above yesterday's high. It was a breakout pullback following the breakout below yesterday's swing low.


第4根K线是第一次突破一条空头趋势线、也是第一次突破均线，虽然只是越过了大约一个最小报价单位，随后市场就创出了新低。它升到了一个小摆动高点上方，因此是一个小型的更高的高点，但它未能升到均线上方，也未能升到第3根K线之后那段空头急速行情的顶部之上，同样没能越过第3根K线之前的摆动高点。大多数交易者把这看作一次简单的两根K线反转，以及均线处的一个低2做空建仓形态。这段 ABC 的每一段行情都只有两三根K线，而如此少的K线数量，很少足以让交易者把这波小幅上涨看成一次趋势反转。


> Bar 4 was the first break of a bear trend line and of the moving average, albeit by only a tick or so, and was followed by a new low. It went above a minor swing high, and therefore was a small higher high, but it failed to get above the moving average, the top of the bear spike that followed bar 3, or the swing high before bar 3. Most traders saw this as a simple two-bar reversal and a low 2 short setup at the moving average. There were only two or three bars in each of the legs of this ABC, and that is rarely enough for traders to see this small rally as a trend reversal.


第5根K线是又一次对均线的测试，这次有两根K线收在均线上方，但都只是勉强收上去，而这次回调之后市场创出了新低。它没能升到第4根K线之后那个小摆动高点上方，反而差一个最小报价单位败下阵来，形成了一个双顶。交易者把第4根K线看成一个有意义的更低的高点，因为它之后跟着一个新的空头低点。在市场于第5根K线之后跌到新低之后，第5根K线就成了最近的一个有意义的更低的高点。


> Bar 5 was another test of the moving average, and this time there were two closes above the moving average, but barely, and the pullback was followed by a new low. Instead of moving above the small swing high that followed bar 4, it failed one tick shy and formed a double top. Traders saw bar 4 as a significant lower high because it was followed by a new bear low. Once the market fell to a new low after bar 5, bar 5 became the most recent lower high of significance.


空头把他们的保护性止损从第4根K线上方移到了第5根K线上方。


> Bears moved their protective stops from above bar 4 to above bar 5.


第8根K线突破了一条主要趋势线，形成了第一根均线缺口K线（一根低点位于 EMA 上方的K线）。第一根缺口K线之后通常是对低点的一次测试，但有时会出现二次入场。突破一条主要趋势线可能是新趋势的第一段行情，但它之后通常跟着一次对低点的测试，这次测试可能过靶、也可能未及靶位，之后才会展开至少两段行情的逆势行情（在这里，也就是空头趋势中的一波上涨行情）。此时，交易者需要开始寻找买入机会，而不是继续交易那个旧的空头趋势。第8根K线之后的那根停顿K线构成了一个做空建仓形态，因为它导致了向上突破空头趋势线的突破失败。


> Bar 8 broke a major trend line and formed the first moving average gap bar (a bar with a low above the EMA). The first gap bar is usually followed by a test of the low, but sometimes there is a second entry. The break of a major trend line might be the first leg of a new trend but will usually be followed by a test of the low that can either overshoot or undershoot the low before a countertrend move of at least two legs unfolds (here, in a bear trend, a rally). At this point, traders needed to be looking to buy instead of continuing to trade the old bear trend. The pause bar after bar 8 set up a short because it led to a failed breakout above the bear trend line.


涨到第8根K线的这波上涨行情还向上突破了第6根与第7根K线之间的那些小高点，在第8根K线处形成了一个小型的更高的高点。不过，第8根K线在更大级别的空头趋势中仍然是一个更低的高点。市场下跌很多根K线，一直跌到第9根K线，在那里测试了第6根K线的空头低点。然而，第9根K线没有创出新的空头低点，反而形成了一个更高低点。大多数空头会把他们的保护性止损移到第8根K线高点略上方。他们很可能会更早就出场了，因为他们判定市场已经反转为始终做多——这个判断出现在从第9根K线更高低点向上那两根K线多头急速行情之时，又或者出现在市场升到稍后由两根K线形成的那面牛旗上方之时。一旦市场升到第8根K线上方并形成一个更高的高点，他们就预期价格会更高。


> The rally to bar 8 also broke above the minor highs between bars 6 and 7, creating a minor higher high at bar 8. However, bar 8 was still a lower high in the larger bear trend. The market fell for many bars to bar 9, where it tested the bar 6 bear low. However, instead of reaching a new bear low, bar 9 formed a higher low. Most bears would have moved their protective stops to just above the bar 8 high. They would likely have exited sooner, because they decided that the market had reversed to always-in long on the two-bar bull spike up from the bar 9 higher low, or when it went above the two-bar bull flag that formed two bars later. Once the market went above bar 8 and formed a higher high, they expected higher prices.


市场在第7根和第9根K线处形成了一个双底牛旗。第9根K线向下扎破了第7根K线一个最小报价单位，打掉了止损，但它没能创出新低。多头在捍卫自己的多头仓位，并且积极逢低买入（吸筹）。第二段上涨行情在次日完成。


> The market formed a double bottom bull flag at bars 7 and 9. Bar 9 dipped one tick below bar 7, running stops, but it was not able to put in a new low. The bulls were defending their longs and were aggressively buying the dips (accumulation). The second leg up was completed the next day.


把第4根、第5根和第8根K线这三次对均线的测试放在一起比较，注意第5根K线刺穿均线的幅度大于第4根K线，而第8根K线刺穿的幅度又超过第5根K线。这是可以预期的；出现这种情况时，对建立做空仓位要小心，因为会有很多聪明的空头只在更高的价格做空，也会有很多多头自信到敢于逢低买入。这会削弱卖压，让你的做空入场变得有风险。


> Compare the bars 4, 5, and 8 tests of the moving average and notice that bar 5 penetrated it more than bar 4, and bar 8 had more penetration than bar 5. This is to be expected, and when this is the case be careful about placing a short trade, because there will be many smart bears who will short only at a higher price, and many bulls who will be confident enough to buy dips. This reduces the selling pressure and makes your short entry risky.


![图 11.2](figures/fig-11-02.jpg)


**图 11.2　均线处的回调**


在图 11.2中，市场在第1根K线的更低低点处反转向上。在涨到第4根K线的这波上涨行情里，有几次回调到20根K线指数移动平均线，每次都引出了新高。


> The market reversed at the bar 1 lower low in Figure 11.2. There were several pullbacks to the 20-bar exponential moving average that led to new highs on the move up to bar 4.


第4根K线是一次趋势通道线过靶，它引出了一轮到第5根K线的急速修正，这次修正测试了15分钟图的20根K线 EMA（点线），之后市场又去测试趋势高点（第6根K线是一个更高的高点）。


> Bar 4 was a trend channel line overshoot that led to a sharp correction to bar 5, which tested the 15 minute 20-bar EMA (dotted line) and was then followed by a test of the trend high (bar 6 was a higher high).


市场向下跳空跌到第7根K线；虽然起初看起来偏空，但这波下跌只是回调到60分钟图的20根K线 EMA（虚线）的第一次回调，它之后跟着第8根K线的新高。


> The market gapped down to bar 7, and, although the market initially appeared bearish, the move down was the first pullback to the 60 minute 20-bar EMA (dashed line) and it was followed by the bar 8 new high.


# 第 12 章　双顶熊旗与双底牛旗

*12. Double Top Bear Flags and Double Bottom Bull Flags*


多头趋势常常以双顶结束，空头趋势常常以双底结束。由于多头趋势中的一次回调就是一段小的空头趋势，这段小的空头趋势可能以双底结束。又因为它是多头趋势中的一次回调，所以它是一面牛旗，可以称为双底牛旗。它是多头趋势中的两段下跌行情，因此是一个高2做多建仓形态。它是一种特别可靠的高2做多建仓形态，所以我一般就称它为双底，以便与其它高2形态区分开。同样，空头趋势中的一次回调是一面熊旗，它是一段小的多头趋势，而这段小的多头趋势可能以双顶结束。如果真是这样，这个双顶就是双顶熊旗。


> A bull trend often ends with a double top, and a bear trend often ends with a double bottom. Since a pullback in a bull trend is a small bear trend, this small bear trend can end in a double bottom. Because it is a pullback in a bull trend, it is a bull flag and can be referred to as a double bottom bull flag. It is two legs down in a bull trend, and therefore a high 2 buy setup. It is a particularly reliable type of high 2 buy setup, so I generally refer to it as a double bottom to distinguish it from other high 2 patterns. Likewise, a pullback in a bear trend is a bear flag and it is a small bull trend, and that small bull trend can end with a double top. If it does, that double top is a double top bear flag.


在多头趋势中，多头常常把保护性止损向下移到最近那个更高的低点之下，因为他们希望趋势继续走出更高的低点和更高的高点。双底牛旗的形成，部分原因就是多头在最近那个摆动低点下方捍卫自己的移动止损。如果市场跌到最近那个摆动低点之下，交易者就会认为多头趋势变弱了，甚至可能已经结束。那将是一个更低的低点，他们会担心紧随其后的可能不是新高，而是一个更低的高点。若果真如此，市场就可能正在构建一段两段式修正（一个大型高2做多建仓形态），甚至是一次趋势反转。正因如此，如果多头对趋势怀有很强的信念，他们就会在最近那个摆动低点处以及仅高于它的位置大举买入，从而形成双底牛旗。空头趋势中的情况正相反，空头希望市场不断走出更低的高点和更低的低点。许多人会把保护性止损移动到最近那个更低的高点略上方，而强势的空头往往在任何涨向该最近更低的高点的上涨行情中积极做空。这可能导致双顶熊旗。


> In a bull trend, bulls often trail their protective stops below the most recent higher low, because they want the trend to continue to make higher lows and higher highs. A double bottom bull flag is, in part, due to bulls defending their trailing stops below the most recent swing low. If the market falls below the most recent swing low, traders will see the bull trend as weaker, and possibly over. That would be a lower low, and they would be concerned that it might be followed by a lower high instead of a new high. If so, the market might be forming a two-legged correction (a large high 2 buy setup), or even a trend reversal. Because of this, if the bulls have a lot of conviction in the trend, they will buy heavily at and just above the most recent swing low, creating a double bottom bull flag. The opposite is true in a bear trend, where the bears want the market to keep forming lower highs and lows. Many will trail their protective stops just above the most recent lower high, and strong bears often short aggressively on any rally up to that most recent lower high. This can result in a double top bear flag.


多头趋势或空头趋势中的任何一次回调，都可能演变成双底牛旗或双顶熊旗。有时两者会同时出现在同一次回调之中，这时这个小型交易区间就让市场进入了突破模式。如果市场向上突破，交易者会把这个形态看成双底牛旗；如果市场向下突破，他们会把它看成双顶熊旗。如果在这个形态之前有显著的向上或向下动量，那么这股动量会提高交易区间只是一段持续形态的可能性。举例来说，如果在交易区间之前刚刚出现一波强劲上涨，那么向上突破的可能性更大，交易者就应当买入区间底部那个双底向上反转的行情。如果随后真的向上突破，交易者会把这个形态看成双底牛旗。反之，如果交易区间之前市场正处于一段空头急速行情之中，交易者就应当找机会做空形态内部那个双顶向下反转的行情，并预期出现向下突破。如果真是这样，交易者会把这个交易区间看成双顶熊旗。


> Any pullback in a bull or bear trend can turn into either a double bottom bull flag or a double top bear flag. Sometimes both are present within the same pullback, and then this small trading range puts the market in breakout mode. If the market breaks to the upside, traders will see the pattern as a double bottom bull flag, and if it breaks to the downside, they will see it as a double top bear flag. If there is significant momentum up or down before the pattern, that momentum increases the odds that the trading range will just be a continuation pattern. For example, if there was a strong move up just before the trading range, an upside breakout is more likely and traders should look to buy the reversal up from a double bottom at the bottom of the range. If there is then an upside breakout, traders will see the pattern as a double bottom bull flag. If instead the market was in a bear spike just before the trading range, traders should look to sell the reversal down from a double top within the pattern and expect a downside breakout. If that happens, traders will see the trading range as a double top bear flag.


当一段多头趋势之后出现一次两段式回调，而其中某一段下跌行情是一段空头急速行情时——这种急速行情看起来也许平平无奇——空头会希望市场一直停留在第一段下跌行情之后那个更低的高点之下。他们会做空，试图把趋势反转为空头趋势。多头总是想要相反的结果，因为交易是一场零和博弈——对空头有利的事就对多头不利，反之亦然。从第二段下跌行情展开的上涨行情，常常在那个更低的高点处或略低于它的位置陷入停滞。多头希望这波上涨能越过那个更低的高点，扫掉空头的保护性止损，然后创出新高。空头会积极做空以阻止这件事发生，而且往往愿意在比那个更低的高点低一两个最小报价单位处以及在该更低的高点处大举做空。这就是为什么在调头向下之前，这波上涨常常会一路走到那个更低的高点。那是空头的最后防线，他们在那个更低的高点处会处于绝对最强的状态。如果空头获胜、市场调头向下，就会形成双顶熊旗，随后常常跟着一段空头通道。在那个更低的高点以及对它的双顶测试之后，空头接下来想要一个更低的低点，然后是一连串更低的高点和更低的低点。


> When there is a bull trend and then a two-legged pullback where either of the down legs is a bear spike, which might appear unremarkable, the bears will want the market to stay below the lower high that followed the first leg down. They will short in an attempt to reverse the trend into a bear trend. The bulls always want the opposite because trading is a zero-sum game—what's good for the bears is bad for the bulls and vice versa. The rally up from the second leg down often will stall at or just below the lower high. The bulls want the rally to go above the lower high, run the protective stops of the bears, and then reach a new high. The bears will short aggressively to keep that from happening and are often willing to short heavily at a tick or two below the lower high and at the lower high. This is why the rally often goes all the way up to the lower high before the market turns down. It is the final defense of the bears, and they will be at their absolute strongest at the lower high. If the bears win and the market turns down, this creates a double top bear flag, and a bear channel often follows. After the lower high and the double top test of the lower high, the bears next want a lower low and then a series of lower highs and lows.


无论从第二段下跌行情展开的这波上涨是在那个更低的高点处停滞、在其上方停滞还是在其下方停滞，只要市场随后再次抛售，它都可能与这次回调的底部构成一个双底。如果有一个合理的做多建仓形态，交易者就会买入，期待这个双底成为一面牛旗、随后创出多头趋势中的新高。许多在两段下跌行情底部买入的多头，会把保护性止损正好放在这次回调下方。如果市场先向上走、随后又跌回来，多头就会在第一段下跌行情底部上方一两个最小报价单位处积极买入，试图把市场推上去。他们不希望市场在那个更低的高点之后创出更低的低点，因为那是空头强势的信号，而且会提高市场继续下跌或转而横盘、而不是上涨的可能性。如果他们成功，就有可能恢复多头趋势。如果市场跌到第一段下跌行情底部之下的一两个最小报价单位处，就可能扫掉多头的保护性止损，然后向下突破、走出一段向下的等距运动。


> Whether or not the rally up from the second leg down stalls at the lower high, above it, or below it, if the market then sells off again, it can form a double bottom with the bottom of the pullback. If there is a reasonable buy setup, traders will buy it, looking for this double bottom to be a bull flag that will be followed by a new high in the bull trend. Many bulls who bought at the bottom of the two legs down will have their protective stops just below the pullback. If the market starts up and comes back down again, the bulls will buy aggressively at a tick or two above the bottom of the first leg down in an attempt to turn the market up. They don't want the market to create a lower low after the lower high, because this is a sign of strength by the bears and it would increase the chances that the market would trade either further down or sideways instead of up. If they succeed, they might be able to resume a bull trend. If the market falls a tick or two below the bottom of that first leg down, it might run the protective stops of the bulls and then break out into a measured move down.


两段式回调在任何趋势中都很常见，而且它们往往是横向的，两段行情的结束位置都在差不多的价位上。有时在趋势恢复之前，这次回调可以持续几十根K线。这段横盘走势的起点和终点往往是两段小行情，它们的极值在价格上非常接近（第二段急速行情可能略微过靶或未及第一段）。从每一段行情开始的趋势恢复，都是一次延续趋势的尝试。举例来说，如果先有一段空头趋势，然后出现一次回调，再然后市场又恢复抛售，那说明空头正在推动价格创出更低的低点、延续空头趋势。然而，如果市场在空头低点上方的买方多于卖方，形成的是一个更高的低点，那么空头就没能把市场压到新低。如果这第二段上涨没有引出新的多头趋势，而空头能够重新夺回控制权、构建出一个低2做空入场点，他们就会再次把市场压下去，试图让市场向下突破、创出新低。如果在与先前差不多的价位附近，多头又一次压倒了空头，那么空头就在同一个价位水平上失败了两次。当市场在尝试做某件事时失败了两次，它通常就会转而尝试去做相反的事。那两次结束在差不多同一价位、就在空头低点上方的向下推进，构成了一个双底牛旗。它是一个更高的低点，只不过有两个底而不是一个。它是失败的低2的一种，在这种情况下是可靠的买入信号。


> Two-legged pullbacks are common in any trend, and they are often horizontal with both legs ending around the same price. Sometimes the pullback can last for dozens of bars before the trend resumes. The sideways move often begins and ends with small legs that have extremes that are very close in price (the second spike can slightly overshoot or undershoot the first one). The trend resumption from each of the legs is an attempt to extend the trend. For example, if there is a bear trend and then a pullback, and then the market sells off again, the bears are pushing for a lower low and an extension of the bear trend. However, if instead the market finds more buyers than sellers above the bear low and forms a higher low, the bears have failed to drive the market down to a new low. If this second leg up does not result in a new bull trend and the bears are able to regain control and create a low 2 short entry, they will drive the market down again in an attempt to have the market break out to a new low. If again the bulls overwhelm the bears around the same price as they did earlier, the bears will have failed twice at the same price level. When the market fails twice in an attempt to do something, it usually then tries to do the opposite. Those two pushes down that ended around the same price, just above the bear low, create a double bottom bull flag. It is a higher low that has two bottoms instead of one. It is a type of failed low 2, and is a reliable buy signal in this situation.


同样，如果多头趋势中出现一波抛售，随后多头重新夺回对市场的控制、试图把价格推高到旧高点之上却失败了，那就说明空头成功地再次把市场压了下去，并构建出一个更低的高点。如果多头再一次夺回控制权、再次把市场向上推、试图创出新的多头高点，而空头又一次在与先前相同的价位附近压倒他们，那么就会出现一个双顶。既然市场两次尝试向上突破、创出新的多头高点都失败了，它很可能就会尝试朝相反的方向走。旧高点附近的多头不够多，无法创出新高，所以市场只好往下走，去寻找更多的多头。


> Similarly, if there is a sell-off in a bull trend but then the bulls regain control of the market and try to rally it up beyond the old high and fail, then the bears were successful in driving the market down again and they created a lower high. If the bulls once again take control and once more push the market up as they try for a new bull high, and again the bears overwhelm them around the same price as they did earlier, there will be a double top. Since the market twice tried to break out to a new bull high and failed, it will likely try to go in the opposite direction. There aren't enough bulls near the old high to create a new high, so the market will have to go lower to find more bulls.


这次回调没能成为多头趋势中一次成功的 ABC 回调（高2做多建仓形态），它没能找到足够多的多头来创出新高，结果就是形成一个更低的高点，而这个更低的高点是由双顶构成的。


> Instead of being a successful ABC pullback (a high 2 buy setup) in the bull trend, the pullback failed to find enough bulls to create a new high and the result was a lower high, which was made of a double top.


这种情况的一种常见形式出现在急速与通道趋势中。举例来说，如果先有一段向上的急速行情，随后一次回调引出一段多头通道，那么市场通常最终会向下修正，去测试通道的底部，并在那里试图再次向上转。这次对通道底部的测试，会与通道底部构成一个双底——而那个通道底部可能是几十根K线之前的事——又因为它处在多头趋势之中（一段急速与通道多头趋势），所以它是一个双底牛旗。


> A common form of this occurs in spike and channel trends. For example, if there is a spike up and then a pullback that leads to a bull channel, the market usually eventually corrects down to test the bottom of the channel, where it tries to turn up again. This test of the bottom of the channel creates a double bottom with the bottom of the channel, which might have been dozens of bars earlier, and since it is in a bull trend (a spike and channel bull trend), it is a double bottom bull flag.


头肩持续形态是另一种变体，由右肩两侧的急速行情构成一个双顶或双底。


> A head and shoulders continuation pattern is another variation, with the spikes on either side of the right shoulder forming a double top or bottom.


与那种位于一轮多头行情顶部、属于反转形态的双顶不同，双顶熊旗是一段已经在进行中的空头趋势里的持续形态。两种双顶都会带来一波抛售。由于双顶熊旗的作用与任何其它双顶一样，许多交易者干脆就称它为双顶，并且把它看成是一个已经调头向下的市场里某轮修正性上涨行情的顶部。同样，双底牛旗是一段上涨行情中的持续形态，而不是空头趋势底部的反转形态。双底牛旗就是一个双底，而且与所有双底一样，它是一个做多建仓形态。


> Unlike a double top that is a reversal pattern at the top of a bull move, a double top bear flag is a continuation pattern in a bear trend that is already underway. Both double tops lead to a sell-off. Since a double top bear flag functions like any other double top, many traders simply call it a double top and think of it as the top of a corrective move up in a market that has already turned down. Similarly, a double bottom bull flag is a continuation pattern in a move up and not a reversal pattern at the bottom of a bear trend. A double bottom bull flag is simply a double bottom, and like all double bottoms, it is a buy setup.


新多头趋势中的第一个更高的低点，常常呈现为双底牛旗；新空头趋势中的第一个更低的高点，常常就是双顶熊旗。


> The first higher low in a new bull trend often takes the form of a double bottom bull flag, and the first lower high of a new bear trend often is a double top bear flag.


当双顶熊旗或双底牛旗失败、市场朝错误的方向突破时，要盯住这次突破是否成功。如果它不成功，而在一两根K线之内就失败，市场通常就会构建出一个楔形旗的变体。举例来说，如果双底牛旗刚刚成型，市场却立刻反转、跌到双底之下，那么就可能存在一段向下的等距运动，其依据是这个失败双底的高度。这往往是一个做空建仓形态，交易者在比双底低一个最小报价单位处挂卖出止损单入场。不过，如果这次向下突破在一两根K线之内就失败，而市场又回到前一根K线的高点之上，那么这就是一个三次推进的底部入场点（作用上与楔形相同）。构成这个双底的两根K线构成了前两次向下推进，而这次突破失败就是最后一次向下推进。任何楔形的关键特征都是三次推进，而不是一个完美的楔形形状。


> When a double top bear flag or a double bottom bull flag fail and the market breaks out in the wrong direction, watch to see if the breakout is successful. If it is not and it fails within a bar or two, the market usually sets up a variation of a wedge flag. For example, if a double bottom bull flag sets up but the market immediately reverses and falls below the double bottom, there might be a downside measured move based on the height of the failed double bottom. This is often a short setup where traders enter on a sell stop at one tick below the double bottom. However, if the downside breakout fails within a bar or two and the market trades above the high of the prior bar, then this is a three-push bottom entry (functionally the same as a wedge). The two bars that formed the double bottom formed the first two pushes down, and the failed breakout is the final push down. The critical feature of any wedge is the three pushes, not a perfect wedge shape.


![图 12.1](figures/fig-12-01.jpg)


**图 12.1　牛旗**


一面顺势的牛旗，其做多入场方式是在前一根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处挂买入止损单，初始保护性止损放在那根信号K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处。入场K线收盘之后，如果它是一根趋势K线，就把止损移到该入场K线下方一个最小报价单位处。如果它是一根小K线，那么在你这个方向出现一根趋势K线之前，不要把止损收紧。


> A with-trend bull flag sets up a long entry on a buy stop order at one tick above the high of the previous bar, and the initial protective stop is one tick below the low of that signal bar. After the entry bar closes, the stop is moved to one tick below the entry bar if it is a trend bar. If it is a small bar, don't tighten the stop until there is a trend bar in your direction.


尽管双底是众所周知的、位于空头市场底部的反转形态，这些旗形在多头市场里却是顺势的建仓形态。它们终结了这次回调——而回调本身是一段小的空头趋势——所以可以说它们反转了回调，但最好还是把它们看成顺势形态。


> Although double bottoms are well-known reversal patterns at the bottom of bear markets, these flags are with-trend setups in bull markets. By ending the pullback, which is a small bear trend, they are reversing it, but it is better to think of them as with-trend patterns.


如图 12.1所示，第2根K线处的双顶熊旗失败了，并且带来了一个可交易的做多机会（还演变成了一个小型头肩底）。


> As shown in Figure 12.1, the double top bear flag at bar 2 failed and resulted in a tradable long (and became a small head and shoulders bottom).


第7根K线是一个双底牛旗的建仓形态，它位于一个小型交易区间之内，而这个区间刚刚形成过一个双顶熊旗。由于进入这个交易区间之前的动量是强劲向上的，概率更倾向于这个形态会向上突破、成为双底牛旗，而不是向下突破、成为双顶熊旗。无论向上还是向下突破，最小目标位都是根据这个小型交易区间的高度测算出的一段等距运动。


> Bar 7 was a setup for a double bottom bull flag within a small trading range that had just formed a double top bear flag. Since the momentum leading up to the trading range was strongly up, the odds favored that the pattern would break to the upside and become a double bottom bull flag, instead of breaking to the downside and becoming a double top bear flag. The minimum target after the breakout up or down is a measured move based on the height of the small trading range.


![图 12.2](figures/fig-12-02.jpg)


**图 12.2　双底牛旗**


如图 12.2所示，高盛（GS）从第3根K线到第4根K线走出一段多头急速行情，随后回调到第5根K线。接着是一段向上到第6根K线的通道，然后又回调到通道底部附近。这使第5根K线和第7根K线构成了一个双底牛旗，尽管中间还有第6根K线那个更高的高点。第5根K线是这轮多头趋势最后一个更高的低点，而第7根K线可能是空头趋势或交易区间的第一个摆动低点。这种情况下，如果从第7根K线展开的上涨没有再越过第6根K线，市场本可能形成一个头肩顶。无论如何，双底牛旗都是一个可靠的建仓形态，至少能做一次剥头皮。而且，由于大多数头肩顶——如同所有顶部形态一样——都会变成失败形态、进而成为持续形态，所以在多头趋势中，始终明智的做法是在任何交易区间的底部附近不断买入。在趋势当中，大多数反转形态都会失败，而大多数持续形态都会成功。


> As shown in Figure 12.2, Goldman Sachs (GS) had a bull spike up from bar 3 to bar 4 and then a pullback to bar 5. This was followed by a channel up to bar 6 and a pullback to around the bottom of the channel. This created a double bottom bull flag with bars 5 and 7, even though there was the bar 6 higher high in between. Bar 5 was the last higher low of the bull trend, and bar 7 was possibly the first swing low of a bear trend or trading range. In this situation, the market could have formed a head and shoulders top if bar 6 was not exceeded by the rally off bar 7. In any case, a double bottom bull flag is a reliable setup for at least a scalp. Also, since most head and shoulders tops, like all tops, turn into failures and become continuation patterns, it is always wise to keep buying near the bottom of any trading range in a bull trend. In a trend, most reversal patterns fail and most continuation patterns succeed.


在第3根K线的低点之后，还出现过一个小的双底牛旗，它由第3根K线之后的第三根和第七根K线构成。这是一个失败的低2做空建仓形态，而失败的低2常常会变成双底牛旗。


> There was also a small double bottom bull flag after the bar 3 low formed by the third and seventh bars that followed bar 3. This was a failed low 2 short setup, which often becomes a double bottom bull flag.


### 本图深入讨论


**回看 图 12.2**

![图 12.2](figures/fig-12-02.jpg)


> ### Deeper Discussion of This Chart


图 12.2中的第1根K线是一根强劲的多头反转K线，它把一次向下的突破反转了过来——那次突破跌到了移动平均线之下，也跌到了延续至昨日收盘的那个小型交易区间之下。随后出现一段两根K线的、向下到第3根K线的空头急速行情，接着市场转入横盘，多空双方为通道的方向展开争夺。由于多头急速行情更大（有些交易者认为急速行情结束于第1根K线的高点，另一些人认为它结束于第2根K线），概率更倾向于多头会构建出一段多头通道，而空头在急速下跌之后争取后续行情的尝试会失败。第3根K线之后的双底牛旗是一个更高低点的做多建仓形态，它引出了一段结束于第6根K线的楔形通道。既然它是楔形，那么出现两段下跌行情的可能性就很大；又因为它是多头急速与通道结构，所以对通道起点第3根K线一带的测试也很可能出现。有时这次测试要花上一天以上，但一旦它成形，市场通常就会试图与通道的低点构成一个双底。由于涨向第2根K线和涨向第6根K线的急速行情都如此强劲，市场也可能不会跌到第3根K线一带，而是转而构成一面楔形牛旗，让第5根K线和第7根K线充当前两次向下推进。事实上，情况正是如此，高盛在接下来的一天跳空高开。


> Bar 1 in Figure 12.2 was a strong bull reversal bar that reversed the breakout below the moving average and the small trading range into yesterday's close. There was a two-bar bear spike down to bar 3 and then the market went sideways as the bulls and bears fought over the direction of the channel. Because the bull spike was bigger (some traders saw the spike ending at the high of bar 1 and others saw it as ending at bar 2), the odds favored that the bulls would create a bull channel and that the bears would fail in their attempt to get follow-through after their spike down. The double bottom bull flag after bar 3 was a higher low buy setup that led to a wedge channel that ended at bar 6. Since it was a wedge, two legs down were likely, and since it was a bull spike and channel, a test of the bar 3 area where the channel began was also likely. Sometimes the test takes more than a day, but once it forms, the market usually tries to form a double bottom with the low of the channel. Because the spikes up to bar 2 and to bar 6 were so strong, the market might not come down to the bar 3 area, and instead might form a wedge bull flag with bars 5 and 7 being the first two pushes down. In fact, that is what happened, and GS gapped up on the following day.


![图 12.3](figures/fig-12-03.jpg)


**图 12.3　双底牛旗**


在图 12.3中，第2根K线与第3根K线、第5根K线与第6根K线各自构成了双底牛旗。第3根K线和第6根K线都略微未及它们各自的第一段行情，但形态很少是完美的。


> Bars 2 and 3 and bars 5 and 6 formed double bottom bull flags in Figure 12.3. Both bars 3 and 6 slightly undershot their first legs, but patterns are rarely perfect.


当双底就形成在趋势低点附近时——第2根K线与第3根K线那次就是如此——这个形态往往是一小段向上的急速行情加一个交易区间，而且它在更高时间级别的走势图上往往是一个 ii形态（内包内包）。


> When the double bottom forms right near the trend low as it did with bars 2 and 3, the pattern is often a small spike up and trading range, and it is often an ii pattern on a higher time frame chart.


从第4根K线开始的上涨几乎是垂直的，因此它是一段急速行情。从第5根K线开始的上涨是通道，尽管它同样近乎垂直。这是一段“急速加高潮”型的急速与通道多头趋势。在一段多头急速与通道形态的通道阶段之后，市场通常会去测试通道底部，并构建出一个双底牛旗，就像这里在第6根K线处那样。此后，市场通常会向上反弹，反弹幅度至少约为这个交易区间的四分之一。再往后，这个形态就走完了，交易者应该去找下一个形态。


> The move up from bar 4 was almost vertical and therefore a spike. The move up from bar 5 was the channel, even though it also was nearly vertical. This is a spike and climax type of spike and channel bull trend. After the channel phase of a bull spike and channel pattern, the market usually tests to the bottom of the channel and sets up a double bottom bull flag, as it did here, at bar 6. From there, the market usually bounces up to at least about a quarter of the trading range. After that, the pattern has played out and traders should look for the next pattern.


从第5根K线开始的上涨，在第4根K线上涨的顶部附近陷入停滞。有些交易者把这看成双顶熊旗并做空。市场随后抛售，并在第6根K线处、也就是第5根K线回调的价位附近找到支撑。许多做空双顶的交易者在测试第5根K线低点时止盈，而强势的多头通过积极买入守住了那个低点。这构建出一个双底牛旗信号。向上突破之后，大致走出了一段向上的等距运动。


> The move up from bar 5 stalled around the top of the move up from bar 4. Some traders saw this as a double top bear flag and shorted. The market then sold off and found support at bar 6 around the level of the bar 5 pullback. Many of the double top shorts took profits on the test of the bar 5 low, and strong bulls defended that low by buying aggressively. This set up a double bottom bull flag signal. The upside breakout went for an approximate measured move up.


![图 12.4](figures/fig-12-04.jpg)


**图 12.4　头肩顶或双底**


如图 12.4所示，高盛的日线图当时正在形成要么一个头肩熊旗，要么一个可能的双底回调（double bottom pullback）。市场先是一段向上到第2根K线的急速行情，随后回调到第3根K线处的更高低点，这个低点在两三周后被第4根K线重新测试。接着市场走出一段向上到第5根K线的多头通道，然后向下测试到第6根K线处的通道底部，并在那里与第4根K线的低点构成了一个双底牛旗。最小目标位是反弹到从第5根K线跌到第6根K线那段抛售高度的约25% 处。


> The daily chart of GS was forming either a head and shoulders bear flag or a possible double bottom pullback, as shown in Figure 12.4. The market had a spike up to bar 2 and then a pullback to a higher low at bar 3, which was retested a couple of weeks later at bar 4. Then the market had a bull channel up to bar 5 and then a test to the bottom of the channel at bar 6, where it set up a double bottom bull flag with the bar 4 low. The minimum objective is a bounce of about 25 percent of the height of the sell-off from bar 5 to bar 6.


对空头来说，左肩是第2根K线，右肩是第7根K线。空头希望市场跌破那条横穿第3、4、6根K线低点画出的颈线。不过，多头看到的是第4根K线和第6根K线构成的双底，他们想要一波上涨。他们会买入跌向第8根K线的回调，如果他们成功地把市场转向上，这就会成为一笔双底回调做多交易。


> For the bears, the left shoulder is bar 2 and the right shoulder is bar 7. The bears want the market to break below the neckline drawn across the lows of bars 3, 4, and 6. The bulls, however, see the double bottom formed by bars 4 and 6 and want a rally. They will buy the pullback down to bar 8, and if they are successful in turning the market up, this would become a double bottom pullback long trade.


抢跑的空头没有等待跌破颈线，而是在第7根K线右肩下方就做空了；如果市场涨到第7根K线右肩之上，他们就会买回自己的空头仓位。那样就会形成一个失败的头肩顶，而向上的最小目标位就是从第6根K线低点到第7根K线高点测算出的一段向上等距运动。


> The early bears shorted below the bar 7 right shoulder instead of waiting for the breakout below the neckline, and they would buy back their shorts if the market went above the bar 7 right shoulder. That would create a failed head and shoulders top, and the minimum objective to the upside would be a measured move up from the bar 6 low to the bar 7 high.


涨向第2根K线的上涨行情强到足以让大多数交易者相信市场很快会走高（他们相信市场已经翻转为始终做多）。这让交易者对两三周后形成的那个双顶熊旗心存犹豫，不愿做空。不过，由于在第1根K线可能形成底部以及强劲上涨到第2根K线之后，他们一直在寻找更高的价位，所以他们买入了第4根K线处那个双底牛旗。


> The rally up to bar 2 was strong enough for most traders to believe that the market would soon be higher (they believed that the market had flipped to always-in long). This made traders hesitant to short the double top bear flag that formed a couple of weeks later. However, because they were looking for higher prices after the possible bottom at bar 1 and the strong rally to bar 2, they bought the bar 4 double bottom bull flag.


![图 12.5](figures/fig-12-05.jpg)


**图 12.5　失败的双底**


在图 12.5中，市场先走出一段五根K线的空头急速行情，随后在第2根K线处出现一段两根K线的多头急速行情。第4根K线试图与第3根K线之前的那根K线、以及与第2根K线之后那根多头入场K线构成双底牛旗。第5根K线和第6根K线也曾试图把这个底部补齐。市场常常会跌破第一个底一个最小报价单位左右，把多头关在场外、把空头关在场内，第5根K线处就是这种情况。第6根K线是对第5根K线那次跌破第4根K线低点的假突破所做的精准回测，它是一根外包上涨K线，也是双底牛旗的入场K线或信号K线。它引出了第7根K线对区间顶部的突破，而这次突破很快就在一次两根K线反转中失败了。


> In Figure 12.5, the market formed a five-bar bear spike that was followed by a two-bar bull spike at bar 2. Bar 4 attempted to form a double bottom bull flag with the bar before bar 3 and with the bull entry bar after bar 2. Bars 5 and 6 also tried to complete the base. Often the market breaks below the first bottom by a tick or so, trapping bulls out and bears in, as was the case at bar 5. Bar 6 was an exact test of the bar 5 false breakout of the bar 4 low, and was an outside up entry bar or signal bar for a double bottom bull flag. It led to the bar 7 breakout of the top of the range, which quickly failed in a two-bar reversal.


市场在第8根K线处第二次向下突破交易区间、幅度为一个最小报价单位。重要的是要认识到，只要市场跌到那个低点之下——哪怕只低一个最小报价单位——交易者就会开始认为空头正在夺取控制权。他们会把这看成一次楔形底尝试的实质性失败：第4根K线是第一次向下推进，第5根K线处那一个最小报价单位的突破是第二次，第8根K线处又一个最小报价单位的突破是第三次。市场一旦跌到第8根K线之下，目标位就是一段大致的向下等距运动，可以用楔形的高度（第6根K线低点到第3根K线高点）来测算，也可以用交易区间的高度（第8根K线低点到第7根K线高点）来测算。这类三次推进形态可以在任何市场中出现，而向下突破的幅度也不必恰好是一个最小报价单位。举例来说，在一只价格在200美元左右的股票上，与这张图里第5根K线和第8根K线相当的突破，有可能是20美分甚至更多。


> The market made a second one-tick breakout below the trading range at bar 8. It is important to realize that if the market falls below that low by even a tick, traders will start to assume that the bears are taking control. They will see this as effectively a failed attempt at a wedge bottom, where bar 4 was the first push down, the one-tick breakout at bar 5 was the second, and the next one-tick breakout at bar 8 was the third. Once the market fell below bar 8, the target was an approximate measured move down using either the height of the wedge (the bar 6 low to the bar 3 high) or the height of the trading range (the bar 8 low to the bar 7 high). This type of three-push pattern can take place in any market, and the downside breakouts don't have to be exactly one tick. For example, in a stock that is trading around $200, the breakouts that are comparable to bars 5 and 8 in this chart might be 20 cents or more.


有些交易者会把从第6根K线起的反转向上看成对区间底部的突破失败，然后把第7根K线看成对区间顶部的突破失败。许多人会在顶部那次两根K线反转的下方做空，其中第7根K线是那两根K线里的第一根，因为他们知道交易区间常常会出现很快就失败的强劲突破。有些人会在涨向第9根K线的过程中于打平处离场，但随后还是在第9根K线那个更低的高点下方做了二次入场的做空。


> Some traders would see the reversal up from bar 6 as a failed breakout of the bottom of the range, and then bar 7 as a failed breakout of the top of the range. Many would short below the two-bar reversal at the top, where bar 7 was the first bar, because they know that trading ranges often have strong breakouts that quickly fail. Some would exit at breakeven on the rally to bar 9 but then would have taken the second entry short below the lower high at bar 9.


另一些交易者会按突破模式来交易，也就是在第6根K线下方挂卖出止损单、在第7根K线上方挂买入止损单。向下突破失败时套住了空头，随后向上突破失败时又套住了多头，而当多空双方都被套住时，下一次突破通常会走出一段像样的波段行情。尽管涨到第9根K线的上涨行情很强，空头还是会在它下方做空，因为他们会把这波上涨看成第8根K线突破之后的一次回调。


> Other traders would trade the market in breakout mode, looking to sell on a stop below bar 6 and buy on a stop above bar 7. There were trapped bears on the failed downside breakout and then trapped bulls on the failed upside breakout, and when there are trapped bulls and bears, the next breakout usually results in a decent swing. Although the rally to bar 9 was strong, the bears would short below it because they would see it as a pullback from the bar 8 breakout.


把这个例子与第11章中的图 11.1对比一下：那里也是在一段早期强劲的空头急速行情之后出现了一个类似的交易区间，但那个有望延续趋势的空头趋势日失败了，市场反转向上了。


> Compare this to Figure 11.1 in Chapter 11, where there was a similar trading range after an early strong bear spike, but the potential trend resumption bear day failed and the market reversed up.


![图 12.6](figures/fig-12-06.jpg)


**图 12.6　双底牛旗与一段向上的等距运动**


一个双底，如果在第二个低点之后出现一波急速上涨，随后在突破之后停顿一下，往往就会引出一段非常强劲的趋势。尽管图 12.6上没有显示出来，但昨天是一个多头趋势日。虽然任何双底——无论它是反转形态还是像这里这样的持续形态——对后续走势的预期都一样，但第1根K线和第8根K线构成了一个双底牛旗。涨向第10根K线的那段上涨远强于跌向第8根K线的那段下跌：每一根K线的开盘价、收盘价、最高价和最低价都高于之前所有K线。这种强势提醒交易者，这个双底牛旗可能引出一波强劲上涨。突破第5根K线之后，市场没有回调，而是转入横盘，这种建仓形态非常强，也相当常见。在向上到第12根K线的急速行情之后，市场回调到第14根K线，并与第11根K线构成了一个双底牛旗。此后是一段一直持续到收盘的多头通道。


> A double bottom followed by a sharp move off the second low and then a pause after the breakout often leads to a very strong trend. Even though the chart in Figure 12.6 does not show it, yesterday was a bull trend day. Although the expectation for the behavior is the same for any double bottom whether it is a reversal or a continuation pattern as it was here, bars 1 and 8 formed a double bottom bull flag. The move up to bar 10 was much stronger than the move down to bar 8, with every bar's open, close, high, and low above those of all of the prior bars. This strength alerted traders that this double bottom bull flag could lead to a strong move up. After breaking out above bar 5, the market went sideways instead of pulling back, and this setup is very strong and fairly common. After the spike up to bar 12, there was a pullback to bar 14 and it formed a double bottom bull flag with bar 11. This was followed by a bull channel that lasted for the rest of the day.


第18根K线与第16根K线构成了一个双底牛旗。记住，两个低点不必完全相同。如果一个形态看起来像教科书式的建仓形态，它很可能也会表现得差不多。第29根K线又与第27根K线构成了一个双底牛旗，并且再次在一段强劲的多头通道中构建出高2做多机会。高2其实就是一次两段式回调，而所有双底都是两段式回调。


> Bar 18 formed a double bottom bull flag with bar 16. Remember, the lows don't have to be exactly the same. If a pattern resembles a textbook setup, it will likely behave in a similar way. Bar 29 formed another with bar 27, and again set up a high 2 buy in a strong bull channel. A high 2 is simply a two-legged pullback, which all double bottoms are.


### 本图深入讨论


**回看 图 12.6**

![图 12.6](figures/fig-12-06.jpg)


> ### Deeper Discussion of This Chart


如图 12.6所示，昨天以一波强劲的多头上冲收盘，随后回调到略微低于移动平均线的位置，多头会在那里寻找一个更高的低点，然后等第二段上涨。跌向第6根K线的通道足够陡峭，因此交易者不应该在开盘时买入第7根K线那个外包上涨突破。第8根K线是一根强劲的多头反转K线，同时也是一个更高的低点，还是一个大型交易区间中的高2。它也是从连续两次卖出高潮反转向上。第一次卖出高潮是第5根K线多头通道之后那段三根K线的空头急速行情，第二次卖出高潮是由第7根K线尝试反转向上之后那两根强劲的空头趋势K线构成的。连续出现的高潮之后，通常至少会跟着一段两段式逆势行情，而且往往跟着一次反转。由于这一切发生在头一个小时之内，它可能正在构建当日的低点，多头应当把他们多头仓位的大部分做波段持有。


> As shown in Figure 12.6, yesterday closed with a strong bull run and then a pullback to just below the moving average, where bulls would be looking for a higher low and then a second leg up. The channel down to bar 6 was steep enough so that traders should not buy the bar 7 outside up breakout on the open. Bar 8 was a strong bull reversal bar, as well as a higher low and a high 2 in a large trading range. It was also a reversal up from consecutive sell climaxes. The first sell climax was the three-bar bear spike that followed the bar 5 bull channel, and the second sell climax was formed by the two strong bear trend bars that followed the bar 7 attempt to reverse up. Consecutive climaxes are usually followed by at least a two-legged countertrend move and often a reversal. Since this was occurring within the first hour, it could be setting up the low of the day and bulls should swing much of their long position.


涨向第10根K线的急速行情之后，跟着一根大的多头趋势K线，从而构成一段“急速加高潮”型的急速与通道多头趋势。市场向下修正到那段短暂通道的起点第14根K线处，并在那里形成了意料之中的双底牛旗。


> The spike up to bar 10 was followed by a large bull trend bar, creating a spike and climax type of spike and channel bull trend. The market corrected down to the bar 14 start of the brief channel, where it formed the expected double bottom bull flag.


从第14根K线开始的那段漫长的多头通道，之前是一段多头急速行情。有些交易者把从第8根K线到第10根K线的走势看成急速行情，把从第10根K线到第11根K线的走势看成回调——在那里，依托微型趋势线构建出了一个高1做多机会。那段跌向第11根K线的窄幅通道下方出现过一次小幅跌破，随后是一次创出更高的高点的回调、到达第12根K线，然后是第二段下跌、到达第14根K线。


> The protracted bull channel from bar 14 followed a bull spike. Some traders saw the spike as the move from bar 8 to bar 10 and the pullback as the move from bar 10 to bar 11, where a micro trend line high 1 long set up. The small breakout below that tight channel down to bar 11 was followed by a higher high pullback to bar 12 and then a second leg down to bar 14.


另一些交易者——尤其是那些使用更高时间级别走势图的交易者——把从第8根K线到第12根K线的走势看成急速行情，把第14根K线处那次两段式移动平均线测试看成引出这段大型多头通道的回调。


> Other traders, especially those using a higher time frame chart, saw the move from bar 8 to bar 12 as the spike, and the two-legged moving average test at bar 14 as the pullback that led to the large bull channel.


第12根K线下方的做空，同时也是第11根K线末端旗形带来的一次反转，并且是从昨日高点开始的第二次反转。


> The short below bar 12 was also a reversal from the bar 11 final flag, and a second reversal from yesterday's high.


第14根K线之前两根K线处有一根大的空头趋势K线，因此那是一段向下的急速行情。由于它紧随一段相对不久前（九根K线之前）的向上急速行情，它就构成了一次买入高潮（一根多头趋势K线之后跟着一根空头趋势K线）。这一点也许并不明显，但你可以去看不同的时间级别，找到那种把整个形态看成一次两根K线反转的级别（事实上，在30分钟图上它就是一次两根K线反转）。这一点根本没有必要，因为你可以从5分钟图上推断出来。每当出现任何高潮，市场很快就会变得不确定，因为多空双方都会加仓，各自试图构建出一段朝自己方向的通道。不确定就意味着市场处在交易区间之中，而有些交易者把从第14根K线到第17根K线那个略高的高点的两段式上涨，仅仅看成第14根K线空头急速行情之后的一次更高的高点回调。考虑到这波走势包含许多十字星K线，这是一种说得通的解读。不过，多头从第14根K线起构建出一段两根K线的多头急速行情，而这与第14根K线之前两根K线处形成的那根空头K线构成了一次卖出高潮。再说一遍，一根空头趋势K线之后很快跟着一根多头趋势K线就是卖出高潮，而你能找到某个时间级别，在那里它就是一次两根K线的向上反转。


> There was a large bear trend bar two bars before bar 14, and this was therefore a spike down. Since it followed a spike up relatively soon (nine bars earlier), it created a buy climax (a bull trend bar followed by a bear trend bar). Although it may not be obvious, you could look at different time frames and find one where this entire pattern is just a two-bar reversal (in fact, it was one on the 30 minute chart). This is never necessary because you can infer it from the 5 minute chart. Whenever there is any climax, the market soon becomes uncertain because both the bulls and bears will add to their positions as they attempt to create a channel in their direction. Uncertainty means that the market is in a trading range, and some traders saw the two-legged move up from bar 14 to the slightly higher high at bar 17 as simply a higher high pullback from the bar 14 bear spike. This is a plausible interpretation, given that the move had many doji bars. The bulls, however, created a two-bar bull spike up from bar 14, and this created a sell climax with the bear bar that formed two bars before bar 14. Again, a bear trend bar followed soon after by a bull trend bar is a sell climax, and you can find some time frame where it is a two-bar reversal up.


第18根K线构建了一个失败低2的做多机会，随后交易者必须评估向上突破的动量，以判断市场更有可能至少再走两段上涨，还是只再推一次、形成一个楔形顶（即低3）。由于第10根K线以来的价格行为一直是双向的，这属于交易区间的表现，所以寻找低2做空建仓形态是合理的（在强多头趋势中不应该这么做）。


> Bar 18 set up a failed low 2 buy, and then traders had to evaluate the momentum of the upside breakout to determine whether it was more likely to have at least two more legs up or simply to have one more push up and form a wedge top (a low 3). Since the price action since bar 10 has been two-sided, this was trading range behavior and it was reasonable to be looking for low 2 short setups (you should not do that in a strong bull trend).


市场以一根大的多头趋势K线向上突破到第19根K线，这提高了第18根K线那个失败低2之后至少再走两段上涨的概率。第18根K线到第19根K线之间的多头通道很窄，连续出现六个多头实体。当通道很强时，最好就不要去做空通道下方的跌破；这意味着最好不要去做空低3（楔形顶），而是去看看有没有看起来像是好做空机会的突破回调。突破回调会是一个二次入场的做空信号。涨向第20根K线的走势本可以是那个形态，但它同样太强了，因为它连续包含五根多头趋势K线。到这个时候，大多数交易者会把第14根K线以来的上涨看成一段强多头趋势——尽管它仍然处在通道之中——他们会像对待任何强多头通道那样交易它：随便找个理由就买入，并且不会被回调关在场外。


> The market had a large bull trend bar breakout up to bar 19, and this increased the odds of at least two legs up from the bar 18 failed low 2. The bull channel from bar 18 to bar 19 was tight, with six consecutive bull bodies. When the channel is strong, it is better not to look to short the breakout below the channel, which means that it was better not to look to short a low 3 (a wedge top) and instead look to see if there was a breakout pullback that looked like a good short setup. A breakout pullback would be a second-entry short signal. The move up to bar 20 could have been that setup but it, too, was too strong, since it had five consecutive bull trend bars. At this point, most traders would see the move up from bar 14 as a strong bull trend, even though it was still in a channel, and they would trade it like any strong bull channel, buying for any reason and not getting trapped out by pullbacks.


每当出现一段强劲的急速行情，你都应当预期会有后续行情，并且可以用等距运动目标位来寻找合理的止盈位置。既然这些目标位常常相当可靠，机构必定也在使用它们。最初的测算应当以这个双底为依据。把从第1根K线到第5根K线的高度、或者从第5根K线到第8根K线的高度，加到第5根K线的高点上，就能找到可能的止盈区域。这两个投射位都在第24根K线处被超越了。由于那时通道仍然很陡，出现更多上涨的可能性更大，所以多头应当继续持有部分多头仓位，并寻找加仓的机会。他们可以按第1册中通道那一节所讲的方法买入。


> Whenever there is a strong spike, you should expect follow-through and you can use measured move projections to find reasonable locations for profit taking. Since they are so often reliable, the institutions must be using them as well. The first measurements should be based on the double bottom. Look for a possible profit-taking area by adding the height from bar 1 to bar 5, or from bar 5 to bar 8, to the high of bar 5. Both of these projections were exceeded at bar 24. Since the channel was still steep at that point, more of a rally was likely so bulls should still hold some of their longs and should be looking for opportunities to buy more. They can buy using the techniques described in the section on channels in book 1.


下一个更高的目标位来自把急速行情的高度翻倍，用第10根K线或第12根K线作为急速行情的顶部。如果你把从第8根K线到第12根K线的点数加到第12根K线的顶部上，那么该投射位在次日头一个小时只是被略微超越，随后在接下来的两三个小时里出现了一段16点的回调。


> The next higher target comes from doubling the height of the spike, using either bar 10 or bar 12 as the top of the spike. If you add the number of points from bar 8 to bar 12 to the top of bar 12, that projection was minimally exceeded on the first hour of the next day and it was followed by a 16-point pullback over the next couple of hours.


第24根K线是通道中的第四次向上推进，而当第24根K线之后的那个低4没能引发反转时，市场便向上突破了。一般来说，交易者在这里不应该使用低4这个说法，因为这是一个多头市场，而不是交易区间或空头趋势；但第23根K线之后的这次突破说明，有很多交易者把失败的低4当成了回补多头仓位的理由。这次突破在第22根K线高点处的突破点与第25根K线低点处的突破回调之间制造了一个缺口。一段强劲走势之后出现的缺口，常常会成为测量缺口，这里就是如此。当前这一段行情始于第24根K线处的通道低点，你可以把从该低点到缺口中点的点数加到缺口中点上，得出多头可能会止盈的位置，也就是等距运动目标位。市场在涨向收盘的过程中距离该目标位还差两个最小报价单位，但在次日开盘时从该目标位短暂向下转折。


> Bar 24 was the fourth push up in the channel, and when the market failed to reverse on the low 4 after bar 24, it broke out to the upside. In general, traders should not be using the low 4 terminology here since this is a bull market and not a trading range or a bear trend, but the breakout after bar 23 indicates that there were many traders who used the failed low 4 as a reason to cover their longs. The breakout created a gap between the breakout point at the bar 22 high and the breakout pullback at the bar 25 low. A gap that occurs after a strong move often becomes a measuring gap, as it did here. The current leg began at the bar 24 channel low and you can take the number of points from that low to the middle of the gap and add it to the middle of the gap to find the measured move projection where bulls might take profits. The market missed the target by two ticks on the rally to the close, but turned down briefly from it on the open of the next day.


交易者应当留意趋势线和趋势通道线，并随着通道的推进不断重画它们。如果你看到一次对通道顶部的突破失败，它就可能带来一次反转。第二次突破失败则是一个更加可靠的做空建仓形态。如果你从第14根K线到第23根K线的低点画一条多头趋势线，再画一条平行线并把它锚定到第12根K线急速行情的顶部，那么你就得到了一条能够容纳这段价格行为的通道。第35根K线是第二次对区间顶部的突破失败，是一个合理的做空建仓形态。最小目标位是先刺穿通道底部，然后再走一段向下的等距运动——做法是用通道的高度，从通道下方突破的位置中减去它。


> Traders should be looking for trend lines and trend channel lines and redrawing them as the channel progresses. If you see a failed breakout of the top of the channel, it can lead to a reversal. A second failed breakout is an even more reliable short setup. if you draw a bull trend line from the bar 14 to bar 23 lows and create a parallel that you then anchor to the top of the bar 12 spike, you then have a channel that contains the price action. Bar 35 was a second failed breakout of the top of the range and a reasonable short setup. The minimum objective is a poke below the bottom of the channel and then a measured move down using the height of the channel and subtracting it from the location of the breakout below the channel.


通道常常在第三次推进之后出现修正。第15、17、19根K线是三次推进，但那段通道实在太陡，因此只有当先出现一次强劲的向下突破、随后再出现一次回调时，你才应该寻找做空交易。第24、26、28根K线的三次向上推进也是同样的道理。这一次没能反转，反而在第29根K线上方构建出一个高2做多机会，随后是五根多头趋势K线构成的一段急速行情。


> Channels often correct after a third push. Bars 15, 17, and 19 were three pushes, but the channel was so steep that you should look for a short trade only if there first was a strong downside breakout and then a pullback. The same is true for the three pushes up at bars 24, 26, and 28. The failure to reverse set up the high 2 long above bar 29, which was followed by five bull trend bars that formed a spike.


第30、33、35根K线构建出另一个三次推进的顶部形态，而这一次值得一试，目标是博取可能出现的当日最高点。在头一个小时里，一次反转可能就是当日的最高点，所以你应该愿意更积极一些。跌向第34根K线的走势有两根强劲的空头趋势K线，说明空头正在变强。第35根K线是一根强劲的空头反转K线，也是从多头通道顶部突破之后向下反转的第二次，而且它略高于用第8根K线到第12根K线急速行情高度测算出的一段向上等距运动目标位。


> Bars 30, 33, and 35 set up another three-push top pattern, and this one was worth taking for a possible high of the day. In the first hour, a reversal can be the high of the day, so you should be willing to be more aggressive. The move down to bar 34 had two strong bear trend bars, so the bears were getting stronger. Bar 35 was a strong bear reversal bar and the second reversal down from a breakout of the top of the bull channel, and it was a little above a measured move up using the height of the bar 8 to bar 12 spike.


今天是一个很好的例子，说明强趋势通道可以包含大量双向成交，而回调看上去从来都不够强、不足以买入。这天有很多空头趋势K线，把空头套进了做空仓位里，因为他们一直在找第二段下跌。然而，每一次测试移动平均线时买方都会回来，而且从来没有出现过好的突破回调可供做空。这就告诉有经验的交易者：只去找做多机会。当天只有两三次逆势剥头皮的机会，而交易者只有在抓住它们之后能马上在下一个做多建仓形态出现时回到多头一侧，才应该考虑去做。如果他们错过了下一个做多机会，就说明他们还不够格在这样的一天里做空，因为在苦苦等待一次罕见的、能赚钱的做空剥头皮机会时，他们很可能错过了太多做多的赢利机会。他们站在了数学期望的错误一侧，而且因为缺乏纪律，没有让自己的盈利潜力最大化。


> Today is a good example of how strong trend channels can have lots of two-sided trading, and pullbacks never look quite strong enough to buy. It had lots of bear trend bars that trapped bears into shorts as they looked for a second leg down. However, buyers returned on every test of the moving average and there was never a good breakout pullback to short. This told experienced traders to only look to buy. There were only a couple of countertrend scalps, but traders should consider taking them only if they then get right back in on the long side with the next buy setup. If they miss that next buy, they are not good enough to be shorting a day like this, because they are likely missing too many long winners as they wait and wait for a rare profitable short scalp. They are on the wrong side of the math and are not maximizing their profit potential because of a lack of discipline.


整段通道如此陡峭，因此你应该假设这段急速行情在更高时间级别的走势图上也是一段大型向上急速行情（事实上，它在60分钟图上构成了一段强劲的、八根K线的多头急速行情），所以它后面应该跟着一段更高时间级别的多头通道。这意味着在接下来的两三天里，5分钟图上很可能会有后续买盘，而事实正是如此。当5分钟图上的一段通道是更高时间级别急速行情的一部分时，最终随之而来的回调通常只会测试更高时间级别走势图上的通道低点，而不会测试5分钟图上的通道低点。


> The entire channel was so steep that you should assume that the spike formed a large spike up on a higher time frame chart as well (in fact, it formed a strong, eight-bar bull spike on the 60 minute chart), and should therefore be followed by a higher time frame bull channel. This means that there would likely be follow-through buying on the 5 minute chart over the next two or three days, and there was. When a 5 minute channel is part of a higher time frame spike, the pullback that eventually follows usually tests only the channel low on the higher time frame chart but not the channel low on the 5 minute chart.


有很多突破回测都精准到最小报价单位地回测了先前那次突破，把那些对多头仓位的波段部分使用保本止损的交易者扫出了场。举例来说，如果交易者买入了第11根K线处的高2，并且一路持有穿越第12根K线那个失败的旗形（不推荐这么做，因为当天的这个时点上它是一个相当不错的做空形态），那么只要他们用了保本止损，就会被精准扫掉。不过，那些识别出这个强劲双底形态的交易者，在第14根K线那次两段式移动平均线测试上方做多时，会在仓位的波段部分使用更宽的止损，因为他们预期这是一个强劲的多头趋势日。看看移动平均线：在最初那段涨到第10根K线的多头急速行情之后，没有任何一根K线收在它之下，所以不要因为害怕在一笔交易上亏掉一两个最小报价单位就使用很紧的止损。事实上，交易者明天应该准备好买入第一根收在移动平均线之下的K线，然后再在移动平均线下方第一根均线缺口K线的高点上方买入。


> There were many breakout tests that tested the earlier breakout to the tick, running stops on traders using a breakeven stop on their swing portion of their long trades. For example, if traders bought the bar 11 high 2 and held long through the bar 12 failed flag (not recommended, because this was a decent short setup at this point of the day), they would have been stopped out to the tick if they used a breakeven stop. However, traders who recognized this strong double bottom pattern would have used a wider stop on the swing portion of their trades after going long above the bar 14 two-legged moving average test, expecting a strong bull trend day. Look at the moving average. There were no closes below it after the initial bull spike to bar 10, so do not use a tight stop out of fear of losing a tick or two on your trade. In fact, a trader should be ready tomorrow to buy the first close below the moving average, and then buy again above the first moving average gap bar below the moving average.

**图 12.7　双底突破失败即楔形变体**


如果一面双底牛旗向下突破，但随即又反转向上，它就变成了楔形牛旗的一种变体。在图 12.7中，第3根K线与第1根K线这根信号K线构成了双底，但市场随即反转向下。不过，这次对双底底部的向下突破失败了，市场在第4根K线处再次反转向上，从而形成了楔形牛旗（你也可以把它叫作三角形）。三次向下推进分别是第1根K线、第3根K线和第4根K线底部的影线。在这个具体例子中，把第2根K线当作第一次向下推进也可以接受。由于市场当时处在第1根K线与第3根K线之间的交易区间之中，在第1根K线顶部买入是有风险的，因为那根K线太高，你会在接近交易区间顶部的位置买入。一根大的多头反转K线，如果处在一个没有什么可供反转的交易区间里，就不起反转K线的作用。在这种情况下，永远更好的做法是先等一等，看看有没有突破回调、也就是有没有二次入场的机会。第4根K线是一次创出更低低点的回调，也是一根更安全的做多信号K线。


> If a double bottom bull flag breaks to the downside but immediately reverses back up, it becomes a variant of a wedge bull flag. In Figure 12.7, bar 3 formed a double bottom with the bar 1 signal bar, but the market immediately reversed down. However, the breakout below the bottom of the double bottom failed and the market reversed up again at bar 4, creating a wedge bull flag (you could also call it a triangle). The three pushes down are the tails at the bottom of bar 1, bar 3, and bar 4. In this particular case, bar 2 is also an acceptable first push down. Since the market was in a trading range between bars 1 and 3, it was risky to buy at the top of bar 1 because it was so tall that you would be buying near the top of a trading range. A large bull reversal bar does not function as a reversal bar when it is in a trading range where there is nothing to reverse. In situations like this, it is always better to wait to see if there is a breakout pullback and then a second-entry opportunity. Bar 4 was a pullback to a lower low and a safer signal bar for a long.


第6根K线和第8根K线试图构建一个双底牛旗，但它始终没有被触发。市场反而在第9根K线处向下突破，然后在两三根K线之后反转向上。这是又一面楔形牛旗，它的三次向下推进是第6、8、9根K线。不过，第7根K线之后那根空头K线可以作为第一次向下推进的另一种选择。对任何楔形来说，只要有至少三次向下推进，存在多种选法都没有关系。


> Bars 6 and 8 tried to set up a double bottom bull flag but it never triggered. Instead, it broke to the downside at bar 9 and then reversed back up a couple of bars later. This is another wedge bull flag, and the three pushes down are bars 6, 8, and 9. However, the bear bar after bar 7 was an alternative first push down. For any wedge, it does not matter if there are multiple choices as long as there are at least three pushes down.


第13根K线和第14根K线构成了一个双顶，尽管第14根K线还高出一个最小报价单位。市场在第15根K线处反转向上，但这次向上突破失败了，于是第13、14、16根K线构成了一面楔形熊旗做空建仓形态。


> Bars 13 and 14 set up a double top, even though bar 14 was one tick higher. The market reversed up at bar 15 but the upside breakout failed and bars 13, 14, and 16 became a wedge bear flag short setup.


### 本图深入讨论
