> ### Deeper Discussion of This Chart


图 12.7中第13、14根K线的双顶，形成于移动平均线略下方的铁丝网之中。空头铁丝网常常包含一个失败的低2，交易者可以在低2信号K线下方买入，预期向下突破会失败。这属于剥头皮。由于从铁丝网中突破出来的第一根趋势K线通常会失败，交易者可以留意在第16根K线下方做空。


> The bars 13 and 14 double top in Figure 12.7 formed in barbwire just below the moving average. Bear barbwire often has a failed low 2, and traders can buy below the low 2 signal bar in anticipation of the downside breakout failing. This is a scalp. Since the first trend bar to break out of barbwire usually fails, traders could look to short below bar 16.


第19根K线可以说是一个高2做多建仓形态（它是一次两根K线的多头反转，但市场始终没有成交在那根多头K线之上），不过，由于市场眼下在强劲跌破交易区间之后可能已经处在空头趋势之中，你就不应该再去找高2做多建仓形态——那种形态只在多头趋势和交易区间里才有效。这个交易区间大部分位于移动平均线之下，而且由于市场在进入交易区间之前就在下跌，所以向下突破的可能性更大（趋势恢复）。交易者会预期这次高2做多失败并把多头套住，然后他们就会留意在第20根K线处那个低2建仓形态的下方做空，让被套的多头在那里卖出他们的多头仓位。


> Bar 19 was arguably a high 2 long setup (it was a two-bar bull reversal, but the market never traded above the bull bar), but since the market might now be in a bear trend on the strong breakout below the trading range, you should not be looking for high 2 buy setups, which are setups only in bull trends and in trading ranges. The trading range was mostly below the moving average, and since the market was falling before entering the trading range, a downside breakout was more likely (trend resumption). Traders would expect the high 2 buy to fail and trap bulls, and these traders would then look to short below the bar 20 low 2 setup, where the trapped bulls would sell out of their longs.


这段空头通道以第三次向下推进、走到第21根K线而告终，次日市场向上跳空，远高于空头通道的起点第18根K线。这段通道之前，是第16根K线之后一段强劲的两根K线空头急速行情。这里出现了一次完美的向下等距运动：用这段急速行情的高度，从急速行情的底部向下投射。


> The bear channel ended with a third push down to bar 21 and the next day gapped up well above the bar 18 start of the bear channel. The channel was preceded by a strong two-bar bear spike after bar 16. There was a perfect measured move down, using the height of the spike and projecting down from the bottom of the spike.


第19根K线是又一段两根K线的向下急速行情，它引出了从第20根K线向下到第21根K线的空头通道。这段通道呈抛物线状，因为它先有一个加速阶段（表现为一根大的空头K线），然后是一个减速阶段（表现为实体越来越小，最后一根甚至是收涨的）。从第20根K线开始的三根空头趋势K线构成了一段空头急速行情，也就是一次卖出高潮。这是连续第三次卖出高潮，而连续高潮之后通常至少会跟着一段持续至少10根K线的两段式修正。第16根K线之后那段两根K线的空头急速行情是第一次卖出高潮，而结束于第19根K线的那段三根K线的空头急速行情是第二次卖出高潮。


> Bar 19 was another two-bar spike down, and it led to the bear channel down from bar 20 to bar 21. The channel was parabolic because it had an acceleration phase in the form of a large bear bar and then a deceleration phase in the form of bodies that became smaller, and the final one even had an up close. The three bear trend bars starting at bar 20 formed a bear spike, which is a sell climax. It was the third consecutive sell climax, and this is usually followed by at least a two-legged correction that lasts at least 10 bars. The two-bar bear spike after bar 16 was the first sell climax, and the three-bar bear spike that ended with bar 19 was the second sell climax.


# 第 13 章　二十根均线缺口K线（连续20根未触及均线的K线）

*13. Twenty Gap Bars*


当市场连续20根K线或更长时间待在均线的一侧、始终没有触及均线时，趋势就很强，但同时也已经走过了头，很可能不久就会回调到均线，从而形成二十根均线缺口K线形态。如果在这次回调之前没有出现明确的趋势反转，那么第一次触及均线就是一个高概率的剥头皮机会，目标是测试趋势的极值。有些交易者会用限价单和市价单在均线处、或略高、略低于均线的地方入场，但更好的做法是等一个价格行为入场信号（先反转回到趋势方向，再用止损单入场），以防这次回调远远越过均线。20这个数字本身毫无魔力，它只是一个有用的经验法则，用来提醒你趋势很强。你可以随意挑任何一个较大的K线数量，生成的建仓形态通常是一样的，它在其它时间级别上也照样有效。趋势可以极其强劲，却仍然每30分钟就触及一次均线；趋势也可以连续四个小时远离均线，随后却突然反转，进入相反的趋势。当这种情况出现在5分钟图上，而市场至少两个小时没有触及均线时，我过去把它叫做距均线两小时形态，简称2HM。既然同一个概念在所有时间级别上都成立，用K线根数而不是小时数来表述就更有用。这20根K线可以出现在一天中的任何时段，不一定非要在头两个小时里。


> When the market stays on one side of the moving average without touching it for 20 consecutive bars or more, the trend is strong, but it is also overdone and will likely soon pull back to the moving average, creating a 20 gap bar setup. If there was no clear trend reversal before the pullback, the first touch is a high-probability scalp for a test of the trend's extreme. There are traders who will enter at or just above or below the moving average with limit and market orders, but it is better to wait for a price action entry (a reversal back in the direction of the trend and an entry on a stop) in case the pullback goes well beyond the moving average. There is nothing magical about 20 bars. It is just a guideline that is useful to remind you that a trend is strong. You can arbitrarily pick any large number of bars and generate a setup that will usually be the same, and it will also work on other time frames. A trend can be extremely strong and still touch the moving average every 30 minutes, and a trend can be away from the moving average for four hours, only to suddenly reverse into an opposite trend. When it occurs on a 5 minute chart and the market has not touched the moving average for at least two hours, I used to refer to it as a two hours from the moving average setup, or a 2HM. Since the same concept works on all time frames, it is more useful to refer to the number of bars instead of the number of hours. The 20 bars can be at any time during the day and not necessarily during the first two hours.


一旦你意识到眼下出现了20根连续的均线缺口K线，就要在每一次触及均线时都寻找反向操作的机会。经过一次或多次均线测试之后，很可能会有一次测试直接穿过均线，形成一根均线缺口K线——这根K线完全位于均线的另一侧，于是K线与均线之间留下一个缺口。这时就等第一根这样的均线缺口K线去反向操作（在多头趋势中，如果前一根K线的高点低于指数移动平均线，就在该高点上方一个最小报价单位处买入）。如果第一次入场失败，而第二次入场信号又出现了，就在第二次入场时再买一次。和所有建仓形态一样，如果前两次都失败了，第三次就不值得再买，因为此时市场很可能已经处在通道之中，而不是在形成反转。由于你是顺势交易，应该把一部分仓位拿去做波段，因为市场可能走得比你想象的远得多。均线测试在个股上尤其可靠，常常一整天都能提供很好的入场机会。不过，如果第一根均线缺口K线是在一次强趋势反转之后才形成的，它多半会失败，因为趋势此时已经反转，而那根均线缺口K线是为先前那个趋势设立的建仓形态，可那个趋势已经结束了。


> Once you become aware that 20 consecutive gap bars are present, look to fade all touches of the moving average. After one or more moving average tests, there will likely be a test that goes through the moving average and forms a moving average gap bar where the bar is completely on the other side of the moving average so that there is a gap between the bar and the moving average. Look to fade the first gap bar (in a bull trend, buy one tick above the high of the previous bar if the high is below the exponential moving average). If the first entry fails, buy again on the second entry, if there is one. As with all setups, it is not worth buying a third time if the first two setups fail since the market at that point is likely in a channel and not forming a reversal. Since you are trading with the trend, you should swing part of your position because the market may run much further than you thought possible. Moving average tests are particularly reliable in stocks, and often provide great entries all day long. However, if the first moving average gap bar forms after a strong trend reversal, it will likely fail because the trend has now reversed and that gap bar is a setup for the prior trend, which now has ended.


![图 13.1](figures/fig-13-01.jpg)


**图 13.1　二十根均线缺口K线**


当趋势强到连续20根或更多K线都没有一根触及均线时，许多交易者就会在价格第一次回调到均线时入场，并持有到测试趋势的极值。在图 13.1中，第11根K线是20多根K线里第一根触及均线的K线；由于空头趋势没有形成明确的底部，交易者把限价单挂在均线下方一点、均线处和均线上方一点，用来建立空头仓位。尽管涨到第11根K线的那段行情由六根连续的多头趋势K线组成，但第10根K线处并没有明确的底部，所以交易者仍在均线附近寻找做空机会。这番做空的结果是，第11根K线之后出现的是一根小的空头内包K线，而不是一根强势的空头趋势K线，这意味着多数交易者认为此时这波上涨太强，做空不合适。不过，在第13根K线下方出现二次入场做空时（第一次入场机会出现在前一根K线），空头变得激进起来。由于涨到第13根K线的那段行情太强，交易者在等待一个更高的低点、然后再来一次向上测试，所以多数空头都在第14根K线附近离场——那里是一次更高的低点，测试的是第10根K线的空头趋势低点。


> When a trend is so strong that no bar touches the moving average for 20 or more bars, many traders will look to enter on the first pullback to the moving average and hold for a test of the trend's extreme. In Figure 13.1, bar 11 was the first bar to touch the moving average in over 20 bars and, since there was no clear bottom to the bear trend, traders had limit orders just below, at, and just above the moving average to enter short positions. Even though the move up to bar 11 was composed of six consecutive bull trend bars, there was no clear bottom at bar 10 so traders were looking for shorts around the moving average. The shorting resulted in a small bear inside bar after bar 11 instead of a strong bear trend bar, and this meant that most traders believed that the rally at this point was too strong to short. However, the bears became aggressive on the second-entry short below bar 13 (the first entry opportunity was one bar earlier). Because the move up to bar 13 was so strong, traders were looking for a higher low and then a second test up, so most of the shorts exited around the bar 14 higher low test of the bar 10 bear trend low.


第8根K线没有触及均线，但它仍然算是对均线的一次两段式测试。空头太急着做空，把限价单挂在均线下方两三个最小报价单位处，因为他们没有把握这波上涨会触及均线。如果他们真有把握，本可以把做空的限价单挂在均线下方一个最小报价单位处，那样在触及均线的瞬间就已经建立空头仓位了。当市场刚好在均线下方掉头向下时，空头就非常激进；尤其当这次测试变成一根大的空头趋势K线时更是明显，这里的走势正是如此。


> Bar 8 did not touch the moving average but was still a two-legged test of the moving average. The bears were so eager to get short that they placed their limit orders at two or three ticks below the moving average because they were not confident that the rally would touch the moving average. If they were confident, they could have placed their limit orders to go short at one tick below the moving average and they then would have become short on the touch of the moving average. When the market turns down just below the moving average, the bears are very aggressive. This is especially evident when the test turns into a large bear trend bar as it did here.


第7、9、10根K线构成了一个空头楔形，这是反转形态。第10根K线作为信号K线还不够强，没能让交易者相信市场正在向上反转，所以他们仍在均线附近寻找做空的建仓形态。但这个底部已经足够强，足以支持第二段上涨行情走到第15根K线，并在那里与第13根K线构成了双顶熊旗。


> Bars 7, 9, and 10 formed a bear wedge, and this is a reversal pattern. The bar 10 signal bar was not strong enough to convince traders that the market was reversing up, so they were still looking for short setups around the moving average. The bottom was strong enough to have a second leg up to bar 15, where it formed a double top bear flag with bar 13.


### 本图深入讨论


**回看 图 13.1**

![图 13.1](figures/fig-13-01.jpg)


> ### Deeper Discussion of This Chart


图 13.1中，市场以一根空头趋势K线跳空低开，所以这次突破有可能演变为开盘即形成的空头趋势。两根K线之后突破失败，但这个建仓形态还不够强，不宜买入。相反，空头应当离场、等待。第4根K线与第3根K线构成双顶熊旗，并与紧随其后的那根K线构成两根K线反转。交易者可以在第4根K线下方挂止损单去做空这个双顶，也可以继续等待。下一根K线是一根空头趋势K线，价格跌破了第4根K线，让第4根K线成为摆动高点。由于此时既有摆动低点也有摆动高点，而开盘区间不到近期日均波幅的三分之一，市场就处在突破模式之中。多头会在交易区间上方挂止损单做多，空头会在区间下方一个最小报价单位处挂止损单做空。突破应当有后续行情，这一天往往就会变成趋势日，这里的走势正是如此。


> The market gapped down with a bear trend bar in Figure 13.1, so the breakout might have become a trend from the open bear trend. Two bars later, the breakout failed, but the setup was not strong enough to buy. Instead, the bears should exit and wait. Bar 4 formed a double top bear flag with bar 3 and a two-bar reversal with the following bar. Traders could short the double top on a stop below bar 4 or they could wait. The next bar was a bear trend bar that traded below bar 4, making bar 4 a swing high. Since there was now both a swing low and a swing high and the opening range was less than a third of the recent average daily range, the market was in breakout mode. Bulls would go long on a stop above the trading range, and bears would go short on a stop one tick below the range. The breakout should have follow-through and the day often becomes a trend day, as it did here.


尽管当天前半段空头力量强劲，多头还是突破了数条空头趋势线。在涨到第13根K线的行情突破空头趋势线之后，出现了一波打掉止损的急跌，一直杀到第25根K线；多头在这波急跌之后仍能把市场推上去，第25根K线也与第21根K线构成了双底。它同时也是针对第21根K线到第24根K线那段熊旗的突破而设的末端旗形买入建仓形态。第13根K线还是空头趋势中第一根位于均线上方的均线缺口K线，因此这是一个卖出建仓形态（见下一章）。


> Despite the bear strength in the first half of the day, the bulls broke several bear trend lines. They were able to move the market up after the stop run plunge down to bar 25 that formed a double bottom with bar 21 after a break of the bear trend line on the rally to bar 13. It was also a final flag buy setup for the breakout of the bar 21 to bar 24 bear flag. Bar 13 was also the first gap bar above the moving average in a bear trend, and therefore a sell setup (see next chapter).


![图 13.2](figures/fig-13-02.jpg)


**图 13.2　二十根均线缺口K线并不总是买入建仓形态**


如果市场连续20根或更多K线没有触及均线，但此前先出现了一次高潮，那么这个二十根均线缺口K线形态就可能不会带来反弹、也不会测试极值。如图 13.2所示，Research in Motion（RIMM）走出一波抛物线式的多头趋势，一直涨到第10根K线。抛物线式的运动无法持续，所以它是一种高潮，而任何高潮之后通常都会跟随一次至少两段式的修正，持续时间至少10根K线，甚至可能跟随一次趋势反转。这使得回调到均线的一段式修正成为一次有风险的多头交易。


> If the market has not touched the moving average for 20 or more bars but there was first a climax, the 20 gap bar setup may not lead to a bounce and a test of the extreme. As shown in Figure 13.2, Research in Motion (RIMM) had a parabolic bull trend up to bar 10. Since a parabolic move is not sustainable, it is a type of climax, and any climax is usually followed by at least a two-legged correction that lasts at least 10 bars, and it can even be followed by a trend reversal. This makes a one-legged correction to the moving average a risky long.


### 本图深入讨论


**回看 图 13.2**

![图 13.2](figures/fig-13-02.jpg)


> ### Deeper Discussion of This Chart


在图 13.2中，多头本来可以在第13根K线处按均线挂限价单做多，剥到一点小利润，但在一次高潮之后买入一段空头急速行情是有风险的，因为至少应该预期有两段下跌行情。第15根K线是更好的建仓形态，因为那是第二段下跌行情，而且有一根不错的多头反转K线，但它在第16根K线的低2处失败了。第16根K线还与第14根K线构成了双顶熊旗。由于市场处在窄幅交易区间里，这算不上一个强有力的做空建仓形态。


> Although bulls could have scalped a small profit on a long in Figure 13.2 based on a limit order at the moving average on bar 13, buying a bear spike after a climax is risky, since at least two legs down should be expected. Bar 15 was a better setup since it was a second leg down and it had a good bull reversal bar, but it failed at the bar 16 low 2. Bar 16 was also a double top bear flag with bar 14. Since the market was in a tight trading range, this was not a strong short setup.


涨到第10根K线的那段行情里，K线之间重叠极少，而且都收在各自的高点附近。第7根K线到第10根K线的整波上涨如此陡直，本身就是一段多头急速行情。急速行情之后会跟随一段停顿或一次回调。这里回调一开始就是三根空头趋势K线，形成向下到第13根K线的急速行情。先有多头急速行情、接着出现空头急速行情，这就是高潮反转，属于两根K线反转的一种（但这一点可能只有在更高时间级别的图上才看得出来）。此后市场通常会横盘一段时间，多头不断买入，试图造出一条多头通道，空头不断卖出，试图把市场压进一条空头通道。在这里空头赢了，市场跌破第13根和第15根K线构成的双底，走出等距运动下跌。当市场两次都没能做到某件事时，通常就会做相反的事。


> The move up to bar 10 had bars that overlapped very little and closed near their highs. The entire rally from bar 7 to bar 10 was so vertical that it was a bull spike. A spike is followed by a pause or a pullback. Here, the pullback began with three bear trend bars forming a spike down to bar 13. When there is a bull spike and then a bear spike, this is a climax reversal, which is a type of two-bar reversal (but this might be evident only on a higher time frame chart). The market usually goes sideways for a while as the bulls keep buying in an attempt to generate a bull channel, and the bears keep selling as they try to push the market down in a bear channel. Here, the bears won and the market fell below the bars 13 and 15 double bottom for a measured move down. When the market fails twice to do something, it usually does the opposite.


虽然图上没有给出，但多头从第20根K线的低点起确实造出了一条强势的多头通道，而且从第20根K线起的这段上涨行情，高度与第4根K线到第10根K线的第一段行情完全相同，构成第1段行情 = 第2段行情的等距运动。涨到第10根K线的多头急速行情，比跌到第13根K线的空头急速行情大得多，而且在更高时间级别上它同样是一段多头急速行情。空头急速行情在这张5分钟图上得到了自己的通道，随后多头急速行情在第二天、在更高时间级别的图上得到了自己的通道（图未给出）。


> Although it is not shown, the bulls were able to create a strong bull channel from the bar 20 low, and the leg up from bar 20 was the exact same height as the bar 4 to bar 10 first leg, forming a leg 1 = leg 2 measured move. The bull spike up to bar 10 was much larger than the bear spike down to bar 13, and it was also a bull spike on a higher time frame. The bear spike got its channel on this 5 minute chart, and then the bull spike got its channel on a higher time frame chart the next day (not shown).


这次高潮还带有一个小的楔形顶。尽管第12根K线低于第11根K线，它的作用仍然像一个楔形——可以说空头太激进，以至于第3次推进没能超过第2次。有些交易者会把第10根K线之后的那根空头K线视为多头通道下方的第一次突破，然后把第11根K线视为突破回调、回撤到更高的高点。这还不够强，不足以做空，但足以让多头减仓或离场。第12根K线是两根K线反转的第一根，它与第11根K线构成了一个更低的高点，也就是双顶。交易者可以在那第二根K线下方做空，那是一根强势的空头趋势K线，最低目标是测试均线。第17根K线是均线下方的第一根均线缺口K线，但多头趋势此时已经演变成交易区间（市场已经横盘20到30根K线），这已经不再是一个可靠的买入建仓形态。


> The climax also had a small wedge top. Even though bar 12 was below bar 11, this still functioned like a wedge where arguably the bears were so aggressive that they prevented the third push from exceeding the second. Some traders would see the bear bar after bar 10 as the first breakout below the bull channel and then bar 11 as the breakout pullback to a higher high. This is not strong enough to short, but it is strong enough for bulls to lighten up or exit. Bar 12 was the first bar of a two-bar reversal, which was a lower high or double top with bar 11. Traders could short below that second bar, which was a strong bear trend bar, and the minimum target was a test of the moving average. Bar 17 was the first gap bar below the moving average, but the bull trend had evolved into a trading range (the market had been sideways for 20 to 30 bars), and this was no longer a reliable buy setup.


# 第 14 章　第一根均线缺口K线

*14. First Moving Average Gap Bars*


通常，一个二十根均线缺口K线形态之后会跟着一次对极值的测试，而下一次对均线的测试会探得更深。这时可能形成一根完全位于均线另一侧的K线。这就是均线缺口K线，它有时也可以同时是一个二十根均线缺口K线的回调形态。缺口是一个泛称，意思只是走势图上两点之间存在一段空间。举例来说，如果今天的开盘价高于昨天的收盘价，那就是向上跳空。如果开盘价高于昨天的高点，日线图上就会出现一个缺口。把这个词用得更宽一些，还会打开其它的交易机会。举例来说，如果某根K线的高点低于均线，那么这根K线与均线之间就有一个缺口。在多头市场或横盘市场中，市场很有可能会走到那里把这个缺口回补掉。有时一根K线会升到前一根K线的高点之上，但随后在一两根K线之内，回调又继续向下走。如果市场再次升到某根先前K线的高点之上，这就是第二个均线缺口K线形态，也就是多头趋势中对均线缺口的第二次回补尝试，而这个形态之后出现一段可交易的上涨行情的几率非常高。同样，空头趋势或横盘市场中，均线上方的缺口也往往会被回补。


> Usually a 20 gap bar setup is followed by a test of the extreme, and the next test of the moving average probes even deeper. A bar may form that is entirely on the other side of the moving average. This is a moving average gap bar, and it sometimes can also be also a 20 gap bar pullback setup. A gap is a general term that simply means that there is a space between two points on the chart. For example, if today's open is above yesterday's close, there is a gap up. If the open is above yesterday's high, there will be a gap on the daily chart. A broader use of the term opens up other trading opportunities. For example, if the high of a bar is below the moving average, then there is a gap between that bar and the moving average. In a bull market or sideways market, there is a good chance that the market will move to fill that gap. Sometimes a bar will go above the high of the previous bar, but then, within a bar or two, the pullback continues down again. If the market again goes above the high of a prior bar, this is a second moving average gap bar setup, or a second attempt to fill a moving average gap in a bull trend, and the odds are excellent that there will be a tradable rally off this setup. Likewise, gaps above the moving average will tend to get filled in a bear trend or sideways market.


如果有强趋势，而这又是该趋势中的第一根均线缺口K线，那么它之后通常会跟着一次对该趋势极值的测试。回撤到这根缺口K线的这一段回调，往往强到足以突破趋势线；而在测试完趋势极值之后，市场一般会形成一段两段式修正，甚至演变成主要趋势反转（见第3册）。举例来说，如果有一段强劲的多头行情，它终于出现了一根高点低于均线的K线，随后一根K线又交易到那根K线的高点之上，那么市场会尝试以更高的高点或更低的高点去测试多头行情的极值。交易者会买入做波段交易，预期市场会接近或升到先前那个高点之上。如果回调在均线下方跌得更多，有些交易者会分批加仓做多（这在第31章关于分批建仓与分批止盈的部分讨论）。如果市场上涨去测试先前那个高点，之后却反转向下，那么通常会出现一段更长的修正，这段修正往往至少有两段行情，并且常常导致趋势反转。


> If there is a strong trend and this is the first moving average gap bar in the trend, it is usually followed by a test of the trend's extreme. This pullback to the gap bar is typically strong enough to break the trend line and after the test of the trend's extreme, the market will generally form a two-legged correction or even a major trend reversal (discussed in book 3). For example, if there is a strong bull and it finally has a bar that has a high below the moving average and then the next bar trades above the high of that bar, the market will try to form a higher high or lower high test of the bull's extreme. Traders will buy for a swing trade, expecting the market to get near or above the old high. Some traders will scale into additional longs if the pullback below the moving average falls some more (this is discussed in Chapter 31 on scaling into and out of trades). If the market rallies to test the old high but there is then a reversal down, there will usually be a more protracted correction that typically has at least two legs and often leads to a trend reversal.


大多数走势图上的大多数K线都是均线缺口K线，因为大多数K线都没有触及均线。不过，如果没有强趋势，而交易者去反向操作其中一根（例如在某根位于均线上方的K线的低点下方一个最小报价单位处做空），他往往只是想做一次到均线的剥头皮，到那里就止盈。只有当到均线之间还有足够的空间、能拿到可接受的利润时，并且只有当这笔交易在当前价格行为的背景下讲得通时，交易者才会去做。所以，如果有强趋势，第一个均线缺口往往会构成波段交易的形态；而如果没有强趋势，交易者去做一个均线缺口K线交易时，更可能是在找一次剥头皮的机会。


> Most bars on most charts are moving average gap bars because most bars do not touch the moving average. However, if there is not a strong trend and a trader fades one (for example, selling one tick below the low of a bar above the moving average), the trader is often just looking for a scalp to the moving average where he will take profits. A trader will take the trade only if there is enough room to the moving average to make an acceptable profit and only if the trade makes sense in the context of the current price action. So if there is a strong trend, a first moving average gap tends to set up swing trades, and if there is not a strong trend and a trader takes a moving average gap bar trade, she is more likely looking for a scalp.


![图 14.1](figures/fig-14-01.jpg)


**图 14.1　均线缺口，二次信号**


在图 14.1中，第2根K线是在一个横盘市场里对均线下方缺口的第二次回补尝试。向下的动能略强，可以说这意味着今天市场并不横盘，但由于昨天强劲的收盘，均线基本上是平的。另外，有几根K线与其前一根或前两根K线相互重叠，而第2根K线是当日第3、4两根K线形成的两根K线空头急速行情之后的第三次向下推进。多头把买入止损单挂在第2根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处做多，打算在测试均线时拿到剥头皮交易者的利润。


> In Figure 14.1, bar 2 was a second attempt to fill the gap below the moving average in a sideways market. The downward momentum was somewhat strong, which arguably means that the market is not sideways today, but the moving average was basically flat because of yesterday's strong close. Also, there were several bars that overlapped with the bar or two bars before, and bar 2 was the third push down after the two-bar bear spike created by the third and fourth bars of the day. Bulls placed buy stops to go long at one tick above the high of bar 2 and looked to take a scalper's profit on a test of the moving average.


第3、4、8根K线也都是第二次尝试（第一次尝试可以只是一根多头趋势K线），也就是第二个均线缺口K线入场形态。


> Bars 3, 4, and 8 were also second attempts (the first attempt can be simply a bull trend bar), or second moving average gap bar entries.


第5根K线是一根均线缺口K线，但交易者不会为了剥头皮到均线而做空它，既因为到均线的空间不够做一次剥头皮，也因为它是紧跟一段强势向上反转以及一个更高的低点之后出现的，而在第4根K线更低的低点反转向上之后，很可能还有第二段上涨。第6根和第9根K线是第二个均线缺口K线做空形态。市场一旦突破第9根K线，接下来就是多头趋势，因为两次向下尝试都失败了（第9根K线是第二个均线缺口K线形态，意思是它是对均线缺口的第二次回补尝试）。


> Bar 5 was a moving average gap bar, but traders would not short it for a scalp to the moving average both because there was not enough room for a scalp and because it followed a strong reversal up and a higher low and a second leg up was likely after the bar 4 lower low reversal up. Bars 6 and 9 were second moving average gap bar short setups. Once the market broke above bar 9, there was then a bull trend because two attempts to go down failed (bar 9 was a second moving average gap bar setup, which means that it was a second attempt to close the gap to the moving average).


第7根K线是一个均线缺口K线形态，但由于到均线的空间太小，仅仅因为它是一根均线缺口K线，交易者就不太可能为了剥头皮而去买它。


> Bar 7 was a moving average gap bar setup, but since there was so little room to the moving average, traders would be less likely to buy it for a scalp solely based on its being a moving average gap bar.

> ### Deeper Discussion of This Chart


市场在图 14.1中向上突破，但当日第一根K线很小，因此不是一根可靠的信号K线去放空突破失败。第三根K线是一根强势K线，因此是一个更好的形态，可能演变成开盘即空头趋势。


> The market broke to the upside in Figure 14.1, but the first bar of the day was small and therefore not a reliable signal bar for a failed breakout short. The third bar was a strong bar and therefore a better setup for a possible trend from the open bear trend.


第6根K线是一次外包下跌反转，来自一段急速与通道多头趋势，这段趋势从第4根K线之后的急速上涨开始。


> Bar 6 was an outside down reversal from a spike and channel bull trend that began with the spike up after bar 4.


第8根K线是那个从第7根K线低点开始的小型扩散三角形的信号K线。它也可以被看成一个楔形，因为它是向下跌破一个小的双底，而这次突破失败了。第8根K线也是第4根K线底部之后的一个楔形牛旗；那三次向下推进分别是第5根K线之后的那根K线、第7根K线和第8根K线。最后，第8根K线是第4根K线更低的低点之后、急速上涨到第5根K线之后的那个更高的低点。


> Bar 8 was the signal bar for the small expanding triangle that began with the bar 7 low. It can also be viewed as a wedge, since it was a breakout below a small double bottom and the breakout failed. Bar 8 was also a wedge bull flag after the bar 4 bottom; the three pushes down were the bar after bar 5, bar 7, and bar 8. Finally, bar 8 was the higher low after the spike up to bar 5 that followed the bar 4 lower low.

> The breakout above bar 9 was a failed wedge bear flag, and therefore a measured move up was likely. The three pushes up were two bars before bar 8, the swing high before bar 9, and bar 9.

第一根均线缺口K线之后，可能出现对趋势极值的测试。在图 14.2中，第1根K线和第2根K线都是强趋势中的第一根均线缺口K线，之后都跟着对趋势极值的测试。第1根K线是空头趋势中第一根低点位于均线上方的K线（这根K线与均线之间有一个缺口），它之后跟着一个更高的低点，测试了空头趋势低点。第2根K线之后则出现了一个新的趋势极值。


> A first moving average gap bar can lead to tests of the trend extreme. In Figure 14.2, both bars 1 and 2 were first moving average gap bars in strong trends and were followed by tests of the trend extreme. Bar 1 was the first bar in the bear trend where the low of the bar was above the moving average (a gap between the bar and the moving average), and it was followed by a higher low test of the bear low. Bar 2 was followed by a new trend extreme.


# 第 15 章　日内催生突破与反转的关键拐点时间

*15. Key Inflection Times of the Day That Set Up Breakouts and Reversals*


市场常常会在经济报告公布时，在太平洋标准时间（PST）上午7:00和7:30前后的一根K线之内突破或反转；太平洋标准时间上午11:30也常常如此，而上午11:00和正午前后则不那么常见。非常常见的是，在强趋势日里会出现一波强劲的逆势恐慌行情，把人吓得平掉仓位，而这通常发生在上午11:00到11:30之间，尽管它也可能来得更早或更晚。一旦你看清楚自己是被一波强劲的逆势行情骗了，趋势通常已经朝着它此前的极值方向走了很远；这时，你和其他被关在场外的贪心交易者会追这波行情，把它推得更远。这波行情是怎么来的？机构能从这段急剧的逆势急速行情（spike）中获益，因为这种行情让它们能以好得多的价位加仓，并预期趋势会恢复、一路延续到收盘。假如你是一名机构交易者，想在临近收盘时重仓建仓，又希望以好得多的价位入场，你就会设法制造、或者助推任何一则可能引发短暂恐慌的谣言——这种恐慌会扫掉止损，让市场短暂地急速冲过某个关键价位。这则谣言或消息具体是什么、是不是某家机构为了赚钱而散布的，都无关紧要。唯一要紧的是：这场扫止损给了那些看懂局势的交易者一个机会，让他们搭上机构的便车，从这次失败的趋势反转中获利。


> The market often breaks out or reverses within a bar before or after 7:00 a.m. and 7:30 a.m. PST on economic reports, at 11:30 a.m. PST, and less often around 11 a.m. and noon PST. Very commonly on strong trend days there will be a strong countertrend panic move that will scare people out of their positions, and this normally happens between 11:00 and 11:30 a.m., although it can come earlier or later. Once it is clear that you were fooled by a strong counter-trend move, the trend will usually have gone a long way back toward its old extreme, and you and the other greedy traders who were trapped out will chase it, making it go further. What causes the move? Institutions benefit from the sharp countertrend spike because it allows them to add on at much better prices, expecting the trend to resume into the close. If you were an institutional trader who wanted to load up going into the close and you wanted to enter at much better prices, you would be looking to create or contribute to any rumor that could cause a brief panic that ran stops and briefly caused the market to spike beyond some key level. It doesn't matter what the rumor or news item is or whether some institution spreads it to make some money. All that matters is that the stop run gives traders who understand what is going on an opportunity to piggyback on the institutions and make a profit off the failed trend reversal.


这种扫止损式回调通常会突破一条重要的趋势线，因此，奔向新极值的那一波行情（趋势线被突破之后对更高的高点或更低低点的一次测试）会促使聪明的交易者在次日头一个小时里寻找反方向的交易机会。


> The stop-run pullback usually breaks a significant trend line, so the run to the new extreme (a higher high or lower low test following a trend line break) prompts smart traders to look for a trade in the opposite direction in the first hour of the next day.


这类陷阱在交易区间日上同样常见：市场在一个极值附近徘徊两三个小时，看上去像一次刚刚萌芽的突破，结果却猛然冲向另一个极值、把它打掉，而这次反方向的突破往往在太平洋标准时间上午11:30前后失败。这样一来，早先为某一个方向的突破布局的交易者被关在场外，而顺着另一个方向、在突破时入场的新一批突破交易者则被套在场内。大多数交易区间日都会收在中间某个位置。


> This type of trap is common on trading range days as well, where the market has been hovering near one extreme for a couple of hours in what appears to be an incipient breakout, only to make a sharp move to take out the other extreme, and this opposite breakout often fails around 11:30 a.m. PST. This traps out the earlier traders who were positioning themselves for the breakout in one direction and traps in the new breakout traders who entered on the breakout in the other direction. Most trading range days close somewhere in the middle.


![图 15.1](figures/fig-15-01.jpg)


**图 15.1　迟来的扫止损**


在图 15.1中，有两个二十根均线缺口K线建仓形态是在迟来的扫止损中形成的。第5根K线是太平洋标准时间上午11:25那波扫止损之后的入场K线，它同时还是均线缺口建仓形态的二次入场（也就是第二次“均线缺口K线做多”建仓形态，此前第一次入场是在第4根K线那根空头急速行情之后那根K线的上方）。注意那根空头趋势K线有多强：实体很大，收盘价接近它的最低点。这根空头突破K线让握不住仓位的人以为市场已经转成空头趋势。聪明的交易者却把它看作绝佳的买入机会，并预期它是一次衰竭性卖出高潮、一次突破失败。这类扫止损通常会突破主要趋势线，而且由于它之后通常会出现趋势的新极值，它常常为次日头一个小时里反方向的交易搭好舞台（此处就是多头趋势线被突破之后出现的一个更高的高点）。它与多头通道的起点——第2根K线——一起，构成了一个双底牛旗。


> In Figure 15.1 there are two 20 gap bar setups that formed on late stop runs. Bar 5 was the entry after the 11:25 a.m. PST stop run, and it was also a second entry on a moving average gap setup (a second moving average gap bar long setup, after the first entry above the bar after the bar 4 bear spike). Notice how strong the bear trend bar was with a large body and a close near its low. This bear breakout bar made the weak hands think that the market had turned into a bear trend. Smart traders looked at this as a great buying opportunity and expected it to be an exhaustive sell climax and a failed breakout. This type of stop run usually breaks the major trend line, and, since it is usually followed by a new extreme in the trend, it often sets the stage for a trade in the opposite direction in the first hour of the next day (here, a higher high after the break of the bull trend line). It formed a double bottom bull flag with the bar 2 start of the bull channel.


这两天里，均线缺口的反向操作机会都是在市场两次或更多次测试均线之后才出现的。在逆势交易者一次次把市场拉回均线之后，他们就有了加大赌注的信心，于是就出现了一根越过均线的缺口K线。然而，像这样第一次越过均线的突破通常会失败，从而为预期中的趋势恢复提供一次绝佳的反向操作机会。


> On both days, the moving average gap fades developed after two or more tests of the moving average. After the countertrend traders were able to bring the market back to the moving average multiple times, they developed the confidence to press their bets, resulting in a gap bar beyond the moving average. However, the first such breakout beyond the moving average usually fails and provides a great fade for the expected trend resumption.


第一个交易日，市场在上午7:00试图向下反转，多半是受一份报告影响。由于当时这一天还是开盘即趋势的多头趋势，这一根K线的抛售就是开盘即趋势日里的第一次回调，因此是一个买入建仓形态。这次失败的反转之后，先是三根K线的多头急速行情，随后是一段通道。


> On the first day, the market tried to reverse down at 7 a.m., presumably on a report. Since the day was a trend from the open bull trend at that point, the one-bar sell-off was the first pullback in a trend from the open day, and therefore a buy setup. The failed reversal was followed by a three-bar bull spike and then a channel.


第二个交易日，上午7:00的那次反转成功了，它变成三根K线的空头急速行情，后面跟着一段空头通道。


> On the second day, the 7 a.m. reversal succeeded and became a three-bar bear spike that was followed by a bear channel.


第二个交易日，市场在正午试图从一面空头末端旗形向上反转，但这次反转在第10根K线处那个均线缺口做空建仓形态上失败了。


> On the second day the market tried to reverse up from a final bear flag at noon, but the reversal failed at the bar 10 moving average gap short setup.


![图 15.2](figures/fig-15-02.jpg)


**图 15.2　迟来的多头陷阱**


在图 15.2中，这一天是开盘即趋势的空头趋势，之后市场一直无法站上均线，交易者便预期会出现太平洋标准时间上午11:30的多头陷阱，而它今天不早不晚，准点出现了。第3根K线还是空头趋势中的第一根均线缺口K线。通常，这个陷阱是一段强劲的逆势行情，它让满怀希望的多头积极买入，结果随着市场迅速反转下跌，他们被迫平仓。不过今天，从第2根K线起的那波上涨行情由几根大幅重叠的十字星组成，说明多空双方都很紧张。如果连信念都没有，交易者又怎么会被套住呢？是这样的：第3根K线之前的那根K线试图形成双顶熊旗，而第3根K线涨到第1根K线高点之上，把这个形态破坏了。这让许多交易者放弃了做空的理由，迫使空头平仓，同时也把一些多头套进了这次突破中的多单。推动这次突破的动量很弱，所以大概没有太多多头被套。然而，由于它没能与第1根K线构成完美的双顶，它反倒把空头关在了场外。既然是个陷阱，空头这一侧就有了燃料——那些被关在场外的空头现在不得不在更低的价位做空、追着市场往下打，而那些被套的多头则不得不卖出自己的多单。从第3根K线起那段下跌行情的疲弱，与从第2根K线起那段上涨行情的疲弱是一致的，但结果与预期相符——收在当日最低点。这是一个空头趋势恢复交易日，但由于恢复开始得太晚，而且此前是一段双边成交强劲的窄幅交易区间（K线又大又重叠、影线很长），最终形成的行情段比开盘那波抛售要小。


> On a bear trend from the open in Figure 15.2, followed by an inability to get above the moving average, traders were expecting an 11:30 a.m. PST bull trap, and it occurred today exactly on time. Bar 3 was also the first moving average gap bar in a bear trend. Usually, the trap is a strong countertrend leg, getting hopeful longs to buy aggressively, only to get forced into liquidation as the market quickly reverses back down. Today, however, the rally from bar 2 was composed of large overlapping dojis, indicating that traders were nervous in both directions. If there was no conviction, then how could traders get trapped? Well, the bar before bar 3 attempted to form a double top bear flag, and bar 3 spoiled it by going above the bar 1 high. This made many traders give up on the bear case, forcing the shorts to liquidate, and it trapped some bulls into longs on the breakout. The momentum leading to the breakout was weak, so there were probably not too many trapped bulls. However, by failing to form a perfect double top with bar 1, it trapped bears out. Since it was a trap, there was fuel for the short side as those bears who were trapped out now had to short lower and chase the market down, and those trapped bulls had to sell out of their longs. The weakness of the down leg from bar 3 is consistent with the weakness of the up leg from bar 2, but the result was as expected—a close on the low of the day. This was a bear trend resumption day, but since the resumption started so late and it followed a tight trading range with strong two-sided trading (large, overlapping bars with big tails), it resulted in a smaller leg than the sell-off at the open.


![图 15.3](figures/fig-15-03.jpg)


**图 15.3　交易区间日上迟来的陷阱**


交易区间日上也常常出现太平洋标准时间上午11:30的陷阱（见图 15.3）。这里，市场在当日区间的上半部待了两三个小时之后，一举打穿了当日最低点，把多头关在场外，同时把新的空头套在场内。在上午11:35那根K线上，市场给出了第24根K线上方的二次入场高2做多机会。市场两次试图跌破当日第9根K线的低点都没成功，所以它很可能转向反方向尝试。大多数交易区间日都会收在中间某个位置。


> There is often an 11:30 a.m. PST trap on trading range days as well (see Figure 15.3). Here, after spending a couple of hours in the upper half of the day's range, the market ran through the low of the day, trapping out the bulls and trapping in new shorts. The market gave a second entry high 2 long above bar 24 on the 11:35 a.m. bar. The market made two attempts to break out below the bar 9 low of the day and failed, so it was likely to try the opposite direction. Most trading range days close somewhere in the middle.


这一天开盘就是一波从第1根K线开始的多头趋势，并在上午7:00回调到第10根K线这根信号K线下方，多半是受某种报告影响。由于当时有三根大幅横盘的K线、影线醒目，这构成了一个小型交易区间，在它上方买入风险较大。于是市场在报告公布时短暂向下突破，把空头套在场内，随后又向上突破第11根K线，把多头套在场内、把空头关在场外；接着它在第12根K线处第二次转跌。当多空双方都有人被套在场内或关在场外时，下一个信号通常至少能带来一次剥头皮的机会。


> The day opened as a trend from the first bar bull trend and pulled back below the bar 10 signal bar at 7:00 a.m., which was likely on some kind of report. Since there were three large sideways bars with prominent tails, this represented a small trading range and buying above it was risky. So the market broke briefly to the downside on the report, trapping bears in, and then it broke to the upside above bar 11, trapping bulls in and bears out; it then turned down a second time at bar 12. When there are trapped bulls and bears, in or out, the next signal is usually good for at least a scalp.


### 本图深入讨论


**回看 图 15.3**

![图 15.3](figures/fig-15-03.jpg)


> ### Deeper Discussion of This Chart


在图 15.3中，奔向昨日收盘价的那波上涨行情，是从一个楔形底部反转上来的，很可能至少有两段行情。第9根K线处的更高低点反转向上，位置足够接近，可以算作一个双底；而太平洋标准时间上午7:40第13根K线出现的更高低点，是一次双底回调。由于开盘之后的那段上涨行情是一段强劲的向上急速行情，市场很可能在回调之后尝试形成一段通道，但它在第12根K线与第1根K线构成双顶时失败了。之后一个小时里出现了几段空头急速行情，最终走成一段空头通道，并在上午11:30、第24根K线处反转向上。上午11:00第22根K线的那次反转尝试失败了。市场所处的空头通道太陡，所以对通道的第一次突破之后，很可能接着一次突破回调，并给出概率更高的做多机会，而第24根K线就是那个信号K线。它同时也是市场从当日新低反转向上的第二次尝试。


> The rally into yesterday's close in Figure 15.3 was a reversal up from a wedge bottom and was likely to have at least two legs. The higher low reversal up at bar 9 was close enough to be a double bottom, and the bar 13 higher low at 7:40 a.m. PST was a double bottom pullback. Since the rally off the open was a strong spike up, the market was likely to try to form a channel after a pullback, but it failed with the bar 12 double top with bar 1. This was followed by several bear spikes over the next hour and ultimately a bear channel that reversed up at bar 24 at 11:30 a.m. The bar 22 reversal attempt at 11:00 a.m. failed. The market was in too steep a bear channel, so the first breakout of the channel was likely to be followed by a breakout pullback and a higher-probability long, and bar 24 was the signal bar. It was also the second attempt to reverse up from a new low of the day.


推向第12根K线的这波上涨形成了一面楔形熊旗，其中第5根K线和第8根K线是前两次向上推进。市场向上走得太陡，所以第11根K线突破自第9根K线起的窄幅多头通道时并不适合做空；但做空这次突破回调——也就是上冲到第12根K线更高的高点的那一段——是合理的。更稳妥的做法是等第12根K线这根外包下跌K线收盘，看看空头能不能守住这根K线。收盘价接近最低点，证实了空头的力量，所以在它下方、趁着后续行情刚刚启动时做空，是一个不错的入场。


> The push up to bar 12 created a wedge bear flag, with bars 5 and 8 being the first two pushes up. The market was too steeply up to short the bar 11 breakout of the tight bull channel up from bar 9, but shorting the breakout pullback to the bar 12 higher high was reasonable. It would be safer to wait for the bar 12 outside down bar to close, to see if the bears could own the bar. The close near the low confirmed the strength of the bears, so shorting below it on the beginning of the follow-through was a good entry.


# 第 16 章　数趋势与交易区间的行情段

*16. Counting the Legs of Trends and Trading Ranges*


趋势往往有两段行情。如果反转之后第一段行情的动能很强，多头和空头都会琢磨：它会不会是可能出现的许多段行情中的第一段，从而开启一轮新趋势？正因如此，多头和空头都会预期，对旧趋势极值的测试会失败，而顺势交易者（顺着旧趋势交易的那批人）会急于离场。举个例子，如果一段持续很久的空头趋势之后出现一波强劲上涨，而这波上涨既越过了均线，也越过了空头趋势的最后一个更低的高点，里面还有许多根多头趋势K线，那么多头和空头都会认为，市场会去测试低点，而且该低点会守在空头低点之上。等到第一段上涨的动能减弱，多头会部分或全部止盈，空头会做空，以防空头还能继续掌控市场。空头并不确定自己的趋势已经结束，因此愿意新开空头仓位。市场于是向下走，因为买方要等到出现更多偏多的价格行为才愿意买。当多头趁着测试低点的回调重新进场时，新空头会急于离场，因为他们不想在这笔交易上亏钱。空头回补自身空仓带来的买盘，会加大上行压力。市场随后形成一个更高的低点。除非这段行情在第一段上涨的顶部附近显出疲态（可能是双顶熊旗），否则空头不会考虑再次做空。如果真出现这种疲态，新多头会急于离场，因为他们不想亏钱；而空头会变得更激进，因为他们会察觉到第二段上涨已经失败。最终，会有一方胜出。这类交易在所有的市场里整天都在发生，制造出大量的两段式运动。


> Trends often have two legs. If the momentum on the first leg after the reversal is strong, both the bulls and the bears will wonder if it will be the first of possibly many legs, creating a new trend. Because of this, both bulls and bears will expect that a test of the old trend's extreme will fail and the with-trend (with the old trend) traders will be quick to exit. For example, if there is a strong move up after a protracted bear trend, and this up move goes above the moving average and above the last lower high of the bear trend and contains many bull trend bars, both the bulls and the bears will assume that there will be a test of the low that will hold above the bear low. Once the momentum of this first up leg wanes, bulls will take partial or full profits and bears will short, just in case the bears are able to maintain control of the market. The bears are not certain if their trend is over and will be willing to initiate new short positions. The market will work down since buyers will be reluctant to buy until there is more bullish price action. As bulls come back in on the pullback that is testing the low, the new bears will be quick to exit because they don't want to take a loss on the trade. The buying by the bears covering their shorts will add to the upward pressure. The market will then form a higher low. The bears will not consider shorting again unless this leg falters near the top of the first up leg (a possible double top bear flag). If it does, the new bulls will be quick to exit because they won't want a loss, and the bears will become more aggressive since they will sense that this second leg up has failed. Eventually, one side will win out. This kind of trading goes on all day long in all markets and creates a lot of two-legged moves.


事实上，市场朝一个方向走出一段行情之后，不论这段行情多大多小，它最终都会试图反转这段行情，而且往往会做两次反转尝试。这意味着每一轮趋势和每一次逆势行情都有很大机会分解成两段行情，而每一段行情又会试图再细分成两段更小的行情。


> In fact, after the market makes a move of any size in one direction, it will eventually try to reverse that move and will often make two attempts at the reversal. This means that every trend and every counter-trend move has a good chance of breaking down into two legs, and every leg will try to subdivide into two smaller legs.


当你在找两段式运动、也看到了两段行情，但这两段行情处在任何一种相对紧凑的通道里，比如楔形，那么它们实际上可能只是第一段行情的细分，而整个通道可能只是两段行情中的第一段。如果这两段行情各自的K线根数，与它正在修正的那个形态相比显得不足，就尤其如此。举例来说，如果有一个持续两小时的楔形顶，接着是三根K线的空头急速行情，再接着是三根K线的通道，那么急速行情加上通道很可能只是向下的第一段行情，交易者在看到至少再走出一段下跌行情之前，会不情愿下重手买入。


> When you are looking for a two-legged move and see one but the two legs are in a relatively tight channel of any kind, such as a wedge, they might in fact be subdivisions of the first leg and the channel may actually be only the first of two legs. This is especially true if the number of bars in each of the two legs looks inadequate compared to the pattern it is correcting. For example, if there is a wedge top that lasts for two hours and then a three-bar bear spike and then a three-bar channel, it is likely that the spike and channel together will be only the first leg down, and traders will be reluctant to buy heavily until after they see at least one more leg down.


![图 16.1](figures/fig-16-01.jpg)


**图 16.1　两段式运动**


在图 16.1中，跌到第6根K线的空头趋势是分两段行情走出来的，而第二段行情又细分成两段更小的行情。涨到第9根K线的上涨行情同样是两段行情，跌到第12根K线的下跌行情也是两段行情。按定义，所有的急速与通道形态都是两段式运动，因为先是高动能的急速阶段，然后是低动能的通道阶段。


> In Figure 16.1, the bear trend down to bar 6 occurred in two legs and the second leg subdivided into two smaller legs. The move up to bar 9 was also in two legs, as was the move down to bar 12. All spike and channel patterns are two-legged moves by definition, because there is a high-momentum spike phase and then a lower-momentum channel phase.


第12根K线是对多头行情起点的完美突破回测。它的最低点恰好等于第6根K线那根信号K线的最高点，把第6根K线做多者的保本止损扫掉了一个最小报价单位。每当出现完美或接近完美的突破回测时，市场很可能走出一个大致的等距运动（预期从第12根K线低点开始的上涨行情，其点数与从第6根K线到第9根K线的行情相等）。


> Bar 12 was a perfect breakout test of the start of the bull move. Its low exactly equaled the high of the bar 6 signal bar, running the breakeven stops of the bar 6 longs by one tick. Whenever there is a perfect or near-perfect breakout test, the odds are high that the market will make about a measured move (expect the move up from the bar 12 low to be equal in points to the move from bars 6 to 9).


到第15根K线为止是一段两段式上涨行情，但当它的高点被超越之后，市场以一段多头急速行情快速上冲，因为第15根K线做空形态之后形成的低2失败了，新空头不得不买回自己的仓位。第9根K线曾与第3根K线构成双顶熊旗，而这个双顶熊旗在从第16根K线起的上涨行情中失败，也助推了那段多头突破。


> There was a two-legged move up to bar 15, but when its high was surpassed, the market ran up quickly in a bull spike as the new shorts had to buy back their positions from the failed low 2 off the bar 15 short setup. Bar 9 had formed a double top bear flag with bar 3, and its failure on the rally up from bar 16 also contributed to the bull breakout.


![图 16.2](figures/fig-16-02.jpg)


**图 16.2　双顶熊旗**


在图 16.2所示的5分钟图上，苹果（AAPL）是一只走势很规矩的股票。它在第2根K线处形成双顶熊旗（比第1根K线的高点低1美分），随后的下跌行情超出了交易区间高度两倍这一大致目标。第2根K线也是空头趋势中一段涨向均线的两段式上涨行情的顶部，构成均线处的一个空头低2做空形态，这是趋势中很可靠的入场点。许多股票中的趋势都十分尊重均线，这意味着均线全天都在提供机会，让人以有限的风险顺着趋势方向入场。第2根K线之后又过了四根K线，就形成了一个双顶回调做空形态。


> Apple (AAPL) was a well-behaved stock on the 5 minute chart shown in Figure 16.2. It formed a double top bear flag at bar 2 (1 cent below the high of bar 1), and the move down more than met the approximate target of twice the height of the trading range. Bar 2 was also the top of a two-legged move up to the moving average in a bear trend, forming a bear low 2 short at the moving average, which is a reliable entry in a trend. Trends in many stocks are very respectful of the moving average, which means that the moving average provides opportunities all day long to enter in the direction of the trend with limited risk. Four bars after bar 2 set up a double top pullback short.


![图 16.3](figures/fig-16-03.jpg)


**图 16.3　楔形顶**


在图 16.3中，SPY 出现了一个由第4、6、10根K线构成的楔形顶，它后面通常跟着两段式横盘到下跌的修正。这里有一段三根K线的空头行情段，结束于第11根K线；向下的第二段行情结束于第13根K线。这段走势处在通道中，放到高一级时间级别的图上就只是一段行情。它的规模与从第7根K线到第10根K线的上涨行情段相当，因此大多数交易者不会确信，它包含的K线根数足以充分修正这个大楔形。市场随后出现第二段横盘修正行情，止于第15根K线，该低点略高于第13根K线的低点，形成一个双底；之后是一段多头急速行情与通道，上涨到新的趋势高点。


> In Figure 16.3, the SPY had a wedge top created by bars 4, 6, and 10, which is usually followed by a two-legged sideways to down correction. There was a three-bar bear leg that ended at bar 11 and a second leg down that ended at bar 13. This move was in a channel and would be just a single leg on a higher time frame chart. It was comparable in size to the leg up from bar 7 to bar 10 and therefore most traders would not be confident that it contained enough bars to adequately correct the large wedge. The market had a second sideways corrective leg to bar 15, slightly above the bar 13 low, creating a double bottom that was followed by a bull spike and channel up to a new trend high.


# 第 17 章　数K线：高1、高2、高3、高4与低1、低2、低3、低4形态及 ABC 修正

*17. Bar Counting: High and Low 1, 2, 3, and 4 Patterns and ABC Corrections*


所有市场都是分形的。这是一个数学概念，意思是市场的每一段都与更低和更高时间级别的每一张图具有同样的一般形态。如果你把走势图上的时间和价格标签去掉，你通常就分辨不出一张图是3分钟图、5分钟图、60分钟图，甚至是月线图。唯一能可靠地大致判断一张图的时间级别的情形，是平均每根K线只有一到三个最小报价单位高的时候——因为那样的图大部分都是十字星，而这种情况只会出现在小时间级别上，或者成交量极少的市场里，而这类市场你也不该去交易。


> All markets are fractal. This is a mathematical concept that means that each segment of a market has the same general patterns as every lower and every higher time frame chart. If you remove the time and price labels from your charts, you will usually not be able to tell whether a chart is a 3 minute, 5 minute, 60 minute, or even a monthly chart. The only time that you can reliably approximate the time frame of a chart is when the average bar is only one to three ticks tall, because the chart will be mostly dojis and that only happens in small time frames or in markets with only minimal volume, and you should not be trading those.


既然每一张图上的每一轮运动都倾向于走成两段，每一次修正也倾向于走成两段，每一次修正的每一次修正也倾向于走成两段，那么理解这一倾向的交易者就会找到大量机会。


> Since every move on every chart will tend to be two-legged and every correction will also tend to be two-legged and every correction of every correction will tend to be two-legged, a trader who understands this tendency will find lots of opportunities.


多头趋势或交易区间中的一次回调已经结束，有一个可靠的标志：当前K线的高点至少高出前一根K线的高点一个最小报价单位。由此引出一种有用的思路——数这件事发生了多少次，也就是所谓的“数K线”。在多头趋势或交易区间的横盘或下跌过程中，第一根高点高于前一根K线高点的K线就是高1，它结束了这段横盘或下跌行情的第一段，尽管这一段可能会变成更大一轮回调中的一小段。如果市场没有转为多头波段、而是继续横盘或下跌，就把下一根高点高于前一根K线高点的K线标为高2，它结束了第二段。高1与高2之间至少要有一点点趋势线突破，才能说明顺势交易者仍然活跃。没有这个，就先别想买入，因为高1和高2更可能只是一段正在形成的下跌通道的一部分，而这段通道正在构成复杂的第一段下跌。


> A reliable sign that a pullback in a bull trend or in a trading range has ended is when the current bar's high extends at least one tick above the high of the prior bar. This leads to a useful concept of counting the number of times that this occurs, which is called “bar counting.” In a sideways or downward move in a bull trend or a trading range, the first bar whose high is above the high of the prior bar is a high 1, and this ends the first leg of the sideways or down move, although this leg may become a small leg in a larger pullback. If the market does not turn into a bull swing and instead continues sideways or down, label the next occurrence of a bar with a high above the high of the prior bar as a high 2, ending the second leg. There needs to be at least a tiny trend line break between the high 1 and the high 2 to indicate that the trend traders are still active. Without this, do not yet look to buy, since the high 1 and high 2 are more likely just part of a channel down that is forming a complex first leg down.


在强劲的上涨行情中，高2的入场价位可能高于高1的入场价位；在强劲的下跌行情中，低2的入场价位可能低于低1的入场价位。顺带一提，多头趋势里的高2和空头趋势里的低2，常常被称为 ABC 修正：第一段是 A，形成高1或低1入场的那次方向转变是 B，回调的最后一段是 C。从 C 起的那次突破，在多头 ABC 修正里就是高2入场K线，在空头 ABC 修正里就是低2入场K线。


> In a strong upswing, the high 2 entry can be higher than that of the high 1, and in a strong downswing, a low 2 entry can be lower than that of the low 1. Incidentally, a high 2 in a bull trend and a low 2 in a bear trend are often referred to as ABC corrections, where the first leg is the A, the change in direction that forms the high 1 or low 1 entry is the B, and the final leg of the pullback is the C. The breakout from the C is a high 2 entry bar in a bull ABC correction and a low 2 entry bar in a bear ABC correction.


多头趋势里的高2与交易区间里的高2之间，以及空头趋势里的低2与交易区间里的低2之间，有一个重要区别。举例来说，多头趋势里出现高2建仓形态时，它通常位于移动平均线处或上方，而且趋势足够强，你可以就在当日高点附近买入。你买的是趋势中的延续形态，因此可以在趋势的顶部附近买入。可如果你在交易区间里买高2，你通常是在买一次反转，此时建仓形态位于移动平均线下方、靠近区间底部。如果你认为市场处在交易区间里，那么在移动平均线上方、靠近交易区间高点处买高2是有风险的。事实上，既然这笔交易很可能失败，你反倒应当考虑用限价单在高于或等于高2信号K线高点的位置做空。如果高2很可能失败，它为什么还会被触发？它之所以被触发，是因为空头想在各根K线的高点之上做空，而不太愿意在K线高点之下一点点做空。他们把做空的限价单挂在前一根K线的高点及其上方。由于愿意在K线高点下方一点做空的空头相对稀少，多头无人对抗，得以把市场推到前一根K线的高点之上，指望着大批多头会因买入止损单而被卷进来。K线的高点就是一个磁力位，而这次推到K线高点之上只是一次小小的买入价格真空。多头发现，那里等着做空的空头多到压倒一切。结果就是高2被触发，但市场立刻掉头向下。那些在最近几个最小报价单位里买入的多头，很快发现前一根K线高点之上根本没有上涨行情。因为市场没有按他们预期的方式走，他们出场，而且至少几根K线之内不会再想买入。他们卖出手中的多头仓位，助推了这轮抛售。交易区间里的低2则恰恰相反。你只应当在移动平均线上方、靠近交易区间高点处考虑卖出低2，因为你交易的是反转形态而不是延续形态。你是想做空一段上涨行情的末端，因此是在逆着一小段趋势交易。如果低2出现在交易区间底部附近，而你认为市场现在处在交易区间里、不在空头趋势里，那么更好的做法是在低2信号K线处或下方买入，预期低2会失败并形成某种双底。这类预期中的失败，通常发生在市场看起来正在走趋势、而你认为市场其实已经进入交易区间的时候。


> There is an important difference between a high 2 in a bull trend and a high 2 in a trading range, and between a low 2 in a bear trend and a low 2 in a trading range. For example, when there is a high 2 setup in a bull trend, it is usually at or above the moving average and the trend is strong enough for you to buy near the high of the day. You are buying a continuation pattern in a trend and therefore can buy near the top of the trend. However, when you are buying a high 2 in a trading range, you are usually looking to buy a reversal where the setup is below the moving average and near the bottom of the range. If you think that the market is in a trading range, it is risky to buy a high 2 above the moving average and near the high of the trading range. In fact, since this trade will likely fail, you should instead consider shorting using a limit order at or above the high of the high 2 signal bar. If the high 2 is likely to fail, why would it ever trigger? It triggers because the bears are looking to short above bars, and less so just below the highs of bars. They place limit orders to short at and above the high of the prior bar. With a relative lack of bears willing to short just below the high of the bar, the bulls are unopposed and are able to push the market above the high of the prior bar, hoping that lots of bulls will enter on buy stops. The high of the bar acts as a magnet, and the push above the bar is a small buy vacuum. The bulls find that there is an overwhelming number of bears waiting to short there. The result is that the high 2 triggers, but the market immediately turns down. Those bulls who bought over the last several ticks quickly see the lack of a rally above the high of the prior bar. Because the market is not doing what they expected, they exit and will not look to buy again for at least a few bars. Their selling out of their longs contributes to the sell-off. The opposite is true of a low 2 in a trading range. You should only look to sell a low 2 above the moving average and near the top of the trading range because you are trading a reversal and not a continuation pattern. You are trying to short the end of a leg up and are therefore trading against a small trend. If one forms near the bottom of a trading range and you believe that the market is now in a trading range and not in a bear trend, it is better to buy at or below the low 2 signal bar, expecting the low 2 to fail and form a type of double bottom. These expected failures usually happen when the market appears to be trending but you think that the market has instead entered a trading range.


多头趋势里的高1和空头趋势里的低1，各自的风险回报比特征取决于它出现在趋势的哪个位置。举例来说，如果市场正在筑底，并形成了一次失败的低1，那么在K线高点之上买入，就是在做一轮新多头趋势里的第一个高1入场。成功的概率也许只有50比50，但风险小、潜在回报大。你以很小的概率赚一笔大钱。新多头趋势里最初那段急速上涨之后的高1做多，有很大概率至少能做成一次成功的波段交易。风险小，而潜在回报与成功概率都高。不过，如果市场正在形成连续第三次高1建仓形态，做成波段的概率就很小，交易者应当剥头皮。这意味着风险与潜在回报都小，而概率比第一次高1时要低。


> A high 1 in a bull trend and a low 1 in a bear trend can have different risk/reward profiles depending on where each is in the trend. For example, if the market is bottoming and it forms a failed low 1, buying above the bar is taking the first high 1 entry of the new bull trend. The odds of success might be only 50–50, but the risk is small and the potential reward is large. You have a small chance of making a big profit. A high 1 long trade after the initial spike up in a new bull trend has a high probability of being at least a successful swing trade. The risk is small and the potential reward and probability of success are high. However, if the market is forming its third consecutive high 1 setup, the odds of a swing are small so traders should scalp. This means that the risk and potential reward are both small, and the probability is less than it was for the first high 1.


有些多头回调会继续发展，形成高3或高4。高4形成时，有时它以高2开头，而这个高2走不了多远。接着出现一次空头突破、又两段下跌、以及第二个高2，而整个走势只不过是一个更高时间级别上的高2。另一些时候，高4是一段小型的急速与通道空头趋势，其中第一或第二次向下推进是一段空头急速行情，接下来的几次向下推进则在一条空头通道里。如果高4没能让趋势恢复，市场反而跌破了它的低点，那么市场很可能已经不再是在多头趋势中回调，而是处在一次空头波段里。此时先等更多的价格行为展开，再下单。


> Some bull pullbacks can grow further and form a high 3 or a high 4. When a high 4 forms, it sometimes begins with a high 2 and this high 2 fails to go very far. It is instead followed by a bear breakout and another two legs down and a second high 2, and the entire move is simply a higher time frame high 2. At other times, the high 4 is a small spike and channel bear trend where the first or second push down is a bear spike and the next pushes down are in a bear channel. If the high 4 fails to resume the trend and the market falls below its low, it is likely that the market is no longer forming a pullback in a bull trend and instead is in a bear swing. Wait for more price action to unfold before placing a trade.


当空头趋势或横盘中的市场正在横向或向上修正时，第一根低点低于前一根K线低点的K线就是低1，它结束了这轮修正的第一段——这一段可能短到只有那一根K线。后续出现的这类K线依次叫低2、低3、低4入场。如果低4失败（低4做空被触发后，有一根K线越过了低4信号K线的高点），那么价格行为说明空头已经失去控制，市场要么变成双边市、多空轮流掌控，要么由多头掌控。无论哪种情况，空头要证明自己重新掌控局面，最好的方式就是用强劲的动能跌破一条多头趋势线。


> When a bear trend or a sideways market is correcting sideways or up, the first bar with a low below the low of the prior bar is a low 1, ending the first leg of the correction, which can be as brief as that single bar. Subsequent occurrences are called the low 2, low 3, and low 4 entries. If the low 4 fails (a bar extends above the high of the low 4 signal bar after the low 4 short triggered), the price action indicates that the bears have lost control and either the market will become two-sided, with bulls and bears alternating control, or the bulls will gain control. In any case, the bears can best demonstrate that they have regained control by breaking a bull trend line with strong momentum.


如果市场处在清晰的多头趋势里，就不要去找低1或低2做空，因为那些只是在空头趋势和交易区间里才有的建仓形态。如果市场处在清晰的空头趋势里，就不要去找高1或高2买入，因为那些只是在多头趋势和交易区间里才有的建仓形态。事实上，如果市场处在空头趋势里，你常常可以考虑在前一根K线的高点之上做空，因为在空头趋势里买高1是一笔低概率的交易。也就是说，如果做多成功的概率只有大约40%，那么在触及止盈限价单之前先触及保护性止损的概率就大约有60%。如果你是在5分钟 Emini 小型合约图上剥头皮，那么市场就有60%的概率先下跌、触及两个点的止损，而不是先触及挂在信号K线上方五个最小报价单位处的限价单。所以，先跌两个点、而不是先涨五个最小报价单位，这件事有60%的概率发生，这就是一个极好的做空建仓形态。同样，在强空头趋势或空头通道里，你可以在任意一根K线的高点之上考虑卖出；在多头趋势里你可以考虑买低1，在多头趋势或多头通道里，任何一根K线跌到前一根K线低点之下时，你都可以买入。


> If the market is in a clear bull trend, do not look for low 1 or low 2 shorts, because those are setups only in bear trends and trading ranges. If the market is in a clear bear trend, do not look for high 1 or high 2 buys, because those are setups only in bull trends and trading ranges. In fact, if the market is in a bear trend, you can often look to short above the high of the prior bar because buying a high 1 in a bear trend is a low-probability trade. That means that if it has only about a 40 percent chance of being a successful long, it has about a 60 percent chance of hitting the protective stop before hitting a profit-taking limit order. If you are scalping on the 5 minute Emini chart, then there is a 60 percent chance that the market will fall and hit a two-point stop before it hits a limit order five ticks above the signal bar. So if there is a 60 percent chance it will fall two points before rising five ticks, this is a great setup for a short. Likewise, you can look to sell above the high of any bar in a strong bear trend or in a bear channel, and you can look to buy a low 1 in a bull trend and to buy below the low of any prior bar in a bull trend or in a bull channel.


在你数这些回调的时候，常常会看到市场没有反转、而是继续它的修正，这时你就得改变视角。如果你原本以为市场处在交易区间里、只是刚创了一个强劲的新高，随后却在旧高点之上看到一个低2（一个卖出建仓形态），但市场并没有下跌、而是继续上行，那么你就应当开始去找高1和高2的买入入场点。很可能多头的强度已经足够让你只做多。你应当推迟寻找低1、低2做空，直到空头展现出足够的强度、让一次可交易的下跌行情变得可能为止（比如跌破一条多头趋势线、随后又是一次对摆动高点的失败测试）。


> As you are counting these pullbacks, you will often see the market continue its correction instead of reversing, in which case you have to change your perspective. If you thought that the market was in a trading range with simply a strong new high and then see a low 2 above the old high (a sell setup), but instead of falling, the market continues up, you should begin to look for high 1 and 2 buy entries. It is likely that the bull strength is sufficient for you to be trading only longs. You should defer looking for low 1 and 2 shorts until the bears demonstrate enough strength to make a tradable down move likely (like a bull trend line break followed by a failed test of the swing high).


注意，在交易区间里，常常在10根K线左右的过程中就能同时看到一个高1、一个高2、一个低1和一个低2，尽管高2是看涨的、低2是看跌的。既然市场在横盘，多空双方谁也无法长时间掌控价格行为，那么双方都试图夺回控制权就是合理的，而在一方试图确立优势的过程中，多头或空头的形态就会形成。在交易区间里非常容易看到大量的高1、高2、低1、低2形态，而非常重要的是别过度交易。当市场大体横盘、K线之间大量重叠，而且这个区间不是极强趋势里的一面小旗形时，大多数交易者应当站到一边、不做任何交易。为什么？如果你在找高2或低2，你就是在窄幅交易区间的顶部或底部挂止损单入场，而你做的正好和机构相反。在窄幅交易区间里，当市场走到前一根K线的高点之上时，他们是在为多头止盈，或者是在做空，所以你不想在那里买入。你的任务是跟随他们在做什么，而不是无视他们在做什么、还骗自己相信你有一个神奇建仓形态，只要一直做它就能赚大钱。窄幅交易区间也可能作为极强趋势里的小旗形出现，出现这种情况时，考虑在区间突破时挂止损单入场是合理的。举例来说，如果有一段强劲的四根K线空头急速行情，而市场横盘10根K线期间既没有高潮也没有强劲反转，那么在空头趋势K线之下挂止损单做空就说得过去。但如果这一天是一个交易区间日、而这个窄幅交易区间又处在当日区间的中间三分之一，那大多数交易者就绝不该根据数K线来下单。


> Notice that in trading ranges, it is common to see a high 1, high 2, low 1, and low 2 all present in the course of 10 bars or so, even though a high 2 is bullish and a low 2 is bearish. Since the market is sideways, neither the bulls nor the bears are controlling the price action for more than a brief period, so it makes sense that each side will try to wrest control, and as each tries to assert itself, bull or bear patterns will form. It is very easy to see lots of high and low 1 and 2 patterns in trading ranges, and it is very important that you do not overtrade. When the market is mostly sideways with lots of overlap among the bars and the range is not a small flag in a very strong trend, most traders should step aside and not take any trades. Why is that? If you are looking for a high 2 or a low 2, you are looking to enter on a stop at either the top or the bottom of a tight trading range and you are doing the exact opposite of what the institutions are doing. When the market goes above the high of the prior bar in a tight trading range, they are taking profits on their longs or they are shorting, so you do not want to be buying. Your job is to follow what they are doing; it is not to ignore what they are doing and to fool yourself into believing that you have some magical setup that will make you a lot of money as long as you keep trading it. Tight trading ranges can form as small flags in very strong trends, and when they do it is reasonable to look to enter on a stop on the breakout of the range. For example, if there is a strong four-bar bear spike and there is no climax or strong reversal as the market goes sideways for 10 bars, it makes sense to go short on a stop below a bear trend bar. But if instead the day is a trading range day and the tight trading range is in the middle third of the day, most traders should never place a trade based on bar counting.


当市场处在窄幅交易区间里时，它常常反复改变方向，所以如果你把每一个高1、高2、高3、高4都买一遍，又把每一个低1、低2、低3、低4都空一遍，那么在一个小时之内，你就会把过去一周赚到的钱全部亏光。在讨论窄幅交易区间的第22章里，我会更详细地讲这件事。没有什么神奇的建仓形态；每一种建仓形态都有让数学期望给它优势的市场环境，也有让它亏钱的其他环境。依据数K线来交易，需要一个有波段的市况。如果市场处在窄幅交易区间里，就别交易——除非你是一位非常有经验的交易者，并且能心安理得地在高于前一根K线高点的位置做空、而不是在那里挂止损单买入，在低于前一根K线低点的位置买入、而不是在那里挂止损单做空。


> When the market is in a tight trading range, it often reverses direction repeatedly, so if you take every high 1, 2, 3, and 4 and also short every low 1, 2, 3, and 4, over the course of an hour you will lose all of the money that you made in the past week. In Chapter 22 on tight trading ranges, I discuss this in more detail. There are no magical setups, and every setup has an environment where the math gives it an edge, as well as other environments where it will lose. Trading based on bar counts requires a market that has swings. If the market is in a tight trading range, do not trade unless you are a very experienced trader and you are comfortable shorting above the high of the prior bar instead of buying there on a stop, and buying below the low of the prior bar instead of shorting there on a stop.


这套编号有多种变体，但目的仍然是帮助识别两段式修正。举例来说，在强多头趋势里，可能形成一轮两段式回调，它只出现一个高1，但在功能上就是一次两段式回调。你可以从5分钟图上的样子推断出来，也可以通过看更小时间级别的图来确认，不过并没有这个必要。你叫它眼前这张图上的高1也好、叫它高2的一种变体也好、还是叫它更小时间级别上的高2，都无所谓，只要你看得懂市场在做什么就行。如果出现一根（或连续两根）空头收盘，即使下一根K线没有走到那根空头K线的高点之上，这也可以代表第一段下跌。如果下一根K线是多头收盘、但它的高点仍然低于本段趋势的高点，那么在再下一根或附近的K线又是空头趋势K线时，它就成为了第一段下跌的终点。如果下一根K线跌破了它的低点，那就在接下来几根K线里找一根高点越过其前一根K线高点的K线，那就是两段下跌的终点。把每一根K线都看作潜在信号K线，在它高点之上一个最小报价单位处挂买入止损单。一旦成交，你就得到了一个高2的变体。严格来说，这根入场K线只是一个高1，但把它当成高2来对待。回调开头的那根空头K线之后跟着一根多头收盘的K线。在更小的时间级别上，这几乎可以肯定是一小段下跌、随后是一段上涨并形成一个更低的高点、最后再来一次向下推进，直到那个高2结束了第二段。


> There are variations on this numbering, but the goal is still to help spot two-legged corrections. For example, in a strong bull trend, a two-legged pullback can form and have just a high 1 but functionally be a two-legged pullback. You can infer it from the appearance on the 5 minute chart, and you can confirm it by looking at a smaller time frame chart, although this is not necessary. It does not matter if you call it a high 1 on the chart in front of you, a high 2 variant, or a smaller time frame high 2, as long as you understand what the market is doing. If there is a bear close (or two), this can represent the first leg down even if the next bar does not extend above the high of the bear bar. If that next bar has a bull close but its high is still below the trend high, it then becomes the end of the first down leg if the next bar or so is again a bear trend bar. If the next bar extends below its low, look for a bar within the next few bars that extends above the high of its prior bar, ending the two legs down. View each bar as a potential signal bar, and place a buy stop at one tick above its high. Once filled, you now have a variant of a high 2. This entry bar is, strictly speaking, just a high 1, but treat it as a high 2. That bear bar at the start of the pullback was followed by a bar with a bull close. On a smaller time frame, this was almost certainly a small down leg followed by an up leg that became a lower high, and then finally another push down to where the high 2 ended the second leg.


回调常常会发展、演变成更大的回调。举例来说，如果市场处在多头趋势中，一个高1做多入场没能创出新高，反而形成了一个更低的高点、接着又是一段下跌，交易者就会去找高2建仓形态来买入。如果高2被触发，但上涨没走多远、市场又掉头跌到高2信号K线的低点之下，交易者接着就会去找高3（楔形或三角形）或高4回调来买入。只要高2或楔形（高3）买入信号K线下方出现强劲突破，市场通常至少还会有两次向下推进。如果高2信号K线下方的那次突破并不强劲，且整段下跌呈楔形、并从趋势通道线处反转向上，那么高3就是在形成一个楔形牛旗，往往是一个可靠的买入建仓形态。记住，这是多头趋势中的一次回调，而不是空头趋势中的一次反转尝试——在空头趋势里，交易者需要先看到多头强度得到清晰的展示，才会考虑买入，这一点在第3册讨论反转的那一节里有详细说明。如果高2买入信号K线下方的那次突破在第二次向下推进之后反转向上，而这四次向下推进大致构成一条通道、看起来并不特别强劲，那就是一个高4买入建仓形态。有些高4买入建仓形态，其实只是更高时间级别上的高2买入建仓形态，其中两段各自又细分成两小段。如果那个失败高2下方的突破动能强劲，而从抛售顶点开始的整轮回调处在一条相对窄幅的通道里，那么买高3就是有风险的。这时交易者应当先等，看是否会出现一次对空头通道的向上突破、随后再出现一个突破回调。每当交易者怀疑这条下跌通道是不是强到不该在高3或高4信号K线之上买入时，他都应当把这个形态当成任何一次通道突破来处理，正如第1册里讨论过的那样。先看多头的突破有多强，再考虑买入。如果突破强劲，交易者就可以考虑买入一次回调。如果它强到一连出现多根多头趋势K线、中间连一次回调都没有（这有可能发生，但并不常见），那么市场就已经变成始终做多，交易者可以凭任何理由买入，包括在任何一根强多头趋势K线的收盘价上买入。由于止损放在急速行情的底部之下、可能离得很远，仓位规模应当小。反过来，如果市场跌到作为信号K线的第4根K线的低点之下，市场很可能处在空头趋势里，交易者就应当开始考虑卖出上涨行情，而不是继续找买点。


> Pullbacks often grow and evolve into larger pullbacks. For example, if there is a bull trend and a high 1 long entry fails to reach a new high and instead there is a lower high and then another leg down, traders will look for a high 2 setup to buy. If the high 2 triggers but the rally does not go very far and the market turns down again below the low of the high 2 signal bar, traders will then look to buy either a high 3 (a wedge or a triangle) or a high 4 pullback. Whenever there is a strong breakout below a high 2 or wedge (high 3) buy signal bar, the market usually will have at least two more pushes down. If the breakout below the high 2 signal bar is not strong and the entire move down has a wedge shape and reverses up from a trend channel line, then the high 3 is forming a wedge bull flag and is often a reliable buy setup. Remember, this is a pullback in a bull trend, and not a reversal attempt in a bear trend, where traders need a clear demonstration of bullish strength before looking to buy, as discussed in the section in book 3 on reversals. If the breakout below the high 2 buy signal bar reverses up after a second push down and the four pushes down are in something of a channel and does not look particularly strong, it is a high 4 buy setup. Some high 4 buy setups are simply high 2 buy setups on higher time frames, where the two legs each subdivide into two smaller legs. If the breakout below the failed high 2 has strong momentum and the entire pullback from the top of the selloff is in a relatively tight channel, then buying the high 3 is risky. Instead, traders should wait to see if there is a breakout above the bear channel and then a breakout pullback. Whenever a trader wonders if the channel down might be too strong to buy above a high 3 or high 4 signal bar, he should treat the setup like any other channel breakout, as was discussed in book 1. Wait to see how strong the bull breakout is before looking to buy. If the breakout is strong, then traders can look to buy a pullback. If it is so strong that it has a series of bull trend bars without a pullback, which can happen but is unusual, the market would have become always-in long and traders can buy for any reason, including on the close of any strong bull trend bar. Since the stop is below the bottom of the spike, which can be far away, the position size should be small. If instead the market falls below the low of the bar 4 signal bar, the market is likely in a bear trend and traders should start to look to sell rallies rather than to continue to look to buy.


在空头趋势的上涨行情里，情况正好相反。如果低2做空失败、市场继续上涨，就去看从失败低2起那段上涨的动能。如果动能不太强、市场又处在一条通道里，特别是呈楔形时，那就考虑做空低3，也就是一个楔形熊旗。如果上涨动能非常强，比如失败低2之后出现了两三根强劲的多头急速K线，那就预期至少还会有两段上涨，不要做空低3。只有当整体格局支持做空时，才去做空低4；如果你认为市场现在已经转成多头趋势，就不要做空。


> The opposite is true in a bear rally. If the low 2 short fails and the market continues to rally, look at the momentum of the move up from the failed low 2. If it is not too strong and the market is in a channel, especially if it has a wedge shape, look to short the low 3, which would be a wedge bear flag. If the momentum up is very strong, like if there is a two-or three-bar strong bull spike up from the failed low 2, look for at least two more legs up and do not short the low 3. Short the low 4 only if the overall picture supports a short, and do not short if you believe that the market has now converted into a bull trend.


正如第3册讲反转的那一章所讨论的，当交易者寻找向下反转时，他们常常去找一个他们预计会失败、并成为这段多头行情末端旗形的高1、高2或三角形（高3）形态，然后在买入信号K线之上做空。由于这次突破是对高点的一次测试，它就形成了双顶（这次突破可能形成更低的高点，也可能形成更高的高点，但既然它是第二次向上推进并且正在掉头向下，它就属于一种双顶，正如第3册所述）。当一个人在高于高2买入信号K线的位置做空时，他是预期市场会下跌，走进一个交易区间或一段新的空头趋势。由于双顶是两次向上推进，而交易者预期它处在交易区间或新空头波段的顶部，它同时也是一个低2卖出建仓形态（在形成双顶的那根K线的低点之下卖出）。几乎每一次向下反转都来自某种形式的双顶。如果这个顶部只是交易区间里一小段上涨之后形成的，双顶往往只涉及几根K线，是一个微型双顶。大多数底部也是如此。它们由失败的低1、低2或三角形突破形成，从而产生双底和末端旗形向上反转。由于交易者预期的是向上走进一个交易区间或一段新的多头趋势，双底同时也是一个高2买入建仓形态，入场点就在形成最后一次下探、创出该双底的那根K线高点之上一个最小报价单位处。


> As is discussed in the chapter on reversals in the third book, when traders are looking for a reversal down, they often look for a high 1, high 2, or triangle (a high 3) pattern that they expect will fail and become the final flag of the bull leg, and then short above the buy signal bar. Since the breakout is a test of the high, it creates a double top (the breakout might form a lower high or a higher high, but since it is a second push up and it is turning down, it is a type of double top, as discussed in book 3). When a person shorts above a high 2 buy signal bar, he is expecting the market to trade down into a trading range or new bear trend. Since a double top is two pushes up, and the trader is expecting that it is at the top of a trading range or new bear swing, and is also a low 2 sell setup (selling below the low of the bar that created the double top). Almost every reversal down comes from some form of double top. If the top is after just a small leg up in a trading range, the double top will often involve only a few bars and be a micro double top. The same is true of most bottoms. They form from failed low 1 or low 2 or triangle breakouts, which create double bottoms and final flag reversals up. Since a trader is expecting a move up into a trading range or a new bull, a double bottom is also a high 2 buy setup, with the entry at one tick above the high of the bar that created the last push down to the double bottom.


高3和低3形态应当按照楔形（如果形态大体是横向的，就是一个传统的三角形）来交易，因为它们在功能上是一回事。不过，为了让术语保持一致，当它们充当反转形态时，最好还是叫楔形——因为按定义，高3是多头趋势或交易区间里的一次回调（一个楔形牛旗），低3是空头趋势或交易区间里的一个楔形熊旗。举例来说，如果处在多头趋势或交易区间里，高3意味着之前有三段下跌，它在信号K线高点之上给出一个买入信号。如果处在空头趋势里，你要找的是低1、低2、低3、低4建仓形态，而不是高1、高2、高3、高4形态。如果空头趋势里出现一个清晰的楔形底，你应当考虑买入这次反转；但既然它出现在空头趋势里，就应当把它叫作楔形底，而不是高3。同样，如果处在空头趋势或交易区间里，低3意味着之前有三次向上推进，你应当按照楔形顶来交易它。如果处在多头趋势里，你就不该去找低3来做空；但在楔形顶之下做空是可以接受的。


> High 3 and low 3 patterns should be traded like wedges (or a traditional triangle, if the pattern is mostly horizontal) because functionally they are the same. However, to keep the terminology consistent, it is better to call them wedges when they act as reversal patterns because by definition a high 3 is a pullback (a wedge bull flag) in a bull trend or trading range, and a low 3 is a wedge bear flag in a bear trend or a trading range. For example, if there is a bull trend or a trading range, a high 3 means that there were three legs down, and that sets up a buy signal above the high of the signal bar. If there is a bear trend, you are looking for low 1, 2, 3, and 4 setups and not high 1, 2, 3, and 4 patterns. If there is a clear wedge bottom in a bear trend, you should look to buy the reversal; but since it is in a bear trend, you should call this a wedge bottom and not a high 3. Likewise, if there is a bear trend or a trading range, a low 3 means that there were three pushes up and you should trade it like a wedge top. If there is a bull trend, you should not be looking for a low 3 to short, but shorting below a wedge top can be acceptable.


失败的高4/低4还有一种变体。如果高4或低4的信号K线特别小，尤其是当它是一根十字星时，有时候入场K线会迅速反转成一根外包K线，把刚刚入场的交易者的保护性止损打掉。当信号K线很小时，为了避免被反复扫损，最好的做法常常是把保护性止损放在信号K线之外一个最小报价单位以上的位置（也许三个最小报价单位，但在Emini 小型合约里，如果平均波幅大约是10个点，从入场算起总共不要超过八个最小报价单位），并且仍然把这个形态当作有效，即使它在技术上已经失败——尽管只是差了一个最小报价单位左右。记住，一切都是主观的，交易者总是在寻找接近完美的东西，但从不期待完美，因为完美很罕见。


> There is also a variation for a failed high/low 4. If the signal bar for the high 4 or low 4 is particularly small, especially if it is a doji, sometimes the entry bar will quickly reverse into an outside bar, running the protective stops of the traders who just entered. When the signal bar is small, to avoid a whipsaw it is often best to place your protective stop at more than one tick beyond the signal bar (maybe three ticks, but no more than a total of eight ticks from your entry in the Emini when the average range is about 10 points) and still to treat the pattern as valid even though technically it failed, albeit by only a tick or so. Remember, everything is subjective and a trader is always looking for something close to perfect, but never expecting perfection, because perfection is rare.


要注意，5分钟图上的复杂修正，在更高时间级别的图上常常表现为简单的高1、高2、低1、低2修正。去看更高时间级别的图并不值得，因为交易机会在5分钟图上已经很明显，而你有可能会为了找那些罕见的信号分散注意力，反而错过太多5分钟图上的信号。


> Be aware that complex corrections on the 5 minute chart often appear as simple high/low 1 or 2 corrections on higher time frame charts. It is not worth looking at the higher time frame charts since the trades are evident on the 5 minute chart and you risk distracting yourself looking for rare signals and missing too many 5 minute signals.


高1买入建仓形态，是市场向下反转的一次失败尝试；低1做空建仓形态，则是空头趋势中一次失败的上涨尝试。因为强趋势通常会延续，反转尝试几乎总会失败。你可以靠押注这种失败来获利。你的入场位置，正好是那些被套住的反向操作者（逆势交易者）认赔出场的地方。他们的出场止损，就是你的入场止损。


> A high 1 buy setup is a failed attempt by the market to reverse down, and a low 1 short setup is a failed rally attempt in a bear trend. Because strong trends usually continue, reversal attempts almost always fail. You can profit by betting on the failure. You enter exactly where those trapped faders (traders trading against the trend) will exit with their losses. Their exit stop is your entry stop.


最可靠的高1和低1入场，出现在趋势的急速阶段（也就是趋势最强的那一段）里微趋势线被假突破的时候。交易者看到一段急速行情，就开始找高1买入，但他们忽略了高1买入建仓形态的第二个关键组成部分。最后一个组成部分是一道筛选条件——在显著的买入高潮之后不要做高1，在显著的卖出高潮之后不要做低1做空。没错，你需要一段多头急速行情；但你同时也需要一轮强多头趋势。交易者最常犯的错误之一，是靠希望交易，把每一个高1都买一遍，指望趋势随后会来。他们必须强迫自己先等多头趋势形成，然后再去找高1。如果那段多头急速行情很强、但仍然位于图上早先的高点之下，市场可能还处在交易区间里，这就让在高1之上买入风险更大。高1买入建仓形态很可能变成这轮上涨行情在大修正或反转之前的末端旗形。那段飞驰而上的多头急速行情，也可能是对交易区间高点的一次买入价格真空式测试，而不是一轮新的多头趋势。如果多头和空头都预期交易区间的高点会被测试，那么一旦市场接近顶部，多头就会积极而不间断地买入，确信市场够得着那个只高一点点就能摸到的磁力位。强空头看到的是同一件事，于是停止做空。几分钟后就能卖到更好的价格，他们何必现在做空？结果就是一段非常强的多头急速行情，而它一旦抵达交易区间顶部附近就会反转；到那时，聪明的交易者不会去买强多头趋势K线的收盘价，也不会去买高1建仓形态。事实上，很多人会挂限价单去做空，因为他们预期这次突破尝试会像大多数强劲的突破尝试一样失败。交易者要想买高1，需要的是强多头急速行情加上多头趋势，而不是交易区间内随便一段向上急速行情。另外，如果那段多头急速行情是以一个过强的买入高潮收尾，他们也不该买这个高1。


> The most reliable high 1 and low 1 entries occur when there is a false breakout of a micro trend line in the spike phase of a trend, which is the strongest segment of the trend. Traders see a spike and start looking to buy a high 1, but they are overlooking the second critical component of a high 1 buy setup. The final component is a filter—do not take a high 1 following a significant buy climax, and don't take a low 1 short after a significant sell climax. Yes, you need a bull spike; but you also need a strong bull trend. One of the most common mistakes that traders make is that they trade on hope and buy every high 1, expecting a trend to follow. Instead, they have to force themselves to wait for the bull trend to form and then look for a high 1. If the bull spike is strong, but still below earlier highs on the chart, the market might still be in a trading range, which makes buying above a high 1 riskier. The high 1 buy setup could easily turn into the final flag of the rally before a big correction or a reversal. The bull spike that is racing up might be due to a buy vacuum test of the trading range high and not a new bull trend. If both the bulls and the bears expect the top of the trading range to get tested, once the market gets close to the top, the bulls will buy aggressively and relentlessly, confident that the market will make it up to the magnet that is just a little higher. The strong bears see the same thing and stop shorting. Why should they short now when they can sell at an even better price in a few minutes? The result is a very strong bull spike that leads to a reversal once it reaches around the top of the trading range, at which point smart traders would not be buying the closes of the strong bull trend bars or the high 1 buy setups. In fact, many would be shorting, using limit orders, since they expect that this breakout attempt will be like most strong breakout attempts, and will fail. For traders to buy a high 1, they need a strong bull spike and a bull trend, not simply a spike up within a trading range. Also, they should not buy the high 1 if the bull spike ended with too strong a buy climax.


低1做空也一样。先等空头趋势出现，而不只是交易区间里的一段空头急速行情，然后再去找带低1卖出建仓形态的急速行情。不要一看到急速行情就去做空每一个低1，因为大多数急速行情发生在交易区间里，而在交易区间底部做空低1是一种亏钱的策略，因为那个低1建仓形态很有可能成为这段下跌行情的末端旗形；市场随后可能大幅向上修正，甚至出现多头反转。如果交易者想买高1或做空低1，他们只应当在趋势的急速阶段这么做；一旦有可能出现高潮的迹象，就不要做这笔交易。举例来说，如果你想买一个高1建仓形态，你是在赌这次回调会非常小、只有一段。许多高1建仓形态只是急涨的三到五根K线之后的一两根K线回调；另一些则是极强趋势中打到移动平均线的四五根K线回调，那种趋势已经走了5到10根K线，可能有点走得太远、太快。如果你在买这样一次短暂的回落，你相信市场里有巨大的紧迫感，而这次短暂回调可能是你在一个你眼中非常强的多头趋势高点之下买入的唯一机会。如果市场横盘走了五根K线、还出现好几根小十字星，那市场已经失去了紧迫感，最好先等一等再买。如果这时形成一个高2，那才是更安全的买入建仓形态。


> The same is true for a low 1 short. Wait for the bear trend, not just a bear spike within a trading range, and then look for a spike with a low 1 sell setup. Don't simply short every low 1 after every spike, because most spikes occur in trading ranges, and shorting a low 1 at the bottom of a trading range is a losing strategy because the low 1 setup has a good chance of being the final flag in the leg down; the market might then have a large correction up or even a bull reversal. If traders are looking to buy a high 1 or short a low 1, they should do so only in the spike phase of a trend and not take the trade if there is evidence of a possible climax. For example, if you are looking to buy a high 1 setup, you are betting that the pullback will be minimal and have only one leg. Many high 1 setups are just one-or two-bar pullbacks after sharp three-to five-bar spikes, while others are four-or five-bar pullbacks to the moving average in extremely strong trends that have run for five to 10 bars, which can be a little too far, too fast. If you are buying such a brief pullback, you believe that there is tremendous urgency in the market and that this brief pullback might be your only chance to buy below the high of what you believe is a very strong bull trend. If the market goes sideways for five bars and has several small dojis, the market has lost its urgency and it is better to wait before buying. If a high 2 forms, it is a safer buy setup.


交易者没能买到高1回调，最常见的原因是他原本在指望一次更大的回调。然而，在出现强多头趋势的时候建立多头仓位很重要，交易者应当在前一个摆动高点之上挂买入止损单，以防这次回调很短、多头趋势很快恢复。强空头趋势里也一样。如果做空低1的三项条件都已具备（强空头趋势、强空头急速行情、没有强卖出高潮），交易者就必须做空。如果他们在犹豫要不要挂一张在低1信号K线之下做空的单子，那就挂一张在摆动低点之下一个最小报价单位处做空的单子。这样，如果他们最终没有做空那个低1、而市场却一路飞奔下跌，他们也会被卷进这轮强空头趋势里。这远比站在场边看着、等下一次回调要好得多。如果他们做空了低1，随后可以再把那张在摆动低点之下做空的单子撤掉。


> The most common reason for a trader failing to buy a high 1 pullback is that the trader was hoping for a larger pullback. However, it is important to get long when there is a strong bull trend, and traders should place a buy stop above the prior swing high, in case the pullback is brief and the bull trend quickly resumes. The same is true in a strong bear trend. If the three criteria for shorting a low 1 are present (a strong bear trend, a strong bear spike, and no strong sell climax), traders must get short. If they are deciding whether to place an order to short below a low 1 signal bar, they should place an order to short at one tick below the swing low. Then, if they end up not shorting the low 1 and the market races down, they will be swept into the strong bear trend. This is far better than watching from the sidelines and waiting for the next pullback. If they short the low 1, they can then cancel the order to short below the swing low.


如果高1在强多头趋势的急速阶段里是如此可靠的买入建仓形态，那么在机构知道趋势恢复、随后再创新高的概率可能有80%的情况下，它怎么还可能形成呢？如果他们认为市场会走得更高，又怎么会容许出现回调？因为它就是他们造出来的。那段急速行情，是许多公司在同一时间不间断地买入造成的，也就是说，他们在自己的买入程序里正在分批建立多头仓位。到了某个时点，这些公司都会开始分批止盈；当其中足够多的公司停止买入、开始卖出平仓时，就会出现一根低点低于前一根K线低点的K线。市场跌破另一根K线时，还会有许多其他公司买入，但如果趋势不是太强，他们也只是剥个头皮。从这一刻起，各家机构都会陆续分批止盈；正因如此，高1建仓形态上方的突破，常常只能带来一次剥头皮的机会。在最强的趋势里，它能成为一次波段交易，而且可能在高一些的位置还有一两个高1建仓形态，然后再来几个高2买入建仓形态；但无论哪种情况，回调都是由机构对它们更低位置的仓位止盈造成的。他们做的就是要赚钱，这意味着他们总得在某个时点止盈；而当足够多的机构同时开始部分止盈时，他们就造出了牛旗，比如高1、高2，或者更大的回调。空头趋势里正好相反。


> If that high 1 is such a reliable buy setup in the spike phase of a strong bull trend, how could it possibly form when the institutions know that there might be an 80 percent chance of the trend resuming and being followed by a new high? Why would they ever allow the pullback if they believe the market will go higher? It is because they created the pullback. The spike was caused by many firms simultaneously buying relentlessly, which means that they were scaling into their long positions during their buy programs. At some point, each of those firms will start scaling out of its position, and once enough of them stop buying and begin to sell out of their positions, a bar will form with a low that is below the low of the prior bar.
