This will make other traders more likely to buy, the rally more likely to continue, and their profit grow. Sometimes the market will fall below a minor higher low and find buyers. This new low is the basis for a new, flatter trend line (from the bottom of the channel) and a less steep, broader channel. It indicates that the price action is becoming more two-sided and therefore more like a trading range, but still in a channel. Once the market clearly enters a trading range, traders will start selling rallies, which will reduce the ability of the bulls to keep pushing the market higher and limit their ability to profit. As long as they can keep the market trending up, they know that most traders will only look to buy. The market will often pull pack to the most recent higher low and set up a double bottom bull flag. This is acceptable to the bulls because they know that it is a bullish setup and that the market will expect about a measured move up if the setup triggers (by trading above the high of the signal bar). At least they then have an idea of how much higher the rally might go, and this will give them a profit-taking target.


当市场处在趋势的急速行情阶段时，它是非常一边倒的，回调是由机构止盈造成的，而不是由它们做反方向交易造成的。随着回调变深，逆势交易者开始剥头皮。一旦回调长成了交易区间，更多的逆势交易者会剥头皮，有些还会分批建立空头仓位。顺势交易者对趋势还能走多远变得没那么有信心，他们从波段交易转向更多的剥头皮。这就是为什么在交易区间中，多空双方的剥头皮占主导地位。双方都在低买高卖。底部的买入，是多头在建多头仓位、空头在止盈；顶部的卖出，是空头在做空、多头在止盈。既然交易者的工作是跟随机构，他也应该剥头皮，在区间底部附近买入、在区间顶部附近卖出。每当市场处在交易区间中，交易者就应该立刻想到：“低买高卖，剥头皮。”


> When the market is in its spike phase of a trend, it is very one-sided and pullbacks are created by institutions taking profits, not by them trading in the opposite direction. As pullbacks get deeper, countertrend traders begin to scalp. Once pullbacks grow into trading ranges, more countertrend traders are scalping and some are scaling into shorts. The with-trend traders become less confident about how much further the trend can go, and they transition from swing trading into more scalping. That is why in a trading range, scalping by both the bulls and bears is dominant. Both are buying low and selling high. The buying at the bottom is being done by bulls initiating longs and bears taking profits, and the selling at the top is by bears shorting and bulls taking profits. Since a trader's job is to follow the institutions, he too should be scalping, and buying near the bottom and selling near the top of the range. Whenever the market is in a trading range, traders should immediately think, “Buy low, sell high, and scalp.”


交易区间有双边交易，多头在底部附近更强，空头在顶部附近更强。交易区间中的每一次上涨行情本质上都是一面熊旗，每一次抛售实际上都是一面牛旗。正因如此，交易者对待区间顶部的方式，就像对待空头趋势中的一面熊旗那样。他们在K线上方和下方卖出，在阻力位上方和支撑位下方卖出。他们在K线上方卖出，包括在强劲的多头趋势K线上方卖出，也在每一种阻力位上方卖出，因为他们把每一次上涨都看成试图突破区间顶部，而他们知道大多数突破尝试都会失败。他们在K线下方卖出，也在每一种支撑位下方卖出，因为他们把每一次下跌都等同于空头趋势中熊旗底部的突破。他们预期突破交易区间顶部的尝试会失败、熊旗突破会成功、市场很快会向下反转并测试区间底部。


> Trading ranges have two-sided trading, where the bulls are stronger near the bottom and the bears are stronger near the top. Every rally in a trading range is essentially a bear flag and every selloff is effectively a bull flag. Because of this, traders trade the top of the range the way they trade a bear flag in a bear trend. They sell above and below bars, and above resistance and below support areas. They sell above bars, including strong bull trend bars, and above every type of resistance, because they see each move up as an attempt to break out of the top of the range, and they know that most breakout attempts fail. They sell below bars and below every type of support, because they see each move down as equivalent to a breakout of the bottom of a bear flag in a bear trend. They expect that attempts to break above the trading range will fail, that the bear flag breakouts will succeed, and that the market will soon reverse down and test the bottom of the range.


他们对待区间底部的方式，就像对待多头趋势中的一面牛旗那样。他们在K线上方和下方买入，在阻力位上方和支撑位下方买入。他们在K线下方买入，包括在强劲的空头趋势K线下方买入，也在每一种支撑位下方买入，因为他们把每一次下跌都看成试图突破区间底部，而他们知道大多数突破尝试都会失败。他们在K线上方买入，也在每一种阻力位上方买入，因为他们把每一次上涨都等同于多头趋势中牛旗顶部的突破。他们预期突破交易区间底部的尝试会失败、牛旗突破会成功、市场很快会向上反转并测试区间顶部。


> They trade the bottom of the range the way they trade a bull flag in a bull trend. They buy above and below bars, and above resistance and below support areas. They buy below bars, including strong bear trend bars, and below every type of support, because they see each a move down as an attempt to break out of the bottom of the range, and they know that most breakout attempts fail. They buy above bars and above every type of resistance, because they see each move up as equivalent to a breakout of the top of a bull flag in a bull trend. They expect that attempts to break below the trading range will fail, and that the bull flag breakouts will succeed, and that the market will soon reverse up and test the top of the range.


当图表处于趋势中时，交易区间相对较小，更准确的说法是回调，因为它们只是趋势中的短暂停顿，之后会跟随一次对趋势极值的测试。如果没有出现测试而市场反转了，那么起初看似回调的东西就演变成了一个反转形态。如果整张图上到处都是上下涨跌的波段，那么多头和空头谁也不占主导，它们交替控制市场，这张图就处在交易区间中。每一次波段都是一段小趋势，具备潜在的可交易性，尤其是在更小的时间级别上。在更大的时间级别上，这个交易区间将会是一段趋势中的回调。举例来说，一张5分钟图上的大型交易区间，很可能只是60分钟图上趋势中的一次回调；而一个60分钟图上的交易区间，则会是日线图或周线图上的回调。


> When the chart is trending, the trading ranges are relatively small and better described as pullbacks since they are just brief pauses in the trend and are followed by a test of the trend's extreme. If no test comes and the market reverses, what at first appeared to be a pullback has evolved into a reversal pattern. If the chart is composed of upswings and downswings across the entire screen, then neither the bulls nor the bears are dominant and they are alternating control over the market and the chart is then in a trading range. Each swing is a small trend that is potentially tradable, especially on a smaller time frame. On a larger time frame, the trading range will be a pullback in a trend. For example, a 5 minute chart that is a large trading range will likely be just a pullback in a trend on the 60 minute chart, and a 60 minute trading range will be a pullback on a daily or weekly chart.


许多交易者使用旗形、三角旗形或三角形这类描述性名称，但名称无关紧要。唯一重要的是双边交易正在发生。市场处在突破模式中，到某个时点它会朝某个方向突破，进入新的趋势。多头和空头都相信这个价格区域是价值不错的区域，并且双方都在建仓。价值在极值处显现。要么市场太便宜，就像在支撑位时那样；要么市场太贵，就像在阻力位时那样。交易区间的中部对多头和空头双方来说也是价值区，因为双方都把它看成极值：多头相信市场正在筑底，因此处在低位；空头认为它正在筑顶，因此处在高位。如果市场下跌一点，空头就会卖得少一些，而多头在这个更好的、更极端的价格上会变得更积极。这往往会把市场抬回区间中部。如果价格涨到区间顶部附近，多头就会买得少一些，因为他们觉得市场有点贵了；而空头相反，会更急于在这些更好的价格上卖出。


> Many traders use descriptive names like flags, pennants, or triangles, but the name is irrelevant. All that matters is that two-sided trading is taking place. The market is in breakout mode and at some point it will break out in either direction into another trend. Both the bulls and the bears believe that this price area is an area of good value, and both are initiating trades. Value exits at extremes. The market is either too cheap, as it is at support, or too expensive, as it is at resistance. The middle of a trading range is also an area of value for both the bulls and the bears, because both see it as an extreme. The bulls believe that the market is bottoming and therefore at a low, and the bears see it as topping and at a high. If the market drops a little, the bears will sell less and the bulls will become more aggressive at this better, more extreme price. This will tend to lift the market back toward the middle of the range. If the price goes up near the top of the range, the bulls will buy less, since they will see the market as a little expensive. The bears, in contrast, will be even more eager to sell at these better prices.


即使是一条陡峭的通道，也代表突破模式。举例来说，如果有一条陡峭的牛通道，市场可能突破通道顶部，趋势可能向上加速。出现这种情况时，突破通常在一两次尝试之后失败，而且通常在五根K线之内；而如果市场反转回到通道中，它通常会刺穿通道的另一侧，之后常常跟随一次更大的修正或一波反转。即使一次突破急速行情持续了好几根K线，通常也很快会出现一次回调来测试通道，而这个回调常常重新进入通道、从另一侧突破，随后至少还有一次两段式修正，有时则是一波趋势反转。


> Even a steep channel represents breakout mode. For example, if there is a steep bull channel, the market can break out of the top of the channel and the trend can accelerate to the upside. When this happens, the breakout usually fails after one or two attempts and usually within about five bars, and if the market reverses back into the channel, it usually pokes through the opposite side of the channel and often is followed by a larger correction or a reversal. Even if a breakout spike lasts several bars, there is usually a pullback soon that tests the channel, and it often reenters the channel, breaks out of the other side, and then is followed by at least a two-legged correction and sometimes a trend reversal.


在一张5分钟 Emini 图上，当市场处在一个相对窄幅的交易区间中、在反转回到区间另一侧之前波段只有两到四根K线长时，正在发生的事情往往比表面上看起来的要复杂得多。人们很容易把这种价格行为简单归结为清淡交易下的随机漂移；但如果你看看成交量，你常常会发现那些K线平均成交一万张合约甚至更多。这不是清淡交易。真正可能正在发生的是：许多机构在运行买入程序，而另一些机构在区间内运行卖出程序。当市场接近区间顶部时，卖出程序卖得更积极；接近底部时，买入程序压倒了卖出程序。哪一方都赢不了。到某个时点，要么买入程序在区间顶部压倒了卖出程序，市场向上突破形成一波上涨行情；要么卖出程序在区间底部压倒了买入程序，市场出现一波向下突破。不过，在那一刻到来之前，这个交易区间可能已经有十几个或更多的上下波段了；而既然那十几次突破尝试在有一次最终成功之前全都失败了，那么与其在每一次突破尝试上入场，远不如反着它们下注。要明白：突破在每张图上都很常见，但大多数都会失败，这一点在第一部分关于突破的那一章讨论过。


> On a 5 minute Emini chart, when the market is in a relatively tight trading range where the swings are only two to four bars long before the market reverses toward the other side of the range, there is often much more going on than what appears to be happening. It is easy to ascribe the price action simply to random drift with light trading; but if you look at the volume, you will often discover that the bars are averaging 10,000 contracts or more. This is not light trading. What is probably happening is that many institutions are running buy programs while other institutions are running sell programs within the range. When the market gets near the top of the range, the sell programs are selling more aggressively; when it is near the bottom, the buy programs are overwhelming the sell programs. Neither side can win. At some point, either the buy programs will overwhelm the sell programs at the top of the range and the market will break out into a rally, or the sell programs will overwhelm the buy programs at the bottom of the range and the market will have a bear breakout. However, the trading range might have a dozen or more up and down swings before that happens, and since those dozen or so breakout attempts fail before one finally succeeds, it is far better to bet against them than to enter on each breakout attempt. It is important to understand that breakouts are common on every chart but most fail, as was discussed in Part I in the chapter on breakouts.


交易区间总是在试图突破，正因如此，那些朝顶部和底部的波段往往动能很强，带有一两根、有时三四根带小影线的大趋势K线。在测试区间底部时，空头正试图积蓄足够的动能来威吓多头并吸引其他卖方，好让出现一次带后续行情的突破。不过，在下跌行情段刚开始时，多头就看到了正在积聚的下跌动能，并已经在预判什么样的价格才是最好的、让他们能再次积极买入的价格。空头也在寻找一个止盈的好价格。还有什么比几根跌破摆动低点的大空头趋势K线更好呢，尤其当这个低点还处在另一个支撑区域，比如趋势线或等距运动目标位的时候？多头和空头都在等市场测试区间底部，不在乎它是未及靶位还是过靶。当市场正跌向区间底部、而多空双方都预期它会走得更远以形成一个清晰的测试时，他们就没有动力去买——因为他们相信自己只要再等一会儿就能买得更便宜。当这些机构交易者这样退到一边时，市场就出现了相对的失衡，动能往往随着市场下跌而增强。这就是价格真空效应，它会迅速把市场吸到区间底部。有些大型程序交易者专做动能，在动能强劲时积极卖出，并且一直卖到下跌动能停止为止。这就制造出了随后跟随一次向上反转的大空头趋势K线。在市场测试区间低点时，经常可以看到一两根这样的大空头趋势K线。一旦它抵达某个支撑位（通常是一个小的等距运动目标位），买盘就进场并积极买入。空头获利买回自己的空头仓位，多头买入新的多头仓位。这止住了动能，使动能交易者也停止卖出并开始买回自己的空头仓位。有这么多大型交易者在积极而不停地买入，市场于是开始一段向上的波段。


> Trading ranges are always trying to break out, and because of this, the swings toward the top and bottom often have strong momentum with one or two, and sometimes three or four, large trend bars with small tails. On a test of the bottom of the range, the bears are trying to generate enough momentum to intimidate the bulls and attract other sellers so that there will be a breakout with follow-through. However, as the down leg begins, the bulls see the building downward momentum and are anticipating what the best price will be where they can buy aggressively again. The bears are also looking for a good price to take profits. What could be better than a couple of large bear trend bars that break below a swing low, especially if it is at another support area like a trend line or measured move target? Both the bulls and the bears wait for the market to test the bottom of the range, not caring if it undershoots it or overshoots it. As the market is falling toward the bottom of the range and the bulls and the bears expect it to go further to make a clear test, they have no incentive to buy when they believe they can buy even more cheaply if they wait a little more. When these institutional traders have stepped aside like this, there is a relative imbalance in the market, and the momentum often picks up as the market falls. This is the vacuum effect and it quickly sucks the market to the bottom of the range. Some large program traders trade momentum, selling aggressively when the momentum is strong and continuing to sell until the momentum down stops. This creates large bear trend bars that then are followed by a reversal up. It is common to see a large bear trend bar or two as the market tests the low of the range. Once it reaches a support level, which is usually a small measured move target, the buyers come in and aggressively buy. The bears buy back their shorts for a profit and the bulls buy new longs. This stops the momentum, causing the momentum traders to also stop selling and begin to buy back their shorts. With so many large traders buying aggressively and relentlessly, the market begins a swing up.


如果你是机构多头或机构空头，这再理想不过了。既然市场已经在区间底部，你就想现在买入，而还有什么比你用来作买入信号的那根过度延伸的空头K线更好？你强烈相信市场将要上涨，而眼前市场正急速下跌，显示出极端的空头强势。这是一个绝佳的买入机会，因为你相信价值极为出色，而且你知道如果自己是对的，这个低价只会短暂存在。机构交易者会不知从哪里突然冒出来，积极买入。有些人会就在那最后一根大空头趋势K线的收盘时买入，另一些人则会等着看下一根K线是不是一根停顿K线。如果它收出阳线，他们就会更有信心。如果它是一根停顿K线，他们会把这看成更多证据，说明空头无法延续自己的卖出，因此是弱势的。他们也可能等市场交易到前一根K线的高点上方并真正反转。会有大型多头和大型空头在所有这些迹象处、在所有时间级别上买入，他们会有各种能想象到的信号提示他们入场。


> If you are an institutional bull or bear, this is perfect. You want to buy now that the market is at the bottom of the range, and what could be better than an overextended bear bar for your signal to buy? You believe strongly that the market will be going up, and here you have the market spiking down, showing extreme bearish strength. This is a great opportunity to buy since you believe the value is excellent and you know that if you are right, it will be at this low price only briefly. The institutional traders will appear out of nowhere and will buy aggressively. Some will buy on the close of that last big bear trend bar, whereas others will wait to see if the next bar is a pause bar. They will be even more confident if it has a bull close. If it is a pause bar, they will see that as more evidence that the bears are unable to follow through on their selling and are therefore weak. They might also wait for the market to trade above the high of the prior bar and actually reverse. There will be large bulls and bears buying at all of these signs and on all time frames, and they will have every imaginable signal telling them to enter.


一些正在止盈的空头随着市场下跌而分批加仓在更低价位。这让他们的平均入场价也下降了，使他们能够在市场向上反转回到他们的平均入场价之前就积极买回自己所有的空头仓位，以确保自己在出场时是盈利的。既然空头在买入而不是卖出，而多头现在也在积极买入，就出现了相对的买盘失衡，市场于是再次向区间顶部移动。在交易区间顶部，情况恰恰相反，强劲的多头趋势K线常常同时引来多头止盈和空头新建空头仓位的卖出。


> Some of the profit-taking bears scaled in lower as the market fell. This made their average entry price fall as well, enabling them to aggressively buy back all of their shorts before the market reverses up to their average entry price to make sure that they have a profit when they exit. Since the shorts are buying and not selling and the bulls are now buying aggressively, there is a relative buy imbalance and the market again moves up toward the top of the range. The opposite happens at the top of the trading range, and strong bull trend bars often lead to selling by both the bulls taking profits and the bears initiating new shorts.


这就是为什么交易区间总是朝顶部和朝底部猛冲，而且它们看起来总是即将突破，结果却反转。这也解释了为什么大多数交易区间的突破都会失败，以及为什么会有突破区间顶部的多头趋势K线和突破区间底部的空头趋势K线。市场越接近区间的顶部或底部，就有越多交易者相信它会越过旧的极值，至少越过一两个最小报价单位。交易区间的顶部和底部有一种磁力，市场越接近顶部或底部，这种磁力就越强，因为那些预期市场会反转的大型交易者正等着最好的价格，然后突然积极地入场，扭转市场。这对所有交易区间都成立，包括多头和空头通道、三角形以及牛旗和熊旗。


> This is why trading ranges always race toward the top and toward the bottom and they always look like they are about to break out, only to reverse. It also explains why most breakouts of trading ranges fail and why there are bull trend bars that break out of the top and bear trend bars that break out of the bottom. The closer the market gets to the top or bottom of the range, the more traders believe that it will exceed the old extreme, at least by a tick or two. The top and bottom of a trading range have a magnetic pull that gets greater as the market gets closer to the top or bottom because large traders who expect the market to reverse are just waiting for the best price and then they suddenly enter aggressively, reversing the market. This is true for all trading ranges, including bull and bear channels, triangles, and bull and bear flags.


绝不要被朝交易区间顶部或底部涌去的强劲动能套住。你需要跟随机构在做什么，而它们所做的，就是在区间顶部卖出强劲的多头趋势K线、在区间底部买入强劲的空头趋势K线，恰恰在市场看起来有力量突破的时候。只有图表解读经验非常丰富的交易者，才应该在突破K线的收盘时反向操作市场。几乎所有交易者，如果改为等待市场反转回到区间内时用止损单入场，成功的机会都会大得多。此外，只有当信号K线不太大时，他们才应该做这笔交易，因为他们需要接近区间的极值入场，而不是在中间入场。


> Never get trapped by the strong momentum surges toward the top or bottom of a trading range. You need to be following what the institutions are doing, and what they are doing is selling strong bull trend bars at the top of the range and buying strong bear trend bars at the bottom, exactly when the market looks like it has the strength to break out. Only traders who are very experienced reading charts should fade the market on the close of breakout bars. Almost all traders are more likely to be successful if they wait to enter on a stop as the market reverses back into the range. Also, they should take the trade only if the signal bar is not too large, because they need to be entering near the extreme of the range and not in the middle.


最终会有一次突破成功，但此前的5到10次尝试都会看起来很强，然后失败。正因为这套数学期望，预期突破失败要好得多。当一次成功的突破出现时，可以寻找在回调处入场做新趋势，甚至在突破过程中入场（如果它看起来足够强、而且整体背景使突破很可能成功）。但在那之前，跟随机构；一旦它们能在区间顶部或底部附近造成一次反转（一次突破失败），就做那笔反转入场。在第一部分中，关于突破的那一章讨论了成功的突破通常是什么样子。


> Eventually a breakout will be successful, but the prior five to ten attempts will all look very strong and fail. Because of this math, it is far better to expect failure. When a successful breakout happens, look to enter the new trend on a pullback or even during the breakout if it looks strong enough, and the overall context makes a breakout likely to succeed. But until then, follow the institutions; as soon as they are able to create a reversal (a failed breakout) near the top or bottom of the range, take the reversal entry. In Part I, the chapter on breakouts discusses how successful breakouts typically appear.


既然多头趋势中的交易区间是一面牛旗，而且它在更高时间级别图表上只是一次回调，交易者可以用止损单买入突破，并把保护性止损放在交易区间底部下方的远处。任何一次突破成功的概率约为20%，但市场最终向上突破的概率约为60%。不过，在多头趋势恢复之前，它可能先向上、向下突破好几次；所以如果交易者买入突破又不想被止损出局，他们需要把保护性止损放在交易区间下方足够远的位置，使那些反复出现的、向下的突破失败不会把他们止损掉。很少有交易者愿意冒那么大的风险、等那么久，所以大多数人应该不要买入大多数交易区间的突破。有时候，多头趋势中交易区间上方的突破是一次不错的买入止损单入场，但只有在多头趋势在突破之前就已明显开始恢复时才行。即便如此，通常在多头趋势正在恢复时于交易区间内部入场更好，或者等突破出现，然后在突破之后、一旦它明显强劲时买入，或者等突破回调最终形成时买入。


> Since a trading range in a bull trend is a bull flag, and it is just a pullback on a higher time frame chart, a trader could buy the breakout on a stop and use a protective stop well below the bottom of the trading range. The chance of any one breakout being successful is about 20 percent, but the chance that the market will eventually break to the upside is about 60 percent. However, it might break to the upside and to the downside several times before the bull trend resumes, so if traders buy a breakout and do not want to get stopped out, they need to place their protective stops far enough below the trading range so that the repeated failed downside breakouts will not stop them out. Few traders are willing to risk that much and wait that long, so the majority of them should not buy most trading range breakouts. Sometimes a breakout above a trading range in a bull trend is a good entry on a buy stop, but only when the bull trend clearly has started to resume before the breakout. Even then, it is usually better to enter within the trading range as the bull trend is resuming or to wait for the breakout and either buy after the breakout, once it is clearly strong, or buy a breakout pullback, when one eventually forms.


媒体把交易者说得像是在恐惧与贪婪之间来回摇摆。对新手来说这大概是真的，但对有经验的交易者来说不是，他们很少感到这两种情绪中的任何一种。他们身上更常见、也更有用的另一对情绪是：不确定与紧迫。趋势是一个确定的区域，或者至少是相对确定的区域。你自己的雷达能告诉你，市场更可能处在趋势中，还是处在交易区间中的一段强行情里。如果你有一种不确定感，市场更可能处在交易区间中；如果你反而有一种紧迫感，并且盼着出现回调，那么市场更可能处在趋势中。每个趋势都由一连串急速行情和交易区间构成，而急速行情都很短暂。当它们存在时，概率带有方向偏向。这意味着，在多头趋势的急速行情期间，市场在下跌 X 个最小报价单位之前先上涨 X 个最小报价单位的概率超过50%，如果趋势强劲，还可能达到70% 或更高。多头和空头都同意，市场需要移动到某个新的价格水平，不确定性才会在那里重新出现。交易区间就是那个不确定的区域，而每当你对市场的方向感到不确定时，它很可能就处在交易区间中。在交易区间的中部，市场上涨或下跌 X 个最小报价单位的概率大多数时候大约是50%。这个概率会有短暂的波动，但其中大多数波动持续的最小报价单位太少，没法靠交易获利。这种对不确定性的寻找，就是等距运动的基础。市场会继续它那个概率更高的方向性移动，直到概率降到50–50以下，也就是反转很可能发生（现在市场朝反方向移动的概率更大）。大多数时候，这会在某个支撑或阻力区域发生，比如一个先前的摆动点、趋势线或趋势通道线，而且大多数时候它会发生在某个等距运动的区域。这个反转是一次朝日后将成为交易区间中部的移动，在那里，市场在朝反方向走 X 个最小报价单位之前先朝某方向走 X 个最小报价单位的概率是50%。


> The media makes it sound like traders oscillate between fear and greed. That is probably true for beginners, but not for experienced traders, who rarely feel either. Another pair of emotions is much more common with them, and also much more useful: uncertainty and urgency. A trend is an area of certainty, or at least relative certainty. Your personal radar can tell you if the market is more likely in a trend instead of a strong leg within a trading range. If you have a sense of uncertainty, the market is more likely in a trading range; if instead you have a sense of urgency and you are hoping for a pullback, then the market is more likely in a trend. Every trend is made of a series of spikes and trading ranges, and the spikes are brief. When they exist, there is a directional bias to the probabilities. This means that during a spike in a bull trend, the odds of the market moving X ticks higher before it moves X ticks lower are more than 50 percent, and can be 70 percent or more if the trend is strong. Both the bulls and the bears agree that the market needs to move to a new price level, where uncertainty will return. A trading range is that area of uncertainty, and whenever you are uncertain about the direction of the market, it is likely in a trading range. Within the middle of a trading range, the probability of the market moving up or down X ticks is about 50 percent most of the time. There are brief fluctuations in this probability, but most of them last for too few ticks to be traded profitably. This search for uncertainty is the basis of measured moves. The market will continue its higher-probability directional move until the odds fall below 50–50, meaning that a reversal is likely (the odds are greater that the market will now move in the opposite direction). Most of the time, that will occur at some area of support or resistance, like a prior swing point or trend line or trend channel line, and most of the time it will be in the area of some measured move. The reversal is a move toward what will become the middle of a trading range where there is a 50 percent chance of the market moving up or down X ticks before it goes X ticks in the opposite direction.


当你对一个交易区间完全中立时，一次上下等幅运动的方向概率是50%，而市场大致处在日后将成为区间中部的位置附近。随着市场朝区间顶部推进，概率变得更有利于下跌，市场在上涨 X 个最小报价单位之前先下跌 X 个最小报价单位的方向概率达到60% 或更高。在区间底部附近，情况相反，方向概率有利于一波上涨行情。如果在这个区间之前曾有一段强劲的多头趋势，而且没有出现清晰的顶部，那么即使市场处在交易区间中部，也存在一个有利于多头的方向偏向。如果此前的趋势非常强，那么区间中部的方向概率可能是53% 到55%，尽管永远无法确定。要知道，交易区间在更高时间级别图表上都是持续形态；如果它之前有一段强劲的多头趋势且没有清晰的顶部，那么向上突破的概率就更大。在一段强劲的多头趋势之后，当市场跌到区间底部时，一次上下等幅运动的方向概率比在一段空头趋势之后形成的交易区间底部更大，所以不是60% 有利于上涨，也许是70% 到80%。事实上，在出现 X 个最小报价单位的抛售之前先出现两倍或三倍 X 个最小报价单位的上涨行情的概率，甚至可能达到70% 或更高。举例来说，如果这个交易区间高50个最小报价单位，而你在一次两段式回调到区间底部的走势中、在一根多头反转K线上方买入，这根K线高8个最小报价单位，那么在触及你止损位之前，市场可能有70% 的概率先上涨20或30个最小报价单位，而你的止损位在你入场价下方10个最小报价单位处。同样，在区间顶部附近，一次上下等幅运动的方向概率低于在一段空头趋势之后形成的交易区间，不是70% 到80% 的概率先下跌 X 个最小报价单位再上涨 X 个最小报价单位，而更可能是60% 左右。再说一次，没有人能知道确切的概率，但清楚这种偏向是有帮助的，因为它应该在你思考要不要做这笔交易时影响你。在一轮大的多头市场中，你应该更倾向于在交易区间底部附近买入，而不是在顶部做空。


> When you are completely neutral about a trading range, the directional probability of an equidistant move is 50 percent, and the market is around what will become the middle of the range. As the market works toward the top of the range, the odds favor the market going down, and the directional probability is 60 percent or more that the market will fall X ticks before it goes up X ticks. Near the bottom of the range, that is reversed, and the directional probability favors a rally. If there has been a strong bull trend leading up to the range and there has not been a clear top, then there is a directional bias in favor of the bulls, even when the market is in the middle of the trading range. If the trend was very strong, then the directional probability in the middle of the range might be 53 to 55 percent, although it is impossible to ever be certain. Just be aware that trading ranges are continuation patterns on higher time frame charts, and if there was a strong bull trend leading up to it and no clear top, the odds of an upside breakout are greater. Following a strong bull trend, when the market falls to the bottom of the range, the directional probability of an equidistant move is greater than at the bottom of a trading range that formed after a bear trend, so instead of 60 percent in favor of a rally, maybe it is 70 to 80 percent. In fact, the odds of a rally that is twice or three times X ticks before a sell-off of X ticks might even be 70 percent or higher. For example, if the trading range is 50 ticks tall and you bought above a bull reversal bar on a two-legged pullback to the bottom of the range, and the bar is eight ticks tall, there might be a 70 percent chance of the market rallying 20 or 30 ticks before hitting your stop 10 ticks below your entry. Likewise, near the top of the range, the directional probability of an equidistant move is less than in a trading range that followed a bear trend, and instead of a 70 percent to 80 percent chance of the market falling X ticks before rallying X ticks, those odds might be more like 60 percent. Again, no one can ever know the exact odds, but it is helpful to be aware of the bias because it should influence you when you are thinking about taking a trade. You should be more inclined to buy near the bottom of a trading range in a large bull market than you are to short at the top.


多头和空头都不知道突破的方向，但双方在区间内交易都很自在；而且由于多头在区间顶部倾向于少买、空头倾向于多卖，在底部则相反，市场大部分时间都待在中部某处。这个舒适区有一种磁力，每当市场离开它，就会被拉回来。即使出现一次成功并持续数根K线的突破，它通常也会被拉回区间内，而这正是末端旗形的基础，末端旗形在第三本书中讨论。同样常见的是：市场先朝一个方向突破、持续数根K线，然后反转，再朝反方向突破，接着回调回到区间内。交易区间的磁力效应可能影响市场好几天，常见的情形是市场从一个强交易区间（比如一个持续10根或更多K线的相对窄幅区间）趋势性地离开，结果两三天后又回到这个区间内。


> Neither the bulls nor the bears know the direction of the breakout, but both are comfortable trading within the range; and because of the tendency of bulls to buy less and bears to sell more at the top of the range and to do the opposite at the bottom, the market spends most of the time somewhere in the middle. This area of comfort has a magnetic pull, and whenever the market moves from it, the market gets drawn back into it. Even if there is a successful breakout that runs several bars, it usually will get pulled back into the range, and that is the basis for final flags, which are discussed in book 3. It is also common to see a breakout in one direction that runs for several bars, then a reversal, then a breakout in the opposite direction, and then a pullback into the range. The magnetic effect of a trading range can affect the market for several days, and it is common to see the market trend away from a strong trading range, like a relatively tight range that lasted 10 or more bars, only to come back into the range two or three days later.


是什么让交易区间中的多头或空头改变了看法，最终使一次突破能够成功？很少见的情况是，会出现一条像联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）报告这样、被预期在日内某个特定时间发布的消息；但大多数时候，突破是无法预料的。电视上总能为突破找到一条与消息有关的理由，但大多数时候这大概跟正在发生的事情无关。一旦市场突破，CNBC 就会找一位评论人士，让他自信地解释这是某条消息的直接结果。如果市场反而朝反方向突破，这位评论人士就会对同一条消息给出相反的解释。举例来说，如果市场因 FOMC 降息而向上突破，这位评论人士会论证利率更低对市场有利。如果市场因同样的降息而向下突破，他就会论证降息证明美联储认为经济疲弱，因此市场定价过高。这两种解释都无关紧要，与刚刚发生的一切毫无关系。没有什么事会那么简单，而且无论如何，这对交易者来说都无关紧要。每天的大部分成交量都是由程序产生的；在突破之前和突破期间有几十个大型程序在运行，它们由不同的公司各自独立设计，每一家都试图从其他家那里赚钱。这些程序背后的逻辑无从知晓，因此也无关紧要。对交易者来说，唯一重要的是净结果。作为交易者，你应该跟随机构：如果它们在推动市场上涨，你就应该跟随它们做买方；如果它们在推动市场下跌，你就应该跟随它们做卖方。


> What causes either the bulls or the bears in a trading range to change their perspective, eventually allowing a breakout to succeed? Rarely, there will be a news item like a Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) report that is expected at a specific time in the middle of the day, but most of the time the breakout is unanticipated. There will always be a news-related reason for the breakout given on TV, but most of the time it probably is irrelevant to what is taking place. Once the market breaks out, CNBC will find some pundit who will confidently explain how it was the direct result of some news item. If instead the market broke out in the opposite direction, the pundit would then argue the opposite interpretation of the same news item. For example, if the market broke out to the upside on an FOMC interest rate cut, the pundit would argue that lower rates are good for the market. If it broke to the downside on the same rate cut, the pundit would argue that the rate cut is proof that the Federal Reserve thinks the economy is weak and therefore the market is overpriced. Both explanations are irrelevant and have nothing to do with what just took place. Nothing is ever that simple and, in any case, it is irrelevant to a trader. Most of the volume every day is generated by programs; there are dozens of big ones running before and during the breakout, and they are designed independently of one another by different firms that are each trying to take money from the others. The logic behind the programs is unknowable and therefore irrelevant. All that matters to traders is the net result. As a trader, you should follow the institutions, and if they are driving the market up, you should follow them and be a buyer. If they are driving the market down, you should follow them and be a seller.


几乎无一例外，突破会在10根以上K线的过程中逐步展开，最后才成功，而这可能就在消息发布前一小时。市场已经就突破的方向拿定了主意，不管消息会是什么；而如果你能读懂价格行为，你常常能在突破发生之前就摆好自己的位置。


> Almost invariably, the breakout will be unfolding over the course of 10 or more bars before it finally succeeds, which might be an hour before the news was released. The market has already made up its mind about the direction of the breakout, no matter what the news will be, and if you can read the price action, you can often position yourself before the breakout occurs.


举例来说，如果多头开始变得不耐烦，因为他们觉得市场到现在本应该已经向上突破了，他们就会开始卖出手中的多头仓位。这会加大空头的卖压。此外，这些多头很可能希望在明显更低的价位才重新买入，而他们在区间底部不买入会移除买盘；结果就是价格会在空头趋势中下跌到一个多头再次看到价值的更低价位，而另一个交易区间又会形成。在一次向上突破中，情况相反。空头不再愿意在区间内做空，他们会买回自己的空头仓位，从而加大多头的买盘。他们只会在明显更高的价格上才重新寻找做空机会，这就创造出一块流动性稀薄的区域，多头在这里让市场以多头突破的形式快速上行。市场会在多头趋势中继续快速上行，直到到达一个空头再次相信做空有价值、而多头开始对自己的多头仓位止盈的水平。那时，双边交易会恢复，另一个交易区间会形成。


> For example, if the bulls begin to become impatient because they thought that the market should have broken out of the upside by now, they will start to sell out of their longs. This will add to the selling pressure of the bears. Also, those bulls will likely want significantly lower prices before looking to buy again, and their absence of buying at the bottom of the range will remove buying pressure; the result will be that prices will fall down in a bear trend to a lower level where the bulls see value again, and another trading range will form. In an upside breakout, the opposite happens. Bears are no longer willing to short within the range and they will buy back their shorts, adding to the buying pressure of the bulls. They will look to short again only at a significantly higher price, which creates a thin area where the bulls move the market up quickly in a bull breakout. The market will continue to move up quickly in a bull trend until it reaches a level where the bears once again believe that there is value in shorting and the bulls start to take profits on their longs. Then, two-sided trading will resume and another trading range will form.


如果这段横盘的价格行为已经持续了大约5到20根K线，而且非常窄幅，那么交易者就必须格外小心，因为多头和空头处在非常紧的平衡之中。在这种情况下交易突破可能代价高昂，因为每一次短暂的上冲都会被空头积极卖出，而新多头又急于离场。这就在区间顶部附近那些K线的上方留下影线。同样，每一次急剧下跌都会被迅速逆转，在区间底部附近那些K线的下方留下影线。不过，交易这种市场是有办法获利的。有些公司和许多交易者每隔几个最小报价单位下跌就分批建立多头仓位、分批退出空头仓位，每隔几个最小报价单位上涨就做相反的操作。然而，这对个人交易者来说很枯燥，而且充其量只能赚到极少的利润，他们会发现等一次成功突破终于出现时，自己已经累得没法好好交易了。


> If the sideways price action has lasted for about 5 to 20 bars and is very tight, then a trader has to be particularly careful because the bulls and bears are in very tight balance. Trading breakouts in this situation can be costly since every brief up move is sold aggressively by the bears and the new bulls are quick to exit. This results in tails at the tops of the bars near the top of the range. Likewise, every sharp move down is quickly reversed, creating tails at the bottoms of the bars near the bottom of the range. There are, however, ways to profitably trade this type of market. Some firms and many traders are scaling into longs and out of shorts every few ticks lower and doing the opposite every few ticks higher. However, this is tedious and minimally profitable at best for individual traders, and they will find themselves too tired to trade well once a successful breakout finally occurs.


一般来说，所有交易区间都是持续形态，意思是它们沿此前那个趋势的方向突破的时候比不沿该方向突破的时候更多。它们也倾向于朝离开均线的方向突破。如果它们位于均线下方，通常向下突破；如果位于均线上方，往往向上突破。如果交易区间紧邻均线，这一点尤其成立。如果它们离均线很远，那它们可能是在为一个回到均线的测试做准备。如果一段多头波段在一个交易区间中停顿，概率有利于最终向上突破。不过，在最终那次突破之前，可能先有几次对顶部和底部的突破失败，而且有时市场会逆势突破。此外，一个交易区间持续得越久，它变成一个反转形态的概率就越大（空头交易区间中的吸筹，多头交易区间中的派发）。这是因为顺势交易者会开始担心自己没能让趋势恢复，于是开始平掉仓位，并且不再加仓。由于这些不确定性，交易者需要小心，并寻找低风险的价格行为建仓形态。一张5分钟图上持续数小时、带有许多大幅而难以解读波段的交易区间，在15分钟或60分钟图上可能只是一个小而干净、容易解读的交易区间，所以有时看看更高时间级别是有帮助的。事实上，许多交易者就交易更高时间级别的图表。


> In general, all trading ranges are continuation patterns, meaning that they more often than not break out in the direction of the trend that preceded them. They also tend to break out away from the moving average. If they are below the moving average, they usually break to the downside, and if they are above it, they tend to break out to the upside. This is especially true if the trading range is adjacent to the moving average. If they are far from the moving average, they may be setting up a test back to the moving average. If a bull swing pauses in a trading range, the odds favor the ultimate breakout taking place to the upside. However, there may be several failed breakouts of the top and bottom before the final breakout, and sometimes the market breaks out countertrend. Also, the longer a trading range continues, the greater are the odds that it will become a reversal pattern (accumulation in a bear trading range, distribution in a bull trading range). This is because the with-trend traders will become concerned that they are failing to make the trend resume, and they will begin to cover their positions and will stop adding to them. Because of these uncertainties, traders need to be careful and look for low-risk price action setups. Trading ranges on a 5 minute chart that last for hours with many big, hard-to-read swings can be small, clean, and easy-toread trading ranges on a 15 or 60 minute chart, so it sometimes is helpful to look at higher time frames. Many traders, in fact, trade higher time frame charts.


你屏幕上的图表大多数时候处在交易区间中，多头和空头对价值的看法大体一致。在交易区间之内，有一些小趋势；而那些小趋势之内，又有小交易区间。当市场处于趋势中时，多头和空头对价值同样是一致的，只不过这个一致是：价值区在别的地方。市场正在快速移动到一个多头和空头都感到有价值的交易区间，双方会在那里较量，直到明显可以看出某一方是对的、另一方是错的，然后市场会再次形成趋势。


> The chart on your screen is in a trading range most of the time, with the bulls and the bears in general agreement about value. Within the trading range, there are small trends; and within those trends, there are small trading ranges. When the market is trending, the bulls and the bears are also in agreement about value, and the agreement is that the value area is somewhere else. The market is moving quickly to a trading range where both bulls and bears feel there is value, and they will fight it out until it becomes clear that one side is right and the other is wrong, and then the market will trend again.


有些交易区间日由两三个大的趋势性波段构成；在这些波段期间，市场表现得像强趋势一样。不过，第一次反转通常要到头一个小时左右之后才开始，而在那之前，一个趋势日通常就已经展开了。当趋势开始得太晚时，这一天很有可能是一个交易区间日，并且至少会有第二次反转和对区间中部的一次测试。


> Some trading range days are composed of two or three large trending swings; during the swings, the market behaves like a strong trend. However, the first reversal usually does not begin until after the first hour or so, and a trend day is usually underway before then. When a trend starts too late, there is a good chance that the day will be a trading range day and that there will be at least a second reversal and a test of the middle of the range.


日内中间那三分之一时间，大约从太平洋时间上午8:30到10:30，在那些并非明确趋势的日子里（换句话说，大多数日子），对交易者来说可能很难做。如果市场正在当日区间的大致中部交易（或者只是在当日区间内某个交易区间的中部），而眼下又处在当日交易时段的中部，那么出现一个K线重叠、大影线、多次小反转的窄幅交易区间的可能性就很大，大多数交易者明智的做法是少做交易。在这种情况下，通常最好是放弃任何不够完美的入场，改为等待一次对当日高点或低点的测试。一个尚未成功的交易者，在市场处在日内中段、同时又处在当日区间的中部时，不应该交易。仅靠改变这一点，就可能决定他是一名亏损者还是一名盈利者。


> The middle third of the day, from around 8:30 a.m. until 10:30 a.m. PST, can be difficult for traders on days that are not clearly trending (in other words, most days). If the market is trading in the approximate middle of the day's range (or just the middle of a trading range within the day's range) and it is now in the middle of the day's trading hours, the chance of a tight trading range with overlapping bars, big tails, and multiple small reversals is significant, and most traders would be wise to trade sparingly. It is usually better to forgo any less than perfect entry under these circumstances and instead wait for a test of the high or low of the day. A trader who is not yet successful should not trade when the market is in the middle of the day while it is also in the middle of the day's range. This change to one's trading alone can mean the difference between being a loser and a winner.


有时中午时分，Emini 上会出现一个看起来极好的形态，而你在入场时会吃到1个最小报价单位的滑点。如果市场没有在几秒内奔向你的止盈目标，那么你大概率已经被套住了。在这种情况下，几乎总是最好挂一张限价单、在保本位出场。每当某样东西看起来好得不像真的、明显到所有人都会想入场时，它很可能恰恰就是它看起来的那个样子——不是真的。


> Sometimes there will be an extremely great-looking pattern setting up midday in the Emini and you will get one tick of slippage on the entry. If the market does not race to your profit target within seconds, the chances are high that you have been trapped. In this case, it is almost always better to place a limit order to get out at breakeven. Whenever something looks too good to be true, so obvious that everyone will look to enter, the odds are high that it is exactly as it appears to be—not true.


每当先出现一波向上急速行情、再出现一波向下急速行情，或者反过来，市场就形成了一个高潮反转，这在第三本书中讨论。急速行情之后通常跟随一条通道；但既然两个方向都出现过急速行情，多头和空头就会继续积极交易，试图压倒对方、制造出朝自己方向的通道。这种通常发生在高潮之后的双边交易就是一个交易区间，它可以短到只有一根K线，也可以持续几十根K线。最终那次突破通常会引出一段等距运动，其幅度大致等于急速行情的高度。


> Whenever there is a spike up and then a spike down, or vice versa, the market has formed a climax reversal, which is discussed in the third book. A spike is usually followed by a channel; but since there have been spikes in both directions, the bulls and bears will continue trading aggressively as they try to overpower each other and create a channel in their direction. This two-sided trading that usually takes place after a climax is a trading range, and it can be as brief as a single bar or can last for dozens of bars. The eventual breakout will usually lead to a measured move that approximates the height of the spike.


一个交易区间有时看起来像反转建仓形态，但实际上只是趋势中的一次停顿。举例来说，如果60分钟图上有一段强多头趋势，而5分钟图上有一段持续数根K线的强急速下跌，随后是一段持续数根K线、相当于回调的上涨行情，然后是又一段持续数根K线的急速下跌，那么这个形态在5分钟图上可能看起来非常偏空，但它在60分钟图上可能只是一个简单的高2或双底买入建仓形态。如果这个 ABC 结束于60分钟均线处，这一点尤其成立。你不一定要看60分钟图，但你应该始终清楚交易区间之前那个趋势的方向。这会让你更有信心下这笔单——这里是一个大型高2买入形态，而不是一段新空头趋势的开始。


> A trading range can sometimes appear to be a reversal setup but in fact be just a pause in the trend. For example, if there is a strong bull trend on the 60 minute chart and the 5 minute chart has a strong spike down that lasts several bars, which is followed by a pullback rally that lasts several bars and then a second spike down for several more bars, the pattern might look strongly bearish on the 5 minute chart, but it could be a simple high 2 or double bottom buy setup on the 60 minute chart. This is especially true if the ABC ends at the 60 minute moving average. You do not have to look at the 60 minute chart, but you should always be aware of the direction of the trend that preceded the trading range. This will give you more confidence to place the trade, which here is a large high 2 buy pattern and not the start of a new bear trend.


有时某个空头趋势日的低点，尤其是一个高潮式的空头趋势日，可能来自一个带大K线的小交易区间，这些K线往往有大影线或大反转实体。这类反转在顶部不那么常见，因为顶部往往不像底部那么高潮化。这些交易区间通常同时也是别的信号，比如双底回调或双顶熊旗。


> Sometimes the low of a bear trend day, especially a climactic one, can come from a small trading range that has large bars, often with large tails or large reversal bodies. These reversals are less common at tops, which tend to be less climactic than bottoms. These trading ranges are often other signals as well, such as double bottom pullbacks or double top bear flags.


尽管交易区间在更高时间级别图表上是旗形，通常沿趋势方向突破，但有些确实朝反方向突破。事实上，大多数反转形态都是某种交易区间。头肩形态就是很明显的一种。双顶和双底也是交易区间。第三本书中关于趋势反转的那一章会更充分地讨论这一点，但重要的是认识到：趋势中的大多数交易区间沿趋势方向突破，并不会引出反转。因此，所有的反转形态其实都是持续形态，只是偶尔没能持续，反而反转了。正因如此，当你看到一个反转形态时，寻找顺势入场远比寻找反转入场要好。这意味着，如果存在一段多头趋势，而它正在形成一个头肩顶，那么在市场试图向下突破时寻找买入信号，远比在突破处做空要好得多。


> Even though trading ranges are flags on higher time frame charts and usually break out in the direction of the trend, some break out in the opposite direction. In fact, most reversal patterns are some type of trading range. A head and shoulders pattern is an obvious one. A double top and a double bottom are also trading ranges. This is discussed further in the chapter on trend reversals in book 3, but it is important to realize that most trading ranges within trends break out in the direction of the trend and do not lead to reversals. Therefore, all reversal patterns are actually continuation patterns that occasionally fail to continue and instead reverse. Because of this, it is far better to look for with-trend entries when you see a reversal pattern than to look for reversal entries. This means that if there is a bull trend and it is forming a head and shoulders top, it is far better to look for a buy signal as the market tries to break out to the downside than it is to short on the breakout.


所有趋势都包含大小不一的交易区间，而有些趋势主要由交易区间构成，比如趋势性交易区间日，这在第一本书第22章中讨论过。你应该知道，市场常常会在最后一小时左右试图反转最后一个交易区间，所以如果这一天是一个空头趋势性交易区间日，那就在进入当天最后一两个小时时，在当日低点处寻找一个买入建仓形态。


> All trends contain trading ranges of different sizes and some trends are predominantly trading ranges, like trending trading range days, which were discussed earlier in book 1, Chapter 22. You should be aware that the market often tries to reverse the final trading range in the last hour or so, so if the day is a bear trending trading range day, look for a buy setup at the low of the day going into the final hour or two of the day.


有些有经验的交易者善于判断一个趋势什么时候正在演变成一个交易区间，一旦他们相信这件事正在发生，就会分批建立逆势仓位。举例来说，如果这一天是一个多头趋势性交易区间日，突破已经到达以较低那个交易区间的高度为基础测算的等距运动区域，而且这波上涨一直处在一条相对弱的牛通道中，那么空头就会开始在前一个摆动高点上方做空。他们还会留意一根相对较大的多头趋势K线，并在它的收盘时或高点上方做空，因为它可能是一个买入高潮，是这条牛通道的终点或接近终点的位置，因此也接近一个交易区间的顶部。只有非常有经验的交易者才应该尝试这种做法，而其中大多数人的交易规模会小到足以在市场继续走高时继续分批加仓空头。如果市场确实继续走高而他们分批加仓了，有些人会在市场回调到他们第一次入场价时对整个仓位止盈。另一些人则会在保本位平掉第一笔入场，保留剩余仓位等待对通道底部的一次测试。当这条牛通道还在推进时，新手看到的只是一段多头趋势，而有经验的交易者看到的是一个正在形成的交易区间的第一段行情。等这一天结束、新手回头看时，他们会看到那个交易区间，并同意它始于牛通道的底部。然而，当那条牛通道还在推进时，新手并没有意识到市场同时处在一条牛通道和一个交易区间中。作为新手，他们不应该在多头趋势中做空；只有在出现强信号时——最好是二次信号——才应该考虑在一个交易区间中交易。那些做空的、有经验的交易者是在剥头皮，因为他们把市场看成正在进入一个交易区间，而不是在反转成一段空头趋势。当市场处在交易区间中时，交易者通常只应该剥头皮，直到下一个趋势开始，那时他们才能再次把部分或全部交易做成波段。


> Some experienced traders are good at knowing when a trend is evolving into a trading range, and they will scale into countertrend trades once they believe it is happening. For example, if the day is a bull trending trading range day and the breakout has reached the area of the measured move based on the height of the lower trading range, and if the rally has been in a relatively weak bull channel, bears will begin to short above prior swing highs. They will also watch for a relatively large bull trend bar and short its close or above its high, since it could be a buy climax and be the end or near the end of the bull channel and, therefore, near the top of a trading range. Only very experienced traders should attempt this, and most of those traders will trade small enough so that they can scale into their short positions if the market continues higher. If it does go higher and they scale in, some would take profits on their entire position once the market pulls back to their first entry. Others will exit the first entry at breakeven and hold the remainder for a test of the bottom of the channel. As the bull channel is progressing, beginners will see only a bull trend, but experienced traders will see the first leg of a developing trading range. Once the day is over and beginners look back, they will see the trading range and agree that it began at the bottom of the bull channel. However, as that bull channel progressed, beginners did not realize that the market was in both a bull channel and a trading range. As beginners, they should not be shorting in a bull trend, and should consider trading in a trading range only if there is a strong signal, preferably a second signal. The experienced traders who shorted were scalping because they saw the market as entering a trading range and not reversing into a bear trend. When the market is in a trading range, traders should generally only be scalping until the next trend begins, at which point they can once again swing part or all of their trades.


在交易区间中交易，最困难的一点就是交易区间两难。既然大多数突破都会失败，你的止盈目标就有限，这意味着你在剥头皮。然而，当你缩小回报却保持风险不变时，你就需要一个高得多的成功率才能满足交易者等式。否则，你就是在交易一个注定最终会让你爆仓的策略（也就是把账户跌到低于你的经纪商允许你下单所需的最低保证金要求）。这个两难在于：你必须剥头皮，但剥头皮要求非常高的成功率，而这么高的确定性不可能在交易区间中长期存在，因为交易区间按定义就是不确定占主导的地方。如果这个区间特别窄，成功的概率就更小。提高成功率的一个办法，是在市场正朝对你不利的方向走时用限价单入场。举例来说，有些交易者会在区间顶部一个看起来疲弱的高1或高2上方做空，或者在摆动高点或多头趋势K线上方做空。他们也可能会在区间底部一个疲弱的低1或低2下方买入，或者在摆动低点或空头趋势K线下方买入。另一种办法是先建立一个较小的初始仓位，然后如果市场朝对你不利的方向走就分批加仓。


> The single most difficult aspect of trading in a trading range is the trading range dilemma. Since most breakouts fail, your profit goals are limited, which means that you are scalping. However, when you reduce your reward yet keep your risk the same, you need a much higher probability of success to satisfy the trader's equation. Otherwise, you are trading a strategy that is guaranteed to eventually blow your account (i.e., drop it to below the minimum margin requirements for your broker to allow you to place trades). The dilemma is that you have to scalp, but scalping requires a very high probability of success, and that high degree of certainty cannot exist for long in a trading range, where by definition uncertainty prevails. If the range is particularly tight, the chance of success is even smaller. One way to improve your chance of success is to enter with limit orders as the market is going against you. For example, some traders will short above a weak-looking high 1 or high 2, or above a swing high or bull trend bar at the top of the range. They might also buy below a weak low 1 or low 2, or a swing low or bear trend bar at the bottom of the range. Another approach is to take a smaller initial position and scale in if the market goes against you.


如果区间足够大，大多数交易者会试图在区间顶部做空小的空头反转K线、在区间底部买入小的多头反转K线，尤其当出现二次入场时，比如在区间顶部做空一个低2，或在区间底部买入一个高2。要记住，虽然高2和低2建仓形态在交易区间中都有效，但交易者对待它们的方式与它们在趋势中形成时不同。当存在多头趋势时，交易者会在一个行情段的顶部附近买入高2；但当存在交易区间时，他们只在区间底部才买入高2。同样，空头会在空头趋势的底部做空一个低2，但他们在交易区间中只会在区间顶部才做空低2。


> If the range is large enough, most traders try to short small bear reversal bars at the top of the range and buy small bull reversal bars at the bottom of the range, especially when there are second entries, like shorting a low 2 at the top of the range or buying a high 2 at the bottom of the range. Remember, although both high 2 and low 2 setups are valid in trading ranges, traders trade them differently from when they form in trends. When there is a bull trend, traders will buy a high 2 near the top of a leg, but when there is a trading range, they will buy a high 2 only if it is at the bottom of the range. Similarly, bears will short a low 2 at the bottom of a bear trend but they will short a low 2 in a trading range only when it is at the top of the range.


既然交易区间就是一条水平通道，你就把它当作任何通道那样交易。如果波段小，你就剥头皮；如果波段大，你可以剥头皮，也可以把部分仓位波段做到另一端。如果交易区间非常大而且已经持续了好几天，那么整天下来的走势都可能是强趋势，而它仍然处在交易区间之内。出现这种情况时，就把这一天当作任何趋势日那样交易。如果波段非常小，这个交易区间就是一个窄幅交易区间，这在第22章讨论。区间越窄，你应该做的交易就越少。当这个区间是一个窄幅交易区间时，你几乎不应该做任何交易。


> Since a trading range is simply a horizontal channel, you trade it like any other channel. If the swings are small, you scalp; if they are large, you can scalp or swing some of your position to the opposite end. If the trading range is very large and has lasted several days, entire days can be strong trends and still be within the trading range. When that happens, trade the day like any other trend day. If the swings are very small, the trading range is a tight trading range, which is discussed Chapter 22. The tighter the range, the fewer trades you should take. When the range is a tight trading range, you should rarely take any trades.


当市场处在交易区间中时，要寻找在区间底部附近买入、在顶部附近做空的机会。一般来说，如果市场已经下跌了大约5到10根K线，就只寻找买入机会，尤其当市场接近区间底部时。如果市场已经上涨了5到10根K线，就只寻找做空机会，尤其当它接近区间顶部时。只有在波段大到足以赚到利润时，才在区间中部交易。举例来说，如果一个交易区间高10个最小报价单位，你不会想在区间低点上方6个最小报价单位处买入，因为市场再上涨6个最小报价单位的概率并不大，而这正是你赚到4个最小报价单位所需要的。如果这个交易区间高6个点，你就可以在一个更高的低点买入、在区间中部入场，因为上方有空间，可以在市场遇到区间顶部的阻力之前赚到一个剥头皮交易者的利润。


> When the market is in a trading range, look to buy near the bottom of the range and short near the top. In general, if the market has been going down for about 5 to 10 bars, only look to buy, especially if the market is near the bottom of the range. If the market has been going up for five to 10 bars, only look to short, especially if it is near the top of the range. Trade in the middle of the range only if the swings are large enough to make a profit. For example, if the trading range is 10 ticks tall, you do not want to buy six ticks above the low of the range, since the odds of the market going six ticks further up are not great and that is what you would need to make a four-tick profit. If the trading range is six points tall, you can buy a higher low and enter in the middle of the range since there is room above to make a scalper's profit before the market encounters the resistance of the top of the range.


第一本书中关于通道的那一章讨论了如何交易通道，而既然交易区间就是一条水平通道，所用的方法是一样的。


> The chapter on channels in book 1 discusses how to trade them, and since a trading range is simply a horizontal channel, the techniques are the same.


大多数K线都会处在区间的中部，而市场在极值处花费的时间极少。当市场处在极值处时，它通常是以一根强趋势K线的形式到达那里的，让许多交易者相信这次突破会成功而且强劲。常常会有三根或更多大幅重叠的K线，外加一根信号K线，迫使多头在高点附近的最小报价单位处买入，而这通常是一个陷阱。举例来说，假设市场刚刚以两根强空头趋势K线狂奔到区间底部，但已经横盘了两根K线，就停在均线下方；现在出现了一根强空头反转K线，但它与前几根K线大部分重叠，而入场价会在熊旗底部上下1个最小报价单位之内。在这种情况下，不要做这笔交易。这通常是一个空头陷阱，与其在它低点下方1个最小报价单位处挂止损单去做空，远不如在那根空头反转K线的低点挂一张限价单买入。只有当你在读图方面很有经验时，才做这笔反向操作。


> Most of the bars will be in the middle of the range, and the market spends very little time at the extremes. When it is at the extremes, it usually got there with a strong trend bar, making many traders believe that the breakout will be successful and strong. There will often be three or more large, overlapping bars with a signal bar forcing bulls to buy near the high tick, and this usually is a trap. For example, suppose the market just raced to the bottom of the range with a couple of strong bear trend bars but has been sideways for a couple of bars, sitting just below the moving average; now there is a strong bear reversal bar, but it mostly overlaps the prior bars, and the entry price would be within a tick or so of the bottom of the bear flag. In this situation, don't take the trade. This is usually a bear trap, and it is much better to place a limit order to buy at the low of that bear reversal bar than to place a stop order to go short at one tick below its low. Take this fade only if you are experienced with your read.


最好的入场是区间顶部或底部的二次入场，此时信号K线是一根朝你交易方向的反转K线，不太大，而且与前一根K线重叠不太多。不过，信号K线长什么样，对交易区间反转来说，没有对趋势反转那么重要。区间顶部的做空建仓形态，其信号K线常常带有阳线实体；而区间底部附近的买入建仓形态，常常带有阴线实体。通常并不强求出现强反转K线，除非交易者想在一段强趋势中做一笔反转交易。


> The best entries are second entries at the top or bottom of the range where the signal bar is a reversal bar in your direction that is not too large and does not overlap the prior bar too much. However, the appearance of the signal bar is less important for trading range reversals than for trend reversals. Short setups at the top of the range often have signal bars with bull bodies, and buy setups near the bottom of the range often have bear bodies. A strong reversal bar is not usually mandatory unless a trader is looking to take a reversal trade in a strong trend.


大多数交易者即使能赢下60% 的交易，剥头皮也会亏钱。这在他们风险约为潜在回报的两倍时尤其如此。这意味着交易者必须非常小心地对待交易区间的交易。考虑到80% 的突破尝试都会失败，一个交易区间的交易者必须有有限的止盈目标，而许多最佳交易会是大号剥头皮或小波段。举例来说，如果 Emini 近期的平均日振幅大约是10到15个点，那么平均的保护性止损大约是2个点。如果交易者在一个至少6个点高的交易区间顶部、在一根强空头信号K线下方做空，尤其是他们在做二次信号，那么他们至少有60% 的概率赚到2个点，而风险是2个点。这产生了一个勉强能盈利的交易者等式，因此是一个成功的策略。如果看起来这波行情可能下跌4个点，交易者可能会在2个点处止盈四分之一到一半，然后试着把剩余仓位波段做到大约4个点。他们可以在赚到2个点的部分利润后把止损移到保本位，也可以把止损从2个点收紧到大约1个点（4个最小报价单位）或5个最小报价单位。到那时，他们是用5个最小报价单位的风险去赚4个点，即使成功概率只有40%，他们也拥有一个能盈利的交易者等式。有些在2个点处部分或全部止盈的交易者，会在原来的入场价挂限价单再次做空，但这一次只冒大约5个最小报价单位的风险。他们会根据整体市场情况，试着在这笔交易上赚2到4个点。如果入场K线或随后那根K线成为一根强空头K线，他们就会倾向于持有以博取更大的行情。


> Most traders will lose money if they scalp, even if they win on 60 percent of their trades. This is especially true if their risk is about twice as large as their potential reward. This means that traders have to be very careful with trading range trades. Given that 80 percent of breakout attempts fail, a trading range trader has to have limited goals, and many of the best trades will be big scalps or small swings. For example, if the average daily range in the Emini has recently been approximately 10 to 15 points, the average protective stop will be about two points. If traders are shorting below a strong bear signal at the top of a trading range that is at least six points tall, especially if they are taking a second signal, they have at least a 60 percent chance of making two points while risking two points. This results in a minimally profitable trader's equation and is therefore a successful strategy. If it appears that the move could fall four points, traders might take a quarter to half off at two points and try to swing the remainder for about four points. They might move the stop to breakeven after taking two-point partial profits, or they could tighten it from two points to maybe one point (four ticks) or five ticks. At that point, they are risking five ticks to make four points, and even if the chance of success is only 40 percent, they have a winning trader's equation. Some traders who took partial or full profits at two points will place limit orders to short again at their original entry price, but risk only about five ticks this time. They might try for two to four points on their trade, depending on the overall market. If the entry bar or the following bar becomes a strong bear bar, they will be inclined to hold for a larger move.


如果交易区间只有3个点高，有时甚至只有4个点高，那么用止损单入场通常是一个亏损策略。这时交易区间就是一个相对窄幅的交易区间，这在后面讨论，只有非常有经验的交易者才应该交易它。这类交易大多需要用限价单入场，而新手绝不该在市场下跌时买入、或在市场上涨时卖出，因为他们总是会挑中那种行情会走得太远、以至于他们被吓到并亏损出场的情形。


> If the trading range is only three or sometimes even four points tall, entering on stops is usually a losing strategy. The trading range is then a relatively tight trading range, which is discussed later, and only very experienced traders should trade it. Most of the trades require limit order entries, and beginners should never buy when the market is falling or sell when it is rallying, because they invariably will choose situations in which the move will go so far that they will become frightened and exit with a loss.


无论这个区间有多高，如果你想交易，而正在测试区间顶部或底部的那个行情段是一条窄幅通道，那就最好等一次突破回调，也就是一次二次入场。所以，如果市场已经上涨了10根K线、正接近交易区间顶部，但这10根K线都处在一条微型通道中，就不要在前一根K线的低点下方做空——向上的动能太强了。相反，等着看这段微型通道突破之后是否会出现一次回调。这个回调可以是对通道顶部的任何一次测试，包括一个更低的高点、一个双顶或一个更高的高点。然后再考虑在前一根K线的低点下方做空，并把保护性止损放在信号K线的高点上方。如果那根信号K线是一根好的空头反转K线，这个建仓形态就更可靠，尤其是当它不太大时。如果它太大，就很可能会与前一根或几根K线重叠过多，让你在离区间高点太远的地方做空。出现这种情况时，通常最好先等一次回调再做空。


> Regardless of how tall the range is, if you are looking to trade and the leg that is testing the top or bottom of the range is a tight channel, it is better to wait for a breakout pullback, which is a second entry. So if the market has been going up for 10 bars and is near the top of the trading range, but these 10 bars are in a micro channel, do not short below the low of the prior bar—the upward momentum is too strong. Instead, wait to see if there is a pullback from this micro channel breakout. The pullback can be any test of the top of the channel, including a lower high, double top, or a higher high. Then look to short below the low of the prior bar and place a protective stop above the high of the signal bar. The setup is more reliable if that signal bar is a good bear reversal bar, especially if it is not too large. If it is too large, it will likely overlap one or more bars too much and will have you shorting too far below the high of the range. When this happens, it is usually better to wait for a pullback before shorting.


如果在此前10根K线内有其它证据表明强空头正在进入市场，比如在这个价位附近有两三根上方带大影线的K线，或者最近有几根带强阴线实体的K线，那么任何做空建仓形态也会更可靠。这代表卖压在积累，提高了这笔交易成功的概率。同样，如果你打算在区间底部买入，而这个价位有几根下方带大影线的K线或几根带阳线实体的K线，那就说明多头正变得积极，这种买压会提高一笔多头交易获利的概率。如果在你入场点附近还有决斗线形态这样的支撑或阻力，这笔交易成功的概率也会提高。


> Any short setup is also more reliable if there is other evidence of strong bears entering the market within the prior 10 bars, like two or three bars around this level with large tails on top, or several recent bars with strong bear bodies. This represents building selling pressure and increases the chances that the trade will be successful. Similarly, if you are looking to buy at the bottom of the range and there are a few bars at this level with large tails on the bottom or several bars with bull bodies, then the bulls are becoming aggressive, and this buying pressure increases the chances of a profitable long trade. If there is support or resistance like a dueling lines pattern near your entry, the odds of a successful trade increase.


交易区间看起来总是像正在突破，但大多数突破尝试都会失败。极值处常常被大趋势K线测试，而如果你是一位有经验的交易者，你可以在其中某根K线的收盘时反向操作。虽然等突破失败之后再入场更稳妥（突破与突破失败在第一部分讨论过），但如果你确信那根趋势K线只是在扫一个摆动高点或低点之外的止损，你也可以在那根K线的收盘时入场，尤其当市场朝对你不利的方向走时你能分批加仓的时候。举例来说，如果市场在过去三个小时里一直处在一个平静的交易区间中，刚刚在先前一个摆动低点下方形成了一段两段式的下跌，而且收盘价收在这根K线的低点上，你就可以考虑在这根K线的收盘时以市价买入。如果此前大多数上涨行情段的动能都强于下跌行情段，概率就更好；而如果这根趋势K线正在测试一条趋势线、一条趋势通道线、一个等距运动目标位或其它支撑位，概率还会更好。


> Trading ranges always look like they are breaking out, but the majority of breakout attempts fail. The extremes are often tested by large trend bars, and, if you are an experienced trader, you can fade the close of one of these bars. Although it is safer to wait for the breakout to fail before entering (breakouts and failures were discussed in Part I), if you are confident that the trend bar is just running stops beyond a swing high or low, you can enter of the close on the bar, especially if you can scale in if the market goes against you. For example, if the market has been in a quiet trading range for the past three hours and just formed a two-legged move down below a prior swing low, and the close was on the low of the bar, you can consider buying at the market on the close of the bar. If most of the up legs have had more momentum than the down legs, the odds are better, and they are better still if the trend bar is testing a trend line, a trend channel line, a measured move target, or other support level.


既然并非所有波段都会抵达区间的极值，你可以考虑分批建立一笔交易。举例来说，如果市场已经上涨了八根K线，并在交易区间顶部下方形成一个低3，你就可以考虑做空这个低3建仓形态，并使用一个较宽的止损，比如在 Emini 中、在日平均振幅约为10个点的日子里用大约4个点的止损。如果这个低3成功了，你就有了一笔盈利的交易，那就出场。如果这个低3失败了，很可能很快会出现一个低4，而且它会成功。如果是这样，你可以通过在你入场价上方固定数目的最小报价单位处做空、或者在前一根K线的高点或摆动高点上方、或者在低4信号处用止损单做空，来分批加仓。然后你可以就在区间底部附近平掉这两个空头仓位，或者也许在第一次做空的入场价处平掉。这样，这笔入场就会是一笔保本的交易，而第二笔更高的入场就会盈利。分批建仓和分批止盈在第31章讨论。


> Since not all of the swings reach the extreme of the range, you can consider scaling into a trade. For example, if the market has been going up for eight bars and is forming a low 3 below the top of the trading range, you can consider shorting the low 3 setup and using a wide stop of maybe four points in the Emini on a day when the average range has been about 10 points. If the low 3 succeeds and you have a profitable trade, you exit. If the low 3 fails, it is likely that there will soon be a low 4 and that it will be successful. If so, you can scale into the trade by shorting a fixed number of ticks above your entry, or above the high of a prior bar or swing high, or on a stop on the low 4 signal. You can then exit both short positions near the bottom of the range or maybe at the entry price of the first short. This entry would then be a breakeven trade and the second, higher entry would be profitable. Scaling in and out of trades is discussed in Chapter 31.


因为交易区间是双边交易，回调很常见。如果你在交易区间中做了一笔交易，你就必须愿意坐等一次回调。不过，如果这个交易区间可能正在转变成趋势，那么当市场朝对你不利的方向走时，你就应该出场，等待一次二次信号。如果你有能力在市场朝对你不利的方向走时分批加仓，你成功的概率就会更大。


> Because trading ranges are two-sided, pullbacks are common. If you take a trade in a trading range, you have to be willing to sit through a pullback. However, if the trading range might be turning into a trend, you should exit if the market goes against you and wait for a second signal. Your odds of success are greater if you have the ability to scale in as the market goes against you.


如果市场处在区间底部，下跌动能疲弱，而市场向上反转了一两根K线，它可能正在形成一个低1做空建仓形态。既然你只应该在空头趋势的急速行情阶段做空一个低1建仓形态，而不应该在交易区间中这么做，那么这个低1就不太可能盈利。于是你会相信，概率是这样的：在前一根K线低点下方做空，市场会先上涨8个最小报价单位，然后才下跌6个最小报价单位。这意味着，在前一根K线低点处或其下方几个最小报价单位处挂一张限价单买入是合理的，你预期这个低1做空会失败并出现一个更高的低点。另外，如果你认为市场正在形成一条牛通道，你就会预期低2也会失败，因此你可以在低2信号K线的低点处或其下方挂一张限价单买入。在区间顶部附近，当市场正在转向下跌并形成低概率的高1和高2买入建仓形态时，你可以做相反的操作：在高1或高2信号K线的高点处或略上方挂一张限价单做空。


> If the market is at the bottom of the range and the downward momentum is weak and the market reverses up for a bar or two, it might be setting up a low 1 short. Since you should short a low 1 setup only in the spike phase of a bear trend and not in a trading range, it is unlikely that this low 1 would be profitable. You then believe that the odds are that a short below the low of the prior bar would go up eight ticks before it falls six ticks. That means that it makes sense to place a limit order to buy at or a couple of ticks below the low of the prior bar, expecting a failed low 1 short and a higher low. Also, if you believe that the market is forming a bull channel, you expect the low 2 to fail as well, and you therefore can place a limit order to buy at or below the low of the low 2 signal bar. You can do the opposite near the top of the range as the market is turning down and forming low-probability high 1 and high 2 buy setups. Place a limit order to short at or just above the high of the high 1 or high 2 signal bar.


既然交易区间中的行情段常常细分成两个更小的行情段，你就可以对前一个行情段的突破做反向操作。在摆动高点上方买入突破，通常只有在强多头趋势中才会带来一笔盈利的交易；而在摆动低点下方做空，通常只有在强空头趋势中才有利可图。如果市场刚刚从交易区间中第一段下跌行情段回调出来，那么你在那第一段底部突破处入场做空的成功概率很小。相反，你可以考虑在那个低点下方几个最小报价单位处挂一张限价单买入，做一次向上的剥头皮。


> Since the legs in a trading range often subdivide into two smaller legs, you can fade the breakout of the prior leg. Buying a breakout above a swing high usually yields a profitable trade only in a strong bull trend, and shorting below a swing low is usually profitable only in a strong bear trend. If the market just pulled back from the first leg down in a trading range, the odds of a successful short trade where you enter on the breakout of the bottom of that first leg are small. Instead, you can consider placing a limit order to buy a few ticks below that low for a scalp up.


因为大多数突破尝试都会失败，所以绝不要为了指望一次成功的突破而过久持有任何交易。要在剥头皮止盈目标处、或在对区间顶部的测试处寻找平掉多头仓位的机会，并用能给出一个剥头皮交易者利润的限价单为空头止盈，或者在对区间底部的测试处出场。绝不要依赖马丁格尔交易法。这在第25章讨论，但它是一种赌博手法：如果你上一笔交易刚刚亏损，就把下一笔交易的规模翻倍或翻三倍；如果你继续亏损，就继续把你上一笔交易的规模翻倍或翻三倍，直到你赢一次为止。几乎无一例外，当你正琢磨这件事的时候，市场处在窄幅交易区间中，很可能会出现四笔或更多连续亏损；因此你会放弃这种做法，因为它会要求你交易远超过你在情绪上能承受的合约数量，而这会给你留下巨大的亏损。一次突破或一笔盈利的交易永远不会“该来了”，而市场维持不可持续行为的时间，可以远长于你能维持自己账户的时间。要挑剔一些，只接受合理的入场，绝不要把任何入场建立在这个想法上：市场“该”给一笔好交易了。


> Because most breakout attempts fail, never overstay any trade hoping for a successful breakout. Look to exit longs on scalp profit targets or on tests of the top of the range, and take profits on shorts on limit orders that give a scalper's profit or exit on a test of the bottom of the range. Never rely on martingale trading. This is discussed in Chapter 25, but it is a gambling technique where you double or triple the size of your next trade if you just lost on your prior trade. If you keep losing, you keep doubling or tripling the size of your prior trade until you win. Almost invariably when you are thinking about this, the market is in a tight trading range and will likely have four or more consecutive losers; you would therefore abandon the approach because it would require you to trade far more contracts than you can handle emotionally, and this will leave you with a huge loss. A breakout or a winning trade is never overdue, and the market can sustain unsustainable behavior much longer than you can sustain your account. Be fussy and take only reasonable entries, and never base any entry on the idea that the market is overdue for a good trade.


![图 PIV.1](figures/fig-PIV-1.jpg)


**图 PIV.1　任何图表上的大多数K线都处在交易区间之内**


市场由交易区间构成，交易区间之间由短暂的趋势分隔，而每个交易区间又由更小的趋势和交易区间组成。图 PIV.1是一张 Emini 的10分钟图，显示了大约六周的价格行为。如果一位交易者只盯着一张带有大约一天半数据的5分钟图，就很容易忽略大局。其中有些日子是小交易区间日，但这些日子处在一轮大多头市场的背景之中。大的交易区间用字母标注，小的交易区间用数字标注（这些数字指的是交易区间，不是K线）。尽管交易区间反复尝试向上和向下突破，而这些尝试中有80% 都会失败，但当突破真的出现时，它通常与在它之前那个趋势的方向一致。大多数反转形态都是交易区间，就比如最右边那个交易区间（13），但大多数反转尝试都会变成旗形，并沿趋势方向突破。


> The market is composed of trading ranges separated by brief trends, and each trading range is made up of smaller trends and trading ranges. Figure PIV.1 is a 10 minute chart of the Emini that shows about six weeks of price action. If a trader were watching only a 5 minute chart with about a day and a half of data, it would be easy to overlook the big picture. Some of the days were small trading range days, but those days were in the context of a large bull market. The large trading ranges are labeled with letters and the small trading ranges with numbers (the numbers refer to the trading ranges and not the bars). Although trading ranges repeatedly try to break out of the top and bottom and 80 percent of those attempts fail, when the breakout does come, it is usually in the same direction as the trend that preceded it. Most reversal patterns are trading ranges, like the rightmost trading range (13), but most reversal attempts turn into flags and break out in the direction of the trend.


当市场处在交易区间中时，交易者可以做两个方向的交易，每笔交易都只求小利；但当多头趋势中的交易区间底部出现一个强买入建仓形态时，交易者可以把全部或部分交易做成波段。举例来说，在大交易区间 B 之内，出现了三次向下推进，形成一个三角形，而每一次向下推进都测试了大交易区间 A 的顶部。小交易区间8也有一个双底，而且它是从交易区间6下来的牛旗。一位日内交易者可能一路持有这笔多头到当日收盘，但愿意持仓过夜的交易者看到，这是一个很好的买入建仓形态，可以支撑一笔持续数日的交易。


> While the market is in a trading range, traders can take trades in both directions, looking for small profits on each trade, but when there is a strong buy setup at the bottom of a trading range in a bull trend, a trader can swing part or all of the trade. For example, within the large B trading range, there were three pushes down, creating a triangle, and each push down tested the top of the large A trading range. The small 8 trading range also had a double bottom, and it was a bull flag down from the 6 trading range. A day trader might have swung a long into the close of the day, but traders willing to hold a position overnight saw that this was a good buy setup for a trade that could last several days.


注意，大多数交易区间的最后一段下跌行情是一条空头通道，这是空头为创造顶部和新空头趋势所做的最后一搏。空头通道是一面牛旗。多头可以在交易区间底部的反转向上处买入，也可以在通常随后不久出现的突破回调处买入。空头趋势中的交易区间则相反，其最后一段行情通常是多头通道，也就是一面熊旗。


> Notice how the final leg down of most trading ranges is a bear channel, which is a last-ditch attempt by the bears to create a top and a new bear trend. A bear channel is a bull flag. Bulls can buy the reversal up from the bottom of the trading range or on the breakout pullback that usually follows soon afterward. The opposite is true of trading ranges in bear trends, where the final leg is usually a bull channel, which is a bear flag.


![图 PIV.2](figures/fig-PIV-2.jpg)


**图 PIV.2　多次早期反转常常引出一个交易区间日**


头几个小时里出现多次反转，通常会导致一个交易区间日。大型交易者进入这一天时往往就预期是个交易区间日，而当这样的人足够多时，他们的剥头皮和反向操作往往就会真的促成这样一个日子。如图 PIV.2所示，今天先是突破，然后在第1根K线处向下反转，又在第2根K线处向上反转。反转在第3根K线处失败，而构建空头通道的尝试在第4根K线处失败，市场再次向上反转。到第5根K线的多头急速行情一路上有两次停顿，表明迟疑。急速上涨之后，市场横盘了大约10根K线，在这面牛旗之内有许多小反转，还有五根阴线实体，再次表明市场非常双边化，而双边化正是交易区间的标志。第7根K线是一根创出当日新高的多头趋势K线，但紧接着跟随的是一根内包的空头K线，而不是再来两根或三根多头趋势K线。市场随后出现了几根大十字星；其中两根在上方带着大影线，表明交易者在K线收盘时积极卖出（卖压）。这说明空头在当日高点非常强势，而这正是交易区间中常见的情形。上下等幅运动的方向概率上升，变得有利于空头。在这里，市场先下跌两个点、再上涨两个点的概率可能是60%。虽然无法确切知道，但交易者相信空头占优势。此时大多数交易者怀疑这是个交易区间日，跌到区间中部下方的概率很大。如果交易者在第7根K线之后的任何时候做空并冒大约2到3个点的风险，他们很可能有大约60% 的概率看到市场测试到当日中点下方；具体取决于他们在哪里做空，中点比入场价低5到8个点。用2个点的风险赚5个点、并有60% 的确定性，是一笔极好的交易。


> Multiple reversals in the first couple of hours usually result in a trading range day. Big traders often come into the day expecting a trading range day, and when enough do, their scalping and reversing often result in one forming. As shown in Figure PIV.2, today broke out but then reversed down at bar 1 and reversed up at bar 2. The reversal failed at bar 3, but the attempt at a bear channel failed at bar 4, and the market reversed up again. The bull spike up to bar 5 had two pauses along the way, indicating hesitancy. After the spike up, the market went sideways for about 10 bars and had many small reversals within the bull flag, as well as five bear bodies, again showing that the market was very two-sided, which is the hallmark of a trading range. Bar 7 was a bull trend bar to a new high of the day, but was immediately followed by a bear inside bar instead of two or three more bull trend bars. The market then had several large dojis; two of them had big tails on the top, showing that traders aggressively sold into the close of the bars (selling pressure). This shows that the bears were very strong at the high of the day, which is what commonly happens in a trading range. The directional probability of an equidistant move rose in favor of the bears. In this case, the odds of a two-point move down before a two-point move up might have been 60 percent. Although it is impossible to know exactly, traders believed that the shorts had the edge. Most traders suspected at this point that the day was a trading range day and the odds of a move down below the middle of the range were good. If traders shorted at any point after bar 7 and risked about two to three points, they probably had about a 60 percent chance of the market testing below the midpoint of the day, which was five to eight points lower, depending on where they shorted. Risking two points to make five points with 60 percent certainty is a great trade.


交易区间日的日内中段是一个磁力位，通常会在一天中被反复测试，包括在创出新高之后。此外，既然交易区间日通常在当日区间的中部收盘，就要在极值被测试时寻找反向操作的机会，比如第7、9、10和12根K线处。交易者在摆动高点上方做空，比如第1、3和5根K线上方，而且他们会加仓，也许在更高一两个点处加仓。如果他们加仓了，许多交易者会在市场回到原来的入场价时平掉部分或全部仓位。那会是一笔保本的交易，但他们会在更高的那笔入场上有利润。如果市场立刻朝他们的方向走，他们就会把大部分或全部仓位剥头皮平掉，因为在交易区间日，除非你是在当天最高点或最低点附近做空——那里你可以把部分仓位波段做成对当日中部的测试、甚至对反向极值的测试——否则最好还是剥头皮。多头在第6和第8根K线下方买入，许多人愿意在更低处分批加仓。


> The middle of the day on a trading range day is a magnet and usually gets tested repeatedly during the day, including after the breakout to a new high. Also, since trading range days usually close in the middle of the day's range, look to fade tests of the extremes, like at bars 7, 9, 10, and 12. Traders were shorting above swing highs, like above bars 1, 3, and 5, and they were adding on, maybe at one or two points higher. If they added on, many traders would have exited some or all of their positions when the market returned to the original entry price. This would be a breakeven trade, but they would have a profit on their higher entries. If the market immediately went their way, they would scalp out of most or all of their positions because on trading range days it is better to scalp unless you are shorting at the very top or bottom of the day, where you can swing part of your position for a test of the middle of the day or even a test of the opposite extreme. Bulls bought below bars 6 and 8, and many were willing to scale in lower.


一般来说，做与你在一根趋势日里会做的事相反的操作是有效的，尤其是当你能分批加仓时。一旦交易者相信这一天是个交易区间日，他们就会基于这个信念下单。与其在高点附近寻找买入高1或高2，不如在这些信号K线上方做空；与其在区间底部附近寻找做空低1或低2，不如在这些K线下方买入。交易者用限价单和市价单入场。有些人看更小时间级别的图表，等一根反转K线，然后通过止损单在反转处入场。交易者会整天剥头皮，预期几乎每一段行情在再次反转之前都不会走很远。他们会在前一根K线的高点上方做空并在更高处加仓，也会在前一根K线的低点下方买入并在更低处加仓。他们还会在正在形成的区间顶部和底部附近反向操作大趋势K线。多头把第1根K线之前两根K线形成的那根大多头趋势K线看成一次在高价止盈的短暂机会。空头也怀疑会有后续买盘，于是做空。多头和空头都在这根大多头趋势K线的收盘时、在它的高点上方、在随后两根空头K线的收盘时、以及在那些空头K线的低点下方卖出。


> In general, doing the opposite of what you would do on a trend day is effective, especially if you can scale in. Once traders believe that the day is a trading range day, they will place trades based on that belief. Instead of looking to buy a high 1 or high 2 near the high, it is better to short above those signal bars. Instead of looking to short a low 1 or low 2 near the bottom of the range, it is better to buy below those bars. Traders enter on limit and market orders. Some look at a smaller time frame chart, wait for a reversal bar, and then enter on stops on the reversal. Traders will be scalping all day, expecting just about every move to not go far before reversing again. They will short above the high of prior bars and add on higher, and they will buy below the low of prior bars and add on lower. They will also fade large trend bars near the top and bottom of the developing range. The bulls saw the large bull trend bar that formed two bars before bar 1 as a brief opportunity to take profits at a high price. The bears also doubted there would be follow-through buying and shorted. Both the bulls and the bears sold at the close of the big bull trend bar, above its high, on the close of the two bear bars that followed, and below the low of the bear bars.


一旦市场在第2根K线之前形成一根大空头趋势K线、下探到当日低点下方、接近昨日低点，多头和空头就都开始买入。空头在买回自己的空头仓位，多头在建立新的多头仓位。两者都在这根K线的收盘时和它的低点下方买入。第2根K线在下方有一根大影线，表明交易者急于买入。下一根K线收阳，他们就在那个收盘价和它的高点上方买入。交易者在第7根K线突破创出新高时卖出，即便那是一根多头趋势K线。他们确信这一天是个交易区间日，所以一直等到市场越过开盘高点才做空。当市场上行时，他们相信当日再创新高的可能性很大，而既然他们觉得市场还会再走高一点，那么在几分钟后能以更好的价格做空的情况下，此刻做空就没有意义。最强卖方这种缺席制造了一个价格真空，把市场迅速吸了上去。由于他们确信这个新高会失败，他们非常乐意在一根强多头趋势K线的收盘时卖出。多头在卖出自己的多头仓位以止盈，空头在做空以建立新的空头仓位。双方都想在市场处于最强的时候卖出，因为他们相信市场应该向下走。交易者在第7根K线之后那根内包空头K线的收盘时和它的低点下方卖出。下一根K线是一根小十字星，是一个疲弱的高1买入建仓形态，许多交易者在其高点上方卖出，预期它会失败。他们还在高1入场K线的低点下方卖出，因为这时它成了一根单K线的更低的高点。两根K线之后，他们把那根十字星信号K线看成高2买入建仓形态的一个疲弱信号，并在其高点上方卖出。等到高2入场K线收在低点附近，他们就在它的低点下方卖出，因为这是一次失败的高2做空信号。


> Once the market formed a large bear trend bar before bar 2 that tested below the day's low and near the low of yesterday, both the bulls and the bears started buying. The bears were buying back their shorts, and the bulls were initiating new longs. Both bought on the close of the bar and below its low. Bar 2 had a large tail on the bottom, showing that traders were eager to buy. The next bar had a bull close, and they bought that close and above its high. Traders sold on the close of the bar 7 breakout to a new high, even though it was a bull trend bar. They were confident that the day was a trading range day, so they waited to short until the market went above the opening high. As the market was going up, they believed that a new high of the day was likely, and since they thought the market would go a little higher, it did not make sense for them to short when they could do so at an even better price a few minutes later. This absence of the strongest sellers created a vacuum that sucked the market up quickly. Since they were confident that the new high would fail, they were very happy to sell on the close of a strong bull trend bar. The bulls were selling out of their longs to take profits, and the bears were selling to initiate new shorts. Both wanted to sell when the market was at maximum strength, since they believed that it should head down. Traders sold on the close of the bear inside bar that followed bar 7 and below its low. The next bar was a small doji bar, which was a weak high 1 buy setup, and many traders sold above its high, expecting it to fail. They also sold below the low of the high 1 entry bar, since it was then a one-bar lower high. Two bars later, they saw the doji signal bar for the high 2 buy setup as a weak signal, and sold above its high. Once the high 2 entry bar closed near its low, they sold below its low, since this was a failed high 2 sell signal.


那根强多头趋势K线是一根高4入场K线，但它同时也是交易区间日高点附近的一根大多头趋势K线。多头剥头皮交易者在卖出自己的多头仓位，而空头在这根K线的收盘时做空，也在第9根K线更低的高点的两K线反转的下方做空（这让跌到第8根K线的走势变成了一面末端旗形）。


> The strong bull trend bar was a high 4 entry bar, but it was also a big bull trend bar near the high of a trading range day. The bull scalpers sold out of their longs, and the bears shorted on the close of the bar and below the bar 9 lower high two-bar reversal (this made the move down to bar 8 a final flag).


一旦市场跌到区间中部，尤其是在它跌破第6根K线摆动低点之后，多头就认为这次突破会失败。总体而言大多数突破都会失败，而在交易区间日、在日内中段、在区间中部时，这一点尤其成立。交易者开始买入那些阴线收盘和那些跌破前一根K线低点的下跌。到第11根K线时，看法已经明确，市场形成了一根多头反转K线，表示向上的紧迫感。在那个位置已经没有人还愿意做空，所以市场必须上行，去找一个空头再次认为做空有价值的价位。这个价位就是他们当天早些时候积极做空的地方，而他们重新开始的卖出造出了第12根K线处的双顶。


> Once the market fell to the middle of the range, and especially after it broke below the bar 6 swing low, the bulls thought the breakout would fail. Most breakouts fail in general, and this is especially true on trading range days, and in the middle of the day and in the middle of the range. Traders started buying the bear closes and the pushes below the lows of the prior bars. By bar 11, the consensus was clear and the market created a bull reversal bar, signifying urgency to the upside. There was no one left who was willing to short down there, so the market had to go up to find a price that the bears once again believed offered value for shorting. This price is where they aggressively shorted earlier in the day, and their renewed selling created the double top at bar 12.


第12根K线有阳线实体，作为一笔反转交易的信号K线来说它很差，但在交易区间中（或在空头趋势中的一次上涨行情的末端），信号K线常常并不强，却仍然可以接受。至少它在上方有一根影线、有一个小阳线实体，收盘价也在中部。


> Bar 12 had a bull body, which is a bad signal bar for a reversal trade, but in a trading range (or at the end of a bear rally in a bear trend), signal bars are often not strong, but are still acceptable. At least it had a tail at the top, a small bull body, and a close in the middle.


![图 PIV.3](figures/fig-PIV-3.jpg)


**图 PIV.3　交易区间中的波段交易**


在图 PIV.3中，有两个交易区间，交易者本来可以把部分仓位波段持有，以博取一次可能突破进入趋势的行情。在上面那个区间中，交易者本来可以在第3根K线的低点下方做空，那根K线是昨日高点楔形反转的信号K线。既然跌到第4根K线的走势跌破了多头趋势线，市场随后可能形成一个更低的高点，然后反转进入一段空头趋势。这让交易者能够在第5根K线的低点下方再次做空，远早于跌破交易区间底部的突破。


> In Figure PIV.3, there are two trading ranges where traders could have swung part of their position for a possible breakout into a trend. In the upper range, traders could have shorted below the low of bar 3, which was the signal bar for the wedge reversal of the high of yesterday. Since the move down to bar 4 broke below the bull trend line, the market might then form a lower high and then a reversal into a bear trend. This allowed traders to short again below the low of bar 5, well before the breakout below the bottom of the trading range.


市场随后形成了一个更低的交易区间。第11根K线涨到区间顶部的行情突破了空头趋势线，所以交易者应该寻找一个更低的低点或更高的低点，然后可能是一波向上的趋势反转。市场在第14根K线的更高的低点处形成了一个楔形牛旗，而第14根K线是一根强多头反转K线。这让多头能够在突破真正发生之前好几根K线就买入。在第16和第17根K线处有高1突破回调的多头建仓形态。


> The market then formed a lower trading range. The bar 11 rally to the top of the range broke the bear trend line, so traders should be looking for a lower low or higher low and then a possible trend reversal up. The market formed a wedge bull flag at the bar 14 higher low, and bar 14 was a strong bull reversal bar. This allowed bulls to buy several bars before the breakout actually took place. There were high 1 breakout pullback long setups at bars 16 and 17.
