一般来说，趋势越强，信号K线对一笔反转交易就越重要。交易区间的信号K线常常不够完美。可以接受的做空建仓形态，其信号K线可以带阳线实体。同样，可以接受的做多建仓形态，其信号K线可以带阴线实体。例子包括第3、5和7根K线、第11根K线之后那根K线、以及第18根K线。有经验的交易者把跌到第6根K线的突破看成一次可能的演变：把一个交易区间日演变成一个趋势性交易区间日。激进的多头在第8根K线的收盘时买入：在他们看来，市场很可能正在形成一个更低的交易区间，而这根大空头趋势K线正好处在向下等距运动的区域里。其他多头在第8根K线跌破第6根K线低点时买入，还有一些多头在第6根K线下方固定数目的最小报价单位处买入。有些人在这根K线下方一个点处买入，并试图在两个、三个甚至四个点下方买入更多。有些人认为这次突破可能是一次5个最小报价单位的突破失败，并以此为理由在下方4个最小报价单位处买入。少数交易者卖出了第6根K线下方的那次突破，并在自己的剥头皮止盈目标处（入场价下方一个点）反手做多。另一些人在第8根K线跌穿由昨日低点和第6根K线构成的趋势通道线（图上未画出）时买入，或者在第8根K线跌破趋势通道线之后从该低点反弹几个最小报价单位之后买入。既然这些多头相信市场正在演变成一个趋势性交易区间日、正在形成更低的那个交易区间，他们就处在剥头皮模式中，就像大多数交易者在市场处于交易区间时那样。今天的波段相对较大，所以许多多头剥的是3个或4个点的头皮，而不是只有1个或2个点。他们需要得到足够的回报，因为他们做的是相对有风险（概率更低）的交易，风险很大（那些分批加仓的多头很可能冒了4到6个点的风险）。既然有经验的交易者相信市场处在交易区间中，做空的剥头皮交易者就在正在形成的交易区间顶部附近卖出上涨行情，比如第7根K线或第11根K线附近。既然第14根K线可能是重新测试上方那个区间的开端、并且随后跟着几根多头趋势K线，大多数空头到那时就不会再寻找做空机会了。


> In general, the stronger the trend, the more important the signal bar is for a reversal trade. Trading range signal bars are often less than perfect. Acceptable short setups can have signal bars with bull bodies. Likewise, acceptable long setups can have signal bars with bear bodies. Examples include bars 3, 5, and 7, the bar after bar 11, and bar 18. Experienced traders saw the breakout down to bar 6 as a likely evolution of a trading range day into a trending trading range day. Aggressive bulls bought the close of bar 8, since it was a large bear trend bar in the area of a measured move down in what they thought was likely a developing lower trading range. Other bulls bought as bar 8 fell below the low of bar 6, and others bought at a fixed number of ticks below bar 6. Some bought at one point below and tried to buy more at two, three, or even four points below. Some thought that the breakout might be a five-tick failed breakout and used that as their reason to buy four ticks below. A few traders sold the breakout below bar 6 and reversed to long at their scalper's profit target, one point below their entry price. Others bought on bar 8 as it fell through the trend channel line (not shown) created by yesterday's low and bar 6, or after the market bounced a few ticks up from the bar 8 low after falling below the trend channel line. Since these bulls believed that the market was evolving into a trending trading range day and was forming the lower trading range, they were in scalping mode, as most traders are when the market is in a trading range. The swings today were relatively large, so many bulls were scalping for three or four points instead of just one or two. They needed to be adequately rewarded for taking relatively risky (lower-probability) trades, where the risk was large (the bulls who were scaling in were probably risking four to six points). Since experienced traders believed that the market was in a trading range, bear scalpers were shorting rallies near the top of the developing trading range, like around bar 7 or bar 11. Since bar 14 was a possible start of a test back into the upper range and was followed by several bull trend bars, most bears would have stopped looking to short at that point.


![图 PIV.4](figures/fig-PIV-4.jpg)


**图 PIV.4　区间的中间三分之一与日内的中间三分之一**


当这一天不是一个清晰的趋势日时，交易者在日内中间三分之一时间、而市场又处在当日区间的中间三分之一附近时，应该非常小心。在图 PIV.4中，大量K线重叠、小十字星、以及细小的突破失败，让价格行为难以解读。这是一种铁丝网式的窄幅交易区间，在第22章会有更多讨论。有经验之后，交易者在这样的环境下也能成功，但绝大多数交易者更可能会把头几个小时赚到的大部分甚至全部利润还回去。目标是赚钱，而有时对你的账户来说，不下单、转而等待强建仓形态要好得多。在图中，这段横盘一直持续到太平洋时间上午11:45，在一天中已经算比较晚了。这些时间参数只是参考。起决定作用的是价格行为，而在交易区间日，最佳交易是反向操作当日的高点和低点，但这需要耐心。


> When the day is not a clear trend day, traders should be very careful during the middle third of the day when the market is around the middle third of the day's range. In Figure PIV.4, there are lots of overlapping bars, small dojis, and tiny failed breakouts, making the price action difficult to read. This is a barbwire type of tight trading range and is discussed more in Chapter 22. With experience, a trader can be successful trading under these circumstances, but the vast majority of traders would more likely give back most or all of the profit that they made in the first couple of hours. The goal is to make money, and sometimes your account is much better served by not placing trades and instead waiting for strong setups. In the chart, the sideways action lasted until 11:45 a.m. PST, which is relatively late in the day. The time parameters are only guidelines. The overriding factor is the price action, and on trading range days the best trades are fades of the highs and lows of the day, but this takes patience.


![图 PIV.5](figures/fig-PIV-5.jpg)


**图 PIV.5　先向上急速行情再向下急速行情，通常引出一个交易区间**


每当市场先出现一波向上急速行情、再出现一波向下急速行情，或者反过来，它往往会进入一个交易区间，因为多头和空头都在争夺谁能造出朝自己方向的后续行情。在图 PIV.5中，礼来（LLY）的日线图显示一波急剧上涨结束于第2根K线，随后是一波急剧下跌。那里没有清晰的买入形态；相反，第4根K线处出现了一个低2突破回调入场。第6和第7根K线是在短暂的空头趋势线突破之后出现的做空信号K线（第6根K线是第一根均线缺口K线）。这段急速与通道空头趋势中第8根K线处的低点并不完全是一个等距运动，随后跟随一次对空头通道起点第4根K线的测试。


> Whenever the market has a spike up and then a spike down, or vice versa, it tends to enter a trading range as the bulls and bears both fight to create follow-through in their direction. In Figure PIV.5, Eli Lilly (LLY)'s daily chart shows a sharp up move that ended at bar 2 and was followed by a sharp down move. There was no clear buy pattern; instead there was a low 2 breakout pullback entry at bar 4. Bars 6 and 7 were short signal bars following brief bear trend line breaks (bar 6 was a first moving average gap bar). The bar 8 low of this spike and channel bear trend was not quite a measured move, and was followed by a test of the bar 4 start of the bear channel.


一波急剧上涨之后急剧下跌，就像这里涨到第2根K线然后下跌的走势，是一个高潮反转，在某个更高时间级别图表上是一次两K线反转。在更高一级的时间级别图表上，它是一根单K线反转。第8根K线是一次卖出高潮，也是一次两K线反转，这波行情在某个更高时间级别图表上会是一根单K线反转。它随后跟随一个交易区间，而这个交易区间又长成了一条牛通道。


> A sharp move up and then down, like the move up to bar 2 and then down, is a climactic reversal and a two-bar reversal on some higher time frame chart. It is a single reversal bar on an even higher time frame chart. Bar 8 was a sell climax and a two-bar reversal, and the move would be a single reversal bar on some higher time frame chart. It was followed by a trading range, which grew into a bull channel.


![图 PIV.6](figures/fig-PIV-6.jpg)


**图 PIV.6　回调可以长成交易区间**


强趋势之后跟随的回调，可以长成交易区间，有时还会长成反转，如图 PIV.6所示。这里，ViroPharma 公司（VPHM）的日线图中有一段强多头趋势，随后是一段强空头趋势，而整张图演变成了一个大交易区间。一波大涨之后紧跟一波大跌，就是一个买入高潮，而它通常接着又跟随一个交易区间，因为多头和空头都在继续交易，双方都试图造出朝自己方向的后续行情。


> Strong trends are followed by pullbacks that can grow into trading ranges and sometimes reversals, as shown in Figure PIV.6. Here, the daily chart of ViroPharma Inc. (VPHM) had a strong bull trend followed by a strong bear trend, and the entire chart evolved into a large trading range. A big move up followed by a big move down is a buy climax and is usually followed in turn by a trading range as the bulls and the bears continue to trade, both trying to generate follow-through in their direction.


在第1根K线底部之后的某个时点，动能交易者控制了市场，把它推得远高于基本面所支持的水平。随后是一波跌到第9根K线的急剧下跌，那里有一个三次推进形态（一种楔形变体），引出了涨到第13根K线的急速与通道，实际上造出了一个大交易区间。第13根K线是对趋势通道线的一次过靶，而突破通道上方的尝试失败了。急速与通道式的多头趋势，无论它们看起来多强，通常之后都会跟随一次对通道起点的测试，也就是第12根K线的低点。


> At some point after the bar 1 bottom, the momentum traders controlled the market and drove it much higher than the fundamentals warranted. There was then a sharp move down to bar 9, where there was a three-push pattern (a wedge variant) that resulted in the spike and channel up to bar 13, effectively creating a large trading range. Bar 13 was an overshoot of the trend channel line, and the attempted breakout above the channel failed. Spike and channel bull trends, no matter how strong they appear, are usually followed by a test of the beginning of the channel, which was the bar 12 low.


第10根K线是一个突破回调的更高的低点，是做多的第二次机会。


> Bar 10 was a breakout pullback higher low second chance to get long.


在第4根K线趋势线突破之后的那波上涨中，许多动能玩家抛掉自己的多头仓位之后，多头仍然能把市场推到第5根K线的新高；但这个区域遇到了积极的卖方，他们能够砸破主要多头趋势线，把市场压到第6根K线的低点，从而为从第7根K线更低的高点处、对第5根K线趋势高点的那次测试之后反转下跌做好了铺垫。这波反转下跌是紧接着三次向上推进到第7根K线之后出现的。此时，动能玩家已经离场，正在寻找另一只股票。涨到第7根K线的行情有好几个波段，说明存在双边交易，因此动能不如之前那些上涨行情、也不如跌到第6根K线的那波抛售强。它成了那次回调，而这次回调引出了跟随跌到第6根K线的急速行情之后的那条空头通道。


> After many momentum players dumped their longs on the rally up from the bar 4 trend line break, the bulls were able to drive the market to a new high at bar 5, but this area found aggressive sellers who were able to break the major bull trend line as they pushed the market down to the bar 6 low, setting up a large reversal down from the bar 7 lower high test of the bar 5 trend high. The reversal down came off of the three pushes up to bar 7. At this point, the momentum players were out and looking for another stock. The rally up to bar 7 had several swings, indicating two-sided trading and therefore less momentum than in the prior rallies and in the sell-off down to bar 6. It became the pullback that led to the bear channel that followed the spike down to bar 6.


市场继续下跌，直到价值交易者认为基本面已经强到足以让这只股票在第9根K线附近变成便宜货。第9根K线也是一次三次向下推进的买入点。它也可能处在某个斐波那契回撤位附近，但那无关紧要。你只要看一眼就能发现，这波回调很深，但还没有深到把从第1根K线开始那波上涨的力量完全抹掉。多头还有足够的力量把这只股票拉起来，尤其是价值交易者又回到了场内。他们觉得基于基本面这只股票很便宜，而且他们的打算是随着股票继续下跌就一直买（除非它跌得太深）。


> The market continued to sell off until value traders thought that the fundamentals were strong enough to make the stock a bargain around bar 9. Bar 9 was also a three-push-down buy. It could also have been near some Fibonacci retracement level, but that is irrelevant. You can just look and see that the pullback was deep, but not so deep that the force of the rally from bar 1 was totally erased. The bulls still had enough force left to rally the stock, especially since the value traders were back in play. They felt that the stock was cheap based on fundamentals, and their intention was to keep buying as the stock continued to drop (unless it dropped too far).


多头市场中一个交易区间的最后一段下跌行情常常是一条空头通道，这里就是如此。有些交易者把从第3根K线到第9根K线的整个走势看成一个楔形牛旗，也就是一条空头通道。另一些人把空头通道看成始于第5根K线、第7根K线，或第8根K线之后那根大空头急速行情之后。那根空头急速行情引出了三次向下推进和一条楔形空头通道。交易者在第9根K线上方买入，并在第10和第12根K线的突破回调处买入。


> The final leg down in a trading range in a bull market is often a bear channel, as it was here. Some traders saw the entire move from bar 3 to bar 9 as a wedge bull flag, which is a bear channel. Others saw the bear channel as starting at bar 5, bar 7, or after the large bear spike that followed bar 8. That bear spike led to three pushes down and a wedge bear channel. Traders bought above bar 9 and on the breakout pullbacks at bars 10 and 12.


![图 PIV.7](figures/fig-PIV-7.jpg)


**图 PIV.7　交易区间可以是一个反转建仓形态**


一个交易区间可以是一个反转建仓形态，尤其是当K线下方有影线、并且出现两K线反转（在更高时间级别图表上就是反转K线）的时候。如图 PIV.7所示，昨天先是一段空头急速行情，然后当天余下时间走成了一条低动能牛通道。所有牛通道都是熊旗，而这一条在今天开盘时向下突破了。不过，市场做了三次尝试（第8、9和12根K线）想跌破昨日低点，每一次遇到的都是买方而不是卖方。从第9根K线到第12根K线的小交易区间引出的是向上反转，而不是向下突破。第12根K线处失败的低2，就是今天这波强多头趋势的建仓形态。


> A trading range can be a reversal setup, especially when there are tails at the bottoms of the bars and two-bar reversals, which are reversal bars on a higher time frame chart. As shown in Figure PIV.7, yesterday had a bear spike and then the remainder of the day was a low-momentum bull channel. All bull channels are bear flags, and this one broke out to the downside on today's open. However, the market made three attempts (bars 8, 9, and 12) to break below yesterday's low and found buyers instead of sellers each time. The small trading range from bar 9 to bar 12 led to a reversal up instead of a downside breakout. The failed low 2 at bar 12 was the setup for today's strong bull trend.


虽然交易者只需要看一张图就能成功交易，但清楚大局通常是有帮助的。市场在四天里处在一个大交易区间中，如15分钟图的插图所示。编号是相同的，但15分钟图的起点更早、终点更晚，还多了一些编号。既然在这个四天的交易区间形成之前有一段多头趋势，交易者就在寻找向上突破。多头市场中交易区间的最后一段行情常常是一条空头通道，那是空头把市场反转向下的最后一次尝试。大多数反转形态都是交易区间，而大多数都会失败，就像这一个那样。这条通道的起点有几个可能的选择（第6、7和8根K线），不同的交易者会认为各不相同的那个最重要。不过他们都同意，第10和第12根K线是合理的买入建仓形态。第10根K线是在跌破昨日低点之后第二次尝试向上反转，而第12根K线则是第11根K线突破空头趋势线之后的突破回调，同时也是一个更高的低点。那几根强多头趋势K线是买盘的迹象，而在寻找买入机会时，看到买盘总是好事。


> Although a trader only needs to look at one chart to trade successfully, it is usually helpful to be aware of the big picture. The market was in a large trading range for four days, as shown in the inset of the 15 minute chart. The numbering is the same, but the 15 minute chart began before and ended after the 5 minute chart and has some additional numbers. Since there was a bull trend before the four-day trading range formed, traders were looking for an upside breakout. The final leg of a trading range in a bull market is often a bear channel, which is the last attempt by the bears to reverse the market down. Most reversal patterns are trading ranges, but most fail, like this one did. There were several possible choices for the start of the channel (bars 6, 7, and 8), and different traders saw each as the most important. However, they all agreed that bars 10 and 12 were reasonable buy setups. Bar 10 was a second attempt to reverse up after breaking below yesterday's low, and bar 12 was a breakout pullback from the bar 11 break above the bear trend line, as well as a higher low. The strong bull trend bars were signs of buying pressure, which is always good to see when looking to buy.


### 本图深入讨论


**回看 图 PIV.7**

![图 PIV.7](figures/fig-PIV-7.jpg)


> ### Deeper Discussion of This Chart


如图 PIV.7所示，昨天从第5根K线到第6根K线的牛通道突破了空头趋势线，因此今天这个更低的低点是一个可能的趋势反转。


> As shown in Figure PIV.7, yesterday's bull channel from bar 5 to bar 6 broke the bear trend line, and today's lower low was therefore a possible trend reversal.


昨天的熊旗成了空头趋势中的末端旗形（但这段空头趋势处在一个多头市场的大四天交易区间之中）。每当存在一面相对水平的熊旗、或一面处在窄幅通道中、呈倾斜状的熊旗，它都会对市场产生磁力，而这常常使突破走不了多远。窄幅交易区间对多空双方都是一个舒适区，双方都把这个价格水平看成价值区。交易者清楚这一点，所以在突破之后一直在寻找向上反转的迹象。第12根K线处那个失败的低2，同时也是一个双底回调买入建仓形态。其他交易者把它看成三重底或三角形反转。大多数反转形态都有多种解读，不同的交易者喜欢用自己特有的方式描述它们。你把它叫什么并不重要，因为唯一重要的是你意识到了这个可能的反转，并找到了做多的理由。


> Yesterday's bear flag became the final flag in the bear trend (but the bear trend was in a large four-day trading range in a bull market). Whenever there is a relatively horizontal bear flag, or a sloping one that is in a tight channel, it will have a magnetic pull on the market, and this often prevents breakouts from going very far. The tight trading range is an area of comfort for both bulls and bears, and both see the price level as an area of value. Traders were aware of this and were looking for signs of a reversal up after the breakout. The failed low 2 at bar 12 was also a double bottom pullback buy setup. Other traders saw it as a triple bottom or a triangle reversal. Most reversal patterns have multiple interpretations, and different traders prefer to describe them in their own particular way. It does not matter what you call it, because all that matters is that you were aware of the possible reversal and looked for some reason to get long.


![图 PIV.8](figures/fig-PIV-8.jpg)


**图 PIV.8　先买入高潮，再交易区间**


FOMC 报告在太平洋时间上午11:15发布，5分钟 Emini 在图 PIV.8中第1根K线处形成了一根大型外包上涨K线，但它的高点从未被超越。它之后跟随一根大空头趋势K线，构成了一个买入高潮，而买入高潮之后通常跟随一个交易区间。这个交易区间可以短到只有一根K线，也可以持续几十根K线。空头没过多久就压倒了多头，造出了一段四根K线的空头急速行情。虽然报告可以带来剧烈波动，但价格行为是可靠的；所以不要陷入情绪之中，只要寻找合理的入场即可。


> The FOMC report was released at 11:15 a.m. PST, and the 5 minute Emini formed a large bull outside bar at bar 1 in Figure PIV.8, but its high was never exceeded. It was followed by a large bear trend bar, setting up a buy climax, which is usually followed by a trading range. The trading range can be as short as a single bar or can last for dozens of bars. It did not take long for the bears to overwhelm the bulls and create a four-bar bear spike. Even though reports can be volatile, the price action is reliable; so don't get caught in the emotion, and just look for sensible entries.


第5根K线开始了一个带有大两K线反转和高十字星的交易区间。每当一个交易区间在当日的某个极值处形成并带有多次大幅反转时，通常最好去寻找反转入场，而不是顺势建仓形态。那些大幅重叠的K线和影线表明存在双边交易，而当双边交易强劲时，在当日高点买入或在当日低点卖出都不明智。始于第5根K线的窄幅交易区间由大K线、下方带影线的K线和两K线反转构成，所有这些都表明多头愿意变得积极。这是一个双边交易强劲的区域，因此也是多空双方都感到有价值的区域。所以，如果价格在一次向下突破中下滑，买方会把更低的价格看成更好的价值，他们会积极买入。空头在区间中看到了价值，就不那么在区间下方做空。空头相对缺席加上多头买盘增加，通常会使突破失败；市场一般会反弹回到这个有磁力的区域，有时还会反转。


> Bar 5 began a trading range that had large two-bar reversals and tall dojis. Whenever a trading range forms with multiple large reversals at an extreme of the day, it is usually better to look for a reversal entry than a with-trend setup. The big, overlapping bars and tails indicated two-sided trading, and when there is strong two-sided trading, it is not prudent to be buying at the high of the day or selling at the low. The tight trading range that began at bar 5 was composed of large bars, bars with tails at the bottom, and two-bar reversals, all indicating that the bulls were willing to become aggressive. This was an area of strong two-sided trading and therefore an area where both the bulls and the bears felt there was value. Therefore, if the price drifted down in a downside breakout, the buyers would see the lower prices as an even better value and they would buy aggressively. The bears saw value in the range and were less willing to short below it. The relative absence of bears and the increased buying by the bulls usually causes breakouts to fail; the market generally rallies back into the magnetic area, and sometimes the market reverses.


所有急速行情同时也是突破和高潮。始于第3根K线的四根K线空头急速行情，其实体在缩小，表明动能在减弱。卖出高潮之后是一根K线的停顿，然后是第4根K线处又一根大空头趋势K线，造出了连续卖出高潮。当情绪化的卖方在短时间内卖了两次之后，通常已经没有多少交易者还愿意在这些低价上卖出，于是底部往往就近了。收盘时出现了第三次卖出高潮，然后在第二天开盘时出现了一波上涨。


> All spikes are also breakouts and climaxes. The four-bar bear spike that began with bar 3 had shrinking bodies, indicating waning momentum. The sell climax was followed by a one-bar pause and then another large bear trend bar at bar 4, which created consecutive sell climaxes. When the emotional sellers have sold twice in a short period of time, there are usually very few traders left who are willing to sell at the low prices, and a bottom is often near. There was a third sell climax into the close and then a rally on the open the next day.


### 本图深入讨论


**回看 图 PIV.8**

![图 PIV.8](figures/fig-PIV-8.jpg)


> ### Deeper Discussion of This Chart


图 PIV.8中的第2根K线是一根高2多头入场K线，但这个建仓形态有一个问题。


> Bar 2 in Figure PIV.8 was a high 2 long entry bar but there was a problem with this setup.


每当出现三根或更多几乎完全重叠的K线，它们就位于均线上方一点，而且有一个买入信号，其入场点会接近这个交易区间的顶部，那么概率有利于它成为一个空头陷阱。如果你做了任何交易，在前一根K线的高点上方做空更有道理，因为这是一个小而窄幅的交易区间，而大多数交易区间突破都会失败。是的，它是一个高2，但是一个永远不该买入的高2。


> Whenever there are three or more bars that almost completely overlap and they are just above the moving average and there is a buy signal where the entry would be close to the top of this trading range, the odds favor it being a bear trap. If you took any trade, it made more sense to short above the high of the prior bar because this was a small, tight trading range, and most trading range breakouts fail. Yes, it was a high 2, but one that should never be bought.


第3根K线是一个失败的高2，所以当日高点处有被套的多头。它同时是一根强空头趋势K线，构成一个很好的做空入场点。既然此时市场处在交易区间中，那两次小幅向上推进就让第3根K线成了一个低2做空建仓形态。既然它接近当日高点，那它就是寻找做空机会的好地方。最后，它还是一面大空头趋势K线之后的双顶熊旗，以及一次高潮反转。


> Bar 3 was a failed high 2, so there were trapped bulls at the high of the day. It was also a strong bear trend bar, setting up a good short entry. Since the market was in a trading range at this point, those two small pushes up made bar 3 a low 2 short setup. Since it was near the high of the day, it was a good place to be looking for shorts. Finally, it was a double top bear flag after a large bear trend bar, and a climactic reversal.


第6根K线是一个低1做空建仓形态，但它跟在连续卖出高潮之后，市场形成一次两段式的横盘到向上的修正的风险很大。概率有利于出现一个更高的低点和第二段修正行情，但这些K线足够大，能够为做空剥头皮留出空间，尽管很可能出现更高的低点。


> Bar 6 was a low 1 short setup, but it followed consecutive sell climaxes, and the risk that the market would form a two-legged sideways to up correction was significant. The odds favored a higher low and a second corrective leg, but the bars were large enough to provide room for a short scalp, despite the likely higher low.


第7根K线是一次两K线反转中的第一根K线，而在这两根K线中较高那根的上方买入，比仅仅在那根阳线上方买入更好。这是一个过度急躁的多头如何被套的例子。既然此时市场已经有几根大横盘K线，它就处在交易区间中，最好是在区间顶部附近寻找做空机会，而不是买入。低买高卖，是交易区间最好的做法。


> Bar 7 was the first bar of a two-bar reversal, and it was better to buy above the higher of the two bars and not simply above the bull bar. This was an example of how overly eager bulls get trapped. Since the market at this point had several big sideways bars, it was in a trading range and it was better to look for shorts near the top of the range and not to buy. Buy low, sell high is the best way to trade trading ranges.


第8根K线把多头套进了一笔糟糕的高2做多，他们会在第8根K线下方那笔低2做空上出场。那根信号K线足够小，所以还有做空剥头皮的空间，但在接连出现两次两K线反转、且信号K线是一根十字星之后，这是一笔有风险的做空。


> Bar 8 trapped bulls into a bad high 2 long, and they would exit on the low 2 short below bar 8. The signal bar was small enough so that there was room for a short scalp, but after a pair of two-bar reversals and with a doji signal bar, this was a risky short.


第10根K线是又一个多头陷阱，弱多头在一根大而诱人的十字星的顶部买入了。同样，聪明的空头会寻找一根小的建仓形态K线来做空入场，因为那样多头会被迫卖出，市场上就不会剩下买方，从而让市场迅速触及做空剥头皮的止盈目标。既然这是第三次向上推进，就应该预期它会像楔形顶部那样运作，而它之后跟随一段跌到收盘的空头行情段。既然这是一个交易区间，就没有什么可供反转形态去反转的，而在区间顶部附近那些高K线上方买入，很可能的结果就是被套的多头。聪明的空头仍在区间顶部附近、在前一根K线的高点上方以及在小区间K线的低点下方做空。


> Bar 10 was another bull trap that was bought by weak bulls at the top of a big, tempting doji. Again, smart bears would have looked for a small setup bar for a short entry because the bulls would have been forced to sell and there would have been no buyers left, making the market quickly reach the short scalp profit target. Since this was the third push up, it should have been expected to function like a wedge top, and it was followed by a bear leg into the close. Since this was a trading range, there was nothing for reversal patterns to reverse, and buying above tall bars near the top of the range was likely to result in trapped bulls. Smart bears were still shorting above the high of the prior bar and below the lows of small bars near the top of the range.


这个交易区间变成了一面末端旗形，在第二天开盘时向上反转，当日第3根K线出现了一个高2入场。事实上，你完全可以把报告之前的整个交易日看成一面末端旗形。市场在报告发布前刚刚向上突破，然后在报告出来后于第1根K线处抛售，并再次试图从这个交易区间向上突破。当市场对同一件事尝试两次、两次都失败时，它通常就会尝试相反的方向。这让第1根K线买入高潮之后的向下突破变得很有可能。


> This trading range became a final flag that reversed up on the open of the next day with a high 2 entry on the third bar of the day. In fact, you can view the entire day up to the report as a final flag. The market broke to the upside just before the report and then sold off on bar 1 on the report, and once again tried to break to the upside from the trading range. When the market tries something twice and fails both times, it usually then tries the opposite. This made a downside breakout likely after the bar 1 buy climax.


第10根K线之后那些大空头趋势K线造出了第三次连续卖出高潮，而它之后有很高的概率至少出现一段两段式上涨行情，但有时反而只是一次两段式的横盘修正。


> The large bear trend bars that followed bar 10 created the third consecutive sell climax, which had a high probability of being followed by at least a two-legged rally, but sometimes instead there is just a two-legged sideways correction.


![图 PIV.9](figures/fig-PIV-9.jpg)


**图 PIV.9　交易区间引出反转**


有时一个交易区间引出的不是持续，而是一波趋势反转，就像图 PIV.9所示的月度 SPY 图上发生了四次的那样。反转形态在第三本书中有更充分的讨论。这张图的目的，是证明交易区间也可以是反转形态。


> Sometimes a trading range can lead to a trend reversal instead of a continuation, as it did four times on the monthly SPY chart shown in Figure PIV.9. Reversal patterns are discussed more fully in book 3. The purpose of this chart is to demonstrate that trading ranges can be reversal patterns.


第4、6和8或9根K线是三次向下推进，而在第9根K线之后两根K线形成的低2做空建仓形态，引出的是一个更高的低点，而不是新低。第4、6和8根K线都是大空头趋势K线，因此它们构成了三次连续卖出高潮。这意味着在这三根K线上，交易者都在不计价格地积极卖出，而不是在回调时卖出。这些是急于卖出的交易者。虽然他们大多是终于放弃的多头，但其中也有一些是迟到的弱空头，他们断定不会再有显著的回调了。他们为自己错过了这么多空头行情而懊恼，决心不再错过，于是在市价上和小幅回调处做空。一旦这些情绪化的空头做空了、情绪化的多头也放弃并卖出之后，已经没有多少交易者还愿意在空头趋势的底部卖出。在三次卖出高潮之后，交易者只有在出现一次带良好做空建仓形态的显著上涨行情时才会做空。他们等到了那波上涨行情，但他们直到这波上涨走了太久、变成一段持续五年的新多头趋势之后，才等来一个做空建仓形态。


> Bars 4, 6, and 8 or 9 were three pushes down, and the low 2 short setup that formed two bars after bar 9 led to a higher low instead of a new low. Bars 4, 6, and 8 were all large bear trend bars, and they therefore formed three consecutive sell climaxes. That means that on all three bars, traders were aggressively selling at any price instead of on pullbacks. These were traders who were desperate to sell. Although they were mostly longs who were finally giving up, some of them were late, weak bears who had decided that there were not going to be any significant pullbacks. They were upset that they had missed so much of the bear trend, and they were determined not to miss any more, so they shorted at the market and on small pullbacks. Once these emotional bears shorted and the emotional bulls gave up and sold, there were very few traders left who were willing to sell at the bottom of the bear trend. After three sell climaxes, traders would have shorted only if there was a significant rally that had a good short setup. They got the rally, but they did not get a short setup until the move up went on for so long that it became a new bull trend that lasted five years.


第8根K线和它后面那根K线的低点都带着大影线。第9根K线是一根多头反转K线，它是一次两K线反转中的第二根，而在更高时间级别图表上就是一根下方带影线的反转K线。第10根K线和它前面那根K线的低点同样有显眼的影线。这意味着多头在所有这些K线临近收盘时都在买入，并且在这个价位上压倒了空头。多头认为这个区域是做多的绝佳价值，而空头认为这里太低，不宜积极做空。有些交易者把第8、9和10根K线看成一个三重底，另一些人把它看成一个头肩底。还有人认为第8和第9根K线形成了双底，而第10根K线是对低点的一次成功测试；有些人则把涨到第9根K线上方的走势看成一个突破，然后把跌到第10根K线的走势看成更高的低点突破回调。你用什么词描述正在发生的事情永远都不重要，只要你能看出市场在告诉你：多头正在取得控制权。在三次卖出高潮和这么长的空头趋势之后，概率有利于至少出现一次两段式回调、回到均线，也可能回到第5和第7根K线处的通道起点。从第2根K线开始的整段下跌都处在一条通道中，而空头通道就是一面牛旗。通道常常在第三次向下推进之后反转，所以聪明的交易者知道，第8根K线到第10根K线这个交易区间可能是一次反转，而不是一面熊旗。


> Bar 8 and the bar after it both had large tails on their lows. Bar 9 was a bull reversal bar that was the second bar of a two-bar reversal, which was a reversal bar with a tail on the bottom on a higher time frame chart. Bar 10 and the bar before it also had prominent tails at their lows. This meant that bulls were buying going into the close of all of these bars and they were overwhelming the bears at this price level. The bulls thought this area was a great value for longs, and the bears thought it was too low to short aggressively. Some traders saw bars 8, 9, and 10 as a triple bottom, and others saw it as a head and shoulders bottom. Others thought that bars 8 and 9 formed a double bottom and bar 10 was a successful test of the low, and some saw the move above bar 9 as a breakout and then the move down to bar 10 as a higher low breakout pullback. It never matters what words you use to describe what is going on as long as you see that the market is telling you that the bulls are taking control. After three sell climaxes and such a long bear trend, the odds favored at least a two-legged pullback to the moving average and possibly to the beginning of the channels at bars 5 and 7. The entire move down from bar 2 was in a channel, and a bear channel is a bull flag. Channels often reverse after the third push down, so smart traders knew that this trading range from bar 8 to bar 10 might have been a reversal instead of a bear flag.


从第20根K线开始的那次向上推进和跌到第22根K线的走势构成了一次买入高潮，尽管第22根K线收阳。一旦市场从第23根K线处的双顶向下反转，空头就希望第23根K线是在跌到第22根K线的空头急速行情之后的一个更高的高点回调，于是他们不断做空，试图造出一条通道或一段下跌急速行情。多头则在不断买入，盼望着出现一个交易区间、然后再来一段上涨。第24根K线的空头急速行情说服力足够强，使大多数交易者认为在接下来几根K线里，价格走低比走高更可能。


> The push up from bar 20 and the move down to bar 22 comprised a buy climax, despite the bull close of bar 22. Once the market reversed down from the double top at bar 23, the bears were hoping that bar 23 was a higher high pullback after the bear spike down to bar 22, and they kept shorting as they tried to create a channel or spike down. The bulls kept buying and were hoping for a trading range and then another leg up. The bar 24 bear spike was convincing enough so that most traders thought that lower prices were more likely than higher prices over the next several bars.


多头在第24、25和27根K线处再次试图筑底，但这发生在一段从急速与通道顶部向下反转之后不久，而那很可能有两段下跌行情，并测试第12根K线处的通道底部。此外，第24根K线正是那根把市场变成很可能是空头波段的急速行情。由于第24根K线跌破双顶第22根K线颈线的那次突破如此强劲，之后很可能会有某种空头通道形式的后续行情。第25根K线相比那些下跌K线相对较小，而且带阴线实体。之后又有一段跌到第27根K线的急速行情，这让下跌动能强到不能在第27根K线上方买入，尤其因为第27根K线只是一根小十字星，而不是一根强多头反转K线。在下跌动能这么强的情况下，买方不会愿意在一个更低的低点上方买入，但如果出现一个强更高的低点，他们也许会愿意在其上方买入。买方在两根K线之后放弃了，市场在卖出高潮中一路崩塌到第29和第31根K线。


> The bulls tried again to create a bottom at bars 24, 25, and 27, but this was right after a reversal down from a spike and channel top, which was likely to have two legs down and test the bar 12 bottom of the channel. Also, bar 24 was the spike down that turned the market into a probable bear swing. There was likely to be follow-through in the form of some type of bear channel because the bar 24 breakout below the bar 22 neckline of the double top was so strong. Bar 25 was relatively small compared to the down bars and had a bear body. There was another spike down to bar 27, which made the downward momentum too strong to be buying above bar 27, especially since bar 27 was only a small doji bar and not a strong bull reversal bar. With the momentum down being so strong, buyers would not have been willing to buy above a lower low, but they might have been willing to buy above a strong higher low had one formed. The buyers gave up two bars later, and the market collapsed in sell climaxes down to bar 29 and bar 31.


第29根K线之前那根K线、以及第29和第31根K线，在下方都有大影线，再次表明买方在每根K线临近收盘时都在积极买入。


> The bar before bar 29, and bars 29 and 31, had large tails at the bottoms, again showing that the buyers were aggressively buying into the close of each bar.


这是一个小的三次向下推进形态（在日线图上很清楚），而从第30根K线开始的急速下跌，是在一波跌到第29根K线的巨大卖出高潮之后的又一次卖出高潮。连续卖出高潮通常引出一波回调，至少回到均线，持续至少10根K线，并至少有两段行情，有时它们还能引出一波趋势反转。这波买入正好出现在多头在第8、9和10根K线底部积极购入的那个价位下方一点。市场正试图从这个摆动低点下方的突破处向上反转，而这在交易区间中很常见。事实上，整张图就是一个大交易区间，尽管其中有好几段长达五年的强趋势。既然大多数突破尝试都会失败，那么当市场跌破第9根K线低点时，就应该预期会有买入。


> This was a small three-push-down pattern (this was clear on the daily chart), and the spike down from bar 30 was a sell climax after a huge sell climax down to bar 29. Consecutive sell climaxes usually lead to a pullback, at least to the moving average, lasting at least 10 bars and having at least two legs, and sometimes they can lead to a trend reversal. This buying was coming in just below the price level where the bulls bought aggressively at the bottom of bars 8, 9, and 10. The market was trying to reverse up from the breakout below that swing low, which is something that is common in trading ranges. In fact, the entire chart was a large trading range, despite the several strong trends that lasted as long as five years. Since most breakout attempts fail, buying should have been expected when the market fell below the bar 9 low.


### 本图深入讨论


**回看 图 PIV.9**

> ### Deeper Discussion of This Chart


如图 PIV.9所示，当市场跌破第1、2、3根K线构成的头肩顶时，交易者开始转为始终做空。有些人在第3根K线那根构成更低的高点的空头趋势K线和两K线反转下方开始做空。另一些人随着急速行情一路延伸到第4根K线，出于各种原因做空。尽管第5根K线是一根多头反转K线，并且是两K线反转上方的突破，但它是突破从第3根K线下来的窄幅空头通道的第一次尝试，因此很可能失败。多头需要有更强力量——表现为几根多头趋势K线——才会变得积极。空头把第5根K线看成一个微型通道低1做空，并盼着一次向下的等距运动。第8、9和10根K线处的底部，就位于一次从第3根K线急速行情起点开盘价到第4根K线（急速行情中最后一根空头趋势K线）收盘价的向下等距运动下方一点。这也促成了空头在那个区域的止盈以及多头的买入。


> As shown in Figure PIV.9, traders began to flip to always-in short as the market fell below the bars 1, 2, 3 head and shoulders top. Some started shorting below the bar 3 bear trend bar and two-bar reversal that formed the lower high. Others shorted for a variety of reasons as the spike grew down to bar 4. Even though bar 5 was a bull reversal bar and a breakout above a two-bar reversal, it was the first attempt to break out above the tight bear channel down from bar 3 and therefore was likely to fail. The bulls needed more strength in the form of several bull trend bars before they would become aggressive. The bears saw bar 5 as a micro channel low 1 short and were hoping for a measured move down. The bottom at bars 8, 9, and 10 was just below a measured move down from the open of the bar 3 start of the spike to the close of bar 4, the final bear trend bar in the spike. This also contributed to the profit taking by the shorts in that area as well as to the buying by the bulls.


第10根K线是一个双底回调买入建仓形态。


> Bar 10 was a double bottom pullback buy setup.


在涨到第11根K线的行情中，随着上涨推进，越来越多的交易者的始终入场交易转为做多。当市场在第12根K线处停顿下来时，几乎所有人都确信多头动能如此之强，很可能还有更多上涨。一旦始终入场交易翻转，交易者就应该设法入场。如果没有回调，那就至少买入一个小仓位，并使用一个较宽的止损，比如放在急速行情底部下方。机构当时做的就是这件事。他们一路上分批买入，因为他们不确定回调什么时候会来，但他们确信近期价格会更高，并且想要确保从这波强趋势中获利。如果他们等回调，回调可能在又出现许多根多头趋势K线之后才发生，而那次回调的入场价可能远高于眼前的价位。


> On the rally up to bar 11, the always-in trade flipped to long for more and more traders as the rally progressed. By the time the market paused at bar 12, just about everyone was convinced that the bull momentum was so strong that more of a rally was likely. Once the always-in trade flips, traders should try to get into the market. If there is no pullback, then buy at least a small position and use a wide stop, like below the bottom of the spike. That was what the institutions were doing. They were buying in pieces all the way up because they were not certain when a pullback would come, but they were certain that prices would be higher in the near term and wanted to be sure to profit from the strong trend. If they had waited for a pullback, it might have occurred after many more bull trend bars, and the entry on that pullback might have been well above where prices were at the moment.


作为一条通则，一旦交易者判定现在有一段多头趋势在展开，他们就应该至少在市价上、或在K线之内一次极小的回调处、或在更低时间级别图表上的一次回调处买入一个小仓位，因为一次上下等幅运动的方向概率大概至少有60%。举例来说，如果他们相信始终入场交易在第10根K线之后那第二根多头趋势K线上转为做多，他们就该假定市场至少有60% 的概率上涨完成一次向上的等距运动。交易者量出从第9根K线底部到第11根K线多头急速行情顶部的高度，再把这个高度加到第11根K线急速行情的顶部上。SPY 的交易者还量了从急速行情第一根K线（第10根K线之后那根）的开盘价到急速行情第二根K线收盘价的距离。如果 SPY 交易者在那第二根多头趋势K线的收盘时买入，他们会把止损放在第一根多头趋势K线（前一根K线）的低点下方，而他们的风险大约是12个点。随着急速行情继续增长，等距运动目标位也不断上移，而风险却固定为12个点，到某个时候他们还可以把止损移到保本位。如果他们一直持有到市场在第17根K线处向下反转，他们用12个点的初始风险赚到了大约50个点，而在入场之后头几根K线之后，风险就已经是保本级了。随着趋势推进到新高，他们本可以把止损移动跟进到最近的摆动低点下方。举例来说，市场涨到第11根K线上方之后，他们的止损就会移到第12根K线下方，那时他们保护的就是大约9个点的利润。


> As a general rule, as soon as traders decide that there is now a bull trend underway, they should buy at least a small position at the market or on a tiny pullback within the bar or a pullback on a lower time frame chart, because the directional probability of an equidistant move is probably at least 60 percent. For example, if they believed that the always-in trade flipped to long on that second bull trend bar after bar 10, they should have assumed that there was at least a 60 percent chance of the market going up for a measured move up. Traders measured the height from the bar 9 bottom to the bar 11 top of the bull spike and added that to the top of the bar 11 spike. SPY traders also measured from the open of the first bar of the spike (the bar after bar 10) to the close of the second bar of the spike. If the SPY traders bought at the close of that second bull trend bar, they would have put their stops below the low of the first bull trend bar (one bar earlier), and their risk would have been about 12 points. As the spike continued to grow, the measured move target continued to grow, yet the risk would have been fixed at 12 points, and at some point they could have moved their stops to breakeven. If they held until the market reversed down at bar 17, they would have made about 50 points with an initial risk of 12 points, and a breakeven risk after the first few bars following their entry. As the trend progressed to new highs, they could have trailed their stops to below the most recent swing low. For example, after the market rallied above bar 11, their stops would then have been below bar 12, and they would have been protecting about nine points of profit.


在急速行情又长了两三根K线之后，交易者本可以止盈一部分、把止损移到保本位，并假定在市场跌破急速行情低点之前，急速行情向上完成一次等于自身高度的上下等幅运动的方向概率约为60% 或更高。


> After the spike grew for two or three more bars, traders could have taken some profits, moved their stops to breakeven, and assumed that the directional probability of the spike going up for a measured move equal to its height was about 60 percent or more before the market fell below the low of the spike.


涨到第11根K线的行情是一段多头急速行情，而涨到第17根K线的通道有三次推进和一个楔形形状。这本来可能是那条通道的终点，但市场却是向上突破，而不是向下突破。通常，牛通道向上的突破会在大约五根K线之内反转回落，但这一次持续了大约10根K线。如果对一个楔形顶部的突破是向上的，通常能看到市场完成一次等距运动式的上涨。第13、15和17根K线形成了一个楔形顶部，而第23根K线的高点就略低于那次从第12根K线低点到第17根K线高点的等距运动。此外，多头急速行情常常引出以第一根K线的开盘价或低点为基准、量到最后一根K线收盘价或高点的等距运动。多头这段行情的顶峰第23根K线就是一次向上的等距运动，它是把第9根K线低点到第11根K线高点之间的点数加到第11根K线高点上得到的。多头通常会在等距运动目标位处止盈部分或全部仓位，而激进的空头会开始在那个价位做空。


> The rally up to bar 11 was a bull spike, and the channel up to bar 17 had three pushes and a wedge shape. This could have been the end of the channel, but the market broke out to the upside instead of to the downside. Usually, upside breakouts of bull channels reverse back down before about five bars, but this one continued for about 10 bars. It is common to see the market rally for a measured move up if the breakout of a wedge top is to the upside. Bars 13, 15, and 17 formed a wedge top, and the bar 23 high was just below that measured move from the bar 12 low to the bar 17 high. Also, bull spikes often lead to measured moves based on the open or low of the first bar to the close or high of the last bar. The bar 23 top of the bull leg was a measured move up, adding the number of points between the low of bar 9 to the high of bar 11 to the high of bar 11. Bulls usually look to take partial or complete profits at measured move targets, and aggressive bears will begin to short at that level.


第23根K线是与第19和第21根K线一起构成的扩张三角形顶部。


> Bar 23 was an expanding triangle top with bars 19 and 21.


第20、24和27根K线形成了一个楔形牛旗，但由于空头趋势K线的数量和大小，它很弱。当市场跌破楔形第27根K线底部时，它下跌的幅度超过了一次等距运动。


> Bars 20, 24, and 27 formed a wedge bull flag, but it was weak because of the number and size of the bear trend bars. When the market broke below the bar 27 bottom of the wedge, it fell for more than a measured move down.


从第10根K线到第23根K线的整段上涨行情是一条牛通道，因此也是一面熊旗。另一些交易者认为这条通道始于第12根K线。在两种情况下，交易者都相信市场至少应该向下测试到第12根K线低点一带。第24、25和27根K线上的影线表明确实有一些买盘，但下跌动能太强，多头无法扭转市场。从第23根K线跌到第27根K线的走势中几乎没有阳线实体，而且它们都相对较小，这段走势也处在一条相对窄幅的空头通道中。多头不会去买那条空头通道上方的第一次突破，而会等待一次以更高低点形式出现的突破回调，并且他们希望看到几根强多头趋势K线之后才愿意变得积极。把这个底部与第23根K线处的顶部比较一下。市场直到出现那根强劲而有说服力的第24根K线空头突破才转为始终做空，而许多空头会等到出现一个更低的高点才做空。市场在第26根K线处形成了一个低2更低的高点、对均线的测试，随后的下跌非常剧烈。


> The entire rally from bar 10 to bar 23 was a bull channel and therefore a bear flag. Other traders thought that the channel began at bar 12. In both cases, traders believed that the market should test down to at least the area of the bar 12 low. The tails on bars 24, 25, and 27 showed that there was some buying, but the momentum down was so strong that the bulls were unable to reverse the market. The move down from bar 23 to bar 27 had very few bull bodies and they were relatively small, and the move was in a relatively tight bear channel. Bulls would not have bought the first breakout above that bear channel and instead would have waited for a breakout pullback in the form of a higher low, and they would have wanted to see several strong bull trend bars before they would have been willing to become aggressive. Compare this bottom to the top at bar 23. The market did not become always-in down until the strong, convincing bar 24 bear breakout, and many bears would not have shorted until there was a lower high. The market formed a low 2 lower high test of the moving average at bar 26, and the move down was dramatic.


第29根K线卖出高潮之后那根内包K线是末端旗形的好候选，尤其因为那次突破又是一次卖出高潮。这是第31根K线处反转的又一个因素。


> The inside bar after the bar 29 sell climax was a good candidate for a final flag, especially since the breakout was another sell climax. This was another factor in the bar 31 reversal.


# 第 21 章　如何交易一个交易区间

*21. Example of How to Trade a Trading Range*


当市场处于交易区间时，交易者应当以“低买高卖”这句箴言为准则。另外，要把自己的交易看作剥头皮，而不是波段。计划好只赚小利，不要抱着等待突破的念头持仓不放。涨向区间顶部的那些上涨行情，往往看起来就要变成一次成功的突破、进入多头趋势，但其中80% 都会失败；同样，那些跌向区间底部的强劲抛售，也有80% 没能突破出去、进入空头趋势。尽量让你的潜在回报至少与风险一样大，这样你的胜率就不必高达70% 或更高。由于市场是双边成交的，你入场之后、出场之前往往会遇到回调，所以如果你不愿意扛过一段回调，就不要做这笔交易。如果市场在交易区间里已经连涨了5到10根K线，那么通常好得多的做法是只去找做空机会，并对多头仓位止盈。如果它已经跌了一段时间，就去找买入机会，或者对空头仓位止盈。在区间中部很少用止损单入场，但在那里用限价单入场，有时是合理的。


> When the market is in a trading range, traders should be guided by the maxim “Buy low, sell high.” Also, think of your trades as scalps and not swings. Plan to take small profits and do not hold on hoping for a breakout. The rallies to the top usually look like they will become successful breakouts into a bull trend, but 80 percent of them fail, and 80 percent of the strong sell-offs to the bottom of the range fail to break out into a bear trend. Try to keep your potential reward at least as large as your risk so your winning percentage does not have to be 70 percent or higher. Since the market is two-sided, there will often be pullbacks after you enter and before you exit, so do not take a trade if you are unwilling to sit through a pullback. If the market has been going up for five to 10 bars in a trading range, it is usually far better to look only for shorts and to take profits on longs. If it has been going down for a while, look to buy or to take profits on shorts. Rarely enter on stops in the middle of the range, but it is sometimes reasonable to enter on limit orders there.


在最好的那些建仓形态中，初学者应当把注意力集中在用止损单入场的做法上，这样在他们入场时，市场正朝着他们的方向走：


> Among the best trade setups, beginners should focus on entries that use stops so that the market is going in their direction when they enter:


- 在区间底部附近买入高2。这类入场往往是从底部把市场向上反转的第二次尝试，就像双底一样。
- 在区间顶部附近卖出低2。这类入场往往是从顶部把市场向下反转的第二次尝试，就像双顶一样。
- 在交易区间的底部买入，尤其是在它向上突破一条空头趋势线之后出现的二次入场。
- 在交易区间的顶部做空，尤其是在它跌破一条多头趋势线之后出现的二次入场。
- 在底部附近买入楔形牛旗。
- 在顶部附近卖出楔形熊旗。
- 在区间底部的某个摆动低点被跌破之后，买入一根多头反转K线，或买入末端旗形（在第3册中讨论）那样的反转形态。
- 在区间顶部的某个摆动高点被突破之后，卖出一根空头反转K线，或卖出末端旗形（在第3册中讨论）那样的反转形态。
- 在区间底部附近向上突破之后，买入一次突破回调（举例来说，如果市场开始上涨接着回调，就找机会在前一根K线的高点上方买入）。
- 在区间顶部附近向下突破之后，卖出一次突破回调（举例来说，如果市场开始下跌接着回调，就找机会在前一根K线的低点下方卖出）。用限价单入场，需要更强的读图经验，因为交易者入场时，市场正朝着与这笔交易相反的方向走。有些交易者会用更小的仓位，并在市场继续朝着对他们不利的方向走时分批建仓；但只有成功的、有经验的交易者才应当尝试这种做法。下面是一些用限价单或市价单入场的建仓形态示例：


> • Buying a high 2 near the bottom of the range. These are often second attempts to reverse the market up from the bottom, like a double bottom. • Selling a low 2 near the top of the range. These are often second attempts to reverse the market down from the top, like a double top. • Buying at the bottom of a trading range, especially if it is a second entry after a break above a bear trend line. • Shorting at the top of a trading range, especially if it is a second entry after a break below the bull trend line. • Buying a wedge bull flag near the bottom. • Selling a wedge bear flag near the top. • Buying a bull reversal bar or reversal pattern like a final flag (discussed in book 3) after a break below a swing low at the bottom of the range. • Selling a bear reversal bar or reversal pattern like a final flag (discussed in book 3) after a break above a swing high at the top of the range. • Buying a breakout pullback after an upside breakout near the bottom of the range (for example, if the market starts up and pulls back, look to buy above the high of the prior bar). • Selling a breakout pullback after downside breakout near the top of the range (for example, if the market starts down and pulls back, look to sell below the low of the prior bar). Entering using limit orders requires more experience reading charts, because the trader is entering in a market that is going in the opposite direction to the trade. Some traders trade smaller positions and scale in if the market continues against them; but only successful, experienced traders should ever attempt this. Here are some examples of limit or market order trade setups:


- 以市价单买入一段空头急速行情，或者在区间底部前一个摆动低点的低点处或更低处用限价单买入（在急速行情中入场需要更宽的止损，而急速行情发生得很快，所以这种组合对很多交易者来说都很难做）。
- 以市价单卖出一段多头急速行情，或者在区间顶部前一个摆动高点的高点处或更高处用限价单卖出（在急速行情中入场需要更宽的止损，而急速行情发生得很快，所以这种组合对很多交易者来说都很难做）。
- 在区间底部附近一根大空头趋势K线的收盘价处买入，或在其低点下方买入，因为它往往是一次衰竭性卖出高潮，也是交易区间里这轮抛售的终点。
- 在区间顶部附近一根大多头趋势K线的收盘价处卖出，或在其高点上方卖出，因为它往往是一次衰竭性买入高潮，也是交易区间里这轮上涨行情的终点。
- 在交易区间底部，在一根弱势的低1或低2信号K线处或更低处用限价单买入。
- 在交易区间顶部，在一根弱势的高1或高2信号K线处或更高处用限价单做空。
- 在一段强劲多头波段启动之际，买入一根空头收盘K线。
- 在一段强劲空头波段启动之际，卖出一根多头收盘K线。


> • Buying a bear spike at the market or on a limit order at or below the low of the prior swing low at the bottom of the range (entering in spikes requires a wider stop and the spike happens quickly, so this combination is difficult for many traders). • Selling a bull spike at the market or on a limit order at or above the high of the prior swing high at the top of the range (entering in spikes requires a wider stop and the spike happens quickly, so this combination is difficult for many traders). • Buying at the close or below the low of a large bear trend bar near the bottom of the range, since it is often an exhaustive sell climax and the end of the sell-off in a trading range. • Selling at the close or above the high of a large bull trend bar near the top of the range, since it is often an exhaustive buy climax and the end of the rally in a trading range. • Buying at or below a low 1 or 2 weak signal bar on a limit order at the bottom of a trading range. • Shorting at or above a high 1 or 2 weak signal bar on a limit order at the top of a trading range. • Buying a bear close at the start of a strong bull swing. • Selling a bull close at the start of a strong bear swing.


![图 21.1](figures/fig-21-01.jpg)


**图 21.1　在交易区间中对两个极值反向操作来做剥头皮**


交易一个像图 21.1中 QQQ 那样的交易区间日，方法有很多，但总的来说，交易者应当找机会在两个极值处反向操作，并且只做剥头皮。虽然信号很多，但交易者不必为抓住全部信号而操心，甚至不必为抓住其中大多数信号而操心。一个交易者每天只需要几个好的建仓形态，就能开始盈利。


> There are many ways to trade a trading range day like the one in QQQ shown in Figure 21.1, but, in general, traders should look to fade the extremes and only scalp. Although there are many signals, traders should not worry about catching all of them or even most of them. All a trader needs is a few good setups a day to begin to become profitable.


我有一位交易了几十年的朋友，在像这样的日子里做得极其出色。我实时看过他交易 Emini 小型合约；在这样的一天里，他会做大约15笔每笔赚1个点的剥头皮交易，全部都是反向操作。举例来说，在第10根K线到第18根K线这一带，他会设法在一切位置的下方挂限价单买入：比如市场跌破第10根K线时、第13根K线跌破它前面那根空头K线时、以及第15根K线跌破它前面那根K线时；而当市场跌破第13根K线时，他还会加仓。市场下探到第15根K线下方时，他会买得更多；如果市场跌破第12根K线，他也会设法买入。有一点很重要，要记住他是非常有经验的交易者，有能力识别出成功率在70% 到80% 的交易。极少有交易者具备这种能力，正因如此，初学者不应当在冒着大约2个点风险的同时，只为赚1个点而剥头皮。最起码，他们只应当做那些他们认为等距运动成功概率不低于60% 的交易区间交易。既然在这张图上他们必须承担大约2个点的风险，那么他们只应在打算持仓等到至少2个点利润时才做这笔交易。这意味着，他们应当找机会在区间底部附近买入，在顶部附近做空。


> I have a friend who has traded for many decades and who does extremely well on days like this. I have watched him trade the Emini in real time, and he would take about 15 profitable one-point scalps on a day like this, all based on fades. For example, in the bar 10 to bar 18 area, he would try to buy with limit orders below everything, like as the market fell below bar 10, as bar 13 went below the bear bar before it, and as bar 15 fell below the bar before it, and he would have added on as it fell below bar 13. He would have bought more as the market dipped below bar 15, and he would have tried to buy if the market fell below bar 12. It is important to remember that he is a very experienced trader and has the ability to spot trades that have a 70 to 80 percent chance of success. Very few traders have that ability, which is why beginners should not be scalping for one point while risking about two points. At a minimum, they should take trading range trades only where they believe the probability of success of an equidistant move is at least 60 percent. Since they would have to risk about two points on this chart, they should trade only if they are holding for at least a two-point profit. That means that they should look to buy near the bottom of the range and short near the top.


如果交易者在区间底部附近买入，他们就应当找机会在区间顶部附近止盈。他们还应当找机会在区间顶部附近开空，并在市场走向区间底部时对那些空头仓位止盈。对大多数交易者来说，反手太难，他们应当改用止盈目标来出场，然后再去找反方向的交易。举例来说，如果他们是在第16根K线涨过前一根K线的高点、触发双底牛旗入场时买入的，那么他们可以挂一张卖出限价单，在涨向第20根K线的行情中赚到10、15或20美分就出场。出场之后，他们就可以去找做空的建仓形态，比如在第22根K线那个更低的高点下方，或者在第24根K线那个更低的高点下方。后者是更好的建仓形态，因为它带有一根强劲的空头反转K线，而且它与第22根K线构成了双顶熊旗。


> If traders bought near the bottom of the range, they should look to take profits near the top of the range. They should also look to initiate shorts near the top of the range and take profits on those shorts when the market moves toward the bottom of the range. Reversing is too difficult for most traders, and instead they should use profit targets for exits and then look for a trade in the opposite direction. For example, if they bought on bar 16 as it went above the high of the prior bar and triggered the double bottom bull flag entry, they could have a sell limit order to exit with a 10, 15, or 20 cent profit on the move up to bar 20. After they exited, they could then look for a short setup, like below the bar 22 lower high or below the bar 24 lower high. The latter was a better setup because it had a strong bear reversal bar and it was a double top bear flag with bar 22.


那么，交易者是从什么时候得出结论，认为这是一个交易区间日的呢？每个人的判断各不相同，但往往很早就出现线索，随着线索越积越多，交易者也越来越有把握。从第一根K线起就有双边成交的迹象，之后的几乎每一根K线又在累积新的迹象。当天的第一根K线是一根十字星，这提高了出现交易区间日的可能性。市场在第3根K线向上反转，但涨向第4根K线的行情后续乏力。头三根K线都在低点带影线，而第2根K线与前一根K线大约重叠了一半。第3根K线在多头入场之后立刻向下反转，接下来一根K线又向上反转。市场在第4根K线再次向下反转、在第5根K线再次向上反转，又在第7根K线、也就是移动平均线处再次向下反转。只要市场在头一个小时里出现四次或五次反转，出现交易区间日的概率就会上升。


> So when did traders conclude that this was a trading range day? Everyone is different, but there are often clues early on, and as more accumulate, traders become more confident. There were signs of two-sided trading right from the first bar, and other signs accumulated on just about every following bar. The first bar of the day was a doji, and that increased the chances of a trading range day. The market reversed up at bar 3 but had weak follow-through on the move up to bar 4. The first three bars had tails at their lows, and bar 2 overlapped about half of the prior bar. Bar 3 was a reversal down immediately after the long entry, and the next bar was a reversal up. The market reversed down again at bar 4 and up again at bar 5, and down again at bar 7 at the moving average. Whenever the market has four or five reversals in the first hour, the odds of a trading range day increase.


第6根K线是一根强劲的多头趋势K线，但没有后续行情。它在移动平均线处停滞，接下来的一根K线是十字星，而不是另一根收盘价远在移动平均线之上的强劲多头趋势K线。再下一根K线是一根空头趋势K线，而它之后的两根K线也都没能收在移动平均线上方。尽管这波上涨很强劲，多头却并没有掌控局面，所以市场是双边成交的。


> Bar 6 was a strong bull trend bar but there was no follow-through. It stalled at the moving average, and the next bar was a doji instead of another strong bull trend bar with a close well above the moving average. The next bar was a bear trend bar, and the two bars after also failed to close above the moving average. The bulls were not in control, despite a strong rally, so the market was two-sided.


第2根K线是一段两根K线多头急速行情的起点，之后是一段三次推进的多头通道，一直涨到第7根K线。由于第2根K线是在向下跳空、出现一轮抛售之后的一根强劲多头反转K线，它是一个很好的开盘反转，也可能是当天的低点。这一天本可以变成一个强劲的多头趋势日，结果却走成了横盘。不过，它始终没有跌破入场K线的低点。


> Bar 2 was the start of a two-bar bull spike, and it was followed by a three-push bull channel up to bar 7. Since bar 2 was a strong bull reversal bar after a gap down and a sell-off, it was a good opening reversal and a possible low of the day. The day could have become a strong bull trend day but instead went sideways. However, it never dropped below the entry bar low.


第2根K线是那段两根K线多头急速行情的第一根K线，而第4根和第7根K线是急速行情之后楔形通道中的第二次和第三次向上推进。急速与通道形态中的通道，就是交易区间的第一段行情，所以此时大多数交易者都假定，市场至少会在接下来10到20根K线里处于交易区间中，甚至可能一直持续到当天结束。他们想买入的是一轮两段式抛售，用来测试第3根K线或第5根K线的低点，因为那两根K线构成了多头通道的底部。即使他们认为这一天有可能变成趋势日，他们也把它看作眼下的交易区间，因此只做剥头皮。他们的剥头皮反过来强化了这个交易区间，因为当大量交易者都在高点附近卖出、在低点附近买入时，市场就很难突破出去、走进一段趋势。


> Bar 2 was the first bar of a two-bar bull spike, and bars 4 and 7 were the second and third pushes up in a wedge channel after the spike. A channel in a spike and channel pattern is the first leg of a trading range, so most traders assumed at this point that the market would be in a trading range for at least the next 10 to 20 bars and maybe for the rest of the day. They looked to buy a two-legged sell-off that would test the bar 3 or bar 5 low, since those bars formed the bottom of the bull channel. Even if they believed that the day might become a trend day, they saw it as a trading range for the time being and were therefore only scalping. Their scalping reinforced the trading range, because when lots of traders are selling near the high and buying near the low, it is very difficult for the market to break out into a trend.


交易者本来会在第2根K线上方买入，至少去博一次对移动平均线的测试。有些交易者本来会在当天的新高处，对第4根K线那根空头反转K线做空；但大多数人本来会认为，来自第2根K线反转K线、那段两根K线多头急速行情以及第4根K线之前那根多头K线的买压足够强，即使出现回调，市场也会去测试移动平均线。正因如此，很多交易者会把限价买单挂在第4根K线低点处和下方，而把保护性止损放在第2根K线之后那根多头入场K线的下方，甚至放在第2根K线信号K线的低点下方。有些人会用金额止损，比如按当天到目前为止一根K线的平均高度，大约10到15美分。有些交易者可能认为，空头本来也可以从第4根K线往下的行情里剥出10美分。那需要价格跌到第4根K线下方12美分处，所以他们可能用了13个最小报价单位的止损。他们本来会假定这笔空头是一次剥头皮，因此空头们本会在第4根K线低点下方11美分处挂限价单买回自己的空头仓位——这样，对于那些在第4根K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处用止损单入场的空头仓位，他们就能剥出10美分的利润。


> Traders would have bought above bar 2 for at least a test of the moving average. Some traders would have shorted the bar 4 bear reversal bar at the new high of the day, but most would have assumed that the buying pressure from the bar 2 reversal bar, the two-bar bull spike, and the bull bar before bar 4 was strong enough for the market to test the moving average, even if there was a pullback. Because of this, many traders placed limit orders to buy at and below the bar 4 low, and they would have put their protective stops below the long entry bar after bar 2 or even below the bar 2 signal bar low. Some would have used a money stop, like around the height of an average bar so far today, maybe 10 to 15 cents. Some traders might have thought that the bears could have made a 10 cent scalp down from bar 4. That would require a 12 cent move below bar 4, so they might have used a 13-tick stop. They would have assumed that the short would have been a scalp, and therefore the bears would have had limit orders to buy back their shorts at 11 cents below the bar 4 low so that they could scalp out 10 cents on the shorts that they had entered on a stop at one tick below bar 4.


机警的交易者本来会在第4根K线之后那根空头入场K线的上方挂止损单做多，因为他们知道，第4根K线那根信号K线足够强，能够吸引空头进场，而那些空头会担心市场向上反转、去测试移动平均线。他们的保护性止损会挂在自己的入场K线上方，并且在市场到达移动平均线之前，不会再去找机会做空。这样一来，在那根入场K线上方买入，就成了一次极好的多头剥头皮。


> Alert traders would have placed a stop order to go long above the bear entry bar after bar 4 since they knew that the bar 4 signal bar was strong enough to entice shorts, and those shorts would be worried about a reversal up to the moving average. They would have their protective stops above their entry bar and not look to short again until the market reached the moving average. This made buying above that entry bar a great long scalp.


多头不相信第5根K线之后那根K线是一个可靠的做空机会，于是把买单挂在它的低点上方一个最小报价单位处、低点处和低点下方，预期它会成为一个失败的更低的高点。结果只有低点上方一个最小报价单位处的那些多头限价单成交了，这说明多头非常激进。其结果是走出了一根强劲的多头趋势K线，直抵移动平均线。这是一次强劲的多头突破，但交易者想不通，为什么它到了移动平均线就停住，而不是远远涨到上方去。他们需要看到立刻出现的后续行情，否则就会怀疑这将是突破开盘高点的一次突破失败。也许第6根K线只是强手暂时退场所造成的一次买入价格真空。如果他们认定市场就要去测试移动平均线，那么在移动平均线下方一点点就卖出，在他们看来毫无道理。强劲多头与强劲空头双双缺席，让市场一路疾涨。然而，一旦市场到达他们心目中可能停下来的区域，他们就不知从哪里冒了出来，猛烈卖出，压倒了那些弱势多头。强劲多头卖出多头仓位获利了结，强劲空头则卖出、建立新的空头仓位。那些把这一天看作可能的交易区间日的空头，会在第6根K线涨到移动平均线上方时用限价单卖出，另一些人则会在这根K线的收盘价处做空。有些人还愿意在更高的价位分批建仓，尤其是在下一根K线后续行情乏力之后。


> The bulls doubted that the bar after bar 5 was a reliable short, so they placed orders to buy one tick above, at, and below its low, expecting it to be a failed lower high. Only the long limit orders at one tick above the low got filled, which means that the bulls were very aggressive. The result was a strong bull trend bar up to the moving average. This was a strong bull breakout, but traders wondered why it stopped at the moving average instead of going far above. They needed to see immediate follow-through or they would suspect that this was going to be a failed breakout above the opening high. Maybe bar 6 was just a buy vacuum caused by the strong traders temporarily stepping aside. If they assumed that the market was going to test the moving average, it made no sense for them to sell just below the moving average. The absence of strong bulls and bears allowed the market to race up. However, once the market reached the area where they thought it was likely to stop, they appeared out of nowhere and sold aggressively, overwhelming the weak bulls. The strong bulls sold out of their longs for a profit, and the strong bears sold to initiate new shorts. Bears who saw the day as a likely trading range day would have had limit orders to sell as bar 6 moved above the moving average, while others would have shorted its close. Some would have been willing to scale in higher, especially after the weak follow-through on the next bar.


随着市场下跌，大多数交易者都看得很清楚：多空双方都很强，而且在双方争夺控制权的过程中，市场很可能继续保持双边成交。这意味着出现交易区间的可能性很大。当市场接近顶部时，多头开始担心在这个价位买入太贵，而空头则认为这是极好的做空价值。这让市场下跌。那些急着在顶部附近做空的空头，对在底部附近做空没有兴趣，于是卖压枯竭。而那些愿意在中部买入的多头，认为区间底部是更好的价值所在；他们在那里积极买入，把市场又抬了回去。


> As the market traded down, it was clear to most traders that both the bulls and the bears were strong and that the market was likely to remain two-sided as both sides fought for control. This meant that a trading range was likely. When the market got near the top, the bulls became concerned that it was too expensive to buy and the bears saw it as a great value to short. This made the market fall. The bears who were eager to short near the top were not interested in shorting near the bottom, so selling dried up. The bulls who were willing to buy in the middle saw the bottom of the range as an even better value; they bought there aggressively, lifting the market back up.


空头愿意在第7根K线那次对移动平均线的测试下方做空。如果多头很强，市场本应强劲地涨到移动平均线上方，而不是这样停滞。第7根K线让第6根K线看起来更像是衰竭，而不是一次强劲突破。另一些空头在第8根K线那个 ii形态（内包内包）下方做空，或者在第7根K线之后那根空头K线下方做空。从 ii形态开始的那段两根K线空头急速行情相当强劲，但它的低点处带一根影线，说明有一些买盘。此时，市场先是走出了一波从当天低点到第7根K线的强劲上涨急速行情，现在又是一波强劲的下跌急速行情。交易者预期会出现一个交易区间。


> Bears were willing to short below the bar 7 test of the moving average. If the bulls were strong, there should have been a strong move above the moving average and not this stall. Bar 7 made bar 6 look more like exhaustion than a strong breakout. Other bears shorted below the bar 8 ii pattern or below the bear bar that followed bar 7. The two-bar bear spike from the ii was reasonably strong, but it had a tail at its low, indicating some buying. At this point, the market had a strong spike up from the low of the day to bar 7 and now a strong spike down. Traders were expecting a trading range.


第9根K线是一个多头陷阱。大多数交易者都把它前面那根十字星内包K线看成空头急速行情之后一个糟糕的买入信号，于是很多人把限价空单挂在那根十字星K线的高点处。他们在等待一次回调，回到第5根K线低点附近的多头通道底部区域。那里也位于第2根K线信号K线高点所在的区域，而这个价位是突破回测的磁力位。多头希望在第3根K线或第5根K线低点那一带形成一个双底牛旗，但他们也希望原来的入场K线低点能够守住（也就是第2根K线之后那根K线的低点）。否则，他们大概就会放弃“这一天仍有机会走成多头趋势日”的信念。


> Bar 9 was a bull trap. Most traders saw the doji inside bar before it as a bad buy signal after the bear spike, and many placed limit orders to go short at the high of the doji bar. They were looking for a pullback to the area of the bottom of the bull channel around the bar 5 low. This was also in the area of the bar 2 signal bar high, which was a magnet for a breakout test. The bulls wanted a double bottom bull flag to develop in the bar 3 or bar 5 low area, but they also wanted the original entry bar low to hold (the low of the bar after bar 2). Otherwise, they would have probably given up on the belief that there was still a chance of a bull trend day.


第10根K线是从第7根K线高点起算的第三次向下推进，它是一根强劲的多头趋势K线。多头担心这段下跌处在一条紧凑的通道里，第一次突破尝试可能会失败。很多多头本来会等到出现一次突破回调再买入。一些确实买入的人仓位下得更小，以防市场继续跌到更靠近第3根K线低点的位置；他们计划在第二次向上信号出现时再买更多，而这个信号在第12根K线出现了。另一些人认为，很多交易者的多头仓位上都挂着10美分的止损，于是把加仓的限价单挂在下方10美分处——正是那些弱势多头将要出场的价位。然后他们会把整个仓位的保护性止损放在再往下大约10美分的地方，也就是第2根K线之后那根入场K线的下方，甚至放在第2根K线下方。那些愿意把风险放到当天新低的交易者，可能会用更小的仓位，以便在比第一次入场低大约10美分处再分批建仓一次多头。


> Bar 10 was the third push down from the bar 7 high, and it was a strong bull trend bar. Bulls were concerned that the move down was in a tight channel and that the first breakout attempt might fail. Many bulls would have waited for a breakout pullback before buying. Some who did buy bought a smaller position, in case the market traded down closer to the bar 3 low, and they planned to buy more on a second signal up, which they got at bar 12. Others thought that many traders would have a 10 cent stop on their longs, so they placed a limit order to buy more 10 cents down, exactly where those weak bulls would be exiting. They then would put a protective stop on their entire position at maybe 10 more cents down, below the entry bar after bar 2, or even below bar 2. The traders who were willing to risk to a new low of the day might have traded even smaller to allow for a second scaled-in long about 10 cents below their first.


第12根K线那根多头反转K线，与第3根K线或第5根K线的低点构成一个大致上的双底，而且它是一次二次信号。这使它在交易区间底部附近成为一个高2。它是从当天高点起算的第四次向下推进，有些交易者把它看作一个高4牛旗。第8根K线之后那段空头急速下跌，对很多交易者来说是第一次向下推进，而第12根K线是第三次。很多急速与通道形态都终结于这样的第三次推进，随后尝试走出一轮两段式上涨，去测试空头通道的顶部，也就是第9根K线高点一带。有些交易者认为，跌向第12根K线的行情处在一条过于紧凑的通道里，不适合买入，他们会一直等到出现一个清晰的二次信号。很多人要等到第12根K线低点附近出现一根相对较小的K线才会买入。这些交易者本来可以在第16根K线上买入，去博那个双底牛旗。第14根K线足够强，向上突破了空头通道，随后市场走了一次两段式回调。第16根K线同时也是楔形牛旗的入场点，其中第10根K线是第一次向下推进，第12根K线是第二次。另一些人则把第13根K线看作第一次向下推进、第15根K线看作第二次。它同时还是一个下降三角形，而第16根K线是向上突破。由于它是一根强劲的突破K线，交易者都想着去买入一次突破回调。他们会在前一根K线的低点处或下方挂限价买单，并且会在第18根K线成交。另一些人会买在第17根空头K线的收盘价处，因为他们认为，出现突破回调和一个更高的低点，比出现突破失败、并跌到第16根K线那个交易区间底部下方更有可能。


> The bar 12 bull reversal bar was an approximate double bottom with the bar 3 or bar 5 low, and it was a second signal. This made it a high 2 near the bottom of the trading range. It was the fourth push down from the high of the day, and some traders saw it as a high 4 bull flag. The bear spike down after bar 8 was the first push down for many traders, and bar 12 was the third. Many spike and channel patterns end in a third push like this and then try for a two-legged rally to test the top of the bear channel, which was around the bar 9 high. Some traders thought that the move down to bar 12 was in too tight a channel to buy, and they would have waited for a clear second signal. Many would not have bought until they got a relatively small bar near the bar 12 low. These traders could have bought on bar 16 for the double bottom bull flag. Bar 14 was strong enough to break above the bear channel, and then the market had a two-legged pullback. Bar 16 was also the entry for a wedge bull flag where bar 10 was the first push down and bar 12 was the second. Others saw bar 13 as the first push down and bar 15 as the second. It was also a descending triangle, and bar 16 was the breakout to the upside. Since it was a strong breakout bar, traders were looking to buy a breakout pullback. They would have limit orders to buy at or below the low of the prior bar and they would have been filled on bar 18. Others would have bought the close of the bear bar 17 since they thought that a breakout pullback and a higher low were more likely than a failed breakout and a move below the bar 16 bottom of the trading range.


交易者运用同样的逻辑，在第12根K线之后那根K线的下方买入；他们认为在那里做空低2是个糟糕的选择，因为它位于交易区间的底部，而且它出现在第二次向上反转之后，而那两次反转都有不错的买压（不错的多头反转K线）。有些人会在第12根K线之后那根空头K线的收盘价处买入，或者在第13根K线的空头收盘价处买入，预期第12根K线的低点能够守住。另一些人会在第13根K线上方买入，认为有空头被套住，因此随着空头回补，市场可能快速上涨。


> Traders used that same logic and bought below the bar after bar 12, believing that it was a bad low 2 short since it was at the bottom of the trading range, and it was after the second reversal up where both reversals had good buying pressure (good bull reversal bars). Some would have bought on the close of the bear bar after bar 12 or on the bear close of bar 13, expecting the bar 12 low to hold. Others would have bought above bar 13, thinking that there were trapped bears and therefore the market could move up quickly as the bears covered.


由于这是一个窄幅交易区间，它是多空双方都看到价值的区域。双方都乐于在那里开仓。在一个多空双方公认的价值区域里，突破通常走不了太远，市场就会被拉回区间之内。它有一股很强的磁力：空头会在上方做空得更重，而多头会在下方买得更多。


> Since this was a tight trading range, it was an area where both the bulls and the bears saw value. Both were comfortable initiating trades there. In an established area of value for both the bulls and the bears, breakouts usually cannot go too far before the market gets pulled back into the range. It has a strong magnetic pull, and bears will short more heavily above, while bulls will buy more heavily below.


第18根K线是一根大的多头趋势K线，它向上突破了此前一个小时左右的交易区间。然而，由于这一整天整体处在一个更大的交易区间中，而市场现在正处在这个更大区间的中部，交易者对买入感到犹豫。这就形成了 ii形态。有些交易者买在第12根K线的收盘价处，也买在第12根K线上方的突破处。另一些人在 ii形态期间买入，也在第19根K线那根多头内包K线上方买入。交易者曾试图把限价买单挂在第18根K线之后那根内包K线的低点处和下方，但没有成交。这让他们更愿意去买入第19根K线上方的突破。他们看到自己的买单在下方没能成交，认为这是多头急不可耐的一个信号。


> Bar 18 was a large bull trend bar that broke out above the trading range of the past hour or so. However, since the overall day was in a larger trading range and the market was now in the middle of that larger range, traders were hesitant to buy. This resulted in the ii pattern. Some traders bought the bar 12 close and the breakout above bar 12. Others bought during the ii and above the bar 19 bull inside bar. Traders tried to buy on limit orders at and below the low of the inside bar after bar 18 but they did not get filled. This made them more willing to buy the breakout above bar 19. They saw that their buy orders did not get filled below and thought that this was a sign of urgency by the bulls.


第18根K线那段突破急速行情之后，紧接着是一段小的抛物线式高潮，一直走到第20根K线，在那里形成了向下的两根K线反转。入场点在两根K线中较低那根的下方，但直到三根K线之后才被触发。那些认为这一天是交易区间日的交易者，正想找机会对一次涨到接近当天高点的强劲上涨行情做空。第21根K线是一根小十字星，因此是一个弱势的高1买入形态，尤其是在一次买入高潮之后。空头在它的高点上方做空。另一些空头在第22根K线下方做空，那里正是多头卖出平掉多头仓位的位置。他们本来是在交易区间顶部买入，期待一波多头突破；既然突破没有出现，他们就迅速出场。就在他们出场时，触发了第20根K线高点处的那次两根K线反转做空。


> The bar 18 breakout spike was followed by a small parabolic climax to bar 20 where a two-bar reversal down set up. The entry was below the lower of the two bars and it was not triggered until three bars later. Traders who believed that the day was a trading range day were looking to short a strong rally to near the high of the day. Bar 21 was a small doji and therefore a weak high 1 buy setup, especially after a buy climax. Bears shorted above its high. Others shorted below bar 22, where the bulls were selling out of their longs. They had bought at the top of a trading range, hoping for a bull breakout, and when it did not happen, they were quick to exit. As they did, they triggered the two-bar reversal short at the bar 20 high.


市场跌到移动平均线，并用一根多头反转K线形成了一个高2买入信号。在多头趋势中，这是一个非常可靠的建仓形态，但大多数交易者仍然把这一天看作交易区间日。很多人在第23根K线上方买入，希望这一天会走成多头趋势，但他们打算，如果没有出现强劲的多头突破就迅速出场。让他们担心的是，第23根K线之后那根K线是一根十字星内包K线，因为他们想要的是紧迫感，而不是犹豫。


> The market fell to the moving average and formed a high 2 buy signal with a bull reversal bar. This is a very reliable setup in a bull trend, but most traders still saw the day as a trading range day. Many bought above bar 23 with the hope that the day would become a bull trend, but they planned to exit quickly if there was not a strong bull breakout. They were concerned that the bar after bar 23 was a doji inside bar, because they wanted a sense of urgency, not hesitation.


他们平掉了多头仓位，而空头在第24根空头反转K线的下方做空——这根K线与第22根K线构成了双顶熊旗。有些人把它看作与第22根K线组成的一个低2做空机会，另一些人则把它看作一个楔形顶部，其中第20根K线是第一次向上推进，第22根K线是第二次。


> They exited their longs, and bears shorted below the bar 24 bear reversal bar, which formed a double top bear flag with bar 22. Some saw it as a low 2 short with bar 22 and others saw it as a wedge top where bar 20 was the first push up and bar 22 was the second.


出现了一段跌向交易区间底部的强劲空头急速行情，但第25根K线的空头实体很小，说明有犹豫。多头没能制造出突破，结果只是一个交易区间。这个交易区间没能抵抗住第10根K线到第16根K线那个窄幅交易区间的磁力吸引。如果这是强劲的空头趋势，市场一旦回到当天早些时候的那个窄幅交易区间，就不会犹豫。相反，它会在一连串强劲的空头趋势K线中跌破那个区间。这告诉交易者，空头并不强，这可能只是一次卖出价格真空。强手可能已经退场旁观，等待市场去测试区间底部。一旦市场到了那里，他们就开始积极而不停地买入：多头建立新的多头仓位，空头对空头仓位止盈。他们决意要把市场托在交易区间低点之上。第26根K线是交易区间底部的一个高2，也是一根强劲的多头反转K线。第25根K线是高1形态。第25根与第26根K线这一带与第12根到第16根K线那一带构成了双底牛旗。这第二个底部同时也是第10根K线到第17根K线那个窄幅交易区间的突破回调。


> There was a strong bear spike to the bottom of the trading range, but bar 25 had a small bear body, indicating hesitation. The bulls were unable to create a breakout, and the result was only a trading range. The trading range failed to resist the magnetic pull of the bar 10 to 16 tight trading range. If this was a strong bear trend, the market would not have hesitated once it got back into the tight trading range from earlier in the day. Instead, it would have fallen below it in a series of strong bear trend bars. This told traders that the bears were not strong and that this might just be a sell vacuum. Strong traders might have stepped aside, expecting a test of the bottom of the range. Once the market got there, they began buying aggressively and relentlessly, the bulls initiating new longs and the bears taking profits on their shorts. They were determined to keep the market above the trading range low. Bar 26 was a high 2 at the bottom of the trading range and a strong bull reversal bar. Bar 25 was the high 1 setup. The bars 25 and 26 area formed a double bottom bull flag with the bars 12 to 16 area. This second bottom was also the breakout pullback from the bar 10 to bar 17 tight trading range.


第26根K线在下一根K线上有很好的后续行情，交易者预期这次向下测试会失败。有些人买在第27根空头趋势K线的收盘价处。另一些人把限价买单挂在第27根K线低点处和下方。买盘如此积极，市场甚至没能跌到第27根K线的低点。机警的交易者看到这一点，迅速把买入止损单挂在第27根K线的高点上方。这带来了一次由两根多头趋势K线构成的突破。


> Bar 26 had good follow-through on the next bar, and traders expected this test down to fail. Some bought the close of the bar 27 bear trend bar. Others placed limit orders to buy at and below the bar 27 low. The buying was so aggressive that the market could not even get to the bar 27 low. Alert traders saw this and quickly placed orders to buy on a stop above the bar 27 high. This resulted in a breakout formed by two bull trend bars.


第28根K线是一根空头内包K线，但由于从第26根K线起的上涨处在一条紧凑的通道里，第一次向下尝试应当会失败。多头把限价买单挂在第28根K线低点处和下方。跌向第26根K线的行情是一次大型两段式运动，其中第23根K线结束了第一段。这是一面大型牛旗，而涨向第28根K线的行情就是突破。第29根K线是那次突破后的回调，同时也是对第26根K线到第28根K线这段微型通道底部的突破失败。第30根K线是一个决斗线形态，随着市场涨到那两条线上方，多头止盈出场，形成了顶部的影线。另一些人在疲弱的收盘价处出场，还有人则是在第31根K线那个两根K线反转顶部的下方出场。


> Bar 28 was a bear inside bar, but the move up from bar 26 was in a tight channel so the first attempt down should fail. Bulls placed limit orders to buy at and below the low of bar 28. The move down to bar 26 was a large two-legged move where bar 23 ended the first leg. This was a large bull flag, and the move up to bar 28 was the breakout. Bar 29 was the pullback from that breakout, and it was also the failed breakout of the bottom of the micro channel from bar 26 to bar 28. Bar 30 was a dueling lines pattern, and bulls took profits as the market went above the two lines, creating the tail at the top. Others exited on the weak close and still others below the bar 31 two-bar reversal top.


第31根K线是一根十字星，因此是一根弱势的高1信号K线。另外，从第26根K线到第30根K线那段急速行情还不够强，不足以让人去买第二个高1（第29根K线是第一个），而且这一天是交易区间日，不是清晰的多头趋势日。空头把这看作交易区间顶部一个糟糕的高1，于是在第31根K线的高点处做空。


> Bar 31 was a doji and therefore a weak high 1 signal bar. Also, the spike from bar 26 to bar 30 was not strong enough to be buying a second high 1 (bar 29 was the first), and the day was a trading range day, not a clear bull trend day. Bears saw this as a bad high 1 at the top of a trading range and they shorted at the bar 31 high.


另一些空头在第32根空头反转K线下方做空。有些人把第30根和第31根K线看作一次两根K线反转，另一些人则忽略第31根K线，把第30根和第32根K线看作一次两根K线反转。它同时还是一个微型双顶。市场在第30根K线向上走、第31根K线向下走，然后第32根K线又向上走，接着在这根K线收盘之前向下走。市场当天还出现了三次向上推进，其中前两次是第7根和第20根K线，所以这一天是一个大三角形。第32根K线之后那根入场K线跌破了从第26根和第29根K线引出的多头趋势线（图中未画出），而在趋势线之下的第二根K线上，市场急剧抛售直到收盘。


> Other bears shorted below the bar 32 bear reversal bar. Some saw bars 30 and 31 as a two-bar reversal and others ignored bar 31 and saw bars 30 and 32 as a two-bar reversal. It was also a micro double top. The market went up on bar 30, down on bar 31, then up again on bar 32, and then down by the close of the bar. The market also made three pushes up on the day where bars 7 and 20 were the first two, so the day was a large triangle. The entry bar after bar 32 broke below the bull trend line from bars 26 and 29 (although not shown), and the market sold off sharply into the close on the second bar below the trend line.


在第10根到第16根K线之间，有很多多头三角形。由于这个形态是在涨向第7根K线那段多头急速行情的底部之上形成的，很多交易者认为，市场可能会走出一段向上的通道，至少去测试第7根K线的高点。这个交易区间里还出现了好几段多头急速行情，制造了买压，也为多头提供了证据：市场正试图形成一个更高的低点。由于这些三角形中没有一个是完全清晰的，并不是所有交易者都同意其中任何一个强到足以让市场进入始终做多的状态。第10、12、16根K线是三次向下推进，构成一个下降三角形。第13、15、16根K线同样是三次向下推进，也是一个三角形。有些交易者把它看作一个楔形牛旗。另一个楔形牛旗则由第14根K线之后两根形成的那根空头K线、第15根K线和第16根K线构成。


> There were many bull triangles between bars 10 and 16. Since the pattern was forming above the bottom of the bull spike up to bar 7, many traders thought that there might be a channel up that would test the bar 7 high at a minimum. There were also several bull spikes in this trading range, creating buying pressure and evidence for the bulls that the market was trying to form a higher low. Since none of the triangles was perfectly clear, not all traders agreed that any one was strong enough to make the market always-in long. Bars 10, 12, and 16 were three pushes down and formed a descending triangle. Bars 13, 15, and 16 were also three pushes down and a triangle. Some traders thought of it as a wedge bull flag. Another wedge bull flag was formed by the bear bar that formed two bars after bar 14, bar 15, and bar 16.


# 第 22 章　窄幅交易区间

*22. Tight Trading Ranges*


窄幅交易区间（tight trading range）是一种常见的形态，人们给它起过很多不同的名字，但没有一个词说得够贴切。它是指任何由两根或更多K线构成的横盘通道：K线之间大量重叠、反转多次、十字星很多、影线醒目，阳线实体和阴线实体都有，而且它可以延伸十几根甚至更多根K线。多数用止损单入场的交易都会以亏损告终，应当避开。如果 Emini 小型合约的日均波幅一直约为10到15个点，那么任何高度在3个点或更小的交易区间很可能就是窄幅交易区间。如果K线够大，4个点、有时5个点高的区间有时也会表现得像窄幅交易区间。


> A tight trading range is a common pattern that has been called many different things, but none of the terms is adequately descriptive. It is any sideways channel of two or more bars with lots of overlap in the bars, multiple reversals, many dojis, prominent tails, and both bull and bear bodies, and it can extend for a dozen or more bars. Most stop entries result in losses and should be avoided. If the average daily range in the Emini has been about 10 to 15 points, then any trading range that is three points tall or smaller is probably a tight trading range. A range of four and sometimes five points can sometimes behave like a tight trading range as well if the bars are large.


多头与空头势均力敌，交易者在等待一次突破，以及突破之后市场的反应。突破会继续下去——也许是在一小段回调之后继续——还是这段回调会长成一次反转，并且很快出现一次穿过交易区间另一侧的突破？市场横盘，并不等于机构大多已经停止交易。每根K线内部的成交量通常仍然很高，尽管低于此前那段趋势中的K线。多头和空头都在积极地建立新仓位，双方都想把市场推向自己一方的突破。有些交易者在反复进出剥头皮交易，另一些交易者则不断加仓，最终达到他们的最大仓位规模。最终一方获胜、另一方放弃，一段新的趋势行情段就此开始。例如，如果有一个窄幅交易区间持续了很久，而许多多头已经达到了他们不愿再超出的仓位规模，那么当市场开始测试区间底部时，已经没有足够的多头把市场重新抬到区间的中部或顶部。市场于是开始向下破位，这些无法或不愿再加大自己大仓位的多头，只能寄希望于还有别的多头拥有足够的买盘力量，能把这段空头突破反转回去。每出现一个更低的最小报价单位，就有更多多头卖出自己的多头仓位、认亏离场，而他们至少在接下来好几根K线内都不会再考虑买入。这些卖压把市场进一步压低，造成更多多头亏损卖出。随着剩下的多头放弃、卖出、等待下一个可能的底部，抛售还可能加速。这个过程在所有交易区间里都会出现，也是趋势性交易区间日里那些尾盘突破的成因之一。例如，如果出现一次向上突破，部分原因就是有太多的空头已经无法或不愿再加大自己的仓位规模，剩下的人不足以抵抗对区间顶部的下一次测试。市场突破之后，空头开始买回自己的空头仓位，并且至少在接下来好几根K线内不愿再卖出。空头不再卖出，加上他们回补空头时的买入，制造出一个一边倒的市场，逼得剩下的空头也买回自己的空头仓位。这种空头回补，加上多头的买入，往往带来一段持续时间较长的多头波段。


> The bulls and the bears are in balance, and traders are waiting for a breakout and then the market's reaction after the breakout. Will the breakout continue, maybe after a small pullback, or will the pullback grow into a reversal and soon be followed by a breakout through the opposite side of the trading range? Just because the market is sideways, do not assume that the institutions have mostly stopped trading. The volume within each bar usually remains high, although less than that of the bars of the trend that preceded it. The bulls and the bears are both aggressively initiating new trades as they both fight to create a breakout in their direction. Some traders are scalping in and out, but others are adding to their positions and eventually reach their maximum size. Eventually one side wins and the other side gives up, and a new trend leg begins. For example, if there is a tight trading range that lasts a long time and many bulls have reached a position size that they do not want to exceed, then when the market begins to test the bottom of the range, there are not enough bulls left to lift the market back to the middle or top of the range. The market then begins to break to the downside, and these bulls who cannot or will not increase the size of their large positions only hope that there are other bulls with enough buying power to reverse the bear breakout. With each new lower tick, more bulls sell out of their longs and take their losses, and they will not consider buying again for at least several more bars. This selling pushes the market down further, causing more bulls to sell out with losses. The selling can accelerate as the remaining bulls give up, sell out, and wait for another possible bottom. This process occurs in all trading ranges, and also contributes to the late breakouts in trending trading range days. For example, if there is an upside breakout, it is in part because there are too many bears who are no longer able or willing to increase the size of their positions, and not enough left to resist the next test of the top of the range. The market breaks out, and the bears begin to buy back their shorts and become unwilling to sell again for at least several bars. The lack of selling by the bears, along with their buying as they cover their shorts, creates a one-sided market that forces the remaining bears to buy back their shorts. This short covering, along with buying by the bulls, often leads to a protracted bull swing.


突破失败和反转都很常见。通常更好的做法是不在突破时入场；而是等强劲的后续行情出现后再用市价单入场，或者等一次突破回调、然后顺着趋势方向入场，又或者等一次突破失败、然后朝相反方向入场。虽然没人知道高频交易（HFT）公司的量化人员用的是什么算法，但那巨大的成交量和伴随大量反转的小幅波动，很可能就是程序反复剥头皮挣一到四个最小报价单位的产物。这些数学家甚至不需要看走势图。他们编写程序，从小幅波动中获利，而窄幅交易区间在一个聪明的程序员眼里就是完美的环境。


> Failed breakouts and reversals are common. It is usually better not to enter on the breakout; instead, wait for strong follow-through and then enter at the market, or wait for a breakout pullback and then enter in the direction of the trend, or wait for a failed breakout and then enter in the opposite direction. Although no one knows what algorithms are being used by the quants at high-frequency trading (HFT) firms, the huge volume taking place and the small moves with lots of reversals could easily be the result of programs trying to scalp one to four ticks repeatedly. The mathematicians do not need to even look at a chart. They design programs to capitalize on small movements, and a tight trading range looks like a perfect environment for a smart programmer.


窄幅交易区间里的每一次回调，都源于一次微型买入或卖出价格真空，就像所有交易区间顶部和底部附近发生的那样。许多多头和空头会想看在高点下方若干个最小报价单位处买入，另一些人则想看在前一根K线低点下方若干个最小报价单位处买入。这些交易者想买，但不想按当前价格买。空头想买回自己那些剥头皮的空头仓位，多头想建立用来剥头皮的多头仓位。当前价位上缺少这些买家，市场就被吸着往下走。价格一到他们的价位，他们就突然积极买入，造成向上反转。空头在自己的空头仓位上止盈，多头则建立多头仓位。一旦市场靠近区间顶部，这个过程就反过来：多头止盈、卖出自己的多头剥头皮仓位，空头则建立新的空头仓位。同样的过程发生在每一种通道里，无论是水平的（像窄幅交易区间）还是倾斜的（像急速行情之后的通道）。


> Every pullback in a tight trading range is due to a micro buy or sell vacuum, just as occurs near the top and bottom of all trading ranges. Many bulls and bears will look to buy at a certain number of ticks below the high, whereas others will look to buy at a certain number of ticks below the low of the prior bar. These are traders who want to buy, but not at the current price. The bears want to buy back their short scalps, and the bulls want to initiate buy scalps. The absence of these buyers at the current price causes the market to get sucked down. Once it reaches their price, they suddenly buy aggressively, causing the reversal up. The bears take profits on their shorts and the bulls initiate longs. Once the market gets near the top of the range, the process reverses. The bulls sell out of their long scalps as they take profits, and the bears initiate new shorts. This same process occurs in every type of channel, whether it is horizontal (like a tight trading range) or sloped (like a channel after a spike).


在窄幅交易区间里用止损单进出，数学期望对交易者不利；但要判断什么时候交易者等式（trader's equation）对限价单入场有利，对多数交易者来说又太难。对多数交易者来说，最好的选择就是等这次突破，然后判断它更可能成功还是失败，再去找交易机会。紧凑的通道也是如此，它不过是一个倾斜的窄幅交易区间。尽管市场大部分时间都待在通道里——无论是横盘的交易区间还是倾斜的通道——紧凑通道内的交易都格外困难。当通道或交易区间很窄时，只有那些最稳定盈利的交易者才该交易，而他们会用限价单入场。多数交易者则应当几乎只用止损单入场。既然这恰好是交易紧凑通道的反向做法，多数交易者就不该去做。他们应当干脆等一段急速行情或者一个更宽的通道出现，然后再交易。


> The math is against a trader entering and exiting on stops in a tight trading range, but determining when the trader's equation is favorable for a limit order entry is too difficult for most traders. The best choice for most traders is simply to wait for the breakout and then decide if it is likely to succeed or fail, and then to look for trades.
