Although some traders think of spikes as beginning at the high of the first bar of the spike and ending at the low of the final bar of the spike, it is usually more reliable to look only at the bodies of the bars instead of the tails. If a measured move down goes beyond one based on the open of the first bar to the close of the last bar, then traders should look at how the market behaves at a measured move based on the high of the first bar to the low of the last bar.


在图 25.1左边的图中，当急速行情还只是单独一根空头趋势K线、实体有五个最小报价单位高时，这波下跌的预估目标位是那根K线收盘价下方五个最小报价单位处。


> In the chart on the left in Figure 25.1, when the spike was just a single bear trend bar that had a body that was five ticks tall, the projected target for the move down was five ticks below the close of that bar.


在右边的图中，急速行情已经长到四根K线，第一根K线的开盘价比最后一根K线收盘价高了19个最小报价单位。此时预估目标位就是最后一根K线收盘价下方19个最小报价单位处。如果你在急速行情刚刚形成时早早买入，尽管你的风险保持不变（因为你的止损一直留在急速行情第一根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处），你的潜在回报却随着等距运动目标不断下移而增加。在市场出现一两根大型空头趋势K线之后，你可以把风险降到保本，甚至可以把保护性止损移到其中一根K线的高点正上方。如果你这样做了，你就能锁定至少一点小利润，同时还处在一个能赚到大利润的有利位置上。


> In the chart on the right, the spike had grown to four bars, and the open of the first bar was 19 ticks above the close of the final bar. The projected target was then 19 ticks below the close of the final bar. If you bought early on as the spike was just forming, even though your risk remained constant since your stop stayed at one tick above the high of the first bar of the spike, your potential reward increased as the measured move target continued to fall. You could reduce your risk to breakeven after the market had one or two large bear trend bars, or even move your protective stop to just above the high of one of those bars. If you did, you would be locking in at least a small profit while still being in a good position to make a large profit.


![图 25.2](figures/fig-25-02.jpg)


**图 25.2　寻找概率短暂升高的时刻**


虽然等距上涨或下跌的方向概率通常徘徊在50%左右，但一天之中它会很多次短暂地升高，交易者应该在这些时刻寻找交易机会。如图 25.2所示，在强劲的三根K线空头急速下跌到第15根K线的过程中，任何时候做空也许都有70%的机会，市场会先下跌X个点，然后再上涨同样的幅度。不那么明显的是第20根K线处的底部。当天是一个趋势性交易区间日，第9根K线低点到第11根K线高点之间的上方区间大约有四个点。由于下方区间通常会测试第9根K线突破点，而且底部区间的高度很可能与上方交易区间相同，所以在第9根K线下方四个点或更低处买入，也许有60%的机会在打到下方四个点的止损之前先带来一波四个点的上涨行情。在第15、16、17根K线、第19根K线之后那根K线，以及第20根K线处反复出现的多头反转K线之后，概率也许已经高达70%。空头反复试图把市场打压到昨收价下方，但都失败了。每一次这样的尝试都代表买压，而这些买压是累积的。一旦它达到一个临界质量，多头就会接管。在最初的三四次触底尝试之后，你可以用限价单在第9根K线下方四个点处买入，冒四个点的风险，并挂一张在上涨四个点处止盈的 OCO 限价单。


> Although the directional probability of an equidistant move up or down is usually around 50 percent, it is briefly higher many times during the day, and traders should look for trades when that happens. As shown in Figure 25.2, shorting anytime during the strong three-bar bear spike down to bar 15 had maybe a 70 percent chance that the market would fall X more points before rallying that same amount. Less obvious was the bottom at bar 20. The day was a trending trading range day, and the upper range between the bar 9 low and the bar 11 high was about four points. Since the lower range usually tests the bar 9 breakout point and the bottom range would likely be about the same height as the upper trading range, buying four or more points below bar 9 had perhaps a 60 percent chance of leading to a four-point rally before hitting a stop four points below. After the repeated bull reversal bars at bars 15, 16, 17, the bar after bar 19, and bar 20, the probability may have been as high as 70 percent. The bears made repeated attempts to push the market below yesterday's close and were failing. Each of these attempts represented buying pressure, which was cumulative. Once it reached a critical mass, the bulls would take over. After the first three or four bottom attempts, you could buy on a limit order at four points below bar 9, risk four points, and have an OCO limit order to take profits four points higher.


在第14根K线下方做空只有大约50%的机会带来一笔好的波段交易，因为它处在窄幅交易区间中，无论向哪个方向做波段，概率都只有大约50%。这个建仓形态是第11根K线处两根K线空头急速行情之后的一个小楔形熊旗和更低的高点。当天早盘有强劲的卖出，所以向下突破的概率也许比50%略微高一点。风险不到两个点，而回报是某种等距运动下跌的幅度，比如也许是以第3根K线到第9根K线的行情为基础的“第1段行情 = 第2段行情”运动，或者以第5根K线到第9根K线交易区间的高度为基础。无论是哪一种，交易者都有大约50%的机会赚到大约四个点，同时冒大约两个点的风险，这就构成了一个稳妥的交易者等式。一旦市场以强劲的空头急速行情向下突破到第15根K线，交易者就把一部分仓位持有到以第14根K线到第15根K线空头急速行情高度为基础的一段等距运动下跌。


> Shorting below bar 14 had only about a 50 percent chance of leading to a good swing trade, because it was in a tight trading range where the probability of a swing in either direction was only about 50 percent. The setup was a small wedge bear flag and a lower high after the two-bar bear spike at bar 11. There was strong selling earlier in the day, so maybe the probability of the downside breakout was slightly higher than 50 percent. The risk was less than two points, and the reward was the size of some kind of measured move down, like maybe a leg 1 = leg 2 move based on the move from bar 3 to bar 9, or the height of the bar 5 to bar 9 trading range. In either case, a trader had about a 50 percent chance of making about four points while risking about two points, which yields a sound trader's equation. Once the market broke out in the strong bear spike down to bar 15, traders held some of their positions for a measured move down based on the height of the bar 14 to bar 15 bear spike.


这是一个趋势性交易区间日，它很好地说明了为什么关注当天正在演变成哪一种日子是明智的。当天前一半时间的交易区间大约只有平均日波动幅度的一半大小。当头一个小时或两个小时之后出现突破时，市场通常会走到大约一段等距运动下跌处，然后在开始形成更低交易区间时反弹。理解这一点的交易者在第16根到第20根K线之间买入时更有信心，许多交易者在前一个最近的摆动低点处或下方用限价单买入。这就是为什么下面有那么多带着下影线的K线。举例来说，在第19根K线处反弹之后，激进的交易者把限价单或市价单挂在第19根K线低点处、略低于它或略高于它的位置买入。他们在第20根K线处做多，并持有到测试上方交易区间的底部、也就是第9根K线低点。许多人大概会使用大约相当于近期平均K线那么多最小报价单位的保护性止损。


> This was a trending trading range day, and it is a good example of why it was wise to pay attention to what type of day is unfolding. The trading range of the first half of the day was about half of the size of an average daily range. When a breakout occurs after the first hour or two, the market usually reaches about a measured move down and then bounces as it begins to form a lower trading range. Traders who understood this were more confident about buying between bars 16 and 20, and many traders were buying on limit orders at or below the most recent swing lows. That is why there were so many bars with tails down there. For example, after the bounce up at bar 19, aggressive traders placed limit or market orders to buy at, just below, or just above the bar 19 low. They went long at bar 20 and held for a test of the bottom to the upper trading range at the bar 9 low. Many would have used a protective stop that was about the same number of ticks as there were in the average recent bar.


市场从第16根K线到第18根K线之前那根K线开始形成强劲的多头K线之后，买压已经强到足以让交易者预期市场会去测试第9根K线下方的那次突破。他们把最近的价格与第9根K线低点之间的空间看作一个缺口，并预期它会补掉。第18根K线处它已经进入三个最小报价单位之内，但交易者通常预期测试会进入两个最小报价单位之内。由于今天市场已经积累了如此多的买压，大多数交易者相信市场会涨到第9根K线低点上方。有些人在限价单上做多，位置大约在第9根K线低点下方一段等距运动处，这是按第9根K线低点到第11根K线高点的交易区间高度测算的（大约有四个点）。其他人开始在前一根K线的低点下方或更早的低点下方买入，比如当市场跌破第19根K线低点时。这些交易者也许用了与回报相等的风险，预期成功概率大约有60%。


> Once the market began to develop strong bull bars from bar 16 to the bar before bar 18, the buying pressure was strong enough for traders to expect a test of the breakout below bar 9. They saw the space between the most recent tick and the bar 9 low as a gap and expected it to fill. It came to within three ticks on bar 18, but traders usually expect a test to come to within two ticks or less. With the market having had as much buying pressure as it had today, most traders believed that the market would trade above the bar 9 low. Some bought on limit orders at about a measured move down from the bar 9 low, based on the height of the trading range from the bar 9 low to the bar 11 high (it was about four points). Others began to buy below the low of the prior bar or below prior lows, like when the market fell below the bar 19 low. These traders might have used a risk equal to their reward, expecting about a 60 percent chance of success.


如果那波空头突破非常强，交易者会反向操作。他们会在空头急速行情底部一带做空，把风险放到急速行情上方，相信有大约60%的机会达到与风险相等的回报。举例来说，有些人在第15根K线收盘价附近做空，并预期有大约60%的机会赚到与他们必须承担的风险一样多的最小报价单位（从第14根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位到他们的入场价，大约四个点）。一旦市场开始在他们止盈限价单上方好几个最小报价单位处形成买压，他们就不再认为自己原来的判断成立。即使他们把保护性止损收紧，他们也不愿意在面对买压时冒两三个点的风险去赚那剩下的一个点；他们开始买回空头，进一步增加买压。既然这些空头刚刚在一笔比他们预期更弱的空头交易中出场，他们就不愿意在再上涨好几根K线之前再次做空。他们只会在更高的价位考虑做空，比如也许在第9根K线低点处，如果那里有一个合理的卖出建仓形态的话。到那时，市场正处于一个窄幅多头通道中，而且很可能继续走高，所以在那里做空的空头数量不足以让市场转头向下，这便导致了直到第23根K线的那个窄幅多头通道，在那里市场被吸上去测试第12根K线低点。


> Had the bear breakout been very strong, traders would have done the opposite. They would have shorted in the area of the bottom of the bear spike and risked to above the spike, believing that there was about a 60 percent chance of reaching a reward equal to their risk. For example, some shorted around the bar 15 close and expected about a 60 percent chance of making as many ticks as they had to risk (one tick above the bar 14 high down to their entry price, or about four points). Once the market began to develop buying pressure several ticks above their profit-taking limit orders, they no longer saw their premise as valid. Even though they tightened their protective stops, they were not willing to risk two to three points to make that remaining point in the face of the buying pressure; they began to buy back their shorts, adding to the buying pressure. Since these bears just exited on a short trade that ended up weaker than they had expected, they would not have been willing to short again until after several more bars up. They would have considered shorting only at higher prices, like maybe at the bar 9 low, if there was a reasonable sell setup. At that point, the market was in a tight bull channel and likely to go higher, so not enough bears shorted there to turn the market down, and this led to the tight bull channel up to bar 23, where the market was vacuumed up to test the bar 12 low.


剥头皮交易者需要高概率的交易才能拥有正的交易者等式，因为他的回报往往与风险大小相当。然而，有些趋势会在多头通道顶部出现一连串弱势的买入建仓形态（或者在空头通道底部出现一连串弱势的卖出建仓形态），因此成功概率很低。许多波段交易者仍然会做这些交易，并且常常赚到风险的好几倍，但大多数剥头皮交易者往往会错过那些能持续10根K线以上、覆盖许多点的趋势。举例来说，剥头皮交易者可能不会在第21根K线之后那根空头十字星上方买入，也不会在第22根K线之后那根空头反转K线上方买入，结果发现自己错过了直到第23根K线的那段上涨行情。对一个看着趋势一路上涨却没有高概率回调的初学交易者来说，这很令人沮丧，但这是一个在数学上稳妥的决定。随着经验积累，他会看到有些高概率的建仓形态本可以抓住，比如买入第21根到第22根K线之间两根多头趋势K线中任意一根的收盘价，或者在第22根K线低点处买入，因为那次回调是一个强劲多头微型通道中的第一次回调。每个月都有几天，多头通道顶部的一个低概率买入建仓形态、或者空头通道底部的一个弱势卖出建仓形态，能带来巨大的趋势，而波段交易者赚到的利润足够大，足以抵消他们在其他大多数类似交易上的亏损。他们也做许多别的交易，其中一些有很高的成功概率。


> A scalper needs high probability trades to have a positive trader's equation, because his reward is often about the same size as his risk. However, some trends will have a series of weak buy setups at the top of bull channels (or weak sell setups at the bottom of bear channels) and therefore low probabilities of success. Many swing traders will still take the trades and often make many times their risk, but most scalpers will often miss trends that can last for 10 or more bars and cover many points. For example, a scalper might not buy above the bear doji that followed bar 21 or the bear reversal bar after bar 22, and find himself missing the rally up to bar 23. This can be frustrating to a beginning trader who watches the trend move up without a high probability pullback, but it is a mathematically sound decision. With experience, he will see that there were some high probability setups that he could have taken, like buying the close of either of the bull trend bars between bars 21 and 22, or buying at the bar 22 low, since the pullback was the first in a strong bull micro channel. There are a couple of days each month where a low probability buy setup at the top of a bull channel or a weak sell setup at the bottom of a bear channel can lead to a huge trend, and swing traders make big enough profits to offset the losses that they have on the majority of their other similar trades. They take many other trades as well, and some have a high probability of success.


剥头皮交易者的止损比止盈目标还大，他能盈利吗？可以，但这需要交易管理，大多数交易者不应该尝试。举例来说，如果他使用一个点的止盈目标和两个点的止损，而市场快速让他的止盈限价单成交、期间没有任何回调，那么他实际上只冒了几个最小报价单位的风险就赚了四个。如果市场在朝他方向走之前回调了七个最小报价单位，那么他就必须冒八个最小报价单位的风险，此时他会把止盈目标至少提高到他所需要的八个最小报价单位，以拥有一个盈利的交易者等式，因为概率很可能仍然在60%左右。


> Can a scalper make a profit with a stop larger than his target? Yes, but it requires trade management and most traders should not try it. For example, if he uses a one-point profit target and a two-point stop, and the market quickly fills his profit-taking limit order without any pullback, he actually risked only a couple of ticks to make four. If the market pulled back seven ticks before going his way, he then had to risk eight ticks and would then increase his profit target to at least the eight ticks he would need to have a profitable trader's equation, because the probability would likely still be around 60 percent.


![图 25.3](figures/fig-25-03.jpg)


**图 25.3　当建仓形态不是高概率时，剥头皮交易者往往会错过趋势**


剥头皮交易者的回报通常大约等于风险，这要求建仓形态的成功概率至少有60%。在一些趋势日里，许多建仓形态看起来不够可靠，结果就是剥头皮交易者往往错过那些能持续10根K线以上、覆盖许多点的趋势。另一方面，波段交易者可以坦然接受成功机会只有40%或更低、但回报是风险好多倍的建仓形态。


> Scalpers usually have a reward that is about equal to their risk, and this requires the setups to have at least a 60 percent probability of success. On some trend days, many of the setups don't look reliable enough, and the result is that scalpers often miss trends that can last 10 or more bars and cover many points. Swing traders, on the other hand, can be comfortable with setups that have a chance of success that is only 40 percent or less when the reward is many times larger than the risk.


从第18根K线开始的那段下跌行情中的几个建仓形态，在许多剥头皮交易者眼里也许都没有60%的成功机会，那些剥头皮交易者会错过这轮大幅空头趋势的大部分。许多人可能会选择在第18根到第25根K线之间的两个小时里少做交易或完全不做。波段交易者则可能在第18根K线的均线缺口K线、第21根K线的两根K线反转和更低的高点、或者第28根K线的双顶更低的高点和熊旗下方做空，赚到的点数足以弥补他们相对较低的成功概率。他们可以在第31根K线下方加仓，尽管那根K线有阳线实体，而且是楔形做多的入场K线（第13根K线、第25根K线和第31根K线之前那根小十字星是三次向下推进）。它是空头趋势中一个六根K线空头微型通道里的第一次回调，顶部带有一条很长的影线，增加了市场会下跌的机会。这次波段的概率仍然相对较低，但潜在回报非常大，因为市场可能正在向下跌破一个楔形底部、可能下跌大约一段等距运动，而市场也确实这样走了。


> Several of the setups in the move down from bar 18 probably did not have a 60 percent chance of success in the eyes of a lot of scalpers, and those scalpers would have missed most of the huge bear trend. Many would have chosen to trade little or not at all in the two hours between bars 18 and 25. Swing traders could have shorted below the bar 18 moving average gap bar, the bar 21 two-bar reversal and lower high, or the bar 28 double top lower high and bear flag, and made more than enough points to offset their relatively low probability of success. They could have added on below bar 31, even though it had a bull body and was the entry bar for a wedge long (bars 13, 25, and the small doji before bar 31 were the three pushes down). It was the first pullback in a six-bar bear micro channel in a bear trend, and it had a prominent tail on the top, increasing the chances that the market would trade down. The probability of the swing was still relatively low, but the potential reward was very large, because the market might have been breaking below a wedge bottom and could fall for about a measured move down, which it did.


大多数剥头皮交易者不会在第18根K线下方做空，因为它有阳线实体，而且处在一个窄幅多头通道中。虽然下一根K线是阴线实体并因此形成了两根K线反转，但它有一条很长的影线，使它成为一个概率较低的信号，尤其是在一段处在窄幅多头通道中的强劲上涨行情之后。


> Most scalpers would not have shorted below bar 18 because it had a bull body and was in a tight bull channel. Although the next bar had a bear body and therefore created a two-bar reversal, it had a prominent tail, making it a lower probability signal, especially after a strong rally that was in a tight bull channel.


虽然第21根K线是一个更低的高点，但在当天那个时点，大多数交易者都在寻找第13根K线强势卖出高潮之后的第二段上涨行情，所以许多剥头皮交易者会犹豫是否在三角形（第16根和第20根K线是前两次向下推进，第21根K线之后那根十字星K线也许会成为第三次）或交易区间的底部下方做空，而那始终是一笔概率相对较低的交易。


> Although bar 21 was a lower high, at that point in the day, most traders were looking for a second leg up after the strong bar 13 sell climax, so many scalpers would have been hesitant to short below the bottom of a triangle (bars 16 and 20 were the first two pushes down, and the doji bar after bar 21 might have become the third) or trading range, which is always a relatively low probability trade.


第22根K线是一次突破回调做空，但它前面跟着一根小十字星，那根十字星可能是第二段上涨行情的起点，所以许多剥头皮交易者不会在一个可能很快成为第二段上涨行情底部的位置下方做空。


> Bar 22 was a breakout pullback short but it followed a small doji, which might have been the start of the second leg up, so many scalpers would not have shorted at the bottom of what could have soon been the bottom of the second leg up.


从第23根到第25根K线的所有空头K线都有很长的影线，这说明交易者在这些K线的低点处买入，因此这个通道是弱的。剥头皮交易者不喜欢在弱势空头通道的底部做空。


> All of the bear bars from bar 23 to bar 25 had prominent tails, which meant that traders were buying at the lows of the bars, and therefore the channel was weak. Scalpers don't like to short at the bottom of a weak bear channel.


从可能的第25根K线更低低点和抛物线通道底部（在下跌至第13根K线的三根K线空头急速行情之后，以及第20根K线和第21根K线之后第二根K线处更小的急速行情）到第26根K线的这段上涨，有四根阳线实体，其中包含一根大型多头趋势K线。它强到足以让许多交易者认为市场已经翻转为始终做多，并倾向于寻找做多的建仓形态，而不是做空。第27根K线是一根强劲的多头反转K线和两段式更高的低点。概率偏向更多横向或向上的交易。第28根K线有阳线实体，因此不是一根强势的卖出信号K线。下一根K线有阴线实体，因此形成了两根K线反转，但它的低点远低于第28根K线低点，使剥头皮交易者不愿意做空，因为与第27根K线低点形成双底的风险太大。


> The move up from the possible bar 25 lower low and bottom of the parabolic channel (after the three-bar bear spike down to bar 13, and the smaller spikes at bar 20 and two bars after bar 21) to bar 26 had four bull bodies, including a large bull trend bar. It was strong enough for many traders to see the market as having flipped to always in long, and be inclined to look for long setups, not shorts. Bar 27 was a strong bull reversal bar and two-legged higher low. The odds favored more sideways or up trading. Bar 28 had a bull body and was therefore not a strong sell signal bar. The next bar had a bear body and therefore created a two-bar reversal, but its low was far enough below the bar 28 low to make scalpers unwilling to short because there was too much risk of a double bottom with the bar 27 low.


一旦市场出现强劲的向下突破到第29根K线，剥头皮交易者也许已经在其收盘价、或下一根K线的收盘价做空，后者确认了始终入场状态翻转为做空。


> Once the market had the strong breakout down to bar 29, scalpers might have shorted its close, or the close of the next bar, which confirmed the always-in flip to down.


第31根K线是一次突破回调，但有阳线实体和很长的影线，这让剥头皮交易者怀疑市场可能正在进入一个小型交易区间。概率大到足以让许多人不在其低点下方做空，但有些人还是会。他们也可能在它涨到十字星K线上方时以及收盘时做空，因为顶部出现了长影线，显示卖压。尽管对剥头皮交易者来说建仓形态都很困难，尤其是第18根K线高点之后做空，但仍然有大量高概率的机会让他们赚钱。他们可以在第2根、第4根、第6根、第12根K线下方做空，也许还有第21根K线（有些人不会做这次做空）；他们也可以在第6根之后那根K线的收盘价、第12根之后那根K线、第29根、第30根、第31根以及第31根之后那根K线处做空；他们还可以在第1根、第17根、第20根之后那根K线、第22根之前那根K线，以及第30根之后那根K线上方的限价单上做空。他们可以在第3根K线、第5根K线、第13根K线之后那根K线、第25根K线之后那根K线的收盘价或再后面那根K线，以及第27根K线上方买入。


> Bar 31 was a breakout pullback, but had a bull body and prominent tails, which made scalpers suspect that the market might be entering a small trading range. The probability was great enough to make many not short below its low, but some would have. They also might have shorted as it moved above the doji bar and on the close, once they saw the large tail on the top, signifying selling pressure. With all of the difficult setups for scalpers, especially for shorting after the bar 18 high, there were still plenty of high probability opportunities for them to make money. They could have shorted below bars 2, 4, 6, 12, and maybe 21 (some would not have taken this short), and they could have shorted the closes of the bar after bar 6, the bar after bar 12, bar 29, bar 30, bar 31 and the bar after, and on limit orders above bar 1, bar 17, the bar after bar 20, the bar before bar 22, and the bar after bar 30. They could have bought above bar 3, bar 5, the bar after bar 13, the close of the bar after bar 25 or the bar after that, and above bar 27.


# 第 26 章　下单需要两个理由

*26. Need Two Reasons to Take a Trade*


有些基本规则能让交易变得更容易，因为一旦某条规则得到满足，你就可以毫不犹豫地行动。最重要的规则之一是：下单需要两个理由，而任何两个理由都足够。理由齐了，就下单入场；一旦入场，只需遵守基本的止盈目标和保护性止损规则，并相信到收盘时你会是盈利的。有一点很重要：如果趋势很陡，永远不要逆势交易，即使那里出现了高2或高4、低2或低4——除非此前先有一次重要的趋势线突破，或者趋势通道线过靶后的反转。另外，与只是横向漂移相比，趋势线突破若能带有强劲动能则要好得多。记住，数K线建仓形态并不是趋势反转形态。例如，高2是多头趋势中或交易区间底部的入场，而不是空头趋势中的入场，所以如果空头趋势很陡，你就不该去找高2、高3或高4的买入建仓形态。要学会预判交易，这样你才能准备好下单。例如，如果市场向下跌破了一个主要摆动低点、随后走出两段下跌行情，或者出现趋势通道线过靶，就去找向上的反转；或者，如果某个过度延伸的行情段中出现ii形态突破，就去找反转。一旦看到外包K线或铁丝网形态，就在其极值处找一根小K线，看看能否反向操作。如果是强趋势，就要为第一次回撤到移动平均线、任何一次回撤到移动平均线的两段式回调，以及第一次均线缺口回调做好准备。


> Some basic rules make trading easier because once a rule is satisfied, you can act without hesitation. One of the most important rules is that you need two reasons to take a trade, and any two reasons are good enough. Once you have them, place your order to enter, and once in, just follow basic profit target and protective stop-loss rules, trusting that you will be profitable by the end of the day. One important note is that if there is a steep trend, never trade countertrend, even if there is a high or low 2 or 4, unless there was first a prior significant trend line break or trend channel overshoot and reversal. Also, it is far better if the trend line break had strong momentum instead of just a sideways drift. Remember that bar counting setups are not trend reversal patterns. For example, a high 2 is an entry in a bull trend or at the bottom of a trading range and not in a bear trend, so if there is a steep bear trend, you should not be looking for high 2, high 3, or high 4 buy setups. Learn to anticipate trades so that you will be ready to place your orders. For example, if there is a break below a major swing low and then two legs down, or an overshoot of a trend channel line, look for a reversal up; or if there is an ii breakout in an overdone leg, look for a reversal. Once you see an outside bar or a barbwire pattern, look for a small bar at the extreme for a possible fade trade. If there is a strong trend, be ready for the first moving average pullback, for any two-legged pullbacks to the moving average, and for the first moving average gap pullback.


只有少数几种情形，你下单只需要一个理由。第一，任何时候只要是强趋势，每一次并非出现在高潮反转或末端旗形反转之后的回调，都必须入场——哪怕这次回调只是强多头急速行情中的高1、或强空头急速行情中的低1。另外，如果出现了趋势线过靶加上一根好的反转K线，你可以反向操作这段行情，并预期原来的趋势会恢复。除此之外，下单只需要一个理由的情形只有一种：出现二次入场时，无论当时处在交易区间还是趋势中。因为按定义此前已经有过一次入场，所以第二次入场本身就是第二个理由。


> There are only a few situations in which you need only one reason to enter a trade. First, anytime there is a strong trend, you must enter on every pullback that does not follow a climax or final flag reversal, even if the pullback is just a high 1 in a strong bull spike or a low 1 in a strong bear spike. Also, if there was a trend line overshoot and a good reversal bar, you can fade the move and expect the trend to resume. The only other time that only one reason is needed to enter a trade, whether in a trading range or in a trend, is when there is a second entry. By definition there was a first entry, so the second entry is the second reason.


下面是可以用来下单的一些理由（记住，你需要两个或更多）：


> Here are some possible reasons for entering a trade (remember, you need two or more):


- 好的信号K线形态，比如一根好的反转K线、两K线反转，或者一个ii形态。
- 趋势中回撤到移动平均线，尤其是两段式的回调（多头趋势中的高2，或空头趋势中的低2）。
- 突破回调。
- 处于明确始终入场状态的市场（强趋势）中的回调。
- 对任何类型的支撑或阻力的测试，尤其是趋势线、趋势通道线、突破回测和等距运动目标位。
- 决斗线。
- 多头趋势中或交易区间底部的高2买入建仓形态（每当你看到双底，那都是一个高2买入建仓形态）。
- 空头趋势中或交易区间顶部的低2卖出建仓形态（每个双顶都是一个低2卖出建仓形态）。
- 大多数多头反转（底部）来自微型双底、双底，或者末端熊旗反转。


> • Good signal bar pattern, like a good reversal bar, a two-bar reversal, or an ii. • Moving average pullback in a trend, especially if two-legged (a high 2 in a bull trend or a low 2 in a bear trend). • Breakout pullback. • Pullback in a clearly always-in market (a strong trend). • Test of any kind of support or resistance, but especially trend lines, trend channel lines, breakout tests, and measured move targets. • Dueling lines. • High 2 buy setup in a bull trend or at the bottom of a trading range (whenever you see a double bottom, it is a high 2 buy setup). • Low 2 sell setup in a bear trend or at the top of a trading range (every double top is a low 2 sell setup). • Most bull reversals (bottoms) come from micro double bottoms, double bottoms, or final bear flag reversals.


- 大多数空头反转（顶部）来自微型双顶、双顶，或者末端牛旗反转。
- 多头趋势中横盘到向下的高3回调，这属于楔形牛旗。
- 空头趋势中横盘到向上的低3回调，这属于楔形熊旗。
- 高4牛旗。
- 低4熊旗。
- 当你想做空时，交易区间顶部出现疲弱的高1或高2信号K线。
- 当你想做多时，交易区间底部出现疲弱的低1或低2信号K线。
- 任何东西的失败（市场在走出预期幅度之前就反转了）：


> • Most bear reversals (tops) come from micro double tops, double tops, or final bull flag reversals. • Sideways to down high 3 pullback in a bull trend, which is a wedge bull flag. • Sideways to up low 3 pullback in a bear trend, which is a wedge bear flag. • High 4 bull flag. • Low 4 bear flag. • Weak high 1 or high 2 signal bar at the top of a trading range when you are looking for a short. • Weak low 1 or low 2 signal bar at the bottom of a trading range when you are looking to buy. • Failure of anything (the market reverses before going as far as expected):


- 对前一个高点或低点的突破。
- 旗形突破（末端旗形在第3本书中讨论）。
- 从趋势线或趋势通道线过靶处发生的反转。
- 未能到达止盈目标，比如 Emini 小型合约剥头皮时市场在五个或九个最小报价单位处反转。


> • A breakout of a prior high or low. • A flag breakout (final flags are discussed in book 3). • A reversal from an overshoot of a trend line or a trend channel line. • A failure to reach a profit target, like the market reversing at five or nine ticks in an Emini scalp.


![图 26.1](figures/fig-26-01.jpg)


**图 26.1　下单至少要有两个理由**


如图 26.1所示，第2根K线是强多头趋势中一次回撤到移动平均线的两段式回调（每个双底都是高2买入建仓形态），这一个理由就足够做多。另一个理由是：在一个大幅跳空高开、从开盘即启动的多头趋势中，这是20多根K线以来第一次触及移动平均线。它还是第一次像样的趋势线突破，所以市场对该高点的一次测试是预期之中的。


> As shown in Figure 26.1, bar 2 was a two-legged pullback to the moving average (every double bottom is a high 2 buy setup) in a strong bull trend and was reason enough to go long. Another reason was that it was the first moving average touch in more than 20 bars in a trend from the open bull trend with a big gap up. It was also the first good trend line break, so a test of the high was expected.


第3根K线出现在两次向上突破第1根K线的尝试都失败之后。那里的建仓形态是一个ii形态，其中第二根K线是空头收盘。它同时也是正在成形的交易区间中的低2，而涨向第1根K线的那段行情是向上行进的第一段。


> Bar 3 followed the second failed attempt to break above bar 1. There was an ii setup with the second bar having a bear close. It was also a low 2 in a developing trading range, where the move up to bar 1 was the first leg up.


第5根K线是强劲的三根K线空头急速行情之后，空头波段中回撤到移动平均线处的低2。在强劲急速行情之后，市场很可能进入一段空头通道。


> Bar 5 was a low 2 at the moving average in a bear swing after a strong three-bar bear spike. The market was likely to have a bear channel after the strong spike.


第6根K线是一次空头趋势通道线过靶后的反转，同时也是对头一个小时窄幅交易区间（一个三角形）的突破回测。不过，它处在一条持续三小时的空头通道的底部，而通道可以延伸得非常远，途中会有很多次回调。几乎总是更好的做法是：等到通道出现一次突破回调之后再去做逆势交易。那第二次入场出现在第7根K线那个更高的低点处，它是向上突破第5根K线引出的下降趋势线（未画出）之后走出的一次回调。


> Bar 6 was a bear trend channel line overshoot and reversal and a breakout test of the tight trading range (a triangle) of the first hour. However, it was at the bottom of a three-hour bear channel, and channels can go very far and have many pullbacks along the way. It is almost always better to wait for a breakout pullback from the channel before taking a counter-trend trade. That second entry came at the bar 7 higher low, which was a pullback after breaking above the trend line down from bar 5 (not shown).


虽然第6根K线是一根反转K线，但它的收盘价仅勉强位于中点之上，因此是一根疲弱的信号K线。


> Although bar 6 was a reversal bar, its close was barely above the midpoint and was therefore a weak signal bar.


![图 26.2](figures/fig-26-02.jpg)


**图 26.2　扩张三角形**


如图 26.2所示，昨天收盘时行情急速上冲到第4根K线，完成了一个正在成形的扩张三角形的四段行情，而这个形态还差一个新低才能完成。如果你意识到了这种可能性，就会在跌破第3根K线之后去寻找做多的入场点。第5根K线跌破了第3根K线，完成了扩张三角形的底部，此时你只需等待一个入场建仓形态，它就在第6根K线那组两K线反转（同时也是一个小幅更高的低点）的高点上方一个最小报价单位处。


> As shown in Figure 26.2, yesterday closed with a surge to bar 4, completing four legs of a developing expanding triangle, which needed one more new low to complete. If you were aware of that possibility, you would have looked for a long entry after a break below bar 3. Bar 5 dropped below bar 3, completing the expanding triangle bottom, and you just had to wait for an entry setup, which was one tick above the high of the bar 6 two-bar reversal and small higher low.


![图 26.3](figures/fig-26-03.jpg)


**图 26.3　下单的两个理由**


如图 26.3所示，第1根K线是在测试昨天高点之后出现的二次入场做空点。此前的上涨很强劲，因此等二次入场更好。交易者可以在行情跌破前一根K线的低点、使其变成外包下跌K线时做空，也可以在两K线之前那根空头K线的低点下方做空。一般说来，在一根强劲空头K线的下方做空总是更可靠。


> As shown in Figure 26.3, bar 1 was a second-entry short following a test of yesterday's high. The run-up was strong, and therefore it was better to wait for the second entry. Traders could have shorted as the bar fell below the low of the prior bar and became an outside down bar, or they could have shorted below the low of the bear bar from two bars earlier. In general, it is always more reliable to short below a strong bear bar.


第2根K线是一根大型内包十字星K线之后的高2，但下跌动能很强。当强劲空头急速行情之后跟着一条窄幅空头通道时，更好的做法是先等一次趋势线突破，然后再买入。同样地，第3根K线是一个糟糕的第二次做多入场，因为它前面是一根强劲的空头趋势K线，而在考虑买进之前，你本应一直等待空头趋势线被突破。


> Bar 2 was a high 2 following a large inside doji bar, but the down momentum was strong. When there is a tight bear channel after a strong bear spike, it is better to wait for a trend line break before buying. Likewise, bar 3 was a bad second long entry because it followed a strong bear trend bar, and you should have still been waiting for a bear trend line break before looking to buy.


第4根K线是回撤到移动平均线处的低2，但它前面有四根几乎完全重叠的K线。像这样的窄幅交易区间里，在两个方向上都绝不应该入场，除非出现下列事件之一：一根大型趋势K线向形态之外突破至少三个最小报价单位，而且你已经等到那根K线失败之后；或者在交易区间顶部或底部附近有一根可以反向操作的小K线。这里是一个两K线反转，它至少与另一根K线重叠，而且信号K线很大，逼得交易者只能在交易区间的底部做空。正如第1本书中讨论反转K线的第5章所述，这很可能是一个空头陷阱，而不是顺势建仓形态。有经验的交易者不会在那里做空，而激进的交易者会在它的低点处挂限价单买入。


> Bar 4 was a low 2 at the moving average, but it followed four bars that almost entirely overlapped. In a tight trading range like this, you should never enter in either direction until after either one of the following events: a large trend bar breaks out of the pattern by at least three ticks and you have waited for that bar to fail, or there is a small bar that you can fade near the top or bottom of the trading range. This was a two-bar reversal that overlapped at least one other bar, and the signal bar was large, forcing traders to short at the bottom of the trading range. As is discussed in book 1 in Chapter 5 on reversal bars, this was a likely bear trap and not a with-trend setup. Experienced traders would not have shorted there, and aggressive traders would have placed limit orders to buy at its low.


许多这种只有一个最小报价单位的假突破——比如第2根K线和第3根K线处的那些——都发生在逆势的5分钟入场K线的头一两分钟之内。发生在K线最后一分钟里的突破往往更可靠，因为此时动能就在K线末端。它延续到下一根K线的几率，比发生在四分钟之前、此后已经回调过的情况要大。


> Many of these one-tick false breakouts like those at bars 2 and 3 occur in the first minute or two of a countertrend 5 minute entry bar. Breakouts that occur in the final minute of the bar tend to be more reliable because you then have momentum right at the end of the bar. The chances of it continuing into the next bar are greater than if it had occurred four minutes earlier and has since pulled back.


交易低概率的交易，抹掉的会比你全部盈利还多。


> Trading low-probability trades will wipe out more than all of your gains.


![图 26.4](figures/fig-26-04.jpg)


**图 26.4　回撤到移动平均线的做空**


当一只股票处于强趋势中时，在头几次测试移动平均线时用限价单入场是合理的，或者你也可以在1分钟图上，按价格行为止损单的方式在移动平均线处入场。在图 26.4中，5分钟图是那张较小的图，而1分钟图上的移动平均线就是5分钟移动平均线，只是画在了1分钟图上。在 AAPL 的第1根K线和第2根K线处，按1分钟图、在5分钟移动平均线处做第二次入场，风险约为25美分；而按5分钟图（插入图）做价格行为入场，风险约为45美分。你也可以在第一次收于移动平均线上方的5分钟K线收盘时以市价做空，并使用约20美分的止损。此处，在5分钟图的第1根K线和第2根K线处，市场只上涨到收盘价上方4美分便反转向下。一般说来，更好的做法要么是等1分钟图上的第二次入场，要么是沿用传统的5分钟价格行为入场（在一根测试指数移动平均线的K线下方挂止损单），因为其它方法几乎没有什么额外好处，只会牵涉更多思考，而那些思考可能让你从更高级别走势图（比如5分钟图）上的主要交易中分心。


> When a stock is in a strong trend, it is reasonable to enter on a limit order on the first couple of tests of the moving average, or you can enter on the 1 minute chart with a price action stop entry at the moving average. In Figure 26.4, the 5 minute chart is the smaller chart, and the moving average on the 1 minute chart is the 5 minute moving average, but plotted on the 1 minute chart. At bars 1 and 2 in AAPL, a second entry off the 1 minute chart at the 5 minute moving average had about a 25 cent risk, and the price action entry off the 5 minute chart (insert) had about a 45 cent risk. You could also have shorted at the market on the first 5 minute close above the moving average and used about a 20 cent stop. Here, at bars 1 and 2 on the 5 minute chart, the market went only 4 cents above the close before reversing down. In general, it is better either to wait for the second 1 minute entry or to use the traditional 5 minute price action entry (on a stop below the bar that tests the exponential moving average), because there is very little gained by the other methods and they just involve more thought, which can distract you from your primary trading on a higher time frame chart, like the 5 minute.


![图 26.5](figures/fig-26-05.jpg)


**图 26.5　通道窄幅时，等第二个信号**


如图 26.5所示，Emini 小型合约用第1根K线、第5根K线和第7根K线构成了一个楔形。由第2根K线、第5根K线和第7根K线构成的那个楔形是可靠性较低的反转建仓形态，因为这条通道太陡了。当通道窄幅时，更好的做法是等一个更低的高点再去做空，比如第10根K线处出现的那个。


> As shown in Figure 26.5, the Emini formed a wedge with bars 1, 5, and 7. The wedge formed by bars 2, 5, and 7 was a less reliable reversal setup because the channel was so steep. When there is a tight channel, it is better to wait to short a lower high, like the one that occurred at bar 10.


第8根K线是一个两K线反转，所以入场点位于这两根K线中较低者的下方，也就是低于第8根K线的低点，而不只是低于第7根K线的低点。大多数交易者会等第10根K线那个更低的高点再做空，而不是在第8根K线跌破第7根K线低点时做空。这次向下反转也源自第6根K线那根小K线构成的末端旗形。楔形顶部和末端旗形顶部之后，通常都至少会跟着一次两段式的横盘到向下修正，而且在修正完成之前，楔形的高点通常不会被超越。明白这一点，就可以合理地在第9根K线的iii形态上方一到两个最小报价单位处挂限价单做空。保护性止损本会放在第7根K线高点之上，那意味着六个最小报价单位的风险。当顶部出现一根强劲的空头趋势K线时，在它下方做空通常是笔好交易，即使入场发生在好几根K线之后。因为第10根K线正是这样一根强劲的空头趋势K线，而且它收在了第8根K线低点下方，这里发生的正是这种情况。


> Bar 8 was a two-bar reversal, so the entry was below the lower of the two bars, which was below the bar 8 low and not just below bar 7. Most traders would have waited to short the bar 10 lower high instead of shorting as bar 8 fell below the low of bar 7. The reversal down was also from the small bar 6 final flag. Both wedge and final flag tops are usually followed by at least a two-legged sideways to down correction, and the high of the wedge usually will not be exceeded until after the correction is complete. Knowing this, it was reasonable to place a limit order to short at one or two ticks above the bar 9 iii pattern. The protective stop would have been above the high of bar 7 and that would have entailed a risk of six ticks. When there is a strong bear trend bar at a top, shorting below it is usually a good trade even if the entry occurs several bars later. Because bar 10 was such a strong bear trend bar and it closed below the bar 8 low, that is what happened here.


![图 26.6](figures/fig-26-06.jpg)


**图 26.6　在空头趋势中买入新低**


尽管图 26.6所示的价格行为既是急速与通道式的强空头趋势，又是从开盘即启动的空头趋势日，而且做空本可以赚到更多钱，但有经验的交易者却一直在买入每一个新低，直到临近收盘的那波强趋势为止。这并不适合新手，因为在你有足够的经验、对正在发生的事情有把握之前，在情绪上极难做到。新手在这种清晰的空头趋势中只应该做空。


> Even though the price action shown in Figure 26.6 is both a strong spike and channel bear trend and a trend from the open bear day and more money could have been made by shorting, experienced traders were buying each new low until the strong trend into the close. This is not for beginners, since this is very difficult to do emotionally until you have enough experience to be confident with what is going on. Beginners should only have been shorting in this clear bear trend.


一种逆势做法是：在前一个摆动低点的价位挂限价单买入半仓，再在低出两个点的位置挂第二张限价单加仓（你是在尝试分批建立多头头寸）。如果你的一个点止盈目标在第二张买单成交之前就被触及，你就止盈离场，撤销那张买单，然后去寻找下一个摆动低点买入。例如，你会在第2根K线期间恰好以第1根K线的低点成交，然后可以剥头皮赚一个点离场。你的第二张单子不会成交，此时你会把它撤销，再去找下一个摆动低点买入。如果你在第4根K线期间以第3根K线低点处的限价单入场，你可以把第二半仓位挂在低出两个点的位置，并把整个头寸的止损设在第二次入场下方两个点处。一旦市场上涨回到你最初的入场价，你就可以全部离场：较低那一笔赚了两个点，第一笔买入则打平。


> One countertrend approach is to buy a half-size position on a limit order placed at the level of the prior swing low, and a second limit order to add on two points lower (you are trying to scale into your long position). If your one-point profit target is filled before the second buy order gets filled, you take your profit, cancel that other buy order, and look to buy a new swing low. For example, you would have been filled during bar 2 at exactly the low of bar 1, and you could have scalped out for a one-point profit. Your second order would not have been filled, and you would have canceled it at this point and looked to buy the next swing low. If you entered during bar 4 on a limit order located at the low of bar 3, you could have put your second half on two points lower and used a stop on the entire position two points below that second entry. Once the market rallied up to your original entry, you could have exited your entire position, having made a two-point profit on your lower entry and having been breakeven on your first buy.


即使在临近收盘、市场进入一段强劲的空头趋势通道时，这套做法也管用。如果交易者在第8根K线期间以第7根K线的低点做多，然后在第9根K线期间于低出两个点的位置继续买入，他们本可以在第10根K线离场。第10根K线的高点位于第7根K线低点上方一个最小报价单位，所以他们第二笔入场会赚到两个点的利润，而第一笔则可以打平离场。


> This approach worked even at the end of the day, when the market entered a strong bear trend channel. If traders got long during bar 8 at the low of bar 7 and then bought more two points lower during bar 9, they could have gotten out during bar 10. The high of bar 10 was one tick above the low of bar 7, so they would have made two points’ profit on their second entry and exited breakeven on the first.


# 第 27 章　用止损单入场

*27. Entering on Stops*


价格行为交易者会寻找一个入场的理由，而完成建仓形态的那根K线称为信号K线。你实际入场的那根K线称为入场K线。用价格行为交易时，最好的做法之一是用止损单入场，因为市场动能会把你带进这笔交易，因此你至少在顺着一个极小的趋势交易（至少一个最小报价单位长的趋势）。这是最可靠的一种入场方式，新手应该只做这种入场，直到他们能够持续盈利。例如，如果你要做空一段空头趋势，可以在前一根K线的低点下方一个最小报价单位处挂一张卖空单，订单成交之后，那根K线就成了你的信号K线。保护性止损的一个合理位置，是信号K线的高点上方一个最小报价单位处。入场K线收盘之后，如果它有强劲的阴线实体，就把止损收紧到入场K线上方一个最小报价单位处。否则，就一直把止损放在信号K线上方，直到市场开始强劲地朝你的方向运行。


> A price action trader is looking for a reason to enter, and the bar that completes the setup is called a signal bar. The bar when you actually enter is called the entry bar. One of the best ways to trade using price action is to enter on a stop, because you are being carried into the trade by the market's momentum and therefore are trading in the direction of at least a tiny trend (at least one tick long). This is the single most reliable entry approach, and beginners should restrict themselves to it until they become consistently profitable. For example, if you are shorting a bear trend, you can place an order to sell short at one tick below the low of the prior bar, which becomes your signal bar after your order is filled. A reasonable location for a protective stop is at one tick above the high of the signal bar. After the entry bar closes, if it has a strong bear body, tighten the stop to one tick above the entry bar. Otherwise, keep the stop above the signal bar until after the market begins to move strongly in your direction.


![图 27.1](figures/fig-27-01.jpg)


**图 27.1　要净赚四个最小报价单位，需要六个最小报价单位的行情**


在Emini 小型合约上，越过信号K线走出六个最小报价单位的行情，通常才能净赚四个最小报价单位的剥头皮利润；走出十个最小报价单位的行情，才能赚到八个最小报价单位的剥头皮利润。在图 27.1中，买入止损单挂在那根第2根K线信号K线的高点上方一个最小报价单位处，也就是A线，你会在那里成交。你的止盈限价卖单挂在比它高四个最小报价单位处，也就是B线，用来为这笔剥头皮赚到四个最小报价单位的利润。你的止盈限价单通常要等到市场越过它一个最小报价单位才会成交，那就是C线，而C线位于信号K线高点上方六个最小报价单位处。


> It usually takes a six-tick move beyond the signal bar to net a four-tick scalp and a ten-tick move to make an eight-tick scalp in the Eminis. In Figure 27.1, the entry buy stop was one tick above the bar 2 signal bar's high at line A, where you would have been filled. Your limit sell order to take four ticks’ profit on your scalp was four ticks above that, at line B. Your limit order usually won't get filled unless the market moves one tick beyond it. This was line C, and it was six ticks above the high of the signal bar.


# 第 28 章　限价单入场

*28. Entering on Limits*


有经验的交易者会根据具体情形，用限价单或止损单入场。市场处在强趋势中时，用止损单入场是合理的做法。当市场更像是在一个通道里运行时，他们会更倾向于用限价单入场。比如，如果出现一段强劲的多头急速行情，交易者会在K线上方挂止损单入场，也会在K线顶部附近用市价单入场。一旦市场转入通道阶段，它仍处在多头趋势中，但此时趋势已经走弱，可能随时结束，并向下测试通道的底部。早期，交易者仍会寻找在高1和高2买入信号上用止损单入场。通道持续一段时间之后（也许10根K线或更多），许多有经验的交易者会改为在前一根K线的低点处及其下方挂限价单入场，而不再用前一根K线高点之上的止损单。一旦通道持续很长时间（也许20根K线）并接近阻力区域，交易者就不再去寻找买入机会，转而开始在前一根K线的高点处及其上方挂限价单卖出。他们卖出是为了给多头止盈，有些人则会分批建空。一旦出现空头突破，这个过程就反向重演。如果空头趋势很强，他们会在K线下方挂止损单卖出；但如果空头行情段偏弱，有经验的交易者不会在低点附近用止损单做空。相反，他们更愿意在回调中用止损单做空——比如在移动平均线附近的低1或低2建仓形态下方——并在前一根K线的高点处及其上方挂限价单做空。


> Experienced traders will enter with stop or limit orders, depending on the situation. When the market is in a strong trend, entering on stops is a reasonable approach. When it is in more of a channel, they will be more inclined to look to enter on limit orders. For example, if there is a strong bull spike, traders will enter on stops above bars and at the market around the tops of bars. Once the market converts into its channel phase, it is still in a bull trend, but now the trend is weaker, and it can end at any time and test down to the bottom of the channel. Early on, traders will still look to enter on stops on high 1 and high 2 buy signals. After the channel has gone on for a while (maybe 10 or more bars), many experienced traders will switch to entering on limit orders at and below the low of the prior bar instead of on stop orders above the high of the prior bar. Once the channel goes on for a long time (maybe 20 bars) and approaches resistance areas, traders will stop looking to buy and will instead begin to sell at and above the high of the prior bar on limit orders. They will sell to take profits on longs, and some will scale into shorts. Once there is a bear breakout, the process begins in reverse. If the bear trend is strong, they will sell on stops below bars, but if the bear leg is weak, experienced traders will not short on stops near the low. Instead, they will prefer to short on stops on pullbacks, like below low 1 or low 2 setups near the moving average, and on limit orders at and above the high of the prior bar.


在交易者能够持续盈利之前，他们只应该用止损单入场；因为这样在入场时市场正朝着他们的方向运行，这会提高他们做成一笔盈利交易的机会。限价单入场的成功概率可以同样高，但要判断建仓形态是否强劲更为困难，这需要经验。从情绪上说，看到交易立刻朝你的方向走，要比看到它继续对你不利容易得多——而后者正是限价单入场常见的情况。挂限价单意味着你在赌市场即将反转方向。你可能是对的，只是早了一点。因此，许多用限价单入场的交易者会使用更小的仓位规模。如果市场继续对自己不利、而他们仍相信它很快就会反转，他们准备加仓。


> Until traders are consistently profitable, they should enter only on stops because then the market is going in their direction as they enter, and this increases the chances that they will have a profitable trade. Limit order entries can have just as good a probability of success, but it is more difficult to determine if the setup is strong, and this takes experience. It is also emotionally easier to see the trade immediately go your way than it is to see it go further against you, as often happens with a limit order entry. A limit order means that you are betting that the market is about to reverse direction. You might be right, but early. Therefore, many traders who enter on limit orders trade smaller sizes. They look to add on if the market continues against them and they still believe that it will soon reverse.


下面是一些限价单入场可能派上用场的情形（所有这些情形的示例都能在三本书相应的章节里找到）：


> Here are some of the situations in which a limit order entry can be useful (examples of all of them are in the appropriate chapters of the three books):


- 如果你比原定入场晚了几秒才挂上止损入场单、而想按原来的价格进场，就在原价处或差一个最小报价单位处挂限价单。
- 如果前一根K线是强多头急速行情中的一根强多头趋势K线，就在它的收盘价处挂限价单买入。
- 如果前一根K线是强空头急速行情中的一根强空头趋势K线，就在它的收盘价处挂限价单卖出。
- 在强多头急速行情中，趁K线尚未收盘买入一次小幅回调，比如在当根K线当前高点下方两个最小报价单位处挂限价买单。
- 在强空头急速行情中，趁K线尚未收盘卖出一次小幅回调，比如在当根K线当前低点上方两个最小报价单位处挂限价卖单。
- 当出现一根可能制造微型缺口的多头突破K线时，在突破K线之前那根K线的高点上方一点买入，那个高点就是突破点。


> • If you missed placing your stop entry order for the original entry by a few seconds and are trying to get in at the original price, place a limit order at the original price or a tick worse. • Buy with a limit order located at the close of the prior bar if it was a strong bull trend bar in a strong bull spike. • Sell with a limit order located at the close of the prior bar if it was a strong bear trend bar in a strong bear spike. • Buy a small pullback in a strong bull spike before the bar closes, like placing a limit order to buy two ticks below the current high of the bar. • Sell a small pullback in a strong bear spike before the bar closes, like placing a limit order to sell two ticks above the current low of the bar. • When there is a bull breakout bar that could create a micro gap, buy just above the high of the bar before the breakout bar, which is the breakout point.


- 当出现一根可能制造微型缺口的空头突破K线时，在突破K线之前那根K线的低点下方一点卖出，那个低点就是突破点。
- 在强多头急速行情中，在前一根K线的低点处或其下方挂限价单买入。
- 在强空头急速行情中，在前一根K线的高点处或其上方挂限价单卖出。
- 在强多头趋势中，于ii形态底部上方一个最小报价单位处挂限价单买入，冒两个最小报价单位的风险去赚四个或更多最小报价单位，因为这种做法的概率约为60%。
- 在强空头趋势中，于ii形态顶部下方一个最小报价单位处挂限价单卖出，冒两个最小报价单位的风险去赚四个或更多最小报价单位，因为这种做法的概率约为60%。
- 当一根并不特别大的多头趋势K线把市场翻转为始终做多时，在它之前那根K线的高点上方一个最小报价单位处挂限价单买入，预期一个测量缺口（如果这根K线没有回落到多头突破K线之前那根K线的高点之下，那就是强势的信号）。
- 当一根并不特别大的空头趋势K线把市场翻转为始终做空时，在它之前那根K线的低点下方一个最小报价单位处挂限价单卖出，预期一个测量缺口（如果这根K线没有升到空头突破K线之前那根K线的低点之上，那就是强势的信号）。
- 在开盘区间形成过程中，如果连续出现两根实体强劲的多头趋势K线，就在前一根K线的低点买入，预期多头急速行情的低点能够守住，至少支持一次向上的剥头皮。
- 在开盘区间形成过程中，如果连续出现两根实体强劲的空头趋势K线，就在前一根K线的高点卖出，预期空头急速行情的高点能够守住，至少支持一次向下的剥头皮。
- 在交易区间的底部，用市价单买入一段空头急速行情，或挂限价单买入。
- 在交易区间的顶部，用市价单卖出一段多头急速行情，或挂限价单卖出。
- 当多头市场中出现一段空头急速行情、而空头需要下一根K线是阴线才能确认始终入场交易翻转为向下时，在这根后续K线形成之前，买入这段急速行情中最后一根空头趋势K线的收盘价，在该空头趋势K线的低点处及其下方买入，如果下一根K线没有阴线实体，就在它的收盘价买入（并可在其高点上方挂买入止损单）。出现回调的可能性大于出现空头急速与通道的可能性。


> • When there is a bear breakout bar that could create a micro gap, sell just below the low of the bar before the breakout bar, which is the breakout point. • Buy on a limit order at or below the low of the prior bar in a strong bull spike. • Sell on a limit order at or above the high of the prior bar in a strong bear spike. • Buy on a limit order at one tick above the bottom of an ii pattern in a strong bull trend, risking two ticks to make four or more ticks, since this has about a 60 percent probability. • Sell on a limit order at one tick below the top of an ii pattern in a strong bear trend, risking two ticks to make four or more ticks, since this has about a 60 percent probability. • When a bull trend bar that is not particularly large flips the market to always-in long, buy on a limit order at one tick above the high of the bar before it, anticipating a measuring gap (it is a sign of strength if the bar does not fall below the high of the bar before the bull breakout bar). • When a bear trend bar that is not particularly large flips the market to always-in short, sell on a limit order at one tick below the low of the bar before it, anticipating a measuring gap (it is a sign of strength if the bar does not go above the low of the bar before the bear breakout bar). • While the opening range is forming, if there are two consecutive bull trend bars with strong bodies, buy at the low of the previous bar, expecting the low of the bull spike to hold for at least a scalp up. • While the opening range is forming, if there are two consecutive bear trend bars with strong bodies, sell at the high of the previous bar, expecting the high of the bear spike to hold for at least a scalp down. • Buy a bear spike at the market or on a limit order at the bottom of a trading range. • Sell a bull spike at the market or on a limit order at the top of a trading range. • When there is a bear spike in a bull market and the bears need the next bar to be a bear bar to confirm a flip of the always-in trade to down, buy the close of the last bear trend bar in the spike before the follow-through bar forms, at and below the low of the bear trend bar, and at the close of the next bar if it does not have a bear body (and buy on a stop above its high). A pullback is more likely than a bear spike and channel.


- 当空头市场中出现一段多头急速行情、而多头需要下一根K线是阳线才能确认始终入场交易翻转为向上时，在这根后续K线形成之前，卖出这段急速行情中最后一根多头趋势K线的收盘价，在该多头趋势K线的高点处及其上方卖出，如果下一根K线没有阳线实体，就在它的收盘价卖出（并可在其低点下方挂卖出止损单）。出现回调的可能性大于出现多头急速与通道的可能性。
- 当出现一根大的空头趋势K线、它很可能是空头趋势末端或多头趋势中回调末端的卖出高潮时，在这根K线的收盘价、其低点下方以及下一根K线的收盘价处买入（并可在其高点上方挂止损单）。
- 当出现一根大的多头趋势K线、它很可能是多头趋势末端或空头趋势中回调末端的买入高潮时，在这根K线的收盘价、其高点上方以及下一根K线的收盘价处卖出（并可在其低点下方挂止损单）。
- 当多头趋势在一段只有一根K线的多头急速行情之后出现回调时，在多头急速行情底部上方一个或两个最小报价单位处挂限价单买入，预期这是一次突破回调，而不是突破失败。


> • When there is a bull spike in a bear market and the bulls need the next bar to be a bull bar to confirm a flip of the always-in trade to up, sell the close of the last bull trend bar in the spike before the follow-through bar forms, at and above the high of the bull trend bar, and at the close of the next bar if it does not have a bull body (and sell on a stop below its low). A pullback is more likely than a bull spike and channel. • When there is a large bear trend bar that is a likely sell climax at the end of a bear trend or pullback in a bull trend, buy at the close of the bar, below its low, and at the close of the next bar (and on a stop above its high). • When there is a large bull trend bar that is a likely buy climax at the end of a bull trend or pullback in a bear trend, sell at the close of the bar, above its high, and at the close of the next bar (and on a stop below its low). • When there is a pullback in a bull trend after a one-bar bull spike, buy on a limit order at a tick or two above the bottom of the bull spike, expecting a breakout pullback instead of a failed breakout.


- 当空头趋势在一段只有一根K线的空头急速行情之后出现回调时，在空头急速行情顶部下方一个或两个最小报价单位处挂限价单卖出，预期这是一次突破回调，而不是突破失败。
- 当多头急速行情之后很可能出现第二段上涨时，在原始信号K线高点上方一个或两个最小报价单位处挂限价单买入，即使这次测试要等几十根K线之后才来。
- 当空头急速行情之后很可能出现第二段下跌时，在原始信号K线低点下方一个或两个最小报价单位处挂限价单卖出，即使这次测试要等几十根K线之后才来。
- 在多头通道中，在前一根K线的低点下方买入，尤其是在通道处于早期阶段时。
- 在空头通道中，在前一根K线的高点上方卖出，尤其是在通道处于早期阶段时。
- 在空头通道的后期阶段、当卖压已经不断累积之后，在前一根K线的低点下方、并在最近一个摆动低点下方买入。
- 在多头通道的后期阶段、当买压已经不断累积之后，在前一根K线的高点上方、并在最近一个摆动高点上方卖出。


> • When there is a pullback in a bear trend after a one-bar bear spike, sell on a limit order at a tick or two below the top of the bear spike, expecting a breakout pullback instead of a failed breakout. • When a second leg up is likely after a bull spike, buy on a limit order at a tick or two above the original signal bar high, even if the test comes dozens of bars later. • When a second leg down is likely after a bear spike, sell on a limit order at a tick or two below the original signal bar low, even if the test comes dozens of bars later. • Buy below the low of the prior bar in a bull channel, especially when the channel is in its early stages. • Sell above the high of the prior bar in a bear channel, especially when the channel is in its early stages. • Buy below the low of the prior bar and below the most recent swing low in a bear channel in its late stages after selling pressure has been building. • Sell above the high of the prior bar and above the most recent swing high in a bull channel in its late stages after buying pressure has been building.


- 在多头微型通道中，在前一根K线的低点下方买入，预期向下突破通道的第一次尝试会失败。
- 在空头微型通道中，在前一根K线的高点上方卖出，预期向上突破通道的第一次尝试会失败。
- 当出现急速与通道式的多头趋势、并出现一次动能很弱、一直回落到通道底部的回调时，在通道底部的测试处买入。
- 当出现急速与通道式的空头趋势、并出现一次动能很弱、一直上涨到通道顶部的回调时，在通道顶部的测试处卖出。
- 在强多头波段开始时，在至少两根强劲的多头趋势K线之后，买入一根空头收盘。
- 在强空头波段开始时，在至少两根强劲的空头趋势K线之后，卖出一根多头收盘。
- 在交易区间的底部，在前一个摆动低点的低点处或其下方买入。
- 在交易区间的顶部，在前一个摆动高点的高点处或其上方卖出。
- 在多头平台（bull ledge：一个小的交易区间，其底部由两根或更多低点相同的K线构成）的底部上方一个或两个最小报价单位处挂限价单买入。
- 在空头平台（bear ledge：一个小的交易区间，其顶部由两根或更多高点相同的K线构成）的顶部下方一个或两个最小报价单位处挂限价单卖出。
- 在交易区间底部，或在强劲向上反转之后的新多头趋势中，在一根疲弱的低1或低2信号K线的低点处或其下方挂限价单买入（这可能是更高的低点）。
- 在交易区间顶部，或在强劲向下反转之后的新空头趋势中，在一根疲弱的高1或高2信号K线的高点处或其上方挂限价单做空（这可能是更低的高点）。
- 在强多头趋势中，对做空剥头皮反向操作，因为大多数都会失败。当强多头趋势之后出现一个做空剥头皮的建仓形态时，在做空的剥头皮交易者打算止盈的位置上方两个或三个最小报价单位处挂限价单买入。例如，如果在强多头趋势中的 Emini 小型合约（Emini）上出现一个做空建仓形态，就考虑在空头信号K线下方约四个最小报价单位处挂限价单买入，冒约三个最小报价单位的风险，预期这轮抛售不会跌到空头做1个点剥头皮所需的六个最小报价单位。


> • Buy below the low of the prior bar in a bull micro channel, expecting the first breakout below the channel to fail. • Sell above the high of the prior bar in a bear micro channel, expecting the first breakout above the channel to fail. • When there is a spike and channel bull trend and a low-momentum pullback to the bottom of the channel, buy the test of the bottom of the channel. • When there is a spike and channel bear trend and a low-momentum pullback to the top of the channel, sell the test of the top of the channel. • Buy a bear close after at least a couple of strong bull trend bars at the start of a strong bull swing. • Sell a bull close after at least a couple of strong bear trend bars at the start of a strong bear swing. • Buy at or below the low of a prior swing low at the bottom of the range. • Sell at or above the high of a prior swing high at the top of the range. • Buy with a limit order a tick or two above the bottom of a bull ledge (a small trading range with a bottom created by two or more bars with identical lows). • Sell with a limit order at a tick or two below the top of a bear ledge (a small trading range with a top created by two or more bars with identical highs). • Buy at or below a low 1 or 2 weak signal bar on a limit order at the bottom of a trading range or in a new bull trend after a strong reversal up (a possible higher low). • Short at or above a high 1 or 2 weak signal bar on a limit order at the top of a trading range or in a new bear trend after a strong reversal down (a possible lower high). • In a strong bull trend, fade short scalps, since most will fail. When there is a strong bull trend and then a short scalp setup, buy on a limit order at two or three ticks above where the short scalpers are looking to take profits. For example, if there is a short setup in the Emini in a strong bull trend, look to buy on a limit order at about four ticks below the bear signal bar and risk about three ticks, expecting the sell-off to not reach the six ticks needed for the bears to make a one-point scalp.


- 在强空头趋势中，对做多剥头皮反向操作，因为大多数都会失败。当强空头趋势之后出现一个做多剥头皮的建仓形态时，在做多的剥头皮交易者打算止盈的位置下方两个或三个最小报价单位处挂限价单做空。
- 在非常强劲的多头趋势中，如果市场尚未跌到移动平均线下方超过两个最小报价单位，就在第一根收盘价位于移动平均线下方一个或两个最小报价单位的小空头趋势K线的收盘价买入。
- 在非常强劲的空头趋势中，如果市场尚未升到移动平均线上方超过两个最小报价单位，就在第一根收盘价位于移动平均线上方一个或两个最小报价单位的小多头趋势K线的收盘价卖出。
- 在移动平均线处一个平静的牛旗中，在前一根K线处或其下方挂限价单买入。
- 在移动平均线处一个平静的熊旗中，在前一根K线处或其上方挂限价单做空。
- 在移动平均线处平静的牛旗中，买入一根空头收盘。
- 在移动平均线处平静的熊旗中，卖出一根多头收盘。
- 在强多头趋势中，买入一次回撤到移动平均线的回调，比如20根均线缺口K线买入建仓形态。


> • In a strong bear trend, fade long scalps, since most will fail. When there is a strong bear trend and then a buy scalp setup, short on a limit order at two or three ticks below where the bull scalpers are looking to take profits. • In a very strong bull trend where the market has not yet dropped below the moving average by more than a couple of ticks, buy the close of the first small bear trend bar with a close that is a tick or two below the moving average. • In a very strong bear trend where the market has not yet poked above the moving average by more than a couple of ticks, sell the close of the first small bull trend bar with a close that is a tick or two above the moving average. • Buy at or below the prior bar on a limit order in a quiet bull flag at the moving average. • Short at or above the prior bar on a limit order in a quiet bear flag at the moving average. • Buy a bear close in a quiet bull flag at the moving average. • Sell a bull close in a quiet bear flag at the moving average. • Buy a moving average pullback in a strong bull trend, like a 20 gap bar buy setup.


- 在强空头趋势中，卖出一次回撤到移动平均线的回调，比如20根均线缺口K线卖出建仓形态。
- 在陡峭上升的移动平均线处的回调中买入，并在移动平均线下方的各个间隔位置分批建仓。
- 在陡峭下降的移动平均线处的回调中卖出，并在移动平均线上方的各个间隔位置分批建仓。
- 在一根向上突破牛旗的阳线下方买入，预期出现突破回调。
- 在一根向下跌破熊旗的阴线上方卖出，预期出现突破回调。
- 在多头趋势中想做一笔波段时，在突破回测处买入或加仓；所谓突破回测，就是市场冲向此前多头入场处的保本止损、试图把它们打掉的举动。
- 在空头趋势中想做一笔波段时，在突破回测处卖出或加仓；所谓突破回测，就是市场冲向此前空头入场处的保本止损、试图把它们打掉的举动。
- 当回调可能形成双底牛旗时，在前一个摆动低点附近挂限价单买入。


> • Sell a moving average pullback in a strong bear trend, like a 20 gap bar sell setup. • Buy on a pullback to a steeply rising moving average and scale in at intervals below the moving average. • Sell on a pullback to a steeply falling moving average and scale in at intervals above the moving average. • Buy below a bull bar that breaks above a bull flag, anticipating a breakout pullback. • Sell above a bear bar that breaks below a bear flag, anticipating a breakout pullback. • When trying for a swing in a bull trend, buy or buy more on a breakout test, which is an attempt to run breakeven stops from an earlier long entry. • When trying for a swing in a bear trend, sell or sell more on a breakout test, which is an attempt to hit breakeven stops from an earlier short entry. • When there is a pullback to a possible double bottom bull flag, buy on a limit order around the prior swing low.


- 当回调可能形成双顶熊旗时，在前一个摆动高点附近挂限价单卖出。
- 只要你认为自己的交易前提足够强，任何一笔交易都可以分批建仓。
- 如果市场处在楼梯形态中，就在回撤到前一级台阶时挂限价单入场。例如，如果 Emini 小型合约的平均日区间约为12点，而今天走的是空头楼梯形态，可以考虑在前一个摆动低点下方4点处挂限价买单，博一次向上测试该摆动低点的上涨。
- 在趋势性交易区间日中，在极端位置挂限价单，预期价格会去测试最近这个交易区间的另一侧。例如，在一个卖压不断累积的多头趋势性交易区间日中，可以考虑在等距运动目标位（以较低那个交易区间的高度测算）下方一个最小报价单位左右处挂限价单做空，博一次对上区间底部的测试，或跌回下区间的一次测试。
- 在交易区间日中，当区间顶部附近出现一段多头急速行情时，卖出一根空头收盘，尤其是当它位于前一根K线区间的上半部分、且属于第二次尝试向下反转时。


> • When there is a pullback to a possible double top bear flag, sell on a limit order around the prior swing high. • Scale into any trade where you believe that your premise is strong. • If the market is in a stairs pattern, enter on a limit order for the pullback to the prior stair. For example, if the average daily range in the Emini is about 12 points and today is in a bear stairs pattern, consider placing a buy limit order at four points below the prior swing low for a rally up to test that swing low. • In a trending trading range day, place a limit order at the extreme in anticipation of a test of the other side of the most recent trading range. For example, in a bull trending trading range day when selling pressure is building, consider shorting on a limit order located a tick or so below the measured move target (based on the height of the lower trading range) for a test of the bottom of the upper range or a test into the lower range. • In a trading range day during a bull spike near the top of the range, sell a bear close, especially if it is in the top half of the range of the prior bar and if it is a second attempt to reverse down.


- 在交易区间日中，当区间底部附近出现一段空头急速行情时，买入一根多头收盘，尤其是当它位于前一根K线区间的下半部分、且属于第二次尝试向上反转时。
- 在多头趋势性交易区间日中，在等距运动目标位附近一根大号多头趋势K线的收盘价处、以及其高点上方卖出，尤其是当这根K线相对较大、因而可能构成买入高潮，并且最近5到10根K线中带有一些卖压时。
- 在空头趋势性交易区间日中，在等距运动目标位附近一根大号空头趋势K线的收盘价处、以及其低点下方买入，尤其是当这根K线相对较大、因而可能构成卖出高潮，并且最近5到10根K线中带有一些买压时。
- 在区间约为10点的多头趋势性交易区间日中，在较低那个区间的高点上方4到6点处挂限价单做空，博一次对突破点的测试。
- 在区间约为10点的空头趋势性交易区间日中，在较高那个区间的低点下方4到6点处挂限价单买入，博一次对突破点的测试。


> • In a trading range day during a bear spike near the bottom of the range, buy a bull close, especially if it is in the bottom half of the range of the prior bar and if it is a second attempt to reverse up. • In a bull trending trading range day, sell the close of, and above the high of, a large bull trend bar near the measured move target, especially if the bar is relatively large and, therefore, a possible buy climax, and if the last five to 10 bars had some selling pressure. • In a bear trending trading range day, buy the close of, and below the low of, a large bear trend bar near the measured move target, especially if the bar is relatively large and, therefore, a possible sell climax, and if the last five to 10 bars had some buying pressure. • In a bull trending trading range day where the range will be about 10 points, short on a limit order four to six points above the high of the lower range for a test of the breakout. • In a bear trending trading range day where the range will be about 10 points, buy on a limit order four to six points below the low of the upper range for a test of the breakout.


- 在强空头通道中，当市场正在构筑向上两K线反转时，在第二根K线上涨到第一根K线的高点时做空，冒几个最小报价单位的风险，预期市场不会升到第二根K线之上、从而触发多头的入场。
- 在强多头通道中，当市场正在构筑向下两K线反转时，在第二根K线下跌到第一根K线的低点时买入，冒几个最小报价单位的风险，预期市场不会跌到第二根K线之下、从而触发空头的入场。
- 在多头趋势中，用限价单买入对多头趋势线的测试（不过通常更好的做法是在测试该趋势线的多头反转K线上方买入）。
- 在空头趋势中，用限价单卖出对空头趋势线的测试（不过通常更好的做法是在测试该趋势线的空头反转K线下方卖出）。
- 在多头趋势或交易区间中，当市场测试向下倾斜的趋势通道线时，买入一个下降楔形（楔形牛旗）（不过通常更好的做法是在测试该通道线的多头反转K线上方买入）。
- 在空头趋势或交易区间中，当市场测试向上倾斜的趋势通道线时，做空一个上升楔形（楔形熊旗）（不过通常更好的做法是在测试该通道线的空头反转K线下方卖出）。
- 在出现回调的多头趋势中——回调本身就是一段小型空头趋势——在某个摆动低点下方买入，预期向下创新低的突破会失败，并演变成一个高2或楔形牛旗买入信号。
- 在出现回调的空头趋势中——回调本身就是一段小型多头趋势——在某个摆动高点上方卖出，预期向上创新高的突破会失败，并演变成一个低2或楔形熊旗卖出信号。
- 在多头趋势中，买入从当前高点回落的60%到70%的回调，止损放在更低的低点，在新高点处或其上方止盈（回报约为风险的两倍，概率约为60%）。
- 在空头趋势中，卖出从当前低点回弹的60%到70%的回调，止损放在更高的高点，在新低点处或其下方止盈（回报约为风险的两倍，概率约为60%）。总的来说，当市场处在多头趋势中时，多头会预期空头的每一次尝试都失败，因此会寻找机会买入每一次尝试。他们会在每一根空头趋势K线的收盘价附近买入，即使这根K线很大、并且收在最低点。当市场跌破前一根K线的低点、任何此前的摆动低点，以及任何支撑位（比如趋势线）时，他们会买入。他们也会买入市场每一次向上走的尝试，比如在一根多头趋势K线的高点附近，或在市场升破前一根K线的高点、或升破某个阻力位时。这与交易者在强空头市场中的做法正好相反——那时他们在K线上方和下方卖出、在阻力位和支撑位的上方和下方卖出。他们在K线上方（以及各种类型的阻力位附近）卖出，包括在强多头趋势K线上方卖出，因为他们把每一次上涨都看作一次反转趋势的尝试，而大多数趋势反转的尝试都会失败。他们在K线下方（以及各种类型的支撑位附近）卖出，因为他们把每一次下跌都看作延续空头趋势的尝试，并预期其中大多数会成功。


> • In a strong bear channel when the market is setting up a two-bar reversal up, short as the second bar rallies to the high of the first bar, risking a few ticks, expecting the market to not trade above the second bar and trigger the long. • In a strong bull channel when the market is setting up a two-bar reversal down, buy as the second bar falls to the low of the first bar, risking a few ticks, expecting the market to not trade below the second bar and trigger the short. • In a bull trend, buy a test of the bull trend line with a limit order (although it is usually better to buy above a bull reversal bar that tests the line). • In a bear trend, sell a test of the bear trend line with a limit order (although it is usually better to sell below a bear reversal bar that tests the line). • In a bull trend or a trading range, buy a falling wedge (a wedge bull flag) as the market tests the downwardly sloping trend channel line (although it is usually better to buy above a bull reversal bar that tests the line). • In a bear trend or a trading range, short a rising wedge (a wedge bear flag) as the market tests the upwardly sloping trend channel line (although it is usually better to sell below a bear reversal bar that tests the line). • In a bull trend where there is a pullback, which is a small bear trend, buy below a swing low, expecting the breakout to a new low to fail and become a high 2 or wedge bull flag buy signal. • In a bear trend where there is a pullback, which is a small bull trend, sell above a swing high, expecting the breakout to a new high to fail and become a low 2 or wedge bear flag sell signal. • In a bull trend, buy a 60 to 70 percent pullback from the current high, risking to a lower low, and taking profit at or above a new high (the reward is about twice the risk, the probability is about 60 percent). • In a bear trend, sell a 60 to 70 percent pullback from the current low, risking to a higher high, and taking profit at or below a new low (the reward is about twice the risk, the probability is about 60 percent). In general, when the market is in a bull trend, the bulls will expect every attempt by the bears to fail, and therefore look to buy each one. They will buy around the close of every bear trend bar, even if the bar is large and closes on its low. They will buy as the market falls below the low of the prior bar, any prior swing low, and any support level, like a trend line. They also will buy every attempt by the market to go higher, like around the high of a bull trend bar or as the market moves above the high of the prior bar or above a resistance level. This is the exact opposite of what traders do in strong bear markets, when they sell above and below bars, and above and below both resistance and support. They sell above bars (and around every type of resistance), including strong bull trend bars, because they see each move up as an attempt to reverse the trend, and most trend reversal attempts fail. They sell below bars (and around every type of support), because they see each move down as an attempt to resume the bear trend, and expect that most will succeed.


市价单其实只是限价单的一种形态：交易者急着进场或出场，并不在乎省下一两个最小报价单位。许多想按市价成交的交易者只是在报价阶梯上挂一张限价单，所以很多限价单交易实际上是想按市价进场或出场。例如，如果 QQQ 报51.10美元、并且正处在多头急速行情中，想按市价做多的交易者往往会直接去点报价阶梯上一个高于卖价的买入限价，比如51.14美元，结果以市价成交。因此，我关于限价单所写的绝大部分内容，对于偏好使用市价单的交易者来说同样适用于市价单。


> A market order is just a type of limit order where a trader is eager to get in or out of a trade and does not worry about saving a tick or two. Many traders who want to trade at the market just place a limit order on their price ladder, so many limit order trades are actually with the intent of entering or exiting at the market. For example, if the QQQ is at $51.10 and in a bull spike, traders who want to get long at the market will often hit a buy limit price on their price ladder that is above the offer, like at $51.14, and get filled at the market. Because of this, most of what I write about limit orders is applicable to market orders for traders who prefer to use market orders.


每当市场升破前一根K线的高点、或跌破它的低点时，都会发生一件非常重要的事。市场正在突破前一根K线的区间，但很重要的一点是要认识到：大多数突破尝试都会失败。可惜的是，新手交易者会被每一次突破的情绪裹挟，以为市场正处在一轮大行情的起点。他们不明白，这次突破其实是一次测试。市场在寻找价值，而突破不过是多空之间的一场争夺，通常并不是一段大趋势的开端。在每一张图、每一个时间级别上，市场每隔一根或两根K线就会做一次这样的测试。一个在每根K线高点上方挂止损单买入、在每根K线低点下方挂止损单做空的交易者，等于参与了每一次突破，结果会亏钱。为什么？因为用止损单入场本质上就是一笔突破交易，而大多数突破都会失败。市场通常会被拉回交易区间——比如回到前一根K线的实体里——然后才决定下一步往哪里走。尽管对刚开始做交易的人来说，用止损单进出是最好的选择，但他们必须有所挑选。


> Something very important happens every time the market moves above the high or below the low of the prior bar. The market is breaking out of the range of the prior bar, but it is very important to realize that most attempts to break out fail. Unfortunately, beginning traders get caught up in the emotion of all breakouts and assume that the market is at the start of a big move. They don't understand that the breakout is a test. The market is searching for value, and the breakout is simply a contest between the bulls and the bears, and usually not the start of a big trend. The market runs this test every bar or two on every chart and in every time frame. A trader who used stop orders to buy above the high of every bar and short below the low of every bar would be taking every breakout and would lose money. Why? Because a stop entry is a breakout trade, and most breakouts fail. The market usually gets pulled back into the trading range, such as the body of the prior bar, and then decides where it will go next. Although stop entries and exits are the best choice for traders starting out, they have to be selective.


假设当前这根K线刚刚上涨到前一根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处。大多数个人交易者要么什么都不做，要么在前一根K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处挂止损单买入，要么在前一根K线的高点处挂限价单卖出。如果这次突破成功、市场向上走得足够远、让多头赚到了利润，那他们的决定就是对的。但如果向上突破前一根K线的行情只是一次买入价格真空，市场很快就会掉头向下，赚钱的会是空头。如果趋势向下，许多空头会等上涨再卖出，而他们最偏爱的建仓形态就是任何一种“涨过某个位置”的行情，比如涨过一条空头趋势线、涨过一个此前的摆动高点，甚至只是涨过前一根K线的高点。如果有足够多强势的空头一直在等市场涨过某个位置才做空，那么这次买入价格真空很容易就只带来前一根K线高点上方一个或两个最小报价单位的突破。市场在那个位置找到的不是一大批强势多头，而是大量强势空头——他们一直在等市场再涨高一点点，比如涨过前一根K线，然后做空。


> Let's say that the current bar just rallied to one tick above the high of the prior bar. Most individual traders would either do nothing, buy on a stop at one tick above the high of the prior bar, or sell on a limit order at the high of the prior bar. If the breakout is successful and the market runs far enough up for bulls to make their profits, then they made the right decision. However, if the move above the prior bar was just a buy vacuum, the market will soon turn down, and the bears will make a profit. If the trend is down, then many bears will wait for rallies to sell, and a favorite setup is a rally above anything, like a bear trend line, a prior swing high, or even simply the high of the prior bar. If there are enough strong bears waiting to short until the market moves above something, then this buy vacuum could easily lead to a one-or two-tick breakout above the high of the prior bar. Instead of the market finding a lot of strong bulls up there, it will find lots of strong bears who were waiting for the market to get just a little higher, like above the prior bar, before shorting.


在一段上升趋势中，多头的情形正好相反。他们想买入回调；如果有足够多强势的多头相信空头能把市场推到当前这根K线的低点之下，那他们何必在那之前买入，反正很快就能买到更低的价？他们干脆让到一边，在前一根K线的低点处挂一张限价买单，然后等空头把市场推到当前这根K线的低点之下。那次卖出价格真空把价格吸进他们的买入区，他们便大举买入，把空头困在里面；空头很快将不得不回补自己的空头头寸（为上涨添柴），市场随即迅速反转向上。


> The opposite is true for the bulls in an uptrend. They want to buy pullbacks, and if enough strong bulls believe that the bears will be able to push the market below the low of the current bar, why should they buy before that happens when they can soon buy lower? They simply step aside, place a limit order to buy at the low of the prior bar, and wait for the bears to push the market below the low of the current bar. That sell vacuum sucks the price down into their buy zone, and they buy aggressively, trapping the bears who will soon have to buy back their shorts (adding fuel to the rally), and the market quickly reverses up.


大多数时候，无论在前一根K线上方挂止损单买入、还是在前一根K线的高点挂限价单做空，概率都约为50%；但常常会有60%或更高的情况偏向其中一方——偏止损单，或偏限价单。有了经验，交易者能够识别出这些60%的情形，并把订单下在拥有优势的那一侧。由于大多数突破尝试都会失败，成功的限价单入场往往更可靠，但这类交易要难下手得多，因为你是在赌一段行情会失败，并在触及你的保护性止损之前反转、朝你的方向走。在交易者积累起大量经验之前，等待市场反转并朝自己方向走的过程压力极大。正如盲目地在每一个止损信号上入场是一套亏钱的策略，盲目地用限价单在相反方向对每一个这样的信号反向操作，同样是一套亏钱的策略。在任何一天里，可能会有大约10个合理的止损单入场建仓形态，以及20个或更多的限价单入场建仓形态，尽管其中许多对没有经验的交易者来说并不明显。正因为可靠的限价单建仓形态如此之多，交易者能够评估它们就显得非常重要。


> Most of the time, the probability for either buying on the stop above the prior bar or shorting on a limit order at the high of the prior bar is about 50 percent, but it is often 60 percent or more in favor of the stop or the limit order. With experience, traders can spot these 60 percent situations and place their orders in the direction that has the edge. Since most breakout attempts fail, successful limit order entries tend to be more reliable, but they are much harder to take because you are betting that a move will fail and reverse in your direction before hitting your protective stop. Until traders have a lot of experience, it is very stressful to wait for the market to reverse and go their way. Just as blindly entering on every stop signal is a losing strategy, blindly fading every one of those signals with a limit order in the opposite direction is also a losing strategy. On any given day, there might be about 10 reasonable stop entry setups and 20 or more limit order setups, although many are not obvious to inexperienced traders. Because there are so many reliable limit order setups, it is important for traders to be able to evaluate them.


当你试图用限价单入场时，你想要的是一个比当前价格更好的价格。例如，如果你想用限价单买入，你的订单在当前价格下方，你需要价格下跌，订单才能成交。总体而言，用止损单入场是更安全的做法，因为入场时市场正朝你的方向走，出现后续行情的可能性更大。对新手来说，这是最好的做法。不过，有很多情形你可以改用限价单而不是止损单入场。事实上，正如前面提到的，限价单建仓形态的数量通常是止损单入场建仓形态的两倍左右，但它们风险更高，而且通常更难下手，因为它们至少是在逆着短期趋势。例如，如果你刚刚在向上突破一条空头趋势线、并出现一根强多头反转K线之后的回调中买入了一个二次入场建仓形态，而在接下来的一两根K线里，市场两次精确测试了入场K线的低点，那就考虑在入场K线低点上方一个最小报价单位处挂限价买单，把仓位加倍，只冒两个最小报价单位的风险（止损设到原来的位置，就在入场K线下方）。如果你试图在入场K线的低点挂限价买单，多半不会成交，因为市场通常必须穿过限价，订单才会成交。谁都知道，在入场K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处挂着很多保护性止损——那为什么聪明钱不去猎杀它们？因为一旦这些止损被打掉，市场的性质就变了。图表上不再是强劲的二次入场，而变成了二次入场失败，那是一个顺势建仓形态，很可能还会走出两段下跌。如果聪明钱已经在底部建好了仓，他们就不愿看到市场再走出两段下跌，所以他们会做出和你完全一样的事：继续累积多头仓位来守住底部。最终，卖方会放弃并开始回补，而在他们回补的过程中，市场会涨得远远超过剥头皮交易者的目标位。


> When you are trying to enter on a limit order, you are trying to get in at a better price than the current price. For example, if you are looking to buy on a limit order, your order is below the current price and you need the price to fall for your order to get filled. Entering on stops is a safer approach in general because the market is moving in your direction as you enter, and the odds of follow-through are greater. For beginners, this is the best approach. However, there are many situations in which you can enter on a limit order instead of a stop. In fact, as mentioned, there are usually about twice as many limit order setups as there are stop entry setups, but they are riskier and usually harder to take because they are counter to at least the short-term trend. For example, if you just bought a second-entry setup in a pullback following a breakout above a bear trend line and a strong bull reversal bar, and the market tests the exact low of the entry bar a couple of times over the next one or two bars, consider placing a limit buy order to double your position at one tick above the low of the entry bar and risk just two ticks (to the original stop, just below the entry bar). You would likely not get filled if you tried to buy the low of the entry bar on a limit order, since the market usually has to trade through the limit price for the order to get filled. Everyone knows that there are many protective stops just one tick below that entry bar low—why isn't the smart money gunning for it? It is because if those stops are hit, the character of the market will have changed. Instead of being a strong second entry, the chart now has a failed second entry, and that is a with-trend setup and will likely result in two further legs down. If the smart money traders had loaded up on the bottom, they would not want to see the market drop for another two legs, so they will do exactly as you did: they will continue to accumulate longs to defend the bottom. Eventually, sellers will give up and start to cover, and as they do, the market will rise well beyond the scalper's target.


用限价单入场至少是在逆着短期趋势交易，而且一般来说可能带来毫无必要的焦虑，进而干扰你当日晚些时候的交易能力。单凭一段强劲的急速行情，并不足以构成开始考虑用限价单在回调中入场的理由。例如，如果在 Emini 小型合约上出现一段强劲多头急速行情、一直冲到交易区间的顶部，或是多头趋势末端一处可能的买入高潮，交易者可能会把它看作强势信号，并挂限价单在低1到4点的位置分批做多。


> Entering on a limit order is trading countertrend to at least the short-term trend and, in general, can create needless anxiety that can interfere with your ability to trade later in the day. A strong spike alone is not a reason to begin to look to enter on a pullback using a limit order. For example, if there is a strong bull spike in the Emini to the top of a trading range or a possible buy climax at the end of a bull trend, traders might see it as a sign of strength and place limit orders to scale into longs at maybe one to four points lower.


然而，他们需要考虑一种可能：这段多头急速行情是一次衰竭性的买入高潮。只要有任何疑虑，交易者就不该在市场下跌时用限价单买入，因为这次抛售可能持续至少10根K线和两段行情，而且它可能是向下反转的开始。单有一段强劲的多头急速行情，还不足以构成用限价单买入回调的理由；交易者需要考虑这段多头急速行情所处的背景。空头急速行情的情形正好相反。


> However, they need to consider the possibility that the bull spike was an exhaustive buy climax. When there is any doubt, a trader should not be buying on limit orders as the market is falling, because the sell-off might last for at least 10 bars and two legs, and it could be the start of a reversal down. A strong bull spike alone is not enough of a reason to buy a pullback on a limit order; traders need to consider the context of the bull spike. The opposite is true of bear spikes.


此外，如果市场上涨了几个小时，现在又已经抛售了一个小时、毫无见底的迹象，而你在斐波那契62% 回调位、或在布林带（Bollinger）、肯特纳带（Keltner）或任何其他类型的带处挂限价买单，那么你做多入场时市场正在下跌，因此你是在逆着当前趋势交易，指望早先的趋势回来。市场常常会在62%回调的区域反弹，但这种事发生的频率和幅度往往都不足以让它相比用止损单入场更划算。如果市场在那个62%回撤附近反转向上，那就先等这根K线收盘，看看它是不是多头收盘。如果是，就在它的高点上方一个最小报价单位处挂买单。这样你入场时市场正朝你的方向走，而多头也同时展示了两方面的强势：多头收盘，以及把市场推到前一根K线高点之上的能力。而且你依然有62%回调这个有利条件。如果这笔交易本身是好的，那么现在它成功的可能性会大得多。是的，为了等止损单入场，你可能会错过几个最小报价单位，但你会避开多得多的亏损交易和大量毫无必要的压力。


> Furthermore, if the market rallied for a couple of hours but has now sold off for an hour with no sign of a bottom and you place a limit order to buy a Fibonacci 62 percent pullback or at a Bollinger, Keltner, or any other type of band, the market will be falling when you enter your long and you will therefore be trading against the current trend, hoping that the earlier trend will return. The market often bounces in the area of a 62 percent pullback, but not often enough or far enough to make it worthwhile compared to entering on a stop. If the market reverses up around that 62 percent retracement, just wait for the bar to close and look to see if it has a bullish close. If so, place an order to buy at one tick above its high. Then the market will be moving in your direction when you enter and the bulls will have demonstrated strength both by the bullish close and by their ability to push the market above the high of the prior bar. And you still have the 62 percent pullback in your favor. If the trade is good, it is now much more likely to be successful. Yes, you might miss a couple of ticks by waiting for the entry on a stop, but you will be avoiding far more losers and a lot of needless stress.


有少数情形下，用限价单入场能取得与一笔好的止损单入场相当的胜率。如果由于某种原因，你错过了一笔看上去极好的交易的止损单入场，而在几秒钟之内你能以那个止损价、或差一两个最小报价单位的价格挂上限价单，那么这种做法可能是有效的。不过，只把它用在非常强的交易上，因为一般来说，一旦你已经错过了原来的入场点，你不想进入一笔“居然还让你以很好的价格进场”的交易。极好的交易很少会回头来搭救那些不够机敏的交易者。


> There are a few instances when entering on a limit order results in a winning percentage comparable to a good stop order entry. If for some reason you missed entering what appeared to be a great trade on a stop and within seconds you are able to place a limit order at the stop price or a tick or two worse, this can be effective. However, use it only for very strong trades because, in general, you do not want to be in a trade that let you in at a great price once you have already missed the original entry. Great trades rarely come back to bail out less astute traders.


在强多头趋势中，你不该去找低1或低2去做空，尤其是当信号K线疲弱的时候。当出现一根停顿K线或一根疲弱的阴线时，许多交易者会退到一边，等市场跌破那根K线之后再买入。这就造成了一次小型的卖出价格真空。在那根K线的低点处或其下方买入，往往是一笔好交易，预期会在高几个最小报价单位的位置触发高1或高2。另一些交易者会在这段急速行情高点下方的固定间隔处买入，比如每下跌1点或2点买一次，而这些位置常常正好是那些低1、低2信号K线的低点。记住，在强多头趋势中，低1和低2信号并不存在，它们只是陷阱。强多头趋势中的顶部，大约有80%的情况会变成牛旗。强空头趋势中的情形正好相反：在高1和高2信号K线的高点处或其上方做空，往往是一套好策略。


> In a strong bull trend, you cannot be looking to short a low 1 or a low 2, especially when the signal bar is weak. When there is a pause bar or a weak bear bar, many traders will step aside and wait until the market trades below that bar to buy. This creates a mini sell vacuum. Buying at or below the low of that bar is often a good trade with the expectation of a high 1 or high 2 trigger several ticks higher. Other traders will buy at fixed intervals below the high of the spike, like one or two points down, and this often coincides with the low of those low 1 and low 2 signal bars. Remember, in a strong bull trend, low 1 and low 2 signals do not exist and are only traps. Tops in strong bull trends become bull flags in about 80 percent of the cases. The opposite is true in strong bear trends, where shorting at or above the highs of high 1 and high 2 signal bars is often a good strategy.


如果你是在做反转交易入场，尤其是在交易区间里，途中经常会有回调，往往就在入场后一两根K线之内出现。如果你对自己的价格行为解读有把握，就可以反向操作这些回调。它们通常是低1、低2，或高1、高2的建仓形态，而你认为它们会失败。例如，如果在交易区间日中出现一个楔形底部，而你买入这次向上反转，你可以预期楔形的低点能够守住。你相信趋势现在已经向上，所以你想买入回调。回调可以小到只有一根K线。因为往上很可能会有两段行情，所以第一段下跌不该走得很远。那个低1做空应当会失败，变成新多头行情段中的一次回调，因为接下来10根或更多K线的趋势已经反转向上了。低1做空唯一可靠的时候是在强空头趋势的急速阶段，而在反转形态之后从来都不可靠。那个低1做空入场很可能跌不到楔形的低点之下，反而会在向上的两段式修正中形成一个小的更高的低点。正因如此，你可以在那根做空信号K线的低点处、或低点下方一至三个最小报价单位处挂限价买单，预期会形成一个小小的更高的低点，而不是一次能赚钱的低1做空。在 Emini 小型合约上，你通常只需要冒四个最小报价单位的风险。


> If you are taking a reversal entry, especially in a trading range, there are frequently pullbacks along the way, often within a bar or two of entering. If you are confident in your reading of the price action, you can fade those pullbacks. These are usually low or high 1 or 2 setups that you believe will fail. For example, if there is a wedge bottom on a trading range day and you buy the reversal up, you can expect the low of the wedge to hold. You believe that the trend is now up, so you want to buy pullbacks. A pullback can be as small as a single bar. Since there will probably be two legs up, the first leg down should not go far. That low 1 short should fail and become a pullback in the new bull leg because the trend for the next 10 or more bars has reversed to up. The only time that a low 1 short is reliable is in the spike phase of a strong bear trend, and never after a reversal pattern. That low 1 short entry will likely fail to fall below the low of the wedge and will instead form a small higher low in the two-legged correction up. Because of that, you can place a limit order to buy at the low or one to three ticks below the low of that short signal bar, expecting a small higher low to form instead of a profitable low 1 short. You usually can risk as few as four ticks in the Emini.


随着向上反转继续推进，你可能会想，也许会出现一个低2做空建仓形态。但是，既然你认为趋势已经反转为多头趋势，你就预期那个低2也会失败，随后价格还会更高。你仍然处在“买入回调”的模式里，而这可以包括像低2这样的小幅回调。这里同样，你可以在低2信号K线的低点处或其下方挂限价买单，在 Emini 小型合约上冒大约四个最小报价单位的风险。你预期这面熊旗向下突破不了几个最小报价单位，反而会继续向上磨成一个多头通道。这是一种末端旗形，因为它就是这轮空头趋势的最后一面旗。空头把它看作熊旗，但当他们无法把它向下突破熊市信号K线超过一两个最小报价单位时，这面旗就会继续向上、向右生长，直到交易者意识到它已经变成一个多头通道。到某个时刻，当足够多的交易者意识到发生了什么，空头就会回补，通常会先出现一次向上突破，然后是一段向上的等距运动。一旦空头认为市场要么已经到达交易区间的顶部，要么多头趋势正在反转向下，他们就会去找高1和高2信号K线，并在这些K线的高点处或略上方挂限价单做空。他们想卖出上涨，哪怕是像高1、高2这样非常小的上涨。多头则会在交易区间的底部寻找低1、低2入场，并在空头趋势的底部、当他们觉得市场正在反转进入一段多头波段时，也寻找这类入场。


> As the reversal up continues, you might think that a low 2 short setup could form.
