However, since you believe that the trend has reversed into a bull trend, you expect that low 2 to fail as well and be followed by higher prices. You are still in the buy pullbacks mode, and that can include a small pullback, like a low 2. Here again you can place a limit order to buy at or below the low of the low 2 signal bar and risk about four ticks in the Emini. You are expecting this bear flag to fail to break out more than a few ticks, and instead to continue to work up into a bull channel. This is a type of final flag because it is the final flag of the bear trend. The bears thought of it as a bear flag, but when they are not able to break it below the bear signal bar by more than a tick or two, the flag will continue to grow up and to the right until traders realize that it has become a bull channel. At some point, when enough traders realize what is happening, the bears will cover and there will usually be an upside breakout and then a measured move up. Once the bears believe that either the market has reached the top of a trading range or the bull trend is in the process of reversing down, they will look for high 1 and high 2 signal bars and place limit orders to short at or just above the highs of those bars. They are looking to sell rallies, even very small ones like a high 1 or a high 2. Bulls will look to buy low 1 and low 2 entries at the bottom of a trading range, and at the bottom of a bear trend when they feel that the market is in the process of reversing into a bull swing.


如第三本书中关于趋势反转的那一章所讨论的，大多数顶部在某种意义上都是双顶，并且都包含一次失败的高1、高2或三角形突破，而这个高1、高2或三角形随后就成了这轮上涨中的末端牛旗。当向上的行情段和顶部都很小时，这个双顶就是微型双顶。当交易者预期会发生反转时，他们会在牛旗的信号K线处及其上方挂限价卖单，预期它会失败。底部通常来自一次失败的低1、低2或三角形突破，由此形成空头行情段中的末端旗形。当双底仅仅用几根K线就形成时，那就是微型双底。预期这面旗会失败并带来向上反转的交易者，会在做空信号K线的低点处及其下方挂限价买单。


> As discussed in the chapter on trend reversals in the third book, most tops are some form of double top and involve a failed high 1, high 2, or triangle breakout, and that high 1, high 2, or triangle then becomes the final bull flag in the rally. When the leg up and top are small, the double top is a micro double top. When traders are anticipating a reversal, they will place sell limit orders at and above the signal bar for the bull flag, expecting it to fail. A bottom usually comes from a failed low 1, low 2, or triangle breakout, creating the final flag in the bear leg. When the double bottom forms over only a few bars, it is a micro double bottom. Traders expecting the flag to fail and lead to a reversal up will place limit orders to buy at and below the low of the sell signal bar.


回到刚才那个楔形底部：如果它以一根大号的多头反转K线收尾，随后又出现一根带小影线的强多头趋势K线，那么走出两段式上涨的可能性就很大。如果接下来那根K线是一根小阳线或一根十字星K线，那么无论处于什么情形，这都是一个疲弱的低1做空建仓形态；而在一个可能的楔形底部之后，它尤其不太可能带来一笔赚钱的做空。至少，空头应当等待一个低2，但如果趋势已经反转，那个低2很可能也会失败。聪明的多头会看到这个疲弱的低1建仓形态，并预期它无法让空头赚到一次剥头皮的利润；他们会在那根K线的低点处、或再低几个最小报价单位处挂限价买单，在 Emini 小型合约上冒大约六个最小报价单位的风险。交易者在所有市场中一直这么做，而限价单和保护性止损的位置取决于具体的市场。例如，假设谷歌（GOOG）近来的平均日区间一直是10美元；如果在5分钟图上从一个空头楔形向上反转，而头几根K线从低点已经向上延伸了3美元，交易者可能会挂一张限价买单，买在第一段行情高点下方约1.50美元、也就是大约回落50%的位置，也许还低于低1信号K线50美分甚至1美元，然后再冒1.50或2.00美元的风险，或者把止损放到楔形低点下方。


> Going back to that wedge bottom, if it ends with a large bull reversal bar and then there is a second strong bull trend bar with small tails, the odds of a two-legged rally are good. If the next bar is a small bull bar or a doji bar, then this is a weak setup for a low 1 short in any circumstance, and after a possible wedge bottom, it is especially likely to not lead to a profitable short. At a minimum, bears should wait for at least a low 2, but if the trend has reversed, that will also likely fail. Smart bulls will see the weak low 1 setup and expect it to fail to yield a scalper's profit for the shorts; they will place a limit order to buy at the low of the bar or maybe a few ticks lower, and risk maybe six ticks in the Emini. Traders do this in all markets all the time, and the locations of the limit order and protective stop depend on the market. For example, suppose the average daily range in Google (GOOG) has been $10 lately; if there is a reversal up from a bear wedge on the 5 minute chart and those first few bars extend $3 off the low, a trader might place a limit order to buy about 50 percent down at maybe $1.50 below the top of the first leg and maybe 50 cents or even a dollar below the low 1 signal bar, and then risk another $1.50 or $2.00, or to below the low of the wedge.


在某些铁丝网形态和小的交易区间里，用限价单入场也可能是有效的——那里K线较大、彼此大部分重叠，整个形态基本是横向的。这种做法有风险，需要快速决策，只有最优秀、最有经验的交易者才应该尝试。


> Entering on limit orders can also be effective in some barbwire patterns and in small trading ranges, where the bars are large and mostly overlapping and the pattern is largely horizontal. This is risky and requires quick decision making, and only the best and most experienced traders should attempt it.


交易者习惯性地用限价单和市价单反向操作各种通道，在顶部做空、在底部反手做多。最安全的通道，是一个支撑与阻力界定清晰、并且已经被测试过多次的交易区间。由于假突破很常见，那些在上方阻力线做空、或在下方支撑线买入、以反向操作极值测试的交易者，会把保护性止损放在足够远的线外，好容许一次突破失败的发生，之后市场才会朝他们的方向反转、去测试区间的另一侧。交易者在趋势通道里也这么做。例如，如果存在一个多头趋势通道，当市场触及或接近趋势通道线时，他们会用市价单或限价单做空，并会在通道内最近一个摆动高点上方做空，随着市场继续走高分批建仓。在一天的最后几个小时里，这不是一套好策略，因为太常出现的情况是：你时间不够用了，只能亏损回补一个很大的空头头寸。


> Traders routinely fade all types of channels with limit and market orders, shorting at the top and reversing to long at the bottom. The safest channel is a trading range with clearly defined support and resistance that has been tested several times. Since false breakouts are common, traders who fade a test of the extremes by shorting at the resistance line above or buying at the support line below put their protective stops far enough beyond the line to allow for a failed breakout before the market reverses in their direction and tests the opposite side of the range. Traders do this in trend channels as well. For example, if there is a bull trend channel, they will short at the market or with a limit order when the market touches or gets close to the trend channel line, and they will short above the most recent swing high in the channel and scale in as the market goes higher. This is not a good strategy for the final couple of hours of the day because you will too often run out of time and have to cover a large short position for a loss.


多头会在市场测试通道底部的趋势线时用市价单或限价单买入，并把保护性止损放在线下足够远的位置，好容许价格对这条线有一次小的过靶。他们还会在前一根K线的低点处或其下方挂限价买单。由于他们是顺势交易，他们更可能把仓位持成波段、并在随后的建仓形态上加仓。在多头通道里，你不该去寻找低1、低2、低3或低4建仓形态，因为那些建仓形态只存在于空头趋势和交易区间中。如果你在多头趋势中看到这样一个形态，既然它多半会失败、并打掉上方的保护性买入止损，那么做相反方向的交易更合理。与其试图在前一根K线的低点下方做空，不如在那根K线处或其下方挂限价买单。你会在那些空头做空的地方买入；既然他们多半会亏，你多半会赢。


> Bulls will buy at the market or with a limit order on a test of the trend line at the bottom of the channel, and they will place a protective stop far enough below the line to allow for a small overshoot of the line. They will also buy with a limit order at or below the low of the prior bar. Since they are trading with the trend, they are more likely to swing their positions up and add on at subsequent setups. In a bull channel, you should not be looking for low 1, 2, 3, or 4 setups, because those are setups only in bear trends and trading ranges. If you see one in a bull trend, since the odds are that it will fail and hit the protective buy stop above, it makes more sense to take the opposite trade. Instead of looking to short below the low of the prior bar, place a limit order to buy at or below that bar. You will be buying where those bears will be shorting, and since they will likely lose, you will likely win.


如果通道内存在幅度更大的波段，比如处在趋势型通道或楼梯形态中，那么双向成交会更强，因此反向操作通道顶部和底部就是更可靠的交易。如果交易者使用的仓位足够小、以便在市场相对初次入场继续不利运行时还能分批建仓，那么所有的通道反向操作都特别可靠。例如，如果市场处在空头通道中，你可以在每一个此前的摆动低点下方挂限价买单，并打算在再低一点的位置加仓，使用较宽的止损。如果市场在第一次入场之后就到达你的止盈目标，你就止盈。反之，如果趋势继续、你的第二张限价单也成交了，你可以在第一次入场的价格处把两个仓位一起平掉。这样你的第一次入场大致保本出场，第二次入场则带着利润出场。对分批建仓做逆势交易的交易者来说，有一个重要的前提：当出现第二次对你不利的动作时，你应当离场，或者反手做顺势方向。这意味着，如果你正在多头趋势中分批建空，就要在高2处离场、甚至反手做多，尤其是当高2出现在移动平均线附近时。同样，当你在空头趋势中分批做多、而市场构筑出一个低2时，尤其是这个低2出现在移动平均线附近时，如果低2被触发，就离场、甚至反手做空。


> If there are broader swings within the channel, like in a trending channel or stairs pattern, there is even stronger two-sided trading, so fading the top and bottom of the channel are even more reliable trades. All channel fading is especially reliable if a trader trades a small enough size to be able to scale in if the market goes further against the initial entry. For example, if the market is in a bear channel, you can buy on a limit order below each prior swing low and look to add on a little lower, using a wide stop. If the market reaches your profit target after the first entry, you take your profit. If instead the trend continues and your second limit order is also filled, you can exit both positions at the entry price of your first entry. You will then get out of your first entry at around breakeven and out of your second entry with a profit. There is one important caveat for traders who scale into countertrend trades, and that is that you should exit or reverse to the with-trend direction on the second move against you. This means that if you are scaling into shorts in a bull trend, exit or even reverse to long on a high 2, especially if it is near the moving average. Similarly, when scaling into longs in a bear trend and it sets up a low 2, especially if it is near the moving average, exit or even reverse to short if the low 2 triggers.


在 Emini 小型合约上做剥头皮，通常需要市场越过信号K线走出六个最小报价单位的行情，才能剥到四个最小报价单位的利润。这是因为入场止损单挂在K线之外一个最小报价单位处，然后你还需要四个最小报价单位来获取利润，而你的止盈限价单通常要等市场越过你的挂单价格一个最小报价单位才会成交。有时市场没有穿过你的挂单价格就让你成交了，但这种情况发生时，市场通常很强，很可能在你成交后几分钟内就走到那个价格之外。同样，要在 QQQ 上剥10个最小报价单位，你通常需要12个最小报价单位的行情。


> A scalper in the Eminis usually needs a six-tick move beyond the signal bar to scalp four ticks of profit. This is because the entry stop is one tick beyond the bar, and then you need four more ticks for your profit, and your profit target limit order usually won't get filled unless the market moves one tick beyond your order. Sometimes your order will get filled without the market moving through it, but when that happens, the market is usually strong and will likely move beyond that price within a few minutes of your fill. Similarly, to scalp 10 ticks in the QQQ, you usually need a 12-tick move.


当某个建仓形态看上去疲弱时，最好的做法是不做它，等下一个机会。如果它疲弱，多半会失败，你不该去冒没有必要的风险。疲弱的建仓形态常常会有一次二次入场，而在那种情况下，它就变成了一个强劲的建仓形态。


> When a setup looks weak, it is best to not take it and to wait for another opportunity. If it is weak, it will likely fail, and you should not take needless risk. Often a weak setup will have a second entry, in which case it becomes a strong setup.


交易者也可以在价格回调到突破区域时用限价单入场——前提是他们认为那次突破很强，并预期这次测试会成功。突破回测的存在，是为了看看交易者是否会在他们此前入场的位置再度入场。例如，如果在5分钟 Emini 小型合约上，空头波段末端旗形之后以一根强多头反转K线向上反转，而且这轮上涨持续了几个小时，那么市场常常会向下测试到那根多头信号K线的高点一两个最小报价单位之内。交易者当初在那根K线上方大举买入，现在市场正回测到那个价位。如果多头趋势很强，买方会在同一个价格区域回来，多头波段将重新启动。许多机构习惯性地在那个价位挂着限价单和市价单，这对交易者来说提供了极佳的风险回报比。他们可能只需要冒四到六个最小报价单位的风险，却有高于50%的机会赚到4个点或更多。相关示例见第5章关于突破失败、突破回调和突破回测的内容。


> Traders can also enter on limit orders on pullbacks to breakout areas if they believe that the breakout was strong and they expect that test to be successful. Breakout tests exist to see if traders will enter again where they entered earlier. For example, if the 5 minute Emini reversed up with a strong bull reversal bar after a final flag in a bear swing and the rally lasted for a couple of hours, it is common for the market to test down to within a tick or two of the high of that bull signal bar. Traders bought aggressively above that bar, and now the market is testing back down to that price level. If the bull trend is strong, buyers will return at that same price area and the bull swing will resume. Many institutions routinely have limit and market orders at that level, and it provides an excellent risk/reward ratio for traders. They might have to risk only four to six ticks and they might have better than a 50 percent chance of making four or more points. For examples, see Chapter 5 on failed breakouts, breakout pullbacks, and breakout tests.


尽管大多数交易都应该用止损单入场，但当存在强趋势时，任何时候入场都是安全的；而在股票上，用限价单在移动平均线处入场尤其好，因为股票往往走势规矩。这样可以做到风险更小、潜在回报更大，而胜率基本不变。在多头趋势中，交易者常常把止损放在最近一个更高的低点下方，所以买入回调意味着他们的保护性止损更小。同样，在空头趋势中，交易者常常把保护性止损放在最近一个更低的高点上方，并在回调中做空。


> Although most trades should be entered on stops, when there is a strong trend it is safe to enter anytime, and entering at the moving average on a limit order is particularly good in stocks, which tend to be well behaved. This allows for a smaller risk and greater potential reward and essentially no change in the winning percentage. In a bull trend, traders often risk to below the most recent higher low, so buying a pullback means that their protective stop is smaller. Similarly, in a bear trend, traders often put their protective stops above the most recent lower high and short on pullbacks.


![图 28.1](figures/fig-28-01.jpg)


**图 28.1　限价单入场**


图 28.1的走势图展示了几笔用限价单入场的好交易。涨向第3根K线的那段行情很强，市场恰好在移动平均线下方停顿，而移动平均线是一个磁力位。市场离得足够近，已经处在移动平均线的磁力吸引范围之内。由于第3根K线是一根十字星，因此在一次强劲上涨之后它是做空的糟糕信号K线，市场很可能不会下跌多远，就会再度上冲去测试移动平均线。激进的多头本可以在第3根K线处或略下方挂限价单买入，博一次对移动平均线的测试，也许冒六个最小报价单位的风险。


> The chart in Figure 28.1 shows several examples of good trades with limit order entries. The move up to bar 3 was strong and the market was pausing just below the moving average, which is a magnet. The market was close enough to be within the magnetic pull of the moving average. Since bar 3 was a doji and therefore a bad signal bar for a short after a strong up move, the market would likely not go down far before it pushed up again to test the moving average. Aggressive bulls could have bought at or just below bar 3 with a limit order for a test of the moving average, maybe risking six ticks.


在第5根K线测试移动平均线之后，市场很可能会走出一段横盘到向下的修正。机敏的交易者看到，多头没能走出连续强劲的多头趋势K线。这提高了他们做空的意愿。第5根K线是一根阴线，测试的是移动平均线的底部。由于它出现在第二次买入高潮之后（这次高潮由当日第1根和第3根K线构成，它们都是大号多头趋势K线），接下来很可能会走出两段横盘到向下的行情。因此，在第6根K线的高点处或上方一个最小报价单位处挂限价单做空，是一笔风险回报比很好的交易。一些多头认为很可能会出现高2买入信号，于是他们在第5根K线的低点处及其下方挂限价买单。然而，考虑到最近这些K线双向成交的特征，这是一套有风险的策略。另一些交易者看到第5根K线的空头收盘，预期在移动平均线处会出现低2做空信号。就在第5根K线收盘之后，他们用市价单做空，或在第5根K线的收盘价处挂限价单做空。


> After the bar 5 test of the moving average, the market was likely to correct sideways to down. Astute traders saw that the bulls were unable to create consecutive strong bull trend bars. This increased their willingness to go short. Bar 5 was a bear bar test of the bottom of the moving average. Since it was after a second buy climax (formed by the first and third bars of the day, which were large bull trend bars), two legs sideways to down were likely to follow. Therefore, shorting on a limit order at the bar 6 high or one tick above was a good risk/reward trade. Some bulls thought that a high 2 buy signal was likely so they placed limit orders to buy at and below the low of bar 5. However, given the two-sided nature of the recent bars, this was a risky strategy. Other traders saw the bear close on bar 5 and anticipated a low 2 short signal at the moving average. Just after bar 5 closed, they shorted at the market or on a limit order at the close of bar 5.


当市场从移动平均线处崩塌下行时，交易者在那三根大号趋势K线的收盘价处做空，并在阴线形成过程中对小幅回调做空。例如，许多人在最近一个低点上方一个、两个或三个最小报价单位处挂着限价卖单。


> As the market collapsed down from the moving average, traders shorted the closes of the three large trend bars, and they shorted on small pullbacks as the bear bars were forming. For example, many had limit orders to short one, two, or three ticks above the most recent low.


从第1根K线到第5根K线的开盘区间，大约只有平均日区间的一半；因此当市场跌破第1根K线之后，一些交易者会去参考等距运动目标位，以寻找当日可能的低点。第8根K线的低点，正好是从第1根K线的开盘价到第5根K线高点的等距下跌目标位。交易者知道，此时当日的开盘价正好处在当日区间的正中间，而市场在收盘前可能会尝试回测到开盘价。这会在日线图上留下一根十字星K线，其开盘价和收盘价都位于当日区间的中部。如果市场能够重新上涨到高点，这一天就会变成一根多头反转交易日。一些多头愿意在等距运动目标位上方一个最小报价单位处挂限价单做多，然后持有到价格测试开盘价为止。成功回测到当日开盘价的机会大概在30%到40%。他们可以把保护性止损放在大约2点之外，然后等着看情况怎么发展。由于抛售正在失去动能，很可能会有足够多的止盈盘让市场在他们的保护性止损被打掉之前先反弹一下。如果市场跌到他们的入场价之下但没有触及止损，而他们觉得自己的交易前提已不再成立，本可以在保本位置离场。一旦市场走出向上两K线反转，他们本可以把保护性止损移到保本位，然后耐心地等这轮上涨是否展开——事实上它展开了。


> The opening range from bar 1 to bar 5 was about half the size of an average day's range, so once the market broke below bar 1, some traders would have looked at measured move targets for a possible low of the day. The bar 8 low was an exact measured move down from the open of bar 1 to the high of bar 5. Traders knew that the open of the day at this point was in the exact middle of the day's range, and that the market might try to test back up to the open before the close. This would create a doji bar on the daily chart with both the open and the close in the middle of the day. If the market could rally back up to the high, the day would become a bull reversal day. Some bulls were willing to go long on a limit order at one tick above the measured move target and then hold for a test of the open. The chance of a successful test of the open of the day was probably 30 percent to 40 percent. They could have used a protective stop of maybe a couple of points, and then they could have waited to see what happened. Since the sell-off was losing momentum, the odds were good that there would be enough profit takers for the market to bounce before their protective stops were hit. If the market fell below their entry price but did not hit their stops, they could have exited at breakeven if they felt that their premise was no longer valid. Once the market had the two-bar reversal up, they could have moved their protective stops to breakeven and then they could have waited patiently to see if the rally developed, which it did.


跌向第8根K线的那段空头急速行情中，有连续七根空头趋势K线。把这看作强势信号的交易者，可能会在大概高1到4点的位置挂限价单分批建空。然而，他们需要考虑一种可能：这段空头急速行情是一次衰竭性的卖出高潮。只要有任何疑虑，交易者就不该在市场上涨时用限价单卖出，因为这轮上涨可能持续至少10根K线和两段行情，而且它可能是向上反转的开始，尤其是在当前这种情况下。单有一段强劲的空头急速行情，还不足以构成用限价单卖出上涨的理由。交易者必须看这段空头急速行情所处的背景。


> The bear spike down to bar 8 had seven consecutive bear trend bars. Traders who saw this as a sign of strength might have placed limit orders to scale into shorts at maybe one to four points higher. However, they needed to consider the possibility that the bear spike was an exhaustive sell climax. When there is any doubt, a trader should not be selling on limit orders as the market is rallying, because the rally might last for at least 10 bars and two legs, and it could be the start of a reversal up, especially under the current circumstances. A strong bear spike alone is not enough of a reason to sell a rally on a limit order. Traders have to look at the context of the bear spike.


低点处的那个窄幅交易区间是一个很好的例子，说明理解交易的数学能够带来一笔极好的交易。这个区间太窄，不适合用止损单入场做剥头皮。当区间窄成这样时，你休想靠“在某根K线上方买入、在某根K线下方做空”来持续地做出赚钱的剥头皮。不过，对波段交易者来说这里有一个极好的机会。这一天是一个趋势性交易区间日；如果它向上突破这个窄幅交易区间，那么它大约有70%的机会去测试上面那个区间在第1根K线低点处的底部。一旦向上越过第11根K线的行情确立了双底牛旗，多头就会守住它的低点。因此，在它上方一个最小报价单位处挂限价单买入、冒它下方一到两个最小报价单位的风险，是一笔风险回报比很好的交易。你的限价单本会在第12根K线成交——那根K线精确到一个最小报价单位地再次测试了第10根和第11根K线构成的双底。你冒大约三个最小报价单位的风险，去赚至少4点、一直到第1根K线低点的空间，甚至如果市场反转向上、测试上面那个区间的高点（它确实这么走了），可以赚到大约12点。由于你是在一个窄幅交易区间的底部买入，你有60%的机会看到价格测试该区间的顶部。然而，你需要一次成功的向上突破，而窄幅交易区间向任一方向突破的概率都是50比50。所以在你买入的那一刻，你有50%的机会赚到4点或更多，而承担的风险不到1点。这是一笔极好的风险回报比交易，但只有那些理解数学的交易者才能这样看待它。


> The tight trading range at the low was a good example of how understanding the mathematics of trading can lead to a great trade. The range was too tight to be scalping with stop entries. You cannot buy above a bar or short below a bar and expect to consistently make profitable scalps when the range is this tight. However, there is a great opportunity for swing traders. The day was a trending trading range day and if it broke above the tight trading range, it would have had about a 70 percent chance of testing the bottom of the upper range at the bar 1 low. Once the double bottom bull flag was established by the move above bar 11, the bulls would defend its low. Therefore, buying one tick above it on a limit order and risking one or two ticks below it was a good risk/reward trade. Your limit order would have been filled on bar 12, which retested the bars 10 and 11 double bottom to the tick. You were risking about three ticks to make at least four points to the bar 1 low, or even about 12 points if the market reversed up and tested the high of the upper range, which it did. Since you were buying at the bottom of a tight trading range, you had a 60 percent chance of a test of the top of the range. However, you needed a successful upside breakout, and the chance of a breakout in either direction of a tight trading range is 50–50. So at the time of your purchase, you had a 50 percent chance of making four or more points while risking less than one point. This was a great risk/reward trade, but only traders who understood the math would have been able to see it that way.


一旦市场开始在第13根和第14根K线处形成更高的低点，你就可以把保护性止损移到最近一个更高的低点下方一个最小报价单位处。在第13根和第14根K线的测试、以及随后第16根K线的突破回调之后，至少走出4点行情的概率从大约50%升到了70%。到那时，你已经锁定了几点利润，并且有70%的机会赚到至少4点，也许还有50%的机会让市场一直涨到上面那个交易区间的顶部。在五根多头趋势K线于第16根K线处发动突破之后，市场至少有60%的机会走出一段向上的等距运动，因为在出现强劲急速行情式突破时这是典型情况。这段等距运动的测算方式是：以第16根K线之后那根K线的开盘价到急速行情第三根K线的收盘价的距离，加到那第三根K线的收盘价上。急速行情中最强的实体部分，往往能带来一段等距运动。这意味着你有60%的机会再赚大约5点。你本可以把保护性止损放在急速行情的底部，这样可以保护住大约2点的浮动利润。


> Once the market started forming higher lows at bars 13 and 14, you could have trailed your protective stop to one tick below the most recent higher low. After the tests at bars 13 and 14 and then the breakout pullback at bar 16, the odds of at least a four-point move went up from maybe 50 percent to 70 percent. At that point, you had locked in a couple of ticks of profit and had a 70 percent chance of making at least four points, and maybe a 50 percent chance of the market going up to the top of the upper trading range. After the five bull trend bars started a breakout at bar 16, the market had at least a 60 percent chance of reaching a measured move up because that is typical when there is a strong spike breakout. The measured move would be based on the open of the bar after bar 16 to the close of the third bar of the spike and adding that to the close of that third bar. The strongest bodies of a spike often lead to a measured move. This meant that you had a 60 percent chance of making about another five points. You would have put your protective stop at the bottom of the spike, which would have protected about two points of your open profit.


第17根K线是一段强多头急速行情中的一根空头反转K线。多头预期市场在一根或两根K线的回调之后会形成一个成功的高1买入建仓形态。然而，那个买入信号K线的高点很可能高于第17根K线这根卖出信号K线的低点，所以激进的多头就在第17根K线的低点买入。第17根K线之后那根K线是一根阳线，向上的趋势很强。如果它之后的那根K线是一根空头趋势K线（它确实是），就会构成一个两K线反转做空形态。由于多头趋势很强，激进的多头本会在这根阳线的低点处挂限价买单。他们本会预期：即使阴线跌到那根阳线的低点之下，这个两K线反转做空也不会跌到两K线反转顶部的两根K线之下、从而在第18根K线处被触发。


> Bar 17 was a bear reversal bar in a strong bull spike. Bulls expected that the market would form a successful high 1 buy setup after a one-or two-bar pullback. However, the high of that buy signal bar was likely to be higher than the low of the bar 17 sell signal bar, so aggressive bulls bought at the low of bar 17. The bar after bar 17 was a bull bar and the trend up was strong. If the bar after it was a bear trend bar, and it was, it would set up a two-bar reversal short. Since the bull trend was strong, aggressive bulls would have placed buy limit orders at the low of the bull bar. They would have expected that if the bear bar traded below the low of the bull bar, the two-bar reversal short would not fall below both bars of the two-bar reversal top and trigger on bar 18.


由于在涨向第17根K线的过程中市场明显处在始终做多状态，而第18根K线之前那根阴线是第二次尝试向下反转，许多多头认为市场很快会恢复上涨。他们不相信会有后续行情，于是第18根K线一开盘，他们就在前一根K线（那根空头趋势K线）的收盘价处挂限价买单。


> Since the market was clearly always-in long on the rally to bar 17 and the bear bar just before bar 18 was the second attempt to reverse down, many bulls thought that the market would soon resume up. They doubted that there would be follow-through, and as soon as bar 18 opened, they placed limit orders to buy at the close of the prior bar (the bear trend bar).


![图 28.2](figures/fig-28-02.jpg)


**图 28.2　清淡交易日的限价单入场**


在12月下旬的清淡交易中，用限价单入场往往是最好的做法。在图 28.2中，跌向第6根K线的抛售带有买压迹象，比如第4根K线那根阳线，以及K线下影线不断变大。因此这并不是一段强空头急速行情，所以跌向第7根K线的低1突破很可能会失败。由于第6根K线同时还处在两日扩张三角形的底部、并向下刺穿了一条长达两周的多头趋势线，交易者正在寻找决斗线买入建仓形态。激进的多头在第7根K线向下跌破iii形态时买入，更保守的交易者则在它的高点上方买入。


> During quiet trading in late December, entering on limit orders is often the best approach. In Figure 28.2, the sell-off down to bar 6 had signs of buying pressure, like the bar 4 bull bar and the increasing size of the tails at the bottoms of the bars. This was therefore not a strong bear spike and consequently the low 1 breakout to bar 7 was likely to fail. Since bar 6 was also at the bottom of a two-day expanding triangle and a poke below a two-week-long bull trend line, traders were looking for a dueling lines buy setup. Aggressive bulls bought during bar 7 as it broke below the iii pattern, and more conservative traders bought above its high.


到第8根K线之前那根多头突破K线收盘时，大多数交易者已经把市场看作始终做多，因此他们在寻找买入回调的机会。由于涨向第8根K线的行情处在多头微型通道中，他们相信第一次跌破前一根K线低点的突破会失败、变成一个空头陷阱，尽管有些交易者把它看作移动平均线附近的低2做空。这些多头本会在前一根K线的低点处及其下方挂限价买单，而这些单子会在第8根K线之后那根K线成交。


> Most traders saw the market as always-in long by the close of the bull breakout bar before bar 8 and were therefore looking to buy pullbacks. Since the move up to bar 8 was in a bull micro channel, they believed that the first breakout below the low of the prior bar would fail and become a bear trap, even though some traders saw it as a low 2 short near the moving average. These bulls would have placed buy limit orders to buy at and below the low of the prior bar, and they would have been filled on the bar after bar 8.


由于第8根K线之前那根K线把市场翻转为始终做多，多头希望市场能守在第8根K线之前那根K线的高点之上。有些人在那根K线的高点上方一个最小报价单位处挂限价买单，并在第8根K线之后那根十字星K线上成交。有些人只会冒两个最小报价单位的风险。另一些人会使用更宽的保护性止损，还有些人会在更低的位置加仓。尽管用两个最小报价单位止损时的成功概率可能只有30%到40%，但潜在回报是自这个测量缺口起的一段向上等距运动，或者至少是六个最小报价单位的利润。现实的坏情况是赚六个最小报价单位、成功概率30%——这在数学上是一套不赚不赔的策略；最好的情况则可能是成功概率60%、赚10或12个最小报价单位。这是一个极好的结果。由于实际结果很可能落在两者之间、数学期望因此依然不错，所以这是一个合理的买入建仓形态。这段假日交易期间的平均日区间只有大约5到6点。由于市场一年中只有少数几天的区间小于5点，今天的区间本应至少扩大到那么大。


> Since the bar before bar 8 flipped the market to always-in long, bulls wanted the market to hold above the high of the bar before bar 8. Some placed buy limit orders at one tick above the high of that bar, and they were filled on the doji bar after bar 8. Some would have risked just two ticks. Others would have used a wider protective stop, and some would have added on lower. Even though the probability of success using a two-tick stop might have been only 30 to 40 percent, the potential reward was for a measured move up from this measuring gap, or at least a six-tick profit. The realistic worst case was a six-tick profit and a 30 percent chance of success, which is a breakeven strategy, and the best case was maybe a 60 percent chance of success and a 10- or 12-tick profit. This is an excellent result. Since the actual outcome was probably going to be somewhere in between and the math was therefore still good, this was a reasonable buy setup. The average daily range during this holiday trading was only about five to six points. Since the market has only a few days a year with a range less than five points, today's range should have become at least that large.


从第7根K线到第8根K线的那段行情是一个多头微型通道。由于向下跌破多头微型通道的第一次突破通常会失败，多头不断在前一根K线的低点处挂限价买单。他们在第8根K线之后那根K线上成交。


> The move from bar 7 to bar 8 was a bull micro channel. Since the first breakout below a bull micro channel usually fails, bulls kept placing limit orders to buy at the low of the previous bar. They were filled on the bar after bar 8.


这个微型通道继续向上延伸到第9根K线，多头在下一根K线跌破第9根K线时再度成交。有些人会在多头仓位上冒四到八个最小报价单位的风险，另一些人则会分批建仓，在首次入场下方四到六个最小报价单位处买入更多。


> The micro channel continued up to bar 9, and the bulls were filled again on the next bar as it fell below bar 9. Some would have risked four to eight ticks on their longs, but others would have scaled in and bought more around four to six ticks below their first entry.


尽管第11根K线是一个可能的末端旗形做空点、并且创出了更高的高点，但大多数交易者认为向上的动能足够强，不太可能出现一段空头行情。市场要么继续上涨，要么只下跌一点点、形成一个交易区间，然后再去创出新高。由于概率偏向更高的价格，他们愿意在前一根K线的低点处及其下方挂限价买单，并在第11根和第12根K线下方成交。


> Although bar 11 was a possible final flag short and a higher high, most traders assumed that the momentum up was strong enough so that a bear leg was unlikely. Either the market would continue up or it would go down just a little, form a trading range, and then go on to a new high. Because the odds favored higher prices, they were willing to buy on limit orders at and below the low of the prior bar and were filled below bars 11 and 12.


从第14根K线开始的那段两根K线空头急速行情，可能已经让一些交易者把市场视为始终做空，但大多数人会希望看到下一根K线出现强劲的后续抛售，来确认这次向下突破。一旦他们看到下一根K线收成十字星、而不是强劲的空头收盘，他们就在那个收盘价附近用限价单买入。


> The two-bar bear spike down from bar 14 might have flipped the market to always-in short for some traders, but most would have wanted to see strong follow-through selling on the next bar to confirm the breakout to the downside. Once they saw the doji close on the next bar instead of a strong bear close, they bought with limit orders around that close.


市场很可能会去测试第7根到第9根K线那段多头急速行情之后所形成的多头通道在第10根K线处的底部。在那之后，随着市场决定下一步怎么走，很可能出现一个小的交易区间。空头在自第15根K线开始的上涨中做空，止损挂在第14根K线那段空头急速行情顶部上方一个最小报价单位处。机敏的空头在第14根K线高点下方一个最小报价单位处挂限价卖单，保护性止损放在高两个最小报价单位处。他们在第17根K线成交。由于他们的风险只有两个最小报价单位、而且是在交易区间里做空，走出等距运动的机会至少有50%，而在他们的两个最小报价单位止损被打掉之前先下跌四个最小报价单位的机会可能也超过50%。由于这是一个小行情日里的交易区间，这些空头处在剥头皮模式，乐于去赚1个点、也就是四个最小报价单位的利润。他们的潜在回报是风险的两倍，概率至少50%，所以交易者等式很有利。


> The market was likely to test the bar 10 bottom of the bull channel that followed the bar 7 to bar 9 bull spike. After that, a small trading range was likely as the market decided on its next move. Bears were shorting on the move up from bar 15 with a stop at one tick above the top of the bar 14 bear spike. Astute bears placed limit orders to short at one tick below the bar 14 high, with protective stops two ticks higher. They were filled on bar 17. Since their risk was only two ticks and they were shorting in a trading range, the chance of success for an equidistant move was at least 50 percent, and the chance of a four-tick move down before their two-tick stop was hit was probably also more than 50 percent. Since this was a trading range on a small day, these bears were in scalp mode and were happy to go for a one-point, four-tick profit. Their potential reward was twice the size of their risk and the probability was at least 50 percent, so the trader's equation was strong.


到第21根K线时，交易者已经把这看作一个交易区间日，并预期突破尝试都会失败。尽管第22根K线之后那段强劲的空头急速行情很扎眼，但由于没有后续抛售、下一根K线也没有空头收盘，它很可能只是一个空头陷阱，而不是一段引出通道的急速行情。激进的交易者在它的收盘价买入，并在它的低点挂限价单做多。他们还看到，第23根K线是对当日开盘价的测试，也是对第7根K线上方那笔原始多头入场的测试。他们可能为一次向上的波段交易冒大约四个最小报价单位的风险。即使概率只有30%到40%，潜在回报也可能是风险的四到五倍，因此值得考虑。更保守的交易者在第23根K线这根多头反转K线的上方买入，它确认了空头突破已经失败。他们的买点距底部更高，因此潜在回报更小、风险更大，但成功概率的大幅提升足以抵消这些不利之处。


> By bar 21, traders saw this as a trading range day and they expected breakout attempts to fail. Even though the strong bear spike after bar 22 was impressive, without follow-through selling and a bear close on the next bar it was likely to be a bear trap instead of a spike leading to a channel. Aggressive traders bought its close and also went long on a limit order at its low. They also saw that bar 23 was a test of the open of the day and of the original long above bar 7. They might have risked about four ticks for a swing trade up. Even if the probability was only 30 to 40 percent, the potential reward might have been four or five times the risk and therefore worth considering. More conservative traders bought above the bar 23 bull reversal bar that confirmed the failed bear breakout. They were buying higher above the bottom, and therefore their potential reward was less and their risk was more, but the greatly increased probability of success more than offset those problems.


当交易者看到第23根K线之后那根入场K线的强劲收盘时，他们在那根K线的收盘价买入。另一些人等到下一根K线开盘，然后立刻挂限价买单，买在前一根K线的收盘价。当这根下一根K线也成为一根强多头趋势K线时，他们在第24根K线上重复了这一过程。


> When traders saw the strong close of the entry bar after bar 23, they bought on the close of the bar. Others waited until the next bar opened and then immediately placed limit orders to buy the close of the prior bar. When this next bar also became a strong bull trend bar, they repeated the process on bar 24.


到第24根K线收盘时，市场已经处在始终做多状态，所以一些多头会去尝试买入第一根空头收盘，它出现在下一根K线上。然而，市场从未跌到那根阴线的收盘价之下，所以他们的限价单大多数可能都没有成交。这是临近收盘时的一种急迫信号；警觉的多头本还会在那根阴线上方挂止损单做多，因为它是一个突破回调买入建仓形态。许多人不够快，只好在下一根K线中追着市场往上买，在那根K线形成过程中用限价单买入一个或两个最小报价单位的回调。


> The market was always-in long by the close of bar 24, so some bulls would have tried to buy the first bear close, which was on the next bar. However, the market never traded below the close of that bear bar, so most of their limit orders would probably not have been filled. This was a sign of urgency going into the close, and alert bulls would have also placed stop orders to go long above that bear bar because it was a breakout pullback buy setup. Many would not have been fast enough and would have chased the market up during the next bar, buying one-or two-tick pullbacks with limit orders as the bar was forming.


当市场上涨至第13根K线时，趋势明显向上。一些交易者挂限价买单，买斐波那契62% 回调，或任何大约60%到70%的回调，止损放在第6根K线那根阳线的低点下方。他们希望在回报约为风险两倍或更多的地方买入。在回落约三分之二处买入、博一次对多头高点的测试，所冒风险约为三分之一，这样目标位就是风险的两倍，而这总是好事。在他们挂单的时候，趋势是向上的，所以买入回调至少有60%的机会走出等距运动（上涨幅度等于他们止损的幅度），还可能有60%的机会创出新的多头高点（回报是风险的两倍）。用回调入场来降低风险是许多交易者采用的做法，并且拥有很有利的交易者等式。


> As the market was rallying up to bar 13, the trend was clearly up. Some traders placed limit orders to buy a Fibonacci 62 percent pullback, or any pullback of around 60 to 70 percent, with a stop below the bar 6 bull low. They were looking to buy where the reward would be about two or more times greater than the risk. Buying about two-thirds down for a test of the bull high was risking about one-third, making their target twice as large as their risk, which is always good. At the time they placed their orders, the trend was up, so buying a pullback had at least a 60 percent probability of an equidistant move (a move up equal to the size of their stop), and possibly a 60 percent chance of a new bull high (a reward twice as large as their risk). Entering on pullbacks to reduce risk is an approach used by many traders and has a strong trader's equation.


![图 28.3](figures/fig-28-03.jpg)


**图 28.3　限价单建仓形态**


图 28.3展示的这张 SPY 60分钟图里有许多例子，显示机构和交易者几乎可以肯定是用限价单或市价单入场的。第3根K线是空头通道的一次高潮式底部，它是一面牛旗，也是一个可能的扩张三角形底部。第1根K线是第二次向下推进，在它之前那个摆动低点是第一次。在第3根K线的低点之后，交易者如此确信市场在跌向第5根K线这段行情之后会走高，以至于他们在市价买入，并在第4根K线低点上方挂限价买单。每当双底牛旗呈现这个样子，都是因为多头太怕错过新趋势，以至于把订单挂在第4根K线低点上方很多个最小报价单位处，而不是挂在低点处或低点上方一个最小报价单位处。这带来了一段冲向第6根K线的急速行情，随后是延伸到第8根K线的通道。交易者也可以在那个区域用限价单入场，冒大约1点的风险、止损放在第4根K线低点下方，并持有到价格去测试通道中105、108、甚至可能是110处的各个交易区间顶部。这些位置每一个都是一段空头急速行情之后向下通道的起点，它们都是磁力位。交易者冒1点的风险去赚3到7点，概率至少40%，这使这笔交易合乎逻辑。或者，他们本可以在第5根K线的高点上方用止损单入场。这会把成功概率提高到大约60%，因为这样他们买的就是一个已经确认的交易区间底部（双底）。他们的止损放在信号K线下方，大约1点，而第一个止盈目标在高2点处，这同样构成一套稳健的策略。


> This 60 minute chart of the SPY presented in Figure 28.3 shows many examples where institutions and traders almost certainly entered on limit or market orders. Bar 3 was a climactic bottom of a bear channel, which was a bull flag, and a possible expanding triangle bottom. Bar 1 was the second push down, and the swing low that preceded it was the first. After the bar 3 low, traders were so confident that the market was going higher on the leg down to bar 5 that they bought at the market and limit orders above the bar 4 low. Whenever a double bottom bull flag looks like this, it is because the bulls are so afraid of missing the new trend that they put their orders many ticks above the bar 4 low rather than at it or one tick above it. This led to a spike up to bar 6 and then a channel to bar 8. A trader could also have entered with a limit order in that area, risking about a point to below the bar 4 low and holding for a test of the tops of trading ranges in the channel at 105, 108, and maybe even 110. Each of these was the start of a channel down after a bear spike, and they were magnets. Traders were risking one point to make three to seven points and the probability was at least 40 percent, which made this a logical trade. Alternatively, they could have entered on a stop above the high of bar 5. This increased the probability of success to about 60 percent because they were then buying a confirmed bottom of a trading range (a double bottom). Their risk was to below the signal bar, which was about one point, and their first profit target was two points higher, again making for a sound strategy.


第6根K线是一段强多头急速行情的顶部，因此任何回调之后跟随一个更高的高点的机会约为70%。因此许多交易者在其低点下方买入。另一些交易者在第7根K线这个高1的高点上方一个最小报价单位处挂止损单买入。当市场再次测试那个价格区域时，他们在第9根K线买入了一些，但没能把市场推高多少。然而，当第10根K线跌破第7根K线的低点时，多头用限价单、市价单（以及止损单）大举买入。


> Bar 6 was the top of a strong bull spike and therefore the chance of any pullback being followed by a higher high was about 70 percent. Many traders therefore bought below its low. Other traders bought one tick above the bar 7 high 1 on a stop. When the market tested that price area again, they bought some at bar 9 but were not able to lift the market much. However, when bar 10 dipped below the bar 7 low, the bulls bought aggressively on limit and market orders (and stop orders).


第14根K线是对向上突破第11根K线的那次突破的一次小规模突破回测，许多交易者在那个位置用限价单买入，把市场抬了起来。


> Bar 14 was a small breakout test of the breakout above bar 11, and many traders bought there on limit orders, lifting the market.


冲向13的急速行情之后，是延伸到15的通道，然后是16处对通道底部的测试；在那里，市场形成了一个双底牛旗，这在急速与通道式的多头趋势中常常出现。买方再次按他们在第14根K线用过的同一个价格、以市价加限价单买入，由此形成了一个双底牛旗。第16根K线跌破从第5根K线到第10根K线所画的趋势线，许多交易者用市价单和限价单买入这次测试。随后他们重画了趋势线，并在第18根K线测试该线、以及测试到该线下方时，再次用限价单和市价单买入。买方大举回到了同一个价格——他们此前在向上突破第11根K线以及回调至第14根K线时正是在那里买入的。


> The spike up to 13 was followed by the channel to 15 and then the test of the bottom of the channel at 16, where the market created a double bottom bull flag as it often does in a spike and channel bull trend. Buyers again bought at the market using limit orders at the same price as they did at bar 14, and this created a double bottom bull flag. Bar 16 dipped below the trend line from bar 5 to bar 10, and many traders bought this test at the market and with limit orders. They then redrew the trend line and bought again with limit and market orders when bar 18 tested it and tested below it. The buyers aggressively returned at the same price where they had bought on the breakout above bar 11 and the pullback to bar 14.


第17根K线是一个决斗线做空建仓形态，因为横跨楔形顶部的趋势通道线正处在第2根K线高点所在的区域，而一个主要的摆动高点总是阻力区域。在接下来的几天里，交易者一次次在阻力线下方做空，市场最终跌破了由第17根和第19根K线构成的小双顶；这轮抛售同时也是从楔形顶部和大型双顶（第2根与第19根K线）向下反转的开始。市场在第17根和第19根K线之间形成了一个交易区间，交易者一次次对该区间顶部的测试做空，其中许多人是用限价单做的。


> Bar 17 was a dueling lines short setup because the trend channel line across the top of the wedge was in the area of the bar 2 high, and a major swing high is always a resistance area. Traders repeatedly shorted below the resistance line over the next several days, and the market finally broke below the small double top formed by bars 17 and 19; this sell-off was also the start of the reversal down from the wedge top and large double top (bars 2 and 19). The market formed a trading range between bars 17 and 19, and traders repeatedly shorted tests of the top of the range, many doing so with limit orders.


涨向第8根K线的这段多头急速与通道行情非常强，以至于接下来很可能还有更高的价格。尽管有些交易者一路上用市价单、并在极小的回调处买入，许多交易者只在回调中买入，比如在第9根和第10根K线测试多头通道第7根K线底部的那一区域。他们在市场下跌时用限价单买入，也会在支撑区域中于前一根K线的高点上方用止损单买入。由于趋势向上，除非市场跌破第5根K线处最近那个更高的低点、或者跌破第3根K线那个波段底部，否则在第8根K线的高点下方相当远处买入可以让交易者使用更小的止损，从而降低风险。在跌向第9根或第10根K线的抛售之后，趋势变得不那么确定，一笔赚钱的多头波段交易的概率随之下降；但涨向第8根K线的行情比跌向第9根K线的抛售更强，所以概率仍然偏向上涨。一旦市场急转向上走到第11根K线，多头就把止损提高到了第10根K线的低点下方。跌向第12根K线的抛售很急，但守住了止损位上方。


> The bull spike and channel up to bar 8 was so strong that higher prices were likely to follow. Although some traders buy at the market and on tiny pullbacks all of the way up, many traders only buy on pullbacks, like in the area of the bar 9 and bar 10 test of the bar 7 bottom of the bull channel. They buy on limit orders as the market is falling, as well as on stops above the high of the prior bar in areas of support. Since the trend was up, unless the market fell below the most recent higher low at bar 5, or below the bar 3 bottom of the swing, buying well below the bar 8 high would allow traders to use a smaller stop, reducing their risk. The trend is less certain after the sell-off to bars 9 or 10, reducing the probability of a profitable long swing, but the rally to bar 8 was stronger than the sell-off to bar 9, so the odds still favored the rally. Once the market turned up sharply to bar 11, the bulls raised their stops to below the bar 10 low. The sell-off to bar 12 was sharp, but held above the stop.


![图 28.4](figures/fig-28-04.jpg)


**图 28.4　用限价单反向操作对趋势线的测试**


许多交易者会反向操作对趋势线和趋势通道线的测试，但大多数交易者靠“等市场从这些线反转离开之后再用止损单入场”赚到更多钱。代价是利润略少、但确定性大得多，而这通常构成一个更有利的交易者等式。


> Many traders fade tests of trend lines and trend channel lines, but most traders make more money by entering on stops after the market reverses away from the lines. The trade-off is a little less profit for much more certainty, and this usually makes for a stronger trader's equation.


如图 28.4所示，第6根K线是 Freeport-McMoRan（FCX）上对空头趋势线的一次测试，一些交易者在市场测试这条线时用限价单做空。在第5根K线那处卖出高潮之后的三根K线窄幅交易区间里，这是一套有风险的策略，那里很可能会出现一次两段式修正。市场处在移动平均线的磁力吸引范围内，很可能会更近地去测试它。更好的策略是在移动平均线处第7根K线这个低2的低点下方一个最小报价单位处用止损单做空。


> As shown in Figure 28.4, bar 6 was a test of the bear trend line in Freeport-McMoRan (FCX), and some traders shorted on a limit order as the market tested the line. This was a risky strategy in the three-bar tight trading range after the bar 5 sell climax, which was likely to have a two-legged correction. The market was within the magnetic pull of the moving average and was likely to test closer. A better strategy would have been to short on a stop at one tick below the bar 7 low 2 at the moving average.


在测试从第9根到第10根K线所画的空头趋势线时，交易者也用限价单做空。更好的策略是在一根低2信号K线下方做空，比如第11根K线之后那根K线，但那个空单从未被触发。随后市场在第13根K线处、于移动平均线位置形成了一个楔形熊旗。交易者在移动平均线处和趋势通道线处用限价单做空，但更好的策略是在第13根K线下方、或在一根空头趋势K线（比如第13根K线之前或之后那根K线）下方做空。当交易者看到第11根K线那个更高的低点时，他们就预期任何向上突破某个摆动高点的突破都会失败。有些人在第10根K线上方一个最小报价单位处挂限价卖单。他们还相信会有更多空头在移动平均线下方一个最小报价单位处做空，而几乎没有多头会去买那次向上突破第10根K线摆动高点的突破。大多数反转空头趋势的尝试都会失败，并变成熊旗。这些激进的空头在熊旗的顶部做空，他们相信这样的高价不会持续多久。另一些人则在市场跌破第12根K线那根多头趋势K线时入场，预期剩下的多头会在那里卖出离场，从而为更低的价格提供燃料。这些多头在至少接下来两根K线里也会不情愿再买入，从而让空头取得了对市场的短期控制权。


> Traders also shorted with limit orders on the test of the bear trend line from bar 9 to bar 10. A better strategy would have been to short below a low 2 signal bar, like the bar after bar 11, but that short never triggered. The market then had a wedge bear flag at the moving average at bar 13. Traders shorted with limit orders at the moving average and at the trend channel line, but a better strategy would have been to short below bar 13, or below a bear trend bar like the bar before or the bar after bar 13. When traders saw the bar 11 higher low, they expected any breakout above a swing high to fail. Some placed limit orders to short at one tick above bar 10. They also believed that there would be additional bears shorting at one tick below the moving average and that very few bulls would buy the breakout above the bar 10 swing high. Most attempts to reverse a bear trend fail and become bear flags. These aggressive bears shorted at the top of the bear flag, trusting that these high prices would not last long. Others entered as the market fell below the bar 12 bull trend bar, expecting remaining longs to sell out at that point and provide fuel for lower prices. These longs would have also been hesitant to buy again for at least a couple of bars, giving the bears short-term control over the market.


第14根K线是三根K线空头急速行情的第一根，它形成了一个空头微型通道。交易者本可以在第15根K线升到趋势线上方时做空。另一些交易者一看出它将成为一根疲弱的多头突破K线，就在它的收盘价做空。第15根K线一收盘，许多交易者立刻在它的高点处、略上方和略下方挂限价卖单。由于下一根K线没有涨到第15根K线之上，那些试图在第15根K线处或其上方做空的人没有成交。随后他们追着市场往下做，许多人在第15根K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处用止损单卖出。这是最好的入场，因为交易者看到了空头微型通道、相信还会有更多抛售，而且他们还看到市场从未升到第15根K线之上。这告诉他们，那些试图在那里做空的人已经被关在场外、会急着做空，而下一个合乎逻辑的入场就是在第15根K线下方挂止损单。


> Bar 14 was the first bar of a three-bar bear spike, which created a bear micro channel. Traders could have shorted during bar 15 as it went above the trend line. Other traders shorted its close once they saw that it was going to be a weak bull breakout bar. Once bar 15 closed, many traders immediately placed limit orders at, just above, and just below its high. Since the next bar did not trade above bar 15, those who tried to short at or above bar 15 did not get filled. They then chased the market down, and many sold on a stop at one tick below the bar 15 low. This was the best entry, because traders saw the bear micro channel and believed more selling would follow, and they also saw that the market never went above bar 15. This told them that the traders who tried to short there were trapped out and would be eager to get short, and the next logical entry was on a stop below bar 15.


![图 28.5](figures/fig-28-05.jpg)


**图 28.5　强空头趋势中趋势通道线把过早进场的多头套进亏损**


在空头市场中于趋势通道线处买入、指望等到一个楔形底部，是一套亏钱的策略。每当你发现自己一边在市场下跌、一边反复地画趋势通道线，通常说明你完全错过了强趋势，并且在错误的方向上寻找交易。


> Buying at trend channel lines in a bear market, hoping for a wedge bottom, is a losing strategy. Whenever you find yourself repeatedly drawing trend channel lines as the market is falling, you are usually totally missing a strong trend and looking for trades in the wrong direction.


在图 28.5中，第3根K线直接崩穿从第1根到第2根K线所画的趋势通道线，那些在市场跌向该线时买入的交易者立刻发现自己被套了。当市场处于强烈的始终做空状态时买入，是一套亏钱的策略。交易者应该只寻找做空交易，并尝试把一部分仓位持成波段。在市场于第6、第8和第9根K线测试其他趋势通道线时买入的交易者，很可能也亏了钱。尽管在第10根K线跌到趋势通道线时买入的交易者可能赚到了钱，但风险很大、概率和潜在回报都很小，所以那是一套糟糕的策略。不过，在大号第10根K线卖出高潮之后那根强劲的多头内包K线上方买入，则是一笔可以接受的多头交易，目标剥头皮到移动平均线附近。


> In Figure 28.5, bar 3 collapsed through the trend channel line drawn from bar 1 to bar 2, and traders who bought as the market fell to the line immediately found themselves trapped. Buying when the market is strongly always-in short is a losing strategy. Traders should look only for short trades and try to swing part of the position. A trader who bought as the market tested other trend channel lines at bars 6, 8, and 9 also likely lost money. Although a trader might have made money buying as bar 10 fell to the trend channel line, the risk was great and the probability and potential reward were small, so that was a bad strategy. However, buying above the strong bull inside bar that followed the large bar 10 sell climax was an acceptable long for a scalp up to around the moving average.


随后，在第12根K线、移动平均线附近出现了楔形熊旗做空。第12根K线是二次入场，而且由于它是一根靠近移动平均线的空头反转K线，在强空头趋势中这是一个特别可靠的做空建仓形态。


> This was followed by a wedge bear flag short near the moving average at bar 12. Bar 12 was the second entry, and because it was a bear reversal bar close to the moving average, this was an especially reliable short setup in a strong bear trend.


# 第 29 章　保护性止损与移动止损

*29. Protective and Trailing Stops*


大多数交易的确定性最高也不过60%，所以你永远得为另外那40% 的情况——交易没有按你预期走的时候——准备一套方案。你该重视那40%，就像你不该无视30码外那个朝你开枪、但命中率只有40% 的人一样。40% 是非常真实而且危险的，所以要永远尊重那些与你看法相反的交易者。这套方案里最重要的部分，就是在市场里挂着一张保护性止损单，以防市场往不利于你的方向走。让止损单一直挂在场内更好，因为许多用心理止损的交易者，在最需要止损的时候总能找出太多理由把它忽略掉，结果无一例外地让小额亏损越滚越大。下止损的方法有好几种，用哪一种都行。最关键的一点是：那张止损单要挂在场内，而不是只挂在脑子里。


> Since most trades are only 60 percent certain at best, you always have to have a plan for that other 40 percent of the time when the trade does not do what you expect. You should not ignore that 40 percent any more than you should dismiss someone 30 yards away who is shooting at you but who has only a 40 percent chance of hitting you. Forty percent is very real and dangerous, so always respect the traders who believe the opposite of you. The most important part of your plan is to have a protective stop in the market in case the market goes against you. It is better to have the stop working, because many traders who use mental stops find too many reasons to ignore them when they are needed most, and they invariably allow their small loss to grow and grow. There are several approaches to placing stops, and any of them is fine. The most important consideration is that you have the stop order working in the market instead of just in your head.


保护性止损主要有两类：一类是资金管理止损，也就是你愿意承担固定数量的最小报价单位或固定金额的亏损；另一类是价格行为止损，也就是市场越过某根K线或某个价位时你就出场。许多交易者会两者都用，或者视情况择一使用。比如，一个在 Emini 小型合约上大多数交易都用两个点止损的交易者，如果K线很大，可能就会改用三个点止损。一位刚刚做多的价格行为交易者，起初可能把保护性卖出止损单挂在信号K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处。但如果那根K线异常大，比如高达六个点，她可能就会改为只交易少得多的合约数量，或者改用大约三个点的资金管理止损。总的来说，最好绝大多数时候、甚至始终使用同一种方法，因为这样它就会成为你固定流程的一部分，让你在进场任何一笔交易时，都立刻有一张保护性止损单在工作。这样你就不会分心去想该用哪种、多大的止损；那些精力本该用在该不该做这笔交易上。


> The two main types of protective stops are money management stops, where you risk a certain number of ticks or dollars, and price action stops, where you get out if the market moves beyond a certain price bar or price level. Many traders use both or either, depending on the situation. For example, a trader who uses a two-point stop in the Emini for most of his trades might use a three-point stop if the bars are large. A price action trader who just went long might initially place a protective sell stop at one tick below the low of the signal bar. However, if the bar is unusually large, like six points tall, she might instead either trade far fewer contracts or switch to a money management stop of about three points. In general, using one method most or all of the time is best because then it is such a part of your routine that you will always have a protective stop working as soon as you enter any trade. This saves you from the distraction of having to think about what type and size stop you should be using in different situations when your focus needs to be on deciding whether to take the trade.


在大多数小幅剥头皮交易中，交易者不希望看到任何回调，常常一有回调就出场。但如果他们相信市场已经进入一段趋势通道，通常就会容忍小幅回调。例如，假设当天是一个交易区间日，市场刚从区间低点急速上涨，现在可能正在形成一条小型多头通道、有可能去测试区间的顶部，那么做多的交易者止盈目标就很有限，因此这笔交易属于剥头皮。既然市场处在多头通道里，就很可能出现回调，也就是说某根K线可能会跌破前一根K线的低点几个最小报价单位，但不会跌破通道内最近的那个摆动低点。既然这位交易者已经料到市场可能进入通道，却仍然选择做多，他就必须愿意扛过这些回调，并把保护性止损放在通道内最近的摆动低点下方。激进且有经验的交易者甚至可能在前一根K线的低点挂限价单加仓买入，因为他们知道通道里的回调通常只有一到两根K线，之后仍会继续走高。


> For most small scalps, traders do not want to see any pullbacks and will often exit as soon as one appears. However, if they believe that the market has entered a trend channel, they will usually allow small pullbacks. For example, if the day is a trading range day and the market just had a spike up off the low of the range and now might be forming a small bull channel that could test the top of the range, the profit goal of a trader who went long would be limited and therefore the trade would be a scalp. Since the market is in a bull channel, it will likely have pullbacks, which means that a bar might trade below the low of the prior bar by a few ticks, but not below the most recent swing low in the channel. Since the trader suspected that the market might enter a channel and he still went long, he has to be willing to hold through those pullbacks and keep his protective stop below the most recent swing low in the channel. Aggressive, experienced traders might even buy more on a limit order at the low of the prior bar, since they know that channels typically have one-or two-bar pullbacks yet continue to work higher.


如果交易者是为波段交易而买入，那他们预期的是多头趋势。既然多头趋势就是一系列更高的高点和更高的低点，那么在市场创出新的摆动高点之后，把保护性止损移到最近的摆动低点下方就是合理的。这叫移动止损。如果市场向上走了五根或10根K线，回调到进场价下方，然后又涨上去创出新的摆动高点，交易者不会愿意看到市场跌破那轮回调的低点，于是会把保护性止损移到该低点下方一个最小报价单位处。许多交易者不愿意让自己的止损被第二次测试，会干脆把止损移到保本位置。


> If traders are buying for a swing, then they are expecting a bull trend. Since a bull trend is a series of higher highs and higher lows, it is reasonable to move the protective stop to below the most recent swing low after the market makes a new swing high. This is called a trailing stop. If the market trades up for five or 10 bars, pulls back to below the entry price, and trades up to a new swing high, traders will not want the market to trade below the low of that pullback and will move their protective stop to one tick below its low. Many traders would not want their stop to be tested a second time and would simply move their stop to breakeven.


一旦交易者看到市场突破出去、并判断当天将成为趋势性交易区间日，他们就必须准备好随着市场开始形成第二个交易区间而改变自己的交易风格。例如，如果出现一段持续两三根K线的多头突破，接着是一根K线的回调，然后是一段更弱的上涨，那么那根回调K线的低点很可能成为上方那个交易区间的低点。由于市场通常会回测到突破缺口里、并且常常回测到下方那个交易区间的顶部，它跌到那根回调K线低点之下的概率很大。所以，多头不该把移动止损放到那个低点下方，因为那样会被扫出局。如果他们本想把保护性止损放在那里，那么更合理的做法是在接下来几根K线里，趁某根多头趋势K线收盘时出场，这样止盈的位置就接近正在成形的交易区间的顶部，而不是等跌破底部才出来。一旦市场演变成交易区间，交易者就不该再按强趋势的方式去交易它。


> Once traders see the market break out into what they believe will be a trending trading range day, they have to be ready to change their trading style as the market begins to form the second trading range. For example, if there is a bull breakout lasting a couple of bars followed by a one-bar pullback and then a weaker rally, the low of that pullback bar will probably become the low of the upper trading range. Since the market usually tests back into the breakout gap and often to the top of the lower trading range, the odds are that it will fall below the low of that pullback bar. Therefore, bulls should not trail their stops below that low, since they will get stopped out. If they were thinking about placing protective stops there, it makes more sense to exit on the close of a bull trend bar within the next several bars, so that they would be taking profits near the top of the developing trading range rather than below the bottom. Once the market evolves into a trading range, traders should no longer trade it as if it was still in a strong trend.


有些交易者会容许回调越过信号K线，只要他们相信自己做波段交易的前提仍然成立。例如，如果他们在多头趋势中买入了高2回调，而信号K线大约有两个点高，那么即使市场跌破这根信号K线的低点，他们也可能愿意继续持有，心想它可能演变成高3，那是一个楔形牛旗买入建仓形态。另一些交易者会在市场跌破信号K线时先出场，等出现强势的高3买入信号再重新买入。有些人甚至会买入两倍于第一笔的仓位，因为他们把那个强劲的二次信号看得更可靠。这些交易者里有很多人，当初看到高2买入信号不太对劲时，只买了半仓；他们当时是给高2失败、进而演变成楔形牛旗留出余地，而楔形牛旗看起来甚至可能更强。一旦真的这样走，他们就能安心地用通常的满仓去交易了。


> Some traders will allow pullbacks beyond the signal bar as long as they believe that their premise for a swing trade is still valid. For example, if they bought a high 2 pullback in a bull trend and the signal bar is about two points tall, they might be willing to hold on to their position even if the market falls below the low of the signal bar, thinking that it might evolve into a high 3, which is a wedge bull flag buy setup. Other traders would exit if the market fell below the signal bar and then buy again if a strong high 3 buy signal sets up. Some might even buy a position that is twice as large as their first because they see the strong second signal as more reliable. Many of these traders would have bought just a half-size position on the high 2 buy signal if they thought that the signal did not look quite right. They were allowing for the possibility of the high 2 failing and then evolving into a wedge bull flag, which might even look stronger. If this happened, they would then feel comfortable trading their usual full size.


另一些交易者看到可疑信号时只做半仓，保护性止损被打掉就出场，然后如果二次信号强劲，就按满仓接第二次信号。那些在交易对自己不利时分批建仓的交易者，显然不会用信号K线的极值作为最初保护性止损，而且很多人专门挑别人止损认亏的位置分批买入。有些人干脆用较宽的止损。例如，当 Emini 小型合约的平均日振幅不到大约15个点时，趋势中的回调很少超过七个点。有些交易者认为，只要市场跌幅不超过平均日振幅的50% 到75%，趋势就仍然有效。只要回调还在自己的容忍范围内，他们就会继续持仓，并默认自己的前提是正确的。如果他们在多头趋势中买了一次回调，进场价比当天最高点低三个点，那他们可能愿意冒五个点的风险。由于他们相信趋势仍然有效，就相信自己有60% 或更高的概率看到一段等距运动。也就是说，他们至少有60% 的把握：市场会先上涨至少五个点，才会回落五个点打到他们的保护性止损——这就构成了一个能赚钱的交易者等式。如果他们在那轮多头回调中的第一个买入信号出现在距高点五个点的位置，他们可能只冒三个点的风险，并打算在高点受到测试时了结多头。既然那轮回调相对较大，趋势可能有点弱，这就会让他们在趋势高点受到测试时止盈。他们会尽量赚到至少与所冒风险相等的幅度，但如果担心市场可能正在转为交易区间、甚至反转成空头趋势，他们也愿意在旧高点稍下方就出场。


> Other traders trade half size when they see questionable signals, exit if their protective stop is hit, and then take the second signal with a full size if the signal is strong. Traders who scale in as a trade goes against them obviously do not use the signal bar extreme for their initial protective stop, and many look to scale in exactly where other traders are taking losses on their protective stops. Some simply use a wide stop. For example, when the average daily range in Eminis is less than about 15 points, a pullback in a trend is rarely more than seven points. Some traders will consider that the trend is still in effect unless the market falls more than between 50 to 75 percent of the average daily range. As long as a pullback is within their tolerance, they will hold their position and assume that their premise is correct. If they bought a pullback in a bull trend and their entry was three points below the high of the day, then they might risk five points. Since they believe that the trend is still in effect, they believe that they have a 60 percent or better chance of an equidistant move. This means that they are at least 60 percent certain that the market will go up at least five points before falling five points to their protective stop, which creates a profitable trader's equation. If their initial buy signal in the bull pullback came at five points below the high, then they might risk just three points, and they would look to exit their long on a test of the high. Since the pullback was relatively large, the trend might be a little weak, and this might make them take profits on a test of the trend high. They would try to get at least as much as they had to risk, but they might be willing to get out just below the old high if they were concerned that the market might be transitioning into a trading range or possibly even reversing into a bear trend.


一旦市场终于开始进入交易区间，交易者就应该考虑在区间高点附近至少先了结部分利润，而不是依赖移动止损。这是因为市场很可能会开始出现跌破前一个摆动低点的回调。只要交易者认为自己的止损大概率会被打掉，在被打掉之前先出场就是明智的，尤其是当他们已经完成了大部分止盈目标时。


> Once the market finally begins to enter a trading range, traders should look to take at least partial profits around the high of the range, rather than relying on their trailing stops. This is because it is likely that the market will begin to have pullbacks that fall below prior swing lows. As soon as traders believe that their stops will likely get hit, it makes sense to exit before that happens, especially if they have already met most of their profit objectives.


大多数交易最初的价格行为止损都设在信号K线外侧一个最小报价单位处，一直保持到入场K线收盘；如果入场K线表现强劲，就把止损收紧到入场K线外侧一到两个最小报价单位。如果入场K线是一根十字星，那就继续用原来的止损。记住，十字星是一根K线构成的交易区间；如果你刚刚买入，就不会想在你自己认为的多头趋势里、在交易区间的下方卖出离场（同理，如果你刚刚做空，就不会想在新的空头趋势里、在交易区间上方买入）。


> The initial price action stop for most trades is one tick beyond the signal bar until the entry bar closes, when it is tightened to one or two ticks beyond the entry bar if the entry bar is strong. If the entry bar is a doji, then rely on your original stop. Remember that a doji is a single-bar trading range, and if you just bought, you don't want to exit (sell) below a trading range in what you think is a bull trend (or if you just shorted, you don't want to buy above a trading range in a new bear trend).


事实上，在可能出现的新多头趋势里，有经验的交易者可以考虑在一根小小的十字星入场K线下方一到两个最小报价单位处加仓（在新的空头趋势里则在十字星入场K线上方加仓），加仓合约的止损沿用最初的那个止损位置。他们之所以在低1做空信号K线下方买入，是因为他们认为市场要涨、而不是要跌。低1是空头趋势中强劲空头急速行情底部、或者交易区间顶部附近的卖出建仓形态（在交易区间里，最好等到低2再做空），而不是交易区间底部或新多头趋势底部的形态。既然在那个位置做空很可能失败，那么做空者那张两个点的保护性买入止损单被打掉的可能性，就比挂在低1信号K线下方六个最小报价单位处的止盈限价单被成交的可能性更大。也就是说，在低1信号K线下方买入之后，市场很可能先上涨至少两个点，才会回落六个最小报价单位。既然交易者认为这是一个新的多头趋势、至少也是一个交易区间，他们就会认为市场至少会涨三到四个点，所以这是一笔合乎逻辑的多头交易。


> In fact, experienced traders can consider adding on at a tick or two below a small doji entry bar in a possible new bull trend (or above a doji entry bar in a new bear trend), relying on the initial stop location for the stop on the added contracts. They are buying below the low 1 short signal bar because they think that the market is going up, not down. A low 1 is a short setup at the bottom of a strong bear spike in a bear trend, or near the top of a trading range (in a trading range, it is better to wait to short a low 2), not at the bottom of a trading range or at the bottom of a new bull trend. Since a short down there is likely to fail, the two-point protective buy stop is more likely to be hit than is a six-tick profit-taking limit order placed below the low 1 signal bar. This means that buying below the low 1 signal bar will probably be followed by the market going up at least two points before falling six ticks. Since traders think this is a new bull trend or at least a trading range, they think that the market will go up at least three or four points, so this is a logical long trade.


如果入场K线是一根反向的K线，那你就得做决定。例如，假设你刚在强势多头市场里买了一次回调，信号K线是两段式回调到移动平均线末端的一根强势多头反转K线。如果入场K线变成了一根空头反转K线，你通常只需把保护性止损留在信号K线下方。


> If it is a bar in the opposite direction, then you have to make a decision. For example, say you just bought a pullback in a strong bull market and the signal bar was a strong bull reversal bar at the end of a two-legged pullback to the moving average. If the entry bar becomes a bear reversal bar, you should usually just keep your protective stop below the signal bar.


但如果你是在强势空头趋势里买入反弹反转，那么一旦市场跌破那根空头入场K线，你通常就该出场。在某些情况下，如果市场背景支持，你甚至应该反手做空。一般来说，如果你认为一次失败的多头会变成做空建仓形态，那你本就不该在强势空头趋势里买入。在这种情形下能反手的交易者极少；如果空头趋势强到让低1做空形态说得通，那它大概就强到不该去找多头机会了。多头应该等一段强势上涨行情出现，然后再找更高的低点回调买入。在还没有证据表明多头能掌控市场之前就在空头趋势里买入，是一种亏钱的策略。由于大多数多头反转最后都变成熊旗，不买、转而找机会做空要好得多——除非反转形态特别强（这一点在第3本书讲趋势反转的那一章里有讨论）。


> However, if you were buying a reversal up in a strong bear trend, you should usually exit if the market falls below that bear entry bar. In some cases, you should even reverse to short, if the context makes sense. In general, you should not be buying in a strong bear trend if you believe that a failed long would be a short setup. Very few traders are able to reverse in such a situation, and if the bear trend is still strong enough so that shorting low 1 setups makes sense, then it is probably too strong to be looking for longs. Instead, a bull should wait for a strong rally and then look to buy a higher low pullback. Buying in a bear trend before there has been evidence that the bulls can control the market is a losing strategy. Since most bull reversals become bear flags, it is far better not to buy and instead to look to short, unless the reversal setup is especially strong (this is discussed in the chapter on trend reversals in the third book).


如果进场时K线太大，比较聪明的做法是改用资金管理止损，比如在 Emini 小型合约5分钟图上用八个最小报价单位，或者用大约70% 的回撤位（比斐波那契62% 回撤位再多几个最小报价单位）。例如，在一根大实体多头信号K线之后做多，你会把保护性止损放在从信号K线底部到进场价这段距离的约30% 处。资金管理止损的幅度与K线的大小成正比。等市场到达第一个止盈目标、锁定部分利润之后，把保护性止损移到大致保本的位置（也就是进场价，它距离信号K线的极值有一个最小报价单位）。最好的那些交易不会打到保本止损，而且在5分钟 Emini 小型合约上也极少会越过进场价四个最小报价单位（例如做多之后，最深只到信号K线高点下方三个最小报价单位）。


> If the bars at the time of entry into any trade are too large, it is wiser to use a money management stop, like eight ticks on the Emini 5 minute chart, or about a 70 percent pullback (a couple of ticks beyond the Fibonacci 62 percent pullback). For example, in a long off a large bull signal bar, you would place the protective stop about 30 percent of the distance up from the bottom of the signal bar to the entry price. The size of the money management stop is in proportion to the size of the bars. After the market reaches the first profit target and partial profits are secured, move the protective stop to about breakeven (the entry price, which is one tick from the signal bar's extreme). The best trades will not hit a breakeven stop and will rarely ever go more than four ticks beyond the entry on the 5 minute Emini (for example, three ticks below the signal bar high after getting long).


如果你因为一根又大又强的反转K线、再加上多个因素共振而对这次反转非常有信心，就可以把止损放在那根大信号K线之外，并容许进场之后出现回调，只要没打到止损就行。你甚至可以把止损放宽到信号K线外几个点；但若这么做，就要算清楚风险，并相应减小仓位规模，让风险和你其它交易保持一致。同样，如果你确信这次反转强到很可能走出两段行情，而且在已经剥头皮平掉部分仓位之后，市场又反向穿过你原始进场价几个最小报价单位，你可以扛住这轮回调、继续用原来的止损，哪怕你正处于几个最小报价单位的浮亏中。否则（比如你做多一笔新仓），你就会在保本位置把波段那部分平掉，然后在打掉你止损的那根K线的高点上方重新买入，结果本来你认定概率极高的第二段行情，白白丢掉两个点甚至更多。


> If you are very confident in the reversal because of a large, strong reversal bar and a confluence of other factors, you can use a stop beyond that large signal bar and allow a pullback after entry, as long as it does not hit your stop. You might even allow a stop of a couple of points beyond your signal bar, but if you do, calculate your risk and reduce your position size to keep your risk the same as on your other trades. Also, if you are confident that a reversal is strong enough to make two legs likely, and if the market comes back through your original entry by a few ticks after you've scalped out part of your trade, you can hold through the pullback and rely on your original stop, despite being in a drawdown of several ticks. Otherwise (for example, in a new long) you will exit the swing portion at breakeven and then buy again above the high of the bar that ran your stop, giving up a couple of points or more of what you considered to be a very high-probability second leg.


如果你要进场的是一次平静、你相信即将结束的回调，而K线都很小，你可以考虑沿用平时那套资金管理止损，即使这意味着止损会放在信号K线之外好几个最小报价单位。例如，当天是空头趋势日，一条动能很低的多头通道一路上行到移动平均线，构成低4做空形态，而信号K线是一根只有三个最小报价单位高的十字星K线，那么相信回调即将结束的交易者可能就会照常冒八个最小报价单位的风险，即便这样一来止损就落在信号K线上方四个最小报价单位处。低4形态常常形成于窄通道中，而入场点就是向下突破这条窄通道。窄通道的突破通常都会有回调，有时还会越过信号K线。在这里，出现一个更高的高点式突破回调并不奇怪。只要交易者相信自己的前提依然成立，就可以给这笔交易一些空间。另一种做法是：如果市场涨到入场K线或信号K线之上，先出场，等市场再次掉头向下时再卖出；但如果他们对自己的分析有信心，就可以沿用原来那八个最小报价单位的止损，容忍这个更高的高点回调。总的来说，如果你正处在一笔亏损的交易里，不妨问问自己：如果我现在是空仓，我还会开这笔交易吗？


> If you are entering a quiet pullback that you believe is about to end and the bars are small, you might consider using your usual money management stop, even if it means that you are risking several ticks beyond your signal bar. For example, if the day is a bear trend day with a low-momentum bull channel up to the moving average that forms a low 4 short setup and the signal bar is a three-tick-tall doji bar, traders who believe that the pullback is about to end might risk their usual eight ticks, even though the stop would then be four ticks above the signal bar. Low 4 setups often form in tight channels, and the entry is a breakout below the tight channel. Tight channel breakouts usually have pullbacks, and sometimes they go beyond the signal bar. Here, a higher high breakout pullback would not be surprising. As long as the traders believe that their premise is still valid, they can allow the trade some room. Alternatively, they could exit if the market goes above the entry or signal bar and then sell again as the market turns down again; but if they are confident in their analysis, they can rely on their original eight-tick stop and allow the higher high pullback. In general, if you are in a losing trade, ask yourself if you would put the trade on now if you were flat.


如果答案是否定的，那就出场。如果你的前提不再成立，就出场，哪怕认亏也要出。


> If the answer is no, then get out. If your premise is no longer valid, then exit, even with a loss.


当你担心市场波动剧烈、K线很大时，只应该用平时仓位规模的一小部分去交易。直接把仓位规模砍到一半、甚至砍到四分之一，然后下单就行。如果你在做多，并且确信某个低点能守住，但这笔多头交易需要的资金管理止损远大于你平时用的幅度，你可以先用这个更大的止损，然后等待。如果市场没怎么回调就打到了你的止盈目标，那就止盈。但如果它只比你的进场价多走了一个最小报价单位左右，然后回调几乎打回你的止损，接着又重新涨到进场价上方，那就上调止盈目标。按一般规律，市场最终上涨的幅度，会等于它让你为了拿住这笔交易不得不承担的那个止损幅度。所以，如果市场在反转向上之前一度跌到进场价下方11个最小报价单位，那么只要12个最小报价单位的止损就能扛住；因此市场也很可能会涨到进场价上方约12个最小报价单位甚至更多。明智的做法是挂一张比这个幅度少一到两个最小报价单位的止盈限价单，并在价格接近目标时把止损移到保本，然后等着看止盈单会不会成交。举例来说，假设那轮回调是11个最小报价单位，信号K线之外的止损没有被打到（也许是12个、甚至18个最小报价单位），现在市场又朝你的方向走了；这时你算一算，为了不被扫出局，你本需要承担多少个最小报价单位的风险。此时此刻，你需要承担的是12个最小报价单位（回调低点之外一个）。那就把止盈目标上调到比这个风险少一到两个最小报价单位，也就是11个最小报价单位。此时你还应该把保护性止损调到那轮回调低点之外一个最小报价单位处，这样你现在承担的风险就是12个最小报价单位。


> When you are concerned that the market might be volatile and have large bars, you should trade only a fraction of your usual position size. Just cut your position size in half or down to a quarter and place the order. If you are buying and are confident that a low will hold, but a long trade would require a much greater money management stop than you typically use, you can use the larger stop and then wait. If the market hits your profit target without much of a pullback, take your profit. However, if it only goes a tick or so beyond your entry, pulls back almost to your stop, and then starts up again above your entry price, raise your profit target. As a general rule, the market will rally enough to equal the size of the stop that it required you to have to stay in the trade. So if the market dipped 11 ticks below your entry before reversing back up, a stop of only 12 ticks would have worked; therefore the market will likely go about 12 ticks or more above your entry price. It would be wise to place a limit order to exit with a profit at a tick or two less than this and, when it approaches the target, to move your stop to breakeven and wait to see if your profit target order gets filled. For example, suppose the pullback was 11 ticks, your stop beyond the signal bar was not hit (maybe it was 12 or even 18 ticks), and now the market is again going in your direction; calculate the total number of ticks that you would have had to risk to avoid being stopped out. At this point, you would have had to risk 12 ticks (one beyond the pullback). Now increase your profit target to one or two ticks less than the risk, or 11 ticks. You also should adjust your protective stop at this point to one tick beyond that pullback, so you are now risking 12 ticks.


如果一笔交易还没赚到剥头皮交易者的利润就被保护性止损打掉，说明你被套进了一笔糟糕的交易，所以偶尔在止损被打掉时反手是不错的策略。这要看具体的行情背景。例如，当你认为市场正在反转成多头趋势时，一次失败的低2做空就是反手做多的好机会。不过，在窄幅交易区间里被扫止损，就不算反转。在考虑反方向交易之前，先花点时间确认自己没看错图。如果你没时间马上杀回去，就等下一个建仓形态——它总会在不太久之后出现。


> When a protective stop is hit before making a scalper's profit, you were trapped into a bad trade, so reversing on the stop is occasionally a good strategy. This depends on the context. For example, a failed low 2 short is a good reversal into a long trade when you think that the market is reversing into a bull trend. However, a stop run in a tight trading range is not a reversal. Take time to make sure that you are reading the chart correctly before considering a trade in the opposite direction. If you don't have time to get right back in, wait for the next setup, which will always come before too long.


研究过某个市场之后，你自然会看出多大的止损才算合理。在 Emini 小型合约5分钟图上，当平均日振幅在10到15个点时，八个最小报价单位在大多数交易日都很好用。但要密切注意头一个小时里所需的最大止损幅度，因为它常常会成为当天余下时间最好用的止损。如果这个止损超过八个最小报价单位，你很可能也可以把止盈目标相应放大。不过，除非K线大得异常，这么做带来的优势充其量也只是有限的。


> After studying a market, you will see what a reasonable stop is. For the Emini 5 minute chart when the average daily range is 10 to 15 points, eight ticks works well on most days. However, pay close attention to the maximum size stop required in the first hour, because this often becomes the best stop to use for the rest of the day. If the stop is more than eight ticks, you will likely be able to increase the size of your profit target as well. However, this provides a modest advantage at best unless the bars are exceptionally big.


有两种常见的建仓形态通常需要较大的止损，也就是说你得做小一点的仓位。这两种形态都涉及在趋势中一根强劲急速行情收盘前后进场，但方向正好相反。当趋势刚开始出现一段强劲急速行情、并连着走出好几根趋势K线时，交易者会随着K线成形和收盘、顺着趋势方向进场。例如，如果出现一段强劲的多头突破，其中有两根大实体多头趋势K线，多头会在第二根K线收盘时买入，也会在其高点上方买入。如果后面又跟着第三、第四、第五根连续的多头趋势K线，多头会随着急速行情延伸而持续买入。他们所有这些进场单的理论止损都在急速行情的底部之下，位置非常远。如果交易者真用那里作止损，他们就必须做得非常小的仓位，才能把风险控制在自己能承受的范围内。实际上，大多数交易者在急速行情后段进场时，会考虑用较大仓位剥头皮、同时用较小的止损。因为此时回调的可能性更大，而回调能让他们在更低的价格、用更小的止损（比如信号K线下方）建立波段仓位。


> There are a couple of common setups that usually require a large stop, which means trading a smaller position. Both involve entering around the close of a strong spike in a trend, but the two trades are in opposite directions. When there is a strong spike at the beginning of a trend and there are several consecutive trend bars, traders will enter in the direction of the trend as the bars are forming and as they close. For example, if there is a strong bull breakout that has two large bull trend bars, bulls will buy the close of the second bar and above its high. If it is followed by a third, fourth, and fifth consecutive bull trend bar, bulls will keep buying as the bull spike grows. The theoretical stop for all of their entries is below the bottom of the spike, which is far away. If traders used that for their stop, they need to trade a very small position size to keep their risk within their comfort zone. Realistically, most traders would consider scalping a larger position and using a smaller stop when they enter late in the spike. This is because a pullback becomes more likely, and it would allow them to then put a swing position on at a lower price and with a smaller stop, like below the signal bar.


第二种情况是交易者在逆势进场时正赶上一根大趋势K线，因而需要很大的止损。例如，如果连续出现第三次卖出高潮、其间没有明显回调，而这第三次高潮走出当天最大的空头趋势K线、收盘价接近最低点，那么激进的多头会在该K线收盘时买入，预期它就在波段低点或非常接近波段低点，并预期随后会出现一轮强劲上涨。在这种情形下，保护性止损没有绝对可靠的放法；但按一般规律，既然交易者预期上涨至少会到达那根大空头趋势K线的高点、并且对这笔交易有60% 的把握，他们承担的风险就应该大致等于那根空头趋势K线所包含的最小报价单位数量。这一点在第3本书讲高潮的那一章里有更多讨论。如果是非常有经验的交易者，这可能是一笔可靠的交易。这类情形下成交量往往极大，意味着机构也在大量买入。空头在为自己的空头头寸止盈，多头则在积极买入。双方常常都在等一根跌向支撑位的大空头趋势K线作为衰竭信号，然后大举买入。因为他们预期底部很快就会形成，所以就退到一旁、在支撑位上方就停止买入，于是形成了以那根大实体空头趋势K线为表现形式的下跌真空。


> The second situation when traders are entering during a large trend bar and need a large stop is when they are entering countertrend. For example, if there is a third consecutive sell climax without a significant pullback, and that third one has the largest bear trend bar of the day and closes near its low, aggressive bulls will buy the close of the bar, expecting it to be at or near the low of the swing; they will also expect a strong rally to follow. Reliable protective stop placement in this situation is never certain, but as a rule, since traders expect the rally to go at least to the high of the large bear trend bar and they are 60 percent certain of the trade, they should risk about as many ticks as there are in the bear trend bar. This is discussed more in the chapter on climaxes in book 3. If they are very experienced traders, this can be a reliable trade. The volume is often huge in these situations, which means that the institutions are buying heavily as well. The bears are taking profits on their shorts, and the bulls are aggressively buying. Both often wait for a large bear trend bar into support as a sign of exhaustion, and then buy heavily. Because they were expecting the bottom to form very soon, they stepped aside and stopped buying just above support, and this creates a sell vacuum in the form of the large bear trend bar.


还有许多其它特殊情形，交易者可能会用异常宽的保护性止损。我有个朋友专门找疲弱的通道、逆着通道分批建仓，赌它反转。例如，如果市场在一段多头急速行情之后进入多头通道、而这条通道并不特别强，他就在通道内前一个摆动高点挂限价单做空，只用平时仓位规模的四分之一左右；如果通道继续延伸，他就在接下来两三个摆动高点上方加仓。当 Emini 小型合约的平均日振幅在10到15个点左右时，他最后的止损距离第一笔进场约八个点，目标是回测自己的第一笔进场价。一旦反转启动，如果他认为反转很强，他常常会把部分仓位按波段持有，目标看向原始进场价下方。


> There are many other special situations when a trader might use an unusually wide protective stop. I have a friend who looks for weak channels and scales in against them, expecting a reversal. For example, if the market is in a bull channel after a bull spike and the channel is not particularly strong, he places a limit order to go short at the prior swing high in the channel, using about a quarter of his normal position size, and adds on above the next two or three swing highs if the channel continues. When the average daily range in the Emini is about 10 to 15 points, his final stop is about eight points from his first entry and his target is a test of his first entry. Once the reversal is underway, if he thinks that it is strong, he will often swing part of his position below his original entry.


交易者在楼梯形态里、或在趋势性交易区间日里反向操作突破时，可以用较宽的止损。如果 Emini 小型合约的平均振幅在10到15个点左右，而某次突破走了大约五个点，交易者可以反向操作这次突破，冒大约五个点的风险去赚五个点，预期市场会回测突破位。在典型情况下，这笔交易的成功概率高于60%，因此交易者等式为正。


> Traders can use wide stops when they are fading breakouts in stairs patterns or on trending trading range days. If the average range in the Emini is about 10 to 15 points and there is a breakout that runs about five points, a trader might fade the breakout and risk about five points to make five points, expecting a test of the breakout. In a typical situation, this trade has better than a 60 percent chance of success and therefore has a positive trader's equation.


交易者有时会在大级别趋势的末端，反向操作单根K线末端旗形带来的大实体趋势K线突破，预期那根趋势K线是一段衰竭性高潮（这一点在第3本书讲高潮反转的那一章中有讨论）。例如，如果一段多头趋势已经走了约30根K线、其间只有小幅回调，然后出现一根大实体多头趋势K线，接着是一到两根K线的回调；此时如果下一根K线也是大实体多头趋势K线，多头和空头都会在它收盘时卖出。多头是为了止盈而卖出，激进的空头则为了开空头头寸而卖出。空头承担的风险大约是那根K线的高度（如果那根K线高10个最小报价单位，他们就大约用10个最小报价单位的止损），他们最初的止盈目标是回测那根K线的底部。下一个目标就是一段向下等距运动。


> Traders sometimes fade large trend bar breakouts of one-bar final flags at the ends of big trends, expecting that the trend bar is an exhaustive climax (this is discussed in the chapter on climactic reversals in book 3). For example, if there is a bull trend that has gone on for 30 bars or so with only small pullbacks, and then there is a large bull trend bar followed by a one-or two-bar pullback, bulls and bears will sell the close of the next bar if it is also a large bull trend bar. The bulls will sell to take profits, and aggressive bears will sell to initiate shorts. The bears will risk about the height of the bar (if the bar is 10 ticks tall, they will use about a 10-tick stop), and their initial profit target will be a test of the bottom of the bar. The next target is a measured move down.


我还有一个朋友，在 Emini 小型合约上逢回调进场时习惯性地用五个点的止损。他觉得自己没办法稳定地判断回调在哪里结束，于是改为在认为趋势即将恢复时进场。他默认自己有时进得偏早、趋势恢复之前回调可能还会再走一点，而较宽的止损让他能一直拿住这笔交易。他的止盈目标是回测趋势的极值，那个位置可能在三到五个点之外。如果趋势恢复得很有力，他就会把这笔交易当成波段来做，目标五个点以上。这种做法有许多变体，不过平均风险一般与平均回报大致相当；又因为这是顺势策略，成功概率至少也有60%。这意味着该策略的交易者等式为正。


> I have another friend who routinely uses a five-point stop when entering on pullbacks in the Emini. He feels that he cannot consistently predict the end of a pullback and instead enters when he thinks that the trend is resuming. He just assumes that he sometimes enters early and that the pullback might go a little further before the trend resumes, and the wide stop allows him to stay in the trade. His profit target is a test of the trend's extreme, which might be three to five points away. If the resumption is strong, he will swing the trade, looking for five or more points. Although there are many variations to this approach, the average risk is generally about the size of the average reward, and since it is a with-trend strategy, the probability is at least 60 percent. This means that the strategy has a positive trader's equation.


只要交易者用了较宽的止损，一旦市场开始朝他们的方向转，他们通常就能收紧止损、大幅降低风险。当一笔波段交易走到止盈目标一半左右时，许多交易者会把保护性止损移到保本位置。如果市场强力朝他们的方向走，成功概率就上升，潜在回报可以保持不变、也可以上调，而风险则变小。这会让交易者等式变得更强，也正是许多交易者宁愿等到市场走到这一步再进场的原因。不过，如果反转非常弱，那么交易者虽然能收紧止损、降低风险，成功概率却会变小，他们可能还得下调回报（把止盈限价单挂得更近）。如果交易者等式弱到一定程度，他们也许会试着赚点小利剥头皮出场，再等别的交易机会。


> Whenever traders use a wide stop, as soon as the market begins to turn in their direction they are usually able to tighten the stop and greatly reduce their risk. Once a swing trade reaches about halfway to the profit target, many traders will move their protective stop to break even. If the market moves strongly in their direction, the probability of success increases, the potential reward can remain the same or they might increase it, and the risk becomes smaller. This increases the strength of the trader's equation and is why many traders prefer to wait to enter until the market is able to get to this point. If, however, the reversal is very weak, although traders can tighten their stop and reduce their risk, their probability of success will be less and they might also reduce their reward (tighten their profit-taking limit order). If the trader's equation is weak enough, they might try to scalp out with a small profit and wait for another trade.


目标就是赚钱，而赚钱要求交易者等式为正。如果K线的幅度决定了你必须用很大的止损，那就得用，但你还必须调整止盈目标，让交易者等式保持为正。同时你也应该减小仓位规模。


> The goal is to make money, which requires a positive trader's equation. If the size of the bars requires a large stop, that is what you must use, but you also must adjust your target to keep the trader's equation positive. You should also reduce your position size.


在一个大市场里，可能有一百家机构在活跃交易，每一家大约贡献总成交量的1%。在另外那99% 的成交量里，只有5% 来自个人交易者。机构想赚的是其他机构的钱——机构占了市场的94%——而不是散户在家里交易出来的那5% 的资金。机构根本不关心我们，也不会专门跑出来扫我们的止损、吃掉小散户。你的止损被打掉，跟你个人毫无关系。举例来说，如果你做多、保护性卖出止损被打掉，你应该默认那是因为至少有一家机构也想在那个价位卖出。散户里要凑出足够多的人同时做同一件事、形成足以吸引机构的成交量，这种情况极少见，所以更好的假设是：任何一个价位之所以能成交，都是因为那里既有一家机构愿意卖，又有另一家机构愿意买。


> In a big market, there might be a hundred institutions actively trading, each contributing about 1 percent of the total volume. Of the other 99 percent of the volume, only 5 percent is from individual traders. Institutions are going to try to take money from other institutions, which make up 94 percent of the market, not the 5 percent of dollars traded by people at home. Institutions could care less about us and are not out there running our stops, trying to devour the little guy. If your stop gets hit, it has nothing to do with you. For example, if you were long and your protective sell stop got hit, you should assume that it was because there was at least one institution that also wanted to sell at that price.
