Only rarely will enough small traders do the same thing to offer enough volume to attract an institution, so it is better to assume that the market will only trade at any price if there is both an institution willing to sell there and another willing to buy there.


![图 29.1](figures/fig-29-01.jpg)


**图 29.1　初始止损就在信号K线外侧**


在图 29.1中，初始止损位于信号K线外侧一个最小报价单位处。入场K线收盘后，如果这根K线表现强劲，就把止损移到入场K线外侧一个最小报价单位处。如果风险太大，就改用资金管理止损，或者冒大约信号K线高度60% 的风险。


> The initial stop is one tick beyond the signal bar in Figure 29.1. Once the entry bar closes, move the stop to one tick beyond the entry bar if the bar is strong. If the risk is too great, use a money management stop or risk about 60 percent of the height of the signal bar.


如果你在第1根K线处、在价格向下跌破一根空头内包K线时做空，初始止损就应设在信号K线上方。第1根K线作为入场K线，在进场后立刻向上反转，但没有超过信号K线的高点，所以这笔交易最终会成为一次盈利的空头剥头皮。入场K线收盘后，如果它是一根多头或空头趋势K线、而不是十字星K线，就把止损上移到它高点上方一个最小报价单位处。在这个例子里，信号K线和入场K线的高点相同，所以止损无需收紧。


> If you shorted on bar 1 on the breakout below the bear inside bar, the initial stop would have been above the signal bar. The bar 1 entry bar reversed up immediately after entry but did not exceed the top of the signal bar, so this would have eventually ended up as a profitable short scalp. Once the entry bar closed, if it is a bull or bear trend bar and not a doji bar, move the stop up to one tick above its high. In this example, the signal and entry bars had the same high, so the stop would not have to be tightened.


第3根K线的前一根，是开盘后三次向下推进之后的一根多头反转K线。虽然买入空头窄通道的第一次突破通常不是好交易，但头一个小时里的反转通常都是可靠的，尤其是在前一天强势收盘的情况下（看看移动平均线延伸到昨天收盘时那条陡峭的斜率就知道了）。第3根K线作为入场K线，进场后立刻遭到抛售，但没有跌破信号K线的低点，也没有跌破其高度约70% 的位置（如果你认为这根信号K线太大、没法把价格行为止损放在其低点下方，因而使用了资金管理止损的话）。入场K线一旦收盘，保护性止损就应该上移到它低点下方一个最小报价单位处。如果市场跌破了它的低点，许多交易者会去做空，因为这属于突破回调式的做空建仓形态。不过，由于这不是一段强劲的空头急速行情，所以它并不是一个可靠的低1做空。另一种做法是把止损一直留在信号K线下方；但在强势空头趋势里抄底时，如果市场跌破一根作为低1做空信号K线的强劲空头趋势K线，继续持有多头就是危险的。


> The bar before bar 3 was a bull reversal bar after three pushes down on the open. Although buying the first breakout of a tight bear channel is not usually a good trade, reversals in the first hour are usually reliable, especially when the prior day had a strong close (look at the steep slope of the moving average going into yesterday's close). The bar 3 entry bar immediately sold off but did not fall below the low of the signal bar, or below about 70 percent of its height (if you used a money management stop, thinking that this signal bar was too big to use a price action stop below its low). Once an entry bar closed, the protective stop should have been moved up to one tick below its low. If the market fell below its low, many traders would have gone short because this was a breakout pullback short setup. However, since this was not a strong bear spike, it was not a reliable low 1 short. Alternatively, a trader could have kept the stop below the signal bar, but when bottom picking in a strong bear trend, it is risky to hold a long if the market falls below a strong bear trend bar that is a low 1 short signal bar.


两根K线之后出现了一根回调K线，但没有打到止损。它分毫不差地回测了入场K线的低点，构成一个双底。既然这个楔形底部很可能向上走出两段行情，有经验的交易者扛过进场后第二根K线处出现的那轮回调、继续依靠入场K线下方的止损，是合理的。否则你就会被止损扫出局、赔掉七个最小报价单位，然后还得在那根回调K线的高点上方买回来以抓住第二段行情；你的进场价会差三个最小报价单位，总共就差了10个最小报价单位。


> Two bars later, there was a pullback bar, but it did not hit the stop. It tested the entry bar low to the tick, creating a double bottom. Since this wedge bottom was likely to have two legs up, it was reasonable for an experienced trader to hold through the pullback that occurred two bars after entry and to rely on the stop below the entry bar. Otherwise, you would have been stopped out for seven ticks and then you would have bought above the high of the pullback bar to catch the second leg; your entry price would have been three ticks worse, so overall you would have been 10 ticks worse off.


第4根K线处回撤到移动平均线的这轮行情，与第1根K线那片区域构成了双顶，是一个小型楔形熊旗。在别的交易者眼里，它只是移动平均线处一个普通的低2。第4根K线低2处的空头，其初始保护性止损并没有被打掉，尽管进场后第二根K线出现了一根回调K线。止损当时在信号K线上方；在市场朝你的方向走出大约四个最小报价单位之前，或者在市场出现一根还算强劲的空头实体K线之前，你不该把止损收紧到最近一根K线的高点上方。给这笔交易一点时间。另外，当入场K线是十字星时，通常容许一到两个最小报价单位的回调是安全的。十字星K线是一根K线构成的交易区间，在交易区间上方买入是有风险的，所以别在那里把你的空头买回来。在市场至少朝你的方向走出几个最小报价单位之前，继续用原来的止损。


> The pullback to the moving average at bar 4 formed a double top with the bar 1 area, and it was a small wedge bear flag. Other traders would have seen it as a simple low 2 at the moving average. The initial protective stop for the short at the bar 4 low 2 was not hit, despite a pullback bar two bars after entry. The stop was above the signal bar, and you should not tighten to above the high of the most recent bar until after the market had moved about four ticks in your direction or until the market had a reasonably strong bear body. Give the trade time to work. Also, when the entry bar is a doji, it is usually safe to allow a one-or two-tick pullback. A doji bar is a one-bar trading range and it is risky to buy above a trading range, so don't buy back your short there. Rely on your original stop until the market has moved at least several ticks in your direction.


第5根K线处的多头，进场后立刻遭到抛售、回测了信号K线的低点（这一点在1分钟图上很清楚，图未给出），构成一个微型双底，随后成为一次成功的多头剥头皮。依靠你的止损，别去看1分钟图。用5分钟图入场，就用5分钟图的止损；否则你会亏得太频繁，为了每笔交易少冒一点风险，反而被大量交易扫出局。


> The bar 5 long immediately sold off to test the signal bar low (this was evident on the 1 minute chart, not shown) forming a micro double bottom and then a successful long scalp. Rely on your stop and ignore the 1 minute chart. When taking a 5 minute entry, rely on a 5 minute stop, else you will lose too often and be stopped out of a great many trades in your attempt to risk less per trade.


第7根K线是一段强劲多头急速行情之后的高2做多。市场回测了信号K线下方的那张止损，但差一个最小报价单位没有碰到；接着又回测了收紧后位于入场K线下方的止损，两张止损都没被打到。进场前出现的几根十字星加大了这笔交易的风险，但在市场自当日新低急速上涨之后已有六次收盘于移动平均线之上，所以这是个可以接受的多头建仓形态，因为你当时本就应该预期会有第二段上涨。


> Bar 7 was a high 2 long after a strong bull spike. The market tested the stop below the signal bar but missed by one tick, and then tested the tightened stop below the entry bar, but neither stop was hit. The do-jis prior to entry increased the risk of the trade, but with six closes above the moving average after the surge from a new low of the day, this was an acceptable long setup since you had to be expecting a second leg up.


第8根K线的 ii形态（内包内包）是一个高1买入建仓形态。但它并不位于强势多头趋势中强劲多头急速行情的顶部，因此不是一笔好交易。事实上，它处在自当日低点急速上涨之后那条多头通道的顶部；它在一个向上等距运动目标位附近，而且可能正在与第4根K线构成双顶。由于大多数交易区间突破的尝试都会失败，市场向下走的概率是60%，突破成功的概率只有40%。这些概率无法精确得知，但谈到交易区间突破的尝试，60–40是一个很好用的经验法则。激进的交易者会在 ii形态的高点挂限价单做空，预期它是个多头陷阱。如果交易者是反过来在第8根K线的 ii形态上方买入，那么保护性止损会在入场K线那一根就被打掉；这本该是一次不错的反手机会——大多数失败的 ii形态都是如此。


> The bar 8 ii pattern was a high 1 buy setup. However, it was not at the top of a strong bull spike in a strong bull trend and therefore it was not a good trade. In fact, it was at the top of a bull channel after the spike up from the low of the day; it was around a measured move up, and it might have been forming a double top with bar 4. Since most trading range breakout attempts fail, there was a 60 percent chance that the market would trade down and only a 40 percent chance that the breakout would be successful. It is impossible to know the probabilities with certainty, but 60–40 is a good rule of thumb when it comes to trading range breakout attempts. Aggressive traders would have shorted with a limit order at the high of the ii pattern, expecting it to be a bull trap. If a trader instead bought above the bar 8 ii pattern, the protective stop was hit on the entry bar; this would have been a good reversal, as are most failed ii patterns.


如果你在这个交易区间日的顶部附近、于第11根K线的摆动高点做空，你可以选择在第12根K线那根回测移动平均线的反转K线上反手做多，也可以在紧跟第11根K线做空之后的那根入场K线高点上方一个最小报价单位处挂买入止损单来反手。


> If you shorted the bar 11 swing high near the top of this trading range day, you could have reversed either on the bar 12 reversal bar that tested the moving average or on a buy stop at one tick above the entry bar that followed the bar 11 short.


在第13根K线摆动高点、也就是低2处做空的那笔交易，成了一笔五个最小报价单位的失败交易，一次失败的低2。你应该在第14根K线、于入场K线（即第13根信号K线之后那根K线）上方一个最小报价单位处反手做多，因为有空头被套住了，而且你本该预期至少还有两段上涨。如果你没在那里买入，就应该在第14根K线之后那根K线买入，因为第14根K线是一次两K线向上反转，也是移动平均线之上、可能正在形成的多头趋势中的一个高2买入信号。


> The short from the bar 13 swing high, low 2 became a five-tick failure and a failed low 2. You should have reversed to long on bar 14 at one tick above the entry bar (the bar after the bar 13 signal bar) since there were trapped shorts, and you should have expected at least two more legs up. If you did not buy there, you should have bought on the bar after bar 14 because bar 14 was a two-bar reversal up and a high 2 buy signal above the moving average in a possible bull trend.


每当交易者在抄顶之后，看到移动平均线处出现一根带多头信号K线的高2买入信号，就应该总是平掉空头、反手做多。如果当时没有空头，就直接做多。这不是一个好的做空建仓形态，因为它可能正在形成一个大楔形牛旗突破之后的回调。两根K线之前那根强劲的多头趋势K线就是突破，而三次向下推进分别从第7根K线附近那几根开始（取前三根是个不错的选择），然后是第9根K线，以及第10根K线的前一根。涨到第8根K线的那段行情向上突破了头两个小时的空头通道，而第10根K线是在向上突破空头趋势线之后、对那个更高低点的二次入场。一些交易者在第10根K线处买入，因为他们把这看成头肩底。另一些交易者用限价单在第13根K线低2下方买入，因为他们认为这是多头趋势、而不是交易区间，而多头趋势中的低2是买入建仓形态。低2只有在交易区间或空头趋势里才是做空建仓形态。当市场处在多头阶段时，交易者会把低2看作空头陷阱，会在它下方买入、博取向上反转。也有些交易者改为在低2入场K线上方一个最小报价单位处挂买入止损单，等待它失败的确认。


> Whenever traders are top picking and then see a high 2 buy signal at the moving average with a bull signal bar, they should always exit the short and reverse to long. If they were not short, they should go long. This was not a good short setup since this could have been setting up a pullback from the breakout of a large wedge bull flag. The strong bull trend bar two bars earlier was the breakout, and the three pushes down began with the bars around bar 7 (three bars before is a good choice), and then bar 9 and the bar before bar 10. The move up to bar 8 broke above the bear channel of the first couple of hours, and bar 10 was a second entry into the higher low after the break above the bear trend line. Some traders bought on bar 10 because they saw this as a head and shoulders bottom. Other traders bought with a limit order below the bar 13 low 2 since they saw this as a bull trend and not as a trading range, and a low 2 in a bull trend is a buy setup. A low 2 is a short setup only in a trading range or in a bear trend. When the market is in a bull phase, traders see a low 2 as a bear trap and will buy below it for the reversal up. Some traders would instead buy on a stop at one tick above the low 2 entry bar, waiting for confirmation that it would fail.


从第12根K线起就把多头当波段来做的交易者，会在市场创出新高之后把止损移动到最近一个摆动低点下方一个最小报价单位处。所以，一旦市场向上突破第13根K线的摆动高点，这位交易者就可以把保护性止损上移到第14根K线那个更高的低点稍下方。


> A trader who was swinging a long up from bar 12 would trail the stop to one tick below the most recent swing low after the market moved to a new high. So once the market rallied above the bar 13 swing high, the trader could move the protective stop up to just below the bar 14 higher low.


![图 29.2](figures/fig-29-02.jpg)


**图 29.2　强势多头趋势中的移动止损**


在强势多头趋势中，交易者常常在市场刚创出新的摆动高点之后，就把保护性止损移动到最近的摆动低点下方。一旦市场看起来要进入交易区间，交易者就应该了结一部分利润，并考虑改为剥头皮、赚取更小的利润。


> In a strong bull trend, traders often trail their protective stops to below the most recent swing low just after the market makes a new swing high. Once the market looks like it will enter a trading range, traders should take some profits, and consider scalping for smaller profits.


如图 29.2所示，今天大幅跳空高开，当天第一根K线就是一根强劲的多头趋势K线，因此很有可能成为从开盘即启动的多头趋势日。如果交易者在第2根K线或第4根K线上方买入，他们可以在第5根K线刚刚突破第3根K线那个最近的摆动高点时就开始移动保护性止损。涨到第5根K线的这三根K线多头急速行情，让大多数交易者相信始终入场方向是多头而且强势，因此许多交易者想让利润奔跑。一旦第7根K线突破第5根K线，他们就可以把保护性止损收紧到第6根K线下方一个最小报价单位处；当市场突破第9根K线时，他们可以再把止损上移到第10根K线下方一个最小报价单位处。


> Today, as shown in Figure 29.2, had a large gap up and a strong bull trend bar for the first bar of the day, and therefore had a good chance of becoming a bull trend from the open day. If traders bought above bar 2 or bar 4, they could have started to trail their protective stops as soon as bar 5 moved above the most recent swing high at bar 3. The three-bar bull spike up to bar 5 convinced most traders that the always-in direction was long and strong, so many traders wanted to let their profits run. Once bar 7 moved above bar 5, they could have tightened their protective stops to one tick below bar 6, and when the market moved above bar 9, they could have raised them to one tick below bar 10.


交易者知道，趋势通常在某个时点会出现一次较大的回调；许多交易者在认为一次更复杂的回调即将到来时，会了结部分或全部利润。等距运动目标位常常能提示机构可能在哪里止盈，也就是说，那可能就是回调开始的地方。既然最初那段强劲的多头急速行情从第4根K线开始、到第8根K线附近结束，那么以此为基准的向上等距运动目标位，很可能就是一个获利了结的位置。从第10根K线到第19根K线的那段上涨同样由三段行情组成，而三段式行情是楔形的一个变体（即使它出现在这样陡峭的通道里也一样），后面可能跟着一次更大的回调。最初的目标是移动平均线。第18根K线是一根大实体多头趋势K线，后面又跟着一根大实体多头趋势K线，这个两K线的买入高潮出现在一段持续很久的趋势之后。出现这种情况时，市场往往会修正至少10根K线和两段行情，尤其是在它远离移动平均线的时候，就像这里一样。当第19根K线变成一根空头反转K线时，许多交易者止盈了。另一些交易者认为第一轮回调之后至少还会创出一个新高，于是扛过了这轮回调。不过，当市场在临近收盘时突破第19根K线时，第30根K线处出现了激进的获利了结，所以许多交易者在新高处、以及市场掉头向下时止盈了。


> Traders know that trends usually have a larger pullback at some point, and many traders will take partial or full profits when they believe that a more complex pullback is imminent. A measured move target can often give an idea of where institutions might take profits, which means it is where a pullback could begin. Since the initial strong bull spike began at bar 4 and ended around bar 8, a measured move up from there would have been a level where profit taking was likely. The move up from bar 10 to bar 19 also had three legs, and a three-legged move is a variant of a wedge (even when it is in a steep channel like this) and can be followed by a larger pullback. The initial target was the moving average. Bar 18 was a large bull trend bar and was followed by another large bull trend bar, and this two-bar buy climax followed a protracted trend. When this happens, the market often corrects for at least 10 bars and two legs, especially when it is far from the moving average, as it was here. When bar 19 became a bear reversal bar, many traders took profits. Other traders assumed that the first pullback would be followed by at least one more new high, and they held through the pullback. However, there was aggressive profit taking on bar 30 when the market moved above bar 19 near the close of the day, so many traders took profits at the new high and as the market turned down.


今天是一个非常强势的多头趋势日，在回调到移动平均线之后，很可能会有一次对高点的测试。跌向第24根K线的那条空头通道动能很低、K线也很小。在第24根K线上方买入的交易者，可能会考虑沿用平时那八个最小报价单位的止损，以防向上突破那条空头通道（所有空头通道都是牛旗）之后，跟着出现一个更低的低点式突破回调。市场强力向上突破，但立刻形成了一次大幅的两K线空头反转。在正在回调到移动平均线的强势多头趋势里，这并不是一个可靠的做空建仓形态。有经验的交易者会继续依靠自己的止损，尽管止损位于信号K线下方好几个最小报价单位处。那些止损并不会被打到，交易者随后可以在当天高点附近了结多头。另一种做法是：交易者在第25根K线的两K线反转下方出场，然后在第26根K线微型通道突破回调的上方重新买入。


> Today was a very strong bull trend day and was likely to have a test of the high after a pullback to the moving average. The bear channel down to bar 24 had low momentum and small bars. A trader who bought above bar 24 might have considered relying on the usual eight-tick stop, in case the breakout above the bear channel (all bear channels are bull flags) was followed by a lower low breakout pullback. The market broke strongly to the upside but immediately formed a big two-bar bear reversal. This was not a reliable short setup in a strong bull trend that was pulling back to the moving average. Experienced traders would have relied on their stops, even though the stops were several ticks below the signal bar. The stops would not have been hit and the traders could have then exited their longs near the high of the day. Alternatively, a trader could have exited below the bar 25 two-bar reversal and then bought again above the bar 26 micro channel breakout pullback.


在强势多头趋势中、直到第19根K线买入高潮之前的任何时点买入的波段交易者，理想情况下会把保护性止损放在最近的摆动低点下方，这意味着要冒两个点以上的风险、使用较宽的止损。第19根K线买入高潮一旦形成，市场很可能就要进入交易区间，交易者这时就该切换到交易区间的交易风格，也就是剥头皮而不是做波段。既然市场正在进入交易区间，就很可能会跌破此前的摆动低点，因此再把保护性止损留在那里就不再合理了。一旦因为交易区间正在形成、止损大概率会被打掉，交易者就应该远在那之前就了结多头。机敏的交易者会在市场走强时、在很可能正在成形的区间顶部出场，比如在第19根K线下方就出场。激进的交易者则会在那时开始做空，目标是一路剥头皮到移动平均线。


> A swing trader who bought during the strong bull trend at any point up to the bar 19 buy climax ideally would have used a protective stop below the most recent swing low, which means risking more than two points and using a wide stop. Once the bar 19 buy climax formed, the market was likely to enter a trading range and the trader would have switched to a trading range style of trading, which means scalping instead of swinging. Since the market was entering a trading range, it was likely to fall below prior swing lows and therefore it no longer made sense to keep protective stops there. Once a stop is likely to get hit because a trading range is forming, traders should exit their longs well before that happens. Astute traders would have exited on strength at the top of the likely developing range, like below bar 19. Aggressive traders would have begun to short at that point, looking for a scalp to the moving average.


大多数波段交易者会把保护性止损一路移动到最近的摆动低点下方。有些交易者不喜欢让波段交易一直做到趋势结束，而更愿意使用止盈目标。这样做的人，往往会在市场走到止盈目标一半路程时，就把保护性止损移到不差于保本的位置。


> Most swing traders would have trailed their protective stops below the most recent swing low. Instead of letting a swing trade run until the trend ends, some traders prefer to use profit targets. Those who do often move their protective stops to no worse than breakeven once the market has reached halfway to their profit targets.


![图 29.3](figures/fig-29-03.jpg)


**图 29.3　回报常常等于风险**


市场常常给交易者多少最小报价单位作为利润，就等于它逼他们承担了多少最小报价单位的风险。总的来说，在空头趋势日里、在大实体信号K线上方买入是有风险的；这里根据图 29.3所示走势图描述的那些交易，充其量也只能算是勉强可以，但它们能说明一个道理。


> The market often rewards traders with as many ticks of profit as it forces them to risk. In general, it is risky to buy above large signal bars in a bear trend day, and the trades described here based on the chart shown in Figure 29.3 are questionable at best, but they illustrate a point.


如果交易者在第5根K线上方买入，认为它是连续第二次卖出高潮、是一段抛物线式下跌的底部，因此后面很可能跟着两段式上涨，那么他们的初始止损就会设在第5根K线低点下方。第7根K线回测了该低点，但没打到止损。不过，一旦市场突破第7根K线，这些交易者就会把止损移到第7根K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处，也就是进场价下方16个最小报价单位。随后市场恰好上涨到第8根K线的高点，正好是进场价上方16个最小报价单位（同时是对移动平均线的测试，空头就在那里进场）。懂这个规律的人会把止盈限价单挂在进场价上方15个最小报价单位处。由于他们认为自己买入的位置会成为一个小型交易区间的底部，他们相信自己至少有60% 的概率看到市场走出等距的上涨。这算是一笔勉强可以接受的交易。


> If traders bought above bar 5, thinking that it was the second consecutive sell climax and the bottom of a parabolic move and therefore likely to be followed by a two-legged rally, their initial stops would have been below the bar 5 low. Bar 7 tested the low but did not hit the stops. However, once the market went above bar 7, the traders would have moved their stops to one tick below the bar 7 low, which was 16 ticks below the entry price. The market then rallied to exactly the bar 8 high, which was 16 ticks above the entry price (and a test of the moving average, where shorts came in). Traders who understood this tendency would have placed a profit-taking limit order at 15 ticks above their entry. Since they were buying at what they thought would become the bottom of a small trading range, they believed that they had at least a 60 percent chance of the market having an equidistant move up. This was a barely acceptable trade.


在第12根K线和第16根K线那两根强劲多头趋势K线上方做多时，同样的事又发生了一次。一旦出现回调、随后又涨回来，交易者就能看出市场逼他们承担了多大风险，于是可以把止盈限价单挂在比这个风险少一个最小报价单位的位置。


> The same thing happened again on a long above the bar 12 and bar 16 strong bull trend bars. Once there was a pullback and then a move back up, traders saw how much the market forced them to risk, and they could put a profit-taking limit order at one tick less than that risk.


在第2根K线到第3根K线那段空头急速行情中任何时点做空、并且打算做波段的交易者，会用较宽的保护性止损，可能就放在这段急速行情的最高点上方。大多数交易者承担的风险会比这个小一些，但他们冒的风险也会是剥头皮交易的两三倍。


> A trader who shorted at any point during the bear spike from bar 2 to bar 3, and who planned to swing the trade, would have used a wide protective stop, possibly above the top of the spike. Most traders would have risked less than that, but they would also have risked two or three times as much as they would have on a scalp.


在第16根K线处，假设一位多头买入的是第三次向下推进之后的向上反转，想博一次末端旗形趋势反转。由于从第13根K线开始的下跌通道很窄，如果交易者先等一等、看突破是否强劲，再买入那段强劲急速行情或随后的回调，做多成功的概率本会更高。不过为了说明问题，就假设这位交易者直接在第16根K线上方买入了。他可能假定自己有50% 的概率看到市场向上突破第13根K线的高点并完成一段向上等距运动，这样他的回报就会远大于风险——他的风险是跌到第16根K线这根买入信号K线下方。但涨向第17根K线那根十字星的过程中，多头表现出的那种不急不忙，可能让他感到不安，从而认定自己的前提已经变了。他可能已经确信，市场只是在空头通道里又创了一个更低的低点，而不是趋势反转，于是他干脆把多头剥头皮平掉。如果他觉得市场正在见顶，那么继续持有多头就毫无道理。如果他觉得可能还有第二段上涨、但不会打到保本止损，他可能已经把保护性止损移到保本。如果他觉得市场可能跌到他的进场价之下、但仍守在信号K线低点之上并形成一个更高的低点，他可以继续用原来的止损，也可以先出场、再去买那个涨向更高低点的突破回调。交易者时时刻刻都在做这类决定，而这些决定做得越好，他们赚钱的能力就越强。如果他们总是死守最初的前提，即使市场并没有按他们预期的走，那他们想靠交易赚钱就会很难。交易者的工作就是跟随市场；如果市场没有去它该去的地方，就应该出场，另找机会。


> At bar 16, assume that a bull bought the reversal up from the third push down, looking for a final flag trend reversal. Since the channel down from 13 was tight, the probability of a successful long would have been higher if a trader waited to see if the breakout was strong, and then bought the strong spike or the pullback that followed. However, for the sake of illustration, assume that the trader simply bought above bar 16. He might have assumed that he had a 50 percent chance of the market breaking above the bar 13 high and reaching a measured move up, making his reward much greater than his risk, which was to below the bar 16 buy signal bar. However, he might have been concerned by the lack of urgency by the bulls on the move up to the bar 17 doji, and decided that his premise had changed. He might have become convinced that the market was simply making another lower low in a bear channel instead of a trend reversal, and then simply scalped out of his long. If he thought that the market was topping out, it would make no sense for him to continue to hold his long. If he thought that it might have a second leg up but not hit a breakeven stop, he might have moved his protective stop to breakeven. If he thought that the market might fall below his entry price but stay above the signal bar low and form a higher low, he could have kept his original stop, or he cold have exited and bought the breakout pullback to the higher low. Traders make these decisions constantly, and the better they get at making them, the better able they are to make money. If they always hold on to their original premise, even when the market is not doing what they expected, they will have a difficult time making money trading. Their job is to follow the market, and if it is not going where they believe it should, they should exit and look for another trade.


波段交易者容许回调，会耐心等到趋势走得很明确之后才收紧止损。一位在第20根K线下方做空的波段交易者，如果预期这是对交易区间顶部的一次测试、随后市场会恢复从开盘起就有的空头趋势，那他追求的回报可能至少是自己风险的两倍。看到那根强劲的空头入场K线之后，他可能已经把止损收紧到它高点上方，也可能一直把止损留在第20根信号K线高点上方，直到市场从第24根K线那个双顶掉头向下。信号K线有三个点（12个最小报价单位）高，所以他的初始风险是14个最小报价单位。如果他的止盈目标是风险的两倍，他就会想在进场价下方28个最小报价单位处、也就是1,305.25止盈；他的止盈限价单应该会在第27根K线之前两根成交。第24根K线越过了第23根K线之前那根强劲空头趋势K线一个最小报价单位，把那些沉不住气的弱空头关在了场外，但它并没有突破入场K线或信号K线。


> Swing traders allow pullbacks and patiently wait to tighten their stops until the trend is well underway. A swing trader who shorted below bar 20, expecting it to be a test of the top of the trading range that would lead to a resumption of the bear trend from the open, might have been looking for a reward that was at least twice as large as his risk. Once he saw the strong bear entry bar, he might have tightened his stop to above its high, or he might have left it above the bar 20 signal bar high until after it turned down from the bar 24 double top. The signal bar was three points (12 ticks) tall so his initial risk was 14 ticks. If his profit target was twice as large as his risk, he was looking to take profits at 28 ticks below his entry, or at 1,305.25, and his profit-taking limit order would have been filled two bars before bar 27. Bar 24 went one tick above the strong bear trend bar before bar 23, trapping out impatient weak shorts, but it did not get above the entry bar or the signal bar.


![图 29.4](figures/fig-29-04.jpg)


**图 29.4　止损幅度常常由当天第一笔交易决定**


如图 29.4所示，市场上涨到昨天的高点之上，然后掉头向下。在第1根K线下方做空的交易者，会把初始保护性止损放在第1根K线上方。当市场在第2根K线掉头向下之后，他们可以推算出来：市场在朝他们的方向走之前，曾逆向走了八个最小报价单位。这就意味着，他们要想拿住这笔交易，至少需要九个最小报价单位的初始保护性止损，而且在当天余下的时间里，他们会一直记着这一点。


> The market rallied to above yesterday's high and then turned down, as shown in Figure 29.4. Traders who shorted below bar 1 would have placed an initial protective stop above bar 1. After the market turned down on bar 2, they could have calculated that the market went eight ticks against them before it went their way. That meant that the minimum initial protective stop that they would have had to use to stay in the trade was nine ticks, and they would have remembered that for the rest of the day.


如果你在第3根K线处买入这个失败的低2，并把初始止损放在信号K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处，你冒的风险就是八个最小报价单位。扫一个最小报价单位的止损很常见；而当天早些时候你已经知道需要九个最小报价单位的止损，所以多冒那一个最小报价单位的风险是明智的。这算不上一次好的买入，因为它跟随的是一次很小的突破，而且前面七根K线基本都在横盘。二次入场会更好。第4根K线是一个高2买入建仓形态；再往后两根K线的那根多头内包K线，是一个突破回调买入建仓形态（那根内包K线就是高2做多突破之后的回调）；这两个都是更强的建仓形态。


> If you bought the failed low 2 at bar 3 and placed the initial stop at one tick below the signal bar's low, you would have risked eight ticks. One-tick stop runs are common and you would have known that a nine-tick stop was needed earlier in the day, so it would have been wise to risk the extra tick. This was not a great buy because it followed a tiny breakout and the last seven bars were largely sideways. A second entry would have been better. Bar 4 was a high 2 buy setup, and the bull inside bar two bars later was a breakout pullback buy setup (the inside bar was the pullback from the high 2 long breakout); both of those were stronger setups.


K线变小之后，你可以把止损幅度调整到适应当前市场状况的水平。不过，市场常常会在当天晚些时候出现一笔需要更大止损的交易。如果你的止损被打掉、认了亏，也不用太在意。这通常比整天不停地调整止损、止盈目标和仓位规模要省事——那样做最后往往会错过交易，或者犯下错误。


> Once the bars become smaller, you can adjust the size of your stop to one that is appropriate for the current market conditions. However, the market often later in the day will have a trade that would require a larger stop. Don't worry if your stop gets hit and you take a loss. It is usually easier than constantly adjusting your stops, targets, and position sizes all day, and end up missing trades or making mistakes.


![图 29.5](figures/fig-29-05.jpg)


**图 29.5　不要过早收紧止损**


不要在进场后几根K线内出现的小十字星K线之后收紧保护性止损。它们是一根K线构成的交易区间，市场在其外侧反向走出一个或两个最小报价单位是常有的事。你不会想在自己的前提依然成立的时候就被止损扫出局。


> Don't tighten your protective stop after small doji bars that form within a few bars of entry. They are one-bar trading ranges, and it is common for the market to reverse beyond them for a tick or two. You do not want to get stopped out of a trade when your premise is still intact.


如果交易者在第2根K线下方做空，看到自己的入场K线收成一根十字星，他们就应该把保护性止损继续留在信号K线高点上方，直到市场强力朝他们的方向走。他们可以在第3根K线那波急跌中先剥头皮平掉一部分；如果觉得移动平均线太陡、存在上涨风险，他们随后可以把止损收紧到保本，或者收紧到第3根K线上方一根K线处。这样做的话，他们会在第4根K线被扫出局，但这仍是明智的决定。不过，在跳空高开幅度很大的日子里，当回调已经接近移动平均线时，往往还会有第二段下跌、测试得更近一些；这常常会造就当天的低点，就像这里在第5根K线出现的情形一样。


> If traders shorted below bar 2 and saw the doji close of their entry bar, they should keep their protective stop above the signal bar high until the market makes a strong move in their direction. They could have scalped out part on the bar 3 plunge, and if they thought that the moving average was steep and there was a risk of a rally, they could then tighten it to breakeven or to one bar above bar 3. If they did, they would have been stopped out on bar 4, but it was still a sensible decision. However, on a large gap up day when there is a pullback that is close to the moving average, there is often a second leg down that tests closer; this often sets up the low of the day, as it did here at bar 5.


如果交易者在第5根K线那根均线缺口K线、同时也是高2和楔形牛旗的测试处上方买入，那么一旦入场K线收盘、并明确是一根强劲的多头趋势K线，他们就可以把波段那部分仓位的保护性止损移到保本。他们不会在第6根K线那根十字星的低点下方出场。


> If traders bought above the bar 5 moving average gap bar and high 2 and wedge bull flag test, they could have moved their protective stop to breakeven on the swing portion of their trade once the entry bar closed and was clearly a strong bull trend bar. They would not have exited below the low of the bar 6 doji.


如果他们是在第16根K线那根多头反转K线上方买入，把它当作一次高2做多、或者一个楔形牛旗（其中第8根或第10根K线构成第一次向下推进），那么当入场K线变成一根十字星之后，他们不会收紧止损。不过，一旦第18根K线成为一根强劲的多头趋势K线，他们就应该把止损移到它低点下方。


> If they bought above the bar 16 bull reversal bar, thinking of it as a high 2 long or as a wedge bull flag (where either bar 8 or bar 10 formed the first push down), they would not tighten their stop after the entry bar became a doji. However, once bar 18 became a strong bull trend bar, they should move their stop to below its low.


# 第 30 章　止盈与止盈目标

*30. Profit Taking and Profit Targets*


所有回调与反转都始于止盈。有经验的交易者会在强势中找机会离场，然后再找机会在回调中重新入场。举例来说，如果一轮多头趋势刚刚开始、而且格外强劲，那么当市场向上突破最近的摆动高点时，多头会买入更多。不过，随着趋势走向成熟、双边交易越来越多，他们就不再在最近的摆动高点上方用买入止损单买入了。相反，随着上涨行情转弱，他们会在那个高点上方、甚至略低于它的位置找机会止盈一部分。如果大多数多头都在前一个高点附近止盈、而不是在突破处继续买入，市场就会开始出现回调。这意味着多头更愿意在更低的价格买入，而且他们相信会出现一次能让他们这么做的回调，因此他们不再愿意追着市场往上买、在前高上方买入。如果止盈非常汹涌，同时又伴随着激进、毫不松懈的做空，这次回调就会长成一次大幅修正（一个交易区间），甚至演变成一次反转。多头也会在任何一个强势特征处找机会止盈，比如在收盘时、在一根大型多头趋势K线刚上方的位置，或者在随后一两根K线的收盘时——尤其当那是一根小K线、或者是空头收盘的K线。他们还会在下一根K线的低点下方止盈更多。这就是为什么那么多大型趋势K线（它们都是突破尝试）之后会跟着小K线和回调，也就是说，那些突破都失败了。交易者还会在前一根K线的低点下方、在最近那个更高的低点下方，或者在保本位挂一张止损单。这是因为，如果市场还没到他们的目标位就强力反转，他们可能会开始相信，自己能够离场、然后再以更好的价格买回来。刚建空头仓位的空头看到的是同样的东西，他们通常开始寻找剥头皮的机会：在新高处卖出，或者在强劲多头趋势K线的收盘价附近卖出。随着回调越来越深，他们会开始把仓位中的一部分转做波段。起初，他们做波段的那部分交易通常会被止损打掉，但随着修正越来越深、或者当趋势终于反转时，他们最终会赚到大笔的波段利润。


> All pullbacks and reversals begin with profit taking. Experienced traders look to exit on strength, and then look to reenter on a pullback. For example, if a bull trend is just beginning and is especially strong, bulls will buy more as the market breaks above the most recent swing high. However, as the trend matures and develops more two-sided trading, they will no longer buy on a stop above the most recent swing high. Instead, as the rally weakens, they will look to take some profits above that high, or even a little below. If most bulls are taking profits around the previous high and not buying more on the breakout, the market will begin to have a pullback. This means that the bulls would rather buy at a lower price and they believe that there will be a pullback that will allow them to do this, so they are no longer willing to chase the market up, buying above prior highs. If the profit taking is very heavy and if there is aggressive, relentless shorting as well, the pullback will grow into a large correction (a trading range) or even a reversal. Bulls will also look to take profits on any sign of strength, like at the close and just above a large bull trend bar, or at the close of the next bar or two, especially if it is a small bar or has a bear close. They will take more profits below the low of the next bar. This is why so many large trend bars, which are breakout attempts, are followed by small bars and pullbacks, which means that the breakouts failed. Traders will also have a stop order below the low of the prior bar, below the most recent higher low, or at breakeven. This is because if the market reverses strongly before reaching their target, they might come to believe that they will be able to exit and then buy again at a better price. Bears initiating shorts see the same thing, and usually begin looking for scalps by selling at new highs or around the closes of strong bull trend bars. As the pullbacks get deeper, they will begin to swing parts of their positions. Initially, they usually get stopped out of the swing portions of their trades, but eventually they will get large swing profits as the corrections get deeper, or when the trend finally reverses.


在空头趋势中，交易者的行为类似。趋势强劲时，空头会在摆动低点下方做空；但随着趋势转弱，他们转而会在最近那个摆动低点附近及下方买回自己的空头仓位，并寻找在更高处再次做空的机会。多头剥头皮交易者会在新低处买入，并在一次小反弹中剥头皮出场，而那个位置正是空头再次做空的地方。多头和空头都在等一根相对较大的空头趋势K线向下创出新低，到那时双方都会在那根K线的收盘价附近买入。随着空头趋势中的反弹行情越来越强，多头会更愿意把一部分仓位转做波段。到了某个时点，市场会转变成一段大型多头波段或趋势，然后整个过程会朝相反方向重新开始。理解那些制造突破的趋势K线，是交易者能够掌握的最重要的技能之一。交易者需要能够评估一次突破是可能成功，还是会遇到止盈和回调，又或者后面会跟着一次反转。这几种情形，在三本书的其它地方都有详细讨论。


> Traders behave similarly in bear trends. Bears will short below swing lows when the trend is strong, but as it weakens, they will instead buy back their shorts around and below the most recent swing low, and look to short again higher. A bull scalper will buy new lows and scalp out on a small rally, around where the bears are shorting again. Both the bulls and the bears wait for a relatively large bear trend bar that breaks to a new low, at which point both will buy around its close. As the bear rallies get stronger, the bulls will be more willing to swing some of their positions. At some point, the market will transition into a large bull swing or trend, and the process will begin in the opposite direction. Understanding trend bars that create breakouts is one of the most important skills that a trader can acquire. Traders need to be able to assess whether a breakout is likely to succeed, whether it will be met with profit taking and a pullback, or whether it will be followed by a reversal. Each of these is discussed in detail elsewhere in the three books.


入场时，你的目标是让市场在触及你的保护性止损之前，先到达你的止盈目标。只要你持有仓位，保护性止损就应当始终挂在场内；止盈目标则不同，它可以挂在场内，也可以只放在心里。举例来说，如果你在一段强趋势中做波段交易，你可能会在行情发展途中对一部分仓位止盈（这就是分批止盈），同时选择保留一部分仓位，直到出现相反方向的信号。那个反向信号一旦触发，你就应当离场。很少有交易者有能力这样反手：一边平掉一笔盈利的波段仓位，一边在相反方向建一笔新仓。


> When you enter a trade, your goal is to have the market reach your profit target before it hits your protective stop. Unlike protective stops, which should always be working in the market whenever you are holding a position, profit targets can be either in the market or in your head. For example, if you are swing trading in a strong trend, you might take profits on some of your position along the way (this is scaling out of your trade) and you might choose to hold on to some of your position until there is a signal in the opposite position. Once that opposite signal triggers, you should exit. Very few traders have the ability to reverse a position by simultaneously exiting a profitable swing position and entering a new trade in the opposite direction.


剥头皮交易者常常一入场就挂好了 OCO 订单（order cancels order 或 one cancels the other，即一单成交即自动撤销另一单）。举例来说，他们可能会买入苹果（AAPL）去做一笔100美分的剥头皮、承担50美分的风险；这个买入点是一次回调，而他们有60% 或更高的把握认为这笔交易会成功。他们一入场，最初那张单可能就自动生成两张单：一张挂在入场价下方50美分处的保护性卖出止损单，一张挂在入场价上方100美分处的卖出限价单。由于这个括号订单是 OCO 的，两张单里只要有一张成交，另一张就自动撤销。无论你怎么管理订单，每次入场和出场之后你都应该检查一下账户，确认当前的仓位和挂单正是你所认为的那样。你不会希望出现这种情况：自己已经空仓（没有任何仓位），而那张你以为早就该自动撤销的买入限价单却还挂在场内。永远不要假定你经纪商的软件100% 的时候都会按预期工作，也不要假定自己下单和挂单一定没错。任何事都有无法避免的失败率，所以当你认为某个操作应当已经完成之后，永远要再确认一遍它是否真的完成了。


> Scalpers often have order cancels order or one cancels the other (OCO) orders working as soon as they enter. For example, they might buy AAPL for a 100 cent scalp and risk 50 cents when they buy a pullback where they are 60 percent or more certain that the trade will be successful. As soon as they enter, their initial order might automatically generate both a protective sell stop order at 50 cents below their entry price and a sell limit order at 100 cents above their entry price. Since this bracket order is OCO, as soon as one of the pair is filled, the other is automatically canceled. No matter how you manage your orders, you should check your account after every entry and exit to make sure that your current position and orders are what you think they should be. You don't want to be flat (have no position) and still have a buy limit order working when you thought that it should have been automatically canceled. Never assume that your broker's software will work as expected 100 percent of the time, or that you placed your trades and orders correctly. There is an inescapable failure rate with everything, and you should always confirm what you expect has been done after you believe it should have been done.


所有交易都应当建立在交易者等式的基础上；入门交易者应该寻找这样的交易：成功概率在60% 或更高，回报至少与风险一样大，最好还约为风险的两倍——不过，交易者等式这么强的建仓形态，平均一天里也就出现两三次。举例来说，如果欧元外汇期货（Euro FX Currency Futures），或者与之对应的外汇（forex）品种 EUR/USD，最近的日均波幅一直在100个最小报价单位（常被称为点，pip）左右，而且每天都会出现好几段20个最小报价单位的行情、期间10个最小报价单位的保护性止损不会被触及，那么交易者就可以考虑在回调到均线处顺势入场，这样一笔赢单的概率很可能有60% 或更高。精心挑选建仓形态的交易者，用大约10个最小报价单位的风险去赚20个最小报价单位，概率大约有60%，这有一个非常出色的交易者等式。而在十年期美国国债期货中，如果日均波幅一直在32个最小报价单位（即16/32个点）左右，而且很多信号K线的高度都是四个最小报价单位，那么交易者同样可以考虑在回调到均线处入场，承担大约6个最小报价单位的风险，并使用8个最小报价单位作为止盈目标。这同样有一个很强的交易者等式。


> All trades should be made on the basis of the trader's equation, and beginning traders should look for trades where the probability of success is 60 percent or higher, and the reward is at least as large and preferably about twice the size of the risk, although a setup with that strong a trader's equation happens only a couple of times on an average day. For example, if the average daily range in the Euro FX Currency Futures or the foreign exchange (forex) equivalent, the EUR/USD, has lately been about 100 ticks (often referred to as pips), and there have been several 20-tick moves every day where a 10-tick protective stop would not have been hit, a trader might look to enter trends on pullbacks to the moving average, so that the probability of a winning trade is likely 60 percent or greater. The trader who carefully selects a setup has about a 60 percent chance of making 20 ticks while risking about 10 ticks, and this has an excellent trader's equation. In 10-Year U.S. Treasury Note Futures, if the average daily range has been about 32 ticks (16/32 of a point) and many signal bars have been four ticks tall, a trader could again look to enter on pullbacks to the moving average, risking about six ticks and using a profit target of eight ticks. This again has a strong trader's equation.


剥头皮和波段交易的交易管理方式不同。做剥头皮的交易者认为利润空间有限，原因要么是没有趋势，要么是他在逆着趋势交易。在交易区间里剥头皮可以是一套盈利的策略，但只有最有经验的交易者才应该考虑逆势交易。如果交易者能耐心等一次回调、顺着趋势方向入场，而不是指望一笔逆势交易会成功，那么赚钱的机会要大得多。一旦你认为存在趋势，你就必须接受这一点：80% 的反转尝试都会失败，并演变成旗形。这就使大多数交易者几乎不可能靠止损单入场去做逆势交易、还能持续赚钱。举例来说，如果你认为强多头趋势顶部的一根小空头反转K线之后会出现一次回调到均线的行情，于是你用卖出止损单在那根K线低点下方一个最小报价单位处做空，那你必须意识到：非常聪明的多头正挂着限价买单，就在那根K线的低点处买入，而概率站在他们那一边。如果你交易的是 Emini 小型合约，你需要市场跌到那根K线低点下方10个最小报价单位处，你的空头才能赚到8个最小报价单位的利润；但在强多头趋势中，大多数回调在跌到那里之前就会变成高1或高2买入建仓形态，于是你就会亏钱。如果你看出存在强趋势、又想买入一次回调，那就不要自欺欺人地以为自己有足够本事，能在等待买入形态形成的同时做一笔赚钱的空头剥头皮。无一例外，你会在这笔空头剥头皮上亏钱，而在买入形态形成时又不去做。你会盼着市场再跌一点，会拒绝承认回调即将结束，于是错过那笔可能赚到好几个点利润的多头交易。


> Trade management is different for scalps than it is for swings. A trader who is taking a scalp believes that the profit potential is limited either because there is no trend or because he is trading against the trend. Scalping in a trading range can be a profitable strategy, but only the most experienced traders should consider trading against the trend. The chances of making money are far greater if a trader can patiently wait for a pullback and enter in the direction of the trend, rather than hoping that a countertrend trade will be successful. Once you believe there is a trend, you must accept that 80 percent of reversal attempts will fail and evolve into flags. This makes it almost impossible for most traders to enter countertrend trades on stops and consistently make a profit. For example, if you think that a small bear reversal bar at the top of a strong bull trend will be followed by a pullback to the moving average, and you short on a stop at one tick below the low of the bar, you must realize that very smart bulls have limit orders to buy at the low of that bar, and the odds are on their side. If you are trading the Emini, you need the market to fall ten ticks below the low of that bar for you to make an eight-tick profit on your short, but most pullbacks in a strong bull trend will turn into high 1 or high 2 buy setups before that happens, and you will lose money. If you see that there is a strong trend and you want to buy a pullback, do not fool yourself into believing that you have enough talent to be able to profitably trade a short scalp as you wait for the buy setup to form. Invariably, you will lose money on the short scalp and not take the buy setup when it forms. You will be hoping for more down and be in denial that the pullback is about to end, and you will miss the long that might be good for several points of profit.


当趋势转变成交易区间之后，逆势交易其实就谈不上逆势了，因为趋势已经暂时结束。不过，许多交易者试图去抓多头趋势的顶或者空头趋势的底，他们相信市场即将进入交易区间、以为自己的风险很小，结果只能眼看着自己的账户慢慢缩水。


> After the trend has turned into a trading range, then countertrend trading is really not countertrend, because the trend has temporarily ended. However, many traders try to pick the top of a bull trend or the bottom of a bear trend, believing that the market is about to enter a trading range and thinking that their risk is small, only to watch their accounts slowly melt away.


无论交易者做哪一笔交易，都需要一个止盈计划，否则市场最终会掉头对付他们，利润就会变成亏损。交易管理完全取决于交易者等式；只要能带来持续的盈利，风险、回报和概率的任何组合都是有效的策略。作为一条通则，大多数交易者应当把自己限制在高概率的交易上，也就是风险至少与潜在回报一样大的那类交易。理想情况下，交易者应当寻找成功机会至少60%、潜在回报约为风险两倍的建仓形态；但通常他们不得不接受回报与风险大致相当、或者只略大一点的交易。这种情形最常出现在趋势中的回调里。


> Whenever traders enter any trade, they need a plan to take profits, because otherwise the market will eventually turn on them and their profits will turn into losses. Trade management depends entirely on the trader's equation, and any combination of risk, reward, and probability that results in a consistent profit is an effective strategy. As a general rule, most traders should restrict themselves to high-probability trades where the risk is at least as great as the potential reward. Ideally, traders should look for setups where the chance of success is at least 60 percent and the potential reward is about twice the size of the risk, but usually they will have to settle for a reward that is about the same size as their risk, or maybe a little bigger. This most often happens in pullbacks in trends.


在强趋势中做波段交易时，很容易过早止盈，因为很难相信这笔交易可能会走出你的止损规模五倍以上的行情。不过，当趋势很强时，这确实是有可能的。如果你认为趋势很强，那么在市场朝你有利的方向走出大约等于最初保护性止损两倍的距离之后，平掉大约一半仓位是合理的。举例来说，如果你在 Emini 小型合约上的初始止损是两个点，而在一段强空头趋势中、在你认为将是一段大跌行情起点附近的位置做空，那就在入场价下方四个点处挂限价单，平掉一半仓位。到那时，把你的止损改成移动止损。你也可以在最初止损规模的三倍处、也就是六个点处再平掉四分之一，然后让最后那四分之一继续跑，只有在出现强劲的买入信号时、或者在当日收盘时才能离场，以先到者为准。不过，如果你对分批止盈感到不自在，那么在赚到风险两倍的位置平掉全部仓位也是一种合理的做法。你总可以在下一个信号处重新入场。


> When swinging a trade in a strong trend, it is easy to take profits too early because it is so difficult to believe that the trade might run five or more times more than the size of your stop. However, when a trend is strong, that can be the case. If you believe that the trend is strong, it is reasonable to take about half of your position off after the market has gone your way for a distance equal to about twice the size of your original protective stop. For example, if your initial stop in the Emini was two points and you shorted in a strong bear trend near what you think will be the start of a big swing down, exit half of your position on a limit order at four points below your entry. At that point, trail your stop. You might take another quarter off at three times your original stop size, at six points, then let the last quarter run, and exit only if a strong buy signal develops or at the close of the day, whichever comes first. However, exiting the entire position at twice the risk is a reasonable approach if you are uncomfortable scaling out of a trade. You can always enter again on the next signal.


每一笔交易的交易者等式都随着每一个最小报价单位而变化。如果交易者等式仍然有利、但不如原来那么强，有经验的交易者往往会收紧保护性止损，或者带着较小的利润离场。如果交易者等式变得勉强，交易者就应当尽快找机会离场，利润能拿多大就拿多大，亏损能压多小就压多小。如果它变成负数，他们就应该立刻用市价单离场，哪怕这意味着要认亏。判断自己该不该离场，有一个办法是：想象你并没有持仓，然后看着市场，判断此时用市价单入场、并使用那个保护性止损是否明智。如果你不会这么做，那么你当前这笔仓位的交易者等式就是弱的、甚至是负的，你应当离场。


> The trader's equation of every trade changes with every tick. If the trader's equation is still favorable but not as strong as it was, experienced traders will often either tighten their protective stops or exit with a smaller profits. If the trader's equation becomes marginal, traders should look to exit as soon as possible, with as big a profit or small a loss as they can. If it becomes negative, they should exit immediately at the market, even if that means taking a loss. One way to decide if you should exit your trade is to imagine that you are not holding a position. Then look at the market and decide if you think that it would be wise to enter at the market and use that protective stop. If you would not, then the trader's equation for your current position is weak or negative and you should exit.


记住，止盈目标是保护性止损的另一面，它的作用就是保护你不至于害了自己。它迫使你在交易者等式仍然为正的时候止盈，并防止你持有过久、等到这笔交易一路回到你的入场价、甚至更糟——已经变成一笔亏损单之后才离场。就像大多数交易者最好是始终使用一张真正挂在场内的保护性止损一样，他们也最好是使用一张始终挂在场内的止盈限价单。


> Remember, a profit target is the flip side of a protective stop and is there to protect you from yourself. It forces you to take profits at a time when the trader's equation is still positive, and prevents you from holding too long and then exiting once the trade has come all of the way back to your entry price, or worse, once it has turned into a loser. Just as it is better for most traders to always use a protective stop that is actually in the market, it is also better to use a profit-taking limit order that is always in the market.


![图 30.1](figures/fig-30-01.jpg)


**图 30.1　回调终结于多种支撑类型的汇合处**


存在趋势时，在回调到均线处入场是一种可靠的做法，成功概率通常至少60%，而且潜在回报大于风险。在图 30.1中，从第6根K线起那段强劲的四根K线多头急速行情之后，跟着一次急剧回调到均线的走势，其中第11根K线之后那根多头内包K线，是一根合理的做多信号K线。由于这根K线高四个最小报价单位，初始风险是6个最小报价单位。有些交易者把这个建仓形态看成高2，另一些人把它看成一个紧凑的楔形，其中第8根和第10根K线的低点是前两次向下推进。斐波那契交易者把它看成一次62% 的回撤；它同时也是对第4根K线高点的一次突破回测，只差一个最小报价单位就把保本止损扫掉。每当一次回调结束，回调底部所在的位置通常都有多个在数学上说得通的理由汇合在一起。不同的机构会用不同的理由，但当很多理由同时出现时，就会有足够多的机构在这一带买入，从而压倒空头，回调就此结束。


> When there is a trend, entering on a pullback to the moving average is a reliable approach where the probability of success is usually at least 60 percent and the potential reward is greater than the risk. In Figure 30.1, the strong four-bar bull spike up from bar 6 was followed by a sharp pullback to the moving average, where the bull inside bar after bar 11 was a reasonable signal bar for a long. Since the bar was four ticks tall, the initial risk was six ticks. Some traders saw the setup as a high 2, and others saw it as a tight wedge, where the lows of bars 8 and 10 were the first two pushes down. Fibonacci traders saw it as a 62 percent retracement, and it was also a breakout test of the bar 4 high, missing the breakeven stops by a tick. Whenever a pullback ends, there is usually a confluence of mathematically logical reasons for the location of the bottom of the pullback. Different firms will use different reasons, but when there are many present, enough firms will buy in the area so that they overwhelm the bears and the pullback ends.


市场很可能在第9根K线的高点处遇到阻力，空头把那个高点看作从第7根K线向下急速跌到第8根K线低点之后那段下跌通道的起点。他们期待的是一个双顶熊旗，很多人一直等到市场去测试第9根K线的高点才做空。空头这种暂时的缺席，反而提高了该价位被触及的可能性。第9根K线的高点恰好比信号K线的高点高10个最小报价单位，而这正是多头用限价单离场、赚到8个最小报价单位利润（即4/32个点）所需要的点数。在主要市场里，一切都要靠数学，因为很大一部分交易是由计算机完成的，而它们做决策必须依靠数学。


> The market was likely to find resistance at the bar 9 high, which bears saw as the start of the channel down following the spike down from bar 7 to the bar 8 low. They were hoping for a double top bear flag, and many waited to short until the market tested the bar 9 high. This temporary loss of bears increased the chances that the level would be reached. The bar 9 high was exactly 10 ticks above the signal bar high, which is exactly how many ticks the bulls needed to be able to exit on a limit order with eight ticks’ profit (4/32 of a point). Everything in major markets is mathematical because so much of the trading is done by computers and they have to rely on math for their decision making.


![图 30.2](figures/fig-30-02.jpg)


**图 30.2　在多头趋势中买入回调**


在欧元外汇期货（或与之对应的外汇品种 EUR/USD）中买入回调，是一种可靠的交易做法。在欧元上，如果交易者精心挑选建仓形态，他们往往可以设定一个约为止损两倍的止盈目标。注意图 30.2中第9根K线的三角形突破是如何毫不犹豫地一路猛冲的。那根小多头内包K线就是买入信号，它的高点只比那段台阶的低点高8个最小报价单位，因此风险是10个最小报价单位。既然那根内包K线是一个买入信号，那么在第9根K线向上越过它、变成一根外包K线时买入就是合理的。交易者本可以把止盈限价单挂在入场价上方20个最小报价单位处，并且会在第10根K线顶部附近成交（就在那条小小的黑色水平线处）。


> Buying pullbacks in the Euro FX Currency Futures (or the forex equivalent, the EUR/USD) is a reliable approach to trading. In the Euro, if traders carefully select their setups, they can often have a profit target that is about twice as large as their stop. Notice in Figure 30.2 how the bar 9 triangle breakout raced up without hesitation. The small bull inside bar was the buy signal and its high was just eight ticks above the low of the ledge, so the risk was 10 ticks. Since the inside bar was a buy signal, it was reasonable to buy as bar 9 went above it and became an outside bar. A trader could have had a profit-taking limit order located 20 ticks above the entry price, and would have been filled near the top of bar 10 (at the small horizontal black line).


随后交易者本可以买第14根K线那个双底（它同时是一个高2——第12根K线是高1——也是向上突破第12根K线那面小牛旗之后的突破回调），并在第15根K线上离场、拿到20个最小报价单位的利润，出场位置恰好在第13根K线高点上方。第14根K线这根信号K线高14个最小报价单位，所以初始风险是16个最小报价单位。由于这是趋势中的一次回调，成功机会被假定为至少60%。


> The trader could then have bought the bar 14 double bottom (it was also a high 2 with the bar 12 high 1, and a breakout pullback from the breakout above the bar 12 small bull flag) and exited with 20 ticks of profit on bar 15, just above the bar 13 high. The bar 14 signal bar was 14 ticks tall, so the initial risk was 16 ticks. Since this was a pullback in a trend, the chance of success was assumed to be at least 60 percent.


第19根K线是一根多头反转K线，也是这段强多头趋势中第一次回调到均线。这根K线高8个最小报价单位，所以风险是10个最小报价单位；交易者本可以在第20根K线顶部稍下方离场，那个位置恰好比信号K线的高点高22个最小报价单位。由于那张限价单挂在信号K线高点上方21个最小报价单位处，多头本可以带着20个最小报价单位的利润离场。此时市场很可能处在交易区间中，因为第16根K线是一段向下急速行情（十字星顶部就是先向上急速、再向下急速，两者都发生在同一根K线之内），而跌到第19根K线的那波走势处在一条通道里。市场很可能会去测试通道顶部并形成一个双顶，而这个交易区间很可能会扩大——事实也确实如此。正因为如此，第19根K线上方那笔做多，更好的做法是剥头皮离场。通道顶部之下还有空间，可以让一个20个最小报价单位的止盈目标成交，所以这里是全部平掉这笔多头剥头皮的合理位置。


> Bar 19 was a bull reversal bar and the first pullback to the moving average in a strong bull trend. The bar was eight ticks tall, so the risk was 10 ticks and a trader could have exited just below the top of bar 20, which was exactly 22 ticks above the signal bar high. Since the limit order was 21 ticks above the signal bar high, the longs could have exited with their 20-tick profit. The market was likely in a trading range at this point, since bar 16 was a spike down (a doji top is a spike up and then a spike down, both within the same bar), and the move down to bar 19 was in a channel. The market was likely to test the top of the channel and form a double top, and the trading range was likely to grow, which it did. Because of this, it would have been better to scalp the long above bar 19. There was room for a 20-tick profit target to be filled below the top of the channel, so this was a reasonable location to exit the entire long scalp.


交易者本可以在第21根K线那次两K线反转的上方再次买入，因为它与第19根K线构成双底，而且是第一根均线缺口K线（这段趋势中第一根高点低于均线的K线）。风险是11个最小报价单位，交易者本可以在第22根K线高点稍下方带着20个最小报价单位的利润离场。


> Traders could have bought again above the bar 21 two-bar reversal, since it was a double bottom with bar 19 and the first moving average gap bar (the first bar in the trend with a high below the moving average). The risk was 11 ticks, and traders could have exited with 20 ticks’ profit just below the bar 22 high.


如果交易者买入了第9根K线的三角形突破，那么一旦看到那两根K线多头急速行情的强度，他们本可以改变计划。他们本可以不必在20个最小报价单位处平掉全部仓位，而是在那里平掉一半，然后也许再挂一张限价单，在再高10个或20个最小报价单位处平掉另外四分之一。然后他们本可以让剩下的仓位一直跑到当日收盘，或者跑到出现一个清晰的做空信号为止。第16根K线的卖出高潮很可能会带来一次回调到均线的行情，交易者本可以在第16根K线下方（或者两根K线之后那根空头内包K线下方）离场，然后在均线处重新买入，这是合理的做法。不过，如果他们一直在分批止盈、手上只剩四分之一仓位，他们本也可以一直持有到收盘，因为他们知道买家很可能会在均线处回来，而他们也许能在收盘前把市场推到一个新高。


> If traders bought the bar 9 triangle breakout, they could have changed their plan once they saw the strength of the two-bar bull spike. Instead of exiting their entire position at 20 ticks, they could have exited half there and then maybe place a limit order to exit another quarter at another 10 or 20 ticks higher. They could then have let the remainder run until the close of the day or until there was a clear short signal. The sell climax at bar 16 was likely to lead to a pullback to the moving average, and it would have been reasonable for traders to exit below bar 16 (or below the bear inside bar two bars later), and buy again at the moving average. However, if they had been scaling out and had only a quarter of their position left, they could have also held until the close, because they would have known that buyers were likely to return at the moving average, and they might have been able to push the market to a new high before the close.


第21根K线那笔做多仍然处在一个交易区间之中，但它与第19根K线构成一个双底牛旗；因此，市场有相当大的机会在收盘前创出一个新高。尽管交易者本可以在20个最小报价单位处把全部仓位剥头皮平掉，而且他那个假设是对的——大多数向上突破交易区间顶部的尝试都会失败——但这次两段式修正带来一次成功突破的机会更大，而且强劲的多头趋势日往往会在临近收盘时上涨到新高。因此，交易者本可以把四分之一到一半的多头仓位转做波段，以防万一。


> The bar 21 long was still in a trading range, but it was a double bottom bull flag with bar 19; therefore there was a reasonable chance that the market might reach a new high before the close. Although a trader could have scalped out of his entire position at 20 ticks on the correct assumption that most attempts to break out of the top of a trading range will fail, this two-legged correction had a higher chance of leading to a successful breakout, and strong bull trend days often rally to a new high at the end of the day. A trader therefore could have swung a quarter to a half of his long, just in case.


# 第 31 章　分批建仓与分批止盈

*31. Scaling Into and Out of a Trade*


分批建仓，简单说就是你已经持有头寸之后再次入场；分批止盈则是：离场时只了结头寸的一部分，剩下的留待稍后再了结。愿意分批止盈的交易者比愿意分批建仓的多；事实上，很多交易者经常分批止盈。比如说，你先了结一部分头寸做一次剥头皮，再把余下的头寸作为一笔波段交易了结，这就是在分批止盈。


> Scaling into a trade simply means that you are entering again once you are already in a position, and scaling out means that when you exit, you exit only part of your position and look to exit the rest later. More traders are willing to scale out than are willing to scale in; in fact, many traders regularly scale out of trades. For example, if you exit part of your position for a scalp and then exit the balance for a swing, you are scaling out of your trade.


分批建仓意味着你在加仓。共同基金这样的机构不得不持续地分批建仓和分批止盈，因为它们每天都会收到新的资金和赎回请求。个人交易者常常在下列情形使用分批建仓：在回调中顺着趋势方向入场时、在交易区间的极值处反向操作时，以及做平均成本法时。对一个潜在的反转分批建仓风险很大；如果市场朝你不利的方向走，通常更好的做法是先离场，然后再去找二次入场的机会。


> Scaling into a trade means that you are adding to your position. Institutions like mutual funds have to scale into and out of positions constantly because they receive new money and requests for redemptions every day. Individual traders commonly use scaling in when they enter in the direction of the trend during a pullback and when fading the extremes of a trading range, and when they dollar cost average. Scaling into a potential reversal is very risky; it is usually better to exit if the market goes against you and then look for a second entry.


你既可以在交易对你不利时分批建仓，也可以在交易朝着你的方向走时分批建仓。如果你已经有盈利之后再分批建仓，这也叫加仓，或者叫加大押注（pressing your trade）。比如说，如果市场处在多头通道里，那么随着市场走高，多头会在每一次回调时加仓。强势多头急速行情也一样。很多交易者在急速行情一根接一根K线迅速扩张的过程中快速加多。强势急速行情总会短暂地创造出交易者等式极其优越的机会，有些交易者很擅长在这种快速行情中加大押注。每一次追加买入通常都在更高的价位，而他们此前所有的入场都是盈利的。在市场走高过程中于多头通道里做空的空头，则是在前一根K线的高点之上分批建仓，并且随着交易继续走高继续加仓。他们此前的每一笔入场亏损都在扩大，但空头预期一旦市场反转，他们就能获得净盈利。我有个朋友，专长就是在 Emini 小型合约的通道中逆势分批建仓、等待反转。他等市场去测试通道的起点，在那里止盈。比如说，假如 Emini 小型合约近期的平均波幅大约是10到15点，而今天走出了一段急速与通道式的多头趋势，已经推进了两次、并且并非特别强势，他就会在最近的摆动高点用限价单开始做空，并在通道中接下来的一两个新高处继续加仓，只要每一次新入场都比前一次至少高两个点。他的一到三笔入场每笔大约是10手合约。多年前他做这些交易时，我和他聊过很多次，市场从来没有在他的第二或第三笔入场之外走多远就反转朝他有利的方向去了，所以在我们的谈话中，止损从来不是问题。不过，我推测止损至少得放在他最后一笔入场之外几个点的位置。按照我的计算，我认为他愿意为自己的30手合约承担5,000到10,000美元的风险。我讲这个故事不是要提倡他的做法，因为极少有人有那样的经验来这样做交易。不过，他是一个很有意思的真实例子：一个专门做某种特定分批建仓、并以此谋生的交易者。


> You can scale in either as the trade moves against you or as it moves in your direction. If you scale in after you already have a profit, this is also referred to as adding to your position, or pressing your trade. For example, if the market is in a bull channel, bulls will add to their positions on every pullback as the market goes higher. The same is true of a strong bull spike. Many traders quickly add to their longs as the spike rapidly grows, bar after bar. Strong spikes always create brief opportunities when the trader's equation is exceptional, and some traders are adept at pressing their trades in these fast markets. Each additional purchase is usually at a higher price, and all of their earlier entries are profitable. Bears who are shorting in the bull channel as the market is going higher are scaling in above the highs of prior bars and adding on as the trade continues higher. Each earlier entry has a growing loss, but the bears expect that once the market reverses, they will have a net profit. I have a friend who is an expert at scaling into countertrend trades in channels in the Emini, looking for a reversal. He looks for the market to test the beginning of the channel, where he takes profits. For example, if the recent average range lately in the Emini has been about 10 to 15 points, and today has a spike and channel bull trend that has had a couple of pushes up and is not particularly strong, he would start to short on limit orders at the most recent swing high, and add to his position at the next one or two new highs in the channel, as long as each new entry was at least two points higher than the prior. Each of his one to three entries was for about 10 contracts. I chatted with him many times years ago as he took these trades, and the market never went much beyond his second or third entry before reversing and going his way, so the stop was never an issue in our conversation. However, I assume that it had to be at least a few points beyond his final entry. According to my math, I believe that he was willing to risk between $5,000 and $10,000 for his 30 contracts. I am telling this story not to advocate what he was doing, because very few people have the experience to trade like that. However, he is an interesting, real example of a trader who specializes in a particular type of scaling in and makes a living by doing it.


在交易正朝你不利的方向走时分批建仓，其关键前提是：你相信市场很快会转向你的方向，你将能够获利。除非你对大格局有把握，否则绝不该对亏损头寸分批建仓；最好的情形是，你相信自己是在一段强趋势中、方向明确的始终入场格局下，对一段正在扩大的回调分批建仓。绝大多数交易者从不对亏损头寸加仓，而是让自己被止损出场，然后再找机会重新入场——如果有另一个信号的话。不过，很多交易者觉得自己永远拿不准趋势或交易区间的确切顶部或底部，但当市场接近反转时他们是有把握的。这类交易者中，有些人会做这笔反转交易并使用宽止损；另一些人用紧止损，如果市场朝他们不利的方向走，他们就被止损出场，然后再找另一次入场。分批建仓的交易者一开始会用小得多的仓位规模，如果市场继续朝他们不利的方向走，只要他们相信自己的前提依然成立，就会加仓。如果市场立刻朝他们有利的方向走，很多人会设法通过加大押注把仓位加满到正常规模。他们本来就愿意在更好或更差的价位分批建仓。比如说，如果他们在交易区间底部买入一次向上反转、并且愿意在更低的价位分批建仓，结果市场却立刻朝他们有利的方向走，他们就可能在市场继续上涨奔向交易区间顶部的过程中，在回调时加仓。另一些交易者可能先做半仓，在更低的价位加上后一半，然后打算在反转向上时把前一半按保本价了结，并用保本止损持有后一半做波段。如果你在对一个亏损头寸分批建仓，而后你断定大格局已经改变、你的前提不再成立，你就必须平掉交易、承担亏损。即便市场开始转向你的方向，如果你觉得原来的目标已不现实，也不要抱着希望、指望前提会重新成立。你必须始终交易眼前的市场，而不是你想要的市场、也不是几根K线之前的那个市场。市场每跳动一个最小报价单位都在变化，如果你原来的目标现在已不现实，就找一个新的目标并在那里离场，即便那意味着你要承担亏损。比如说，如果你在一个始终做多的多头市场里分批建仓，而它随后翻转成始终做空的方向，你就应该平仓、转而寻找做空机会，而不是指望始终做多的多头市场会再回来。希望从来不是持仓的可靠依据，因为市场建立在数学之上，而不是运气、公平、情绪、因果报应或宗教之上。


> The key premise to scaling into a trade that is moving against you is that you believe that the market will soon turn in your direction and that you will be able to make a profit. You should never scale into a losing position unless you are confident about the big picture, and the best situation is when you believe that you are scaling into a growing pullback in a strong trend and with a clear always-in direction. Most traders never add to a losing position and instead let themselves get stopped out, and then look to re-enter if there is another signal. However, many traders feel that they can never be certain of the exact bottom or top of a trend or trading range, but are confident when the market is close to a reversal. Some of those traders take the reversal trade and use a wide stop. Others use a tight stop, and if the market goes against them, they get stopped out and then look for another entry. Scale in traders trade a much smaller position size initially and will add to their position if the market continues against them, as long as they believe that their premise remains valid. If the market goes their way immediately, many will look to build their position up to full size by pressing their bets. They were willing to scale in at either a better or worse price. For example, if they bought a reversal up from the bottom of a large trading range and were willing to scale in lower, but instead the market immediately goes their way, they might add to their position on pullbacks as the market continues to rally toward the top of the trading range. Other traders might trade half size, add the second half lower, and then look to exit the first half at breakeven on the reversal up, and swing the second half with a breakeven stop. If you are scaling into a losing position and you then decide that the big picture has changed and your premise is no longer valid, you must exit your trade and take your loss. Even if the market begins to turn your way, if you feel that your original target has become unrealistic, do not hold on and hope that your premise will once again become valid. You have to always trade the market that is in front of you and not the one that you want or the one that you had a few bars ago. The market changes with every tick, and if your original target is now unrealistic, look for a new target and get out there, even if that means that you will be taking a loss. For example, if you scaled into an always-in bull market and it then flipped to an always-in bear direction, you should exit and look for short trades instead of hoping that the always-in bull market will once again return. Hope is never a sound basis for holding a position, because the market is based on mathematics and not luck, fairness, emotion, karma, or religion.


“绝不向亏损头寸加仓。”这是华尔街最基本的规则之一。可是它有误导性，因为机构一直在这么做，而且这是许多盈利策略的一部分。这怎么可能呢？因为这条格言说的是逆势交易，而机构是在顺势交易中分批建仓。每当一家机构觉得市场涨得太多或跌得太多，它就看到了做反方向的价值。由于没有人能经常抓到确切的转折点，很多机构会在许多根K线的时间里分笔入场。它们不在意某些入场信号出现时，此前的入场正处在浮亏之中。只要它们看到价值、而且有大量的头寸要建立，它们就会设法以尽可能好的价格成交，无论这个价格高于还是低于它们此前的入场价。这类似于个人投资者的平均成本法。如果一位投资者有些现金、想买入股票，他可能在接下来10个月里每月的1号用现金的10% 买入，无论后面的买入价是不是更低。平均成本法是一种成功的方法，而且往往要求投资者向一个亏损头寸加仓。不过，这与下面这种交易者截然不同：他在一段强势空头急速行情的底部买入，心想很快总得有一次反弹。当市场再连续两根K线直直下跌时，他买得更多；然后价格更低时再买，试图摊低成本。很快，他就盼着出现任何一次反弹，涨到接近他的平均入场价附近，好让他按保本价脱身。


> “Never add to a losing position.” That is one of the most fundamental rules on Wall Street. However, it is misleading because institutions do it all the time and it is part of many profitable strategies. How can that possibly be? It is because the adage refers to counter-trend trades and the institutions are scaling into with trend trades. Whenever an institution feels that the market has gone too far up or down, it sees value in doing the opposite. Because no one can regularly pick exact turning points, many institutions enter in pieces over the course of many bars. They do not care if some of the entry signals form when their earlier entries have an open loss. As long as they see value and have a large position to build, they will work to fill it at the best possible price, regardless of whether it is above or below their earlier entries. This is similar to dollar cost averaging for an individual investor. If an investor has some cash and wants to buy stock, he might use 10 percent of the cash to buy on the first of each of the next 10 months, regardless of whether the later entries are at a lower price. Dollar cost averaging is a successful approach and more often than not requires an investor to add to a losing position. However, this is far different from a trader who buys at the bottom of a strong bear spike, thinking that there has to be a bounce soon. When the market falls straight down for two more bars, he buys more, and then more again even lower, as he attempts to lower his average cost. Soon, he is hoping for any bounce up to near his average entry price so that he can get out at breakeven.


无一例外，他的头寸已经变得太大，于是他决定必须在下一根空头趋势K线上出场。那根K线通常是一段巨大的卖出高潮，他带着巨亏离场，亏损比他当初做多剥头皮想赚的利润大许多倍；而他离场的位置，恰恰就是市场在大幅上涨之前的底部。


> Invariably, his position has become so large that he decides that he has to get out on the next bear trend bar. That bar is usually a large sell climax and he exits with a huge loss, many times greater than the original profit he was trying to make from his buy scalp, and his exit is at the bottom of the market just before a huge rally.


对一笔交易分批建仓或分批止盈，是有可靠的数学依据的，但很多交易者做这件事，只是因为他们发现这样做行得通，并不在乎其中的道理。职业交易者在日线图和周线图上一直这么做。这对日内交易者同样有效。如果你做的是股票日内波段交易、又没时间全天持续盯盘，并且你读价格行为很有经验、确信自己的入场处在某段波段的起点附近，那么你可以使用宽的保护性止损，并在市场继续朝你不利的方向走时考虑加仓。你的初始交易可以是平常仓位规模的二分之一或三分之一，而在市场朝你不利的方向走时，可以分批建仓一到两次。


> There is a sound mathematical basis for scaling into or out of a trade, but many traders do it simply because they discovered that it works and they don't care about the reasoning. Professional traders do it on daily and weekly charts all the time. It works for day traders as well. If you are taking swing trades intraday on stocks that you do not follow constantly throughout the day and you are experienced at reading price action and confident that your entry is near the start of a swing, you can use a wide protective stop and look to add on if the market continues against you. Your initial trade could be a half or a third of your usual position size, and you can look to scale in one or two times as the market goes against you.


分批建仓通常最好用在始终入场市场（即清晰的趋势）中一段正在扩大的回调里——至少要在更高的时间级别上如此——以及用在交易区间极值处的反向操作中。交易者可以分批建仓的时机包括：


> Scaling into a trade is usually best in a growing pullback in an always-in market (a clear trend), at least on a higher time frame, and in fading the extremes of a trading range. A trader can scale:


- 在强势多头急速行情的小回调处加多（回调就是一段小的逆势通道）。
- 在强势空头急速行情的小回调处加空。
- 在空头通道下跌过程中加多，或在多头通道上升过程中加空。
- 在回调进一步下跌时加多（回调是小级别趋势，因此都处在通道中），或在空头反弹上升时加空。比如说，如果移动平均线陡直上升，多头会在价格回调至移动平均线下方时分批加多。
- 在任何强趋势的回调中，按固定间隔加仓，间隔依据此前回调的大小和近期的日均波幅来定。
- 在交易区间中加多或加空。
- 在突破期间建立逆势头寸，如果市场有可能回调到突破点的话，比如在宽幅通道日、趋势性交易区间日或楼梯形态中就是这样。由于涉及的变量太多，分批建仓或分批止盈的方式有很多。这些变量包括：


> • Into longs on a small pullback from a strong bull spike (a pullback is a small countertrend channel). • Into shorts on a small pullback from a strong bear spike. • Into longs as a bear channel falls or into shorts as a bull channel rises. • Into longs as a pullback falls further (pullbacks are small trends and therefore are in channels) or into shorts as a bear rally rises. For example, if there is a steeply rising moving average, bulls will scale into longs on a pullback below the moving average. • At fixed intervals in pullbacks in any strong trend based on the size of the prior pullbacks and the recent average daily range. • Into longs or into shorts in a trading range. • Into a countertrend position during a breakout if a pullback to the breakout point is likely, like in a broad channel day, in a trending trading range day, or in a stairs pattern. There are many ways to scale into or out of a position since there are so many variables, which include:


- 你分批建仓的次数。你可以分批建仓一次，也可以很多次。


> • The number of times that you will scale in. You can scale in one time or many times.


- 你的仓位规模。如果你要为市场朝你不利方向走时的分批建仓留出余地，务必让初始仓位足够小，好让你最终头寸上的风险落在你平常能承受的范围之内。
- 每个价位入场的股数。你的第一笔入场可以是100股，第二笔200股，第三笔500股，多少股都行。不过，大多数交易者每次分批建仓都用相同的股数。
- 各笔入场的价格。间隔不必固定，这意味着你可以在第一笔入场下方20美分处加多，再在下方30美分、70美分或下方任意美分数处加多。或者，你可以在第一个反转信号处入场，如果趋势继续，就在下一个反转信号处分批建仓，也许再在之后那一个信号处也建一部分。
- 风险。这就是你的保护性止损距你平均入场价有多远。
- 回报。这就是你的止盈限价单距你平均入场价有多远。
- 概率。它永远是不确定的，并且会随着风险、回报和平均入场价的组合而变化。比如说，冒着30美分的风险赚30美分的概率，大于冒着20美分的风险赚30美分的概率，但小于冒着40美分的风险赚30美分的概率。分批操作涉及不确定性，而这是双向成交正在发生的通道和交易区间所固有的。交易者是在押注一段短期行情即将结束、一段更大的行情即将开始。即便在交易区间中也是如此，比如交易者在空头行情段中分批加多，因为他相信更大的格局是交易区间，而那一段小的空头行情段很可能无力把交易区间转变成空头趋势。这些变量的任何组合，只要它能令胜率乘以潜在回报大于败率乘以风险，就是有效的策略。你始终知道风险与潜在回报，因为你在下达保护性止损和止盈限价单时就已把它们设定好了。概率永远无从确切得知，但你通常能知道它何时达到60% 或更高；如果你拿不准，那就按50% 来假设。


> • Sizes of your positions. If you are allowing for the possibility of scaling in if the market goes against you, make sure to keep your initial positions small enough so that the risk on your final position is within your usual tolerance. • The number of shares entered at each level. Your first entry can be for 100 shares, the second can be for 200, and the third can be for 500 or any number. However, most traders scale in with the same number of shares each time. • The prices of the different entries. The steps don't have to be fixed, which means that you can scale into a long at 20 cents below the first entry and again at 30, 70, or any number of cents below that. Alternatively, you can enter at the first reversal signal and if the trend continues, you can scale in at the next reversal signal and maybe the one after that as well. • The risk. This is how far your protective stop is from your average entry price. • The reward. This is how far your profit-taking limit order is from your average entry price. • The probability. It is never known with certainty, and it varies with the amount of risk, reward, and average entry price. For example, the probability of making 30 cents while risking 30 cents is greater than the probability of making 30 cents while risking 20 cents but less than the probability of making 30 cents while risking 40 cents. Scaling involves uncertainty, which is inherent in channels and trading ranges where two-sided trading is taking place. The trader is betting that a short-term move is ending and that a larger move is about to begin. This is true even in a trading range, like when a trader is scaling into longs during a bear leg in the belief that the bigger picture is that of a trading range and that the small bear leg will probably fail to convert the trading range into a bear trend. Any combination of the variables that results in the chance of winning times the potential reward being greater than the chance of losing times the risk is a valid strategy. You always know the risk and the potential reward because you set them when you place your protective stop and your profit-taking limit order. You never know the probability with certainty, but you usually know when it is 60 percent or greater; if you are uncertain, then assume that it is 50 percent.


只要你是逆着趋势分批建仓，作为一般规则，如果市场朝你不利的方向走出了第二段行情，你就应该离场。这意味着：如果你正在空头趋势中抄底，而市场走出了一次低2做空信号，尤其是当它靠近移动平均线、并且带着一根空头信号K线时，你就应该平掉多头，甚至可以考虑反手做空。如果你仍然相信底部就在附近，可以着手在更低的价位重新开始分批建仓。另外，在一天中最后大约一个小时里逆着趋势分批建仓是有风险的，因为你会太经常地发现自己持有一个大额亏损头寸，不得不在收盘前平掉。时间对你不利。最后，对任何强趋势逆势分批建仓都是有风险的。比如说，如果你相信市场处在强势空头趋势中，那你就必须相信它很快会更低。如果你相信它很快会更低，那么现在开始买入就太早了。趋势强势时，你应该考虑的唯一一种分批建仓，就是给顺势头寸加仓。


> Whenever you scale in against a trend, as a general rule you should exit if the market makes a second move against you. This means that if you are bottom picking in a bear trend and the market forms a low 2 short, especially if it is near the moving average and has a bear signal bar, you should exit your longs and even consider reversing to short. If you still believe that a bottom is near, you can look to begin to scale in again lower. Also, it is risky to scale in against a trend in the final hour or so of the day, because you will too often find yourself holding a large losing position that you will have to cover by the close. Time is against you. Finally, it is risky to scale in against any strong trend. For example, if you believe that the market is in a strong bear trend, then you must believe it will soon be lower. If you believe that it will soon be lower, then it is too early to begin to buy. When a trend is strong, the only type of scaling in that you should consider is adding to your with-trend position.


分批建仓与分批止盈有数学依据，但这并不意味着分批建仓或分批止盈就是运用你的资金最明智的方式。举个例子，假设你相信一只现价20美元的股票跌到零的概率不超过1%，于是你买入100股；如果你在股价每下跌5美元时分批建仓，你就会在15美元再买100股、在10美元再买100股、在5.00美元再买100股。此时你做多400股，平均价格为12.50美元。不错，这只股票也许不会跌到零，但你现在需要上涨150% 才能回到保本，而且几乎可以肯定的是，如果你把全部股票亏损了结、转而用这笔钱去买一只处在强势上升趋势中的股票，你会赚得更多。


> There is a mathematical basis for scaling into and out of positions, but that does not mean that scaling in or out is the wisest use of your money. For example, suppose you believe that the chance that a stock now trading at $20 will fall to zero is 1 percent or less so you then buy 100 shares of a stock; if you scale in at each $5 drop, you would buy 100 more shares at $15, 100 more at $10, and 100 more at $5.00. You would then be long 400 shares with an average price of $12.50. Yes, the stock might not fall to zero, but you now need a 150 percent rally to get back to breakeven, and it is almost certain that you will make more money if you exit all of your shares at a loss and instead use the money to buy a stock that is in a strong uptrend.


交易者也可以对盈利的交易和亏损的交易分批止盈。在前面那个多头通道的例子中，那些随着多头通道上行而分批建仓的多头，会在某一时点停止买入并开始止盈。如果他们了结了交易的一部分，他们就是在分批止盈。空头则可能已经断定，他们所期盼的反转不会像原先想的那么强，于是他们可能回购刚刚卖出的一部分空单。如果市场又朝他们不利的方向走了10个最小报价单位，他们可能回购更多，并打算在更高的价位重新做空。他们是在对自己的亏损头寸分批止盈，尽管他们可能打算稍后重新分批建仓。


> Traders can also scale out of winning and losing trades. In that bull channel example, those bulls who were scaling into their longs as the bull channel went up would stop buying at some point and begin to take profits. If they took part of their trades off, they were scaling out of their trades. The bears might have decided that the reversal they were expecting would not be as strong as they originally thought and they might buy back some of the shorts that they just sold. If the market went another 10 ticks against them, they might buy back even more and look to short again higher. They were scaling out of their losing positions, although they might be planning to scale back in later.


有一条你可以用来确定第二笔入场放在哪里的指导原则：想一想如果你不做分批建仓，你的保护性止损会在多远的位置。比如说，如果你在美国银行公司（BAC）的多头趋势中买入一次回调，本打算用30美分的止损，那你也许可以改在那个价位买入更多，并把整个头寸的保护性止损放在低30美分处，也就是比你的第一笔入场低60美分的位置。


> One guideline that you can use to determine where to place your second entry is to think about how far away your protective stop would be if you were not scaling in. For example, if you were buying a pullback in a bull trend in Bank of America Corporation (BAC) and were thinking about using a 30 cent stop, you might instead buy more at that price and place a protective stop on your entire position 30 cents lower, or 60 cents below your first entry.


对一笔正在朝你不利方向走的交易分批建仓，方式有很多，你可以分批建仓任意多次。你可以按固定间隔分批建仓，也可以在不同的支撑位或阻力位分批建仓，或在每一个随后的反转形态处分批建仓。你可以让每一笔后续入场与最初那笔同样大，也可以让它们更大或更小。最重要的一点是：如果你要为分批建仓留出余地，你就必须一开始就有计划。如果你对制订计划感到不自在，那就不要对亏损头寸分批建仓，哪怕你是在强势多头趋势中买入回调、或在强势空头趋势中卖出反弹。你必须知道你最终的止损在哪里、你的平均入场价是多少，因为你需要把总体风险保持在正常范围之内。如果你不小心，你可能会发现自己持有的是平常的合约数量，但止损距平均入场价太远，以致你的风险比你平常承担的要大好几倍。


> There are many ways to scale into a trade that is moving against you, and you can scale in any number of times. You can scale in at fixed intervals or at different support or resistance levels or at each subsequent reversal setup. You can make each subsequent entry the same size as the original or you can make them larger or smaller. The most important point is that if you are allowing for the possibility of scaling in, you have to have a plan at the outset. If you are not comfortable with creating a plan, do not scale into a losing position, even if you are buying a pullback in a strong bull trend or selling a bear rally in a strong bear trend. You must know where your final protective stop is and what your average entry price is, because you need to keep your total risk within your normal range. If you are not careful, you might find yourself holding your usual number of contracts but the stop is so far from your average entry price that your risk is several times greater than what you normally incur.


如果交易者执意要尝试对一笔交易分批建仓，风险最小的做法是：当自己还持仓、且前提依然成立时，如果出现了一次二次入场，就把这一笔也接下来。举个例子，假定他们做多，市场横盘或小跌，但没有跌到触发保护性止损的位置；或者小涨，但没有涨到足以使止盈限价单成交的位置；如果市场又制造出一次交易者等式良好的买入信号，他们就可以把这次入场也接下来，并把两笔入场当作两笔独立的交易来对待。两笔交易可能有不同的止损和止盈目标，但只要每一笔都有利好的交易者等式，交易者就可以把它们当作独立的交易来对待，并根据各自的特性分别管理。如果出现第三个好信号，他们可以再买一次，但到某个程度，头寸就会复杂得不值得再费力气。由于一次只管理一笔交易压力更小，绝大多数交易者都不应该分批建仓，即使后续的信号看起来不错。


> If traders are determined to try to scale into a trade, the least risky approach is to take a second entry if one appears while they are still in their trade and if their premise remains valid. For example, suppose they are long and the market goes sideways or a little down but not far enough to hit their protective stop, or a little up but not high enough to fill their profit-taking limit order; if the market creates another buy signal that has a good trader's equation, the traders can take that entry as well and treat their two entries as separate trades. They might have different stops and profit targets, but as long as each has a favorable trader's equation, the traders can treat them as separate trades and manage each based on its own characteristics. If a third good signal appears, they can buy again, but at some point their position becomes too complicated to be worth the effort. Since it is less stressful to just manage one trade at a time, most traders should not scale in, even if the subsequent signals look good.


![图 31.1](figures/fig-31-01.jpg)


**图 31.1　多数交易者不该分批建仓**


新手交易者不该对交易分批建仓，因为这会把他自己的风险抬高到超出舒适水平，而任何一次错误都可能造成巨亏。不过，有经验的交易者可能会在强趋势的回调中接下第二笔或第三笔入场，或者在强势急速行情的每根K线过程中加仓，就像第3根K线到第4根K线的那波上涨中那样。


> A beginning trader should not scale into trades because it can increase his risk to beyond his comfort level, and any mistake can result in a huge loss. However, an experienced trader might take a second or third entry on a pullback in a strong trend, or add to his position during each bar of a strong spike, like in the move up from bar 3 to bar 4.


到第4根K线收盘时，多数交易者都认为图 31.1中的市场已强势转为始终做多状态——第4根K线是一段四根K线的多头急速行情，K线之间重叠极少、实体很大。此前开盘时已有买压，第1根K线处的两根K线急速行情又形成了一次买压。第7根K线是有效的两K线反转和高2买入信号（其中第5根K线是高1）。其他交易者把第7根K线看作高1买入形态。入场K线是第7根K线之后那根小十字星K线，它构成了牛旗的突破。市场随后在第8根K线处给出突破回调的买入形态，这也是一个有效信号。有些交易者把它看作由第6根和第7根K线构成的三角形。入场价格与第7根K线之上做多的入场价相同。由于前提仍然成立，而且第8根K线是市场试图走得更高的更强证据，交易者本可以在那个信号上买入第二个头寸。此后那波两根K线的上涨行情是一次五最小报价单位的失败，很可能没有使止盈限价单成交，但多头趋势仍然完好，保护性止损也没有被触及。不过，这波上涨突破了另一条小型空头趋势线，因此又是牛旗的另一次突破。第9根K线是突破回调的买入形态。由于趋势仍然完好、这个新形态的交易者等式也很好，交易者可以在这里买入第三个头寸，并把它当作一笔独立的交易来管理，使用相应的保护性止损和止盈目标。交易者本可以在第10根K线的急速行情中以一个点的利润把三笔入场全部剥头皮了结。


> Most traders saw the market shown in the chart in Figure 31.1 as strongly always-in long by the close of bar 4, which was a four-bar bull spike with very little overlap and big bodies. It followed earlier buying pressure on the open and again on the two-bar spike at bar 1. Bar 7 was a valid two-bar reversal and high 2 buy signal (where bar 5 was the high 1). Other traders saw bar 7 as a high 1 buy setup. The entry bar was the small doji bar after bar 7, and that constituted the breakout of the bull flag. The market then had a breakout pullback buy setup at bar 8, which was also a valid signal. Some traders saw it as a triangle with bars 6 and 7. The entry price was the same as that for the long above bar 7. Since the premise was still valid and bar 8 was even stronger evidence that the market was trying to go higher, a trader could have bought a second position on that signal. The two-bar rally from there was a five-tick failure and probably did not result in a fill of the profit-taking limit orders, but the bull trend was still intact and the protective stops were not hit. The move up, though, broke above another small bear trend line and was therefore another breakout of a bull flag. Bar 9 was the breakout pullback buy setup. Since the trend was still intact and this new setup also had a good trader's equation, the trader could buy a third position here and manage it as a separate trade, using the appropriate protective stop and profit target. The trader would have been able to scalp out of all three entries with a one-point profit on the bar 10 spike.


第14、15、16根K线提供了类似的机会，可以用三笔独立的入场分批加多。


> Bars 14, 15, and 16 provided a similar opportunity to scale into longs with three separate entries.


第20、21、22、23根K线有四个有效的买入形态，全部四个都可以在第24根K线的多头急速行情中以一个点的利润了结。


> Bars 20, 21, 22, and 23 had four valid buy setups, and all four could have been exited with a one-point profit on the bar 24 bull spike.


![图 31.2](figures/fig-31-02.jpg)


**图 31.2　对多头分批建仓**


如图 31.2所示，5分钟 SPY 处在强势多头趋势中，多头本可以在第9根K线到第14根K线之前那根K线之间的多头急速行情中，或者在第14根K线高点之后的复杂回调中，对一个多头头寸分批建仓。右侧的图是左侧图的局部放大，但只标注了回调中相关的K线。多头本可以买入这波回踩移动平均线的小楔形牛旗回调，目标是在此前的多头高点（第14根K线）止盈。他们本可以把买入止损单放在第18根K线之后那根多头内包K线上方一个最小报价单位处。另一个选择是，他们可以在两K线反转的高点之上入场（即第18根K线的高点）。如果他们在那根多头内包K线上方买入200股，他们就会在130.76美元处做多。他们的保护性止损在第18根K线低点130.66美元下方一个最小报价单位处，他们计划用限价单在当日新高130.94美元处止盈，也就是第14根K线的高点。他们冒着11美分的风险去赚18美分，而由于这是移动平均线处的牛旗，他们很可能至少有60% 的成功机会和40% 的失败机会。在这个例子中，当第20根K线跌破第18根K线时，他们本会亏损11美分。由于他们买入了200股，他们本会亏损22美元外加佣金。


> As shown in Figure 31.2, the 5 minute SPY was in a strong bull trend, and bulls could have scaled into a long position during the bull spike from bar 9 to the bar before bar 14, or during the complex pullback from the bar 14 high. The chart on the right is a closeup of the one on the left, but only relevant bars of the pullback are labeled.
